article.articleHeadline: В Кении на протестах против американского центра для изоляции контактных с Эболой погибли два человека
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people died in Kenya during protests against an American center for isolating Ebola contacts.
article.articleSummary: Two people died in Nanyuki, Kenya, amid protests over plans to establish a 50-person quarantine center at Laikipia Air Base for Americans who could have Ebola exposure in Uganda or the Democratic Republic of Congo. Protesters allege police fired on demonstrators, though officials have not confirmed details. The demonstrations followed the plan’s disclosure, prompting Kenya’s High Court to extend a ban on construction and operation until the case is resolved; the next hearing is set for June 23. President William Ruto defended the project as part of Kenya’s preparedness for potential outbreaks. Ebola, first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the DRC, is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted via contact with infected blood or bodily fluids. Symptoms include fever, weakness, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, and can progress to bleeding and multi-organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのウガンダおよびコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ患者接触者隔離米国センターに反対するデモで2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（国際的な重大感染症）に関連するイベントであり、死亡者が発生し、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、ケニア）に関連する地域での隔離施設構想に対する社会的紛争が発生している。IHR基準「異常または予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、重大な公衆衛生上の対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にケニアでの政治的デモの死亡事件を扱っているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラウイルスの重要性と国際的な懸念、複数国にまたがる地理的状況から、フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Tecnologia e novas estratégias podem acelerar combate à tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Technology and new strategies could accelerate the fight against tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis remains a leading infectious killer, with WHO aiming for 80% fewer cases by 2030 (vs 2014) and an incidence cap of 6.7 per 100,000 by 2030. In Brazil, 2023 incidence is estimated at 39.8/100,000, with projections around 18.5/100,000 by 2030. Bottlenecks span the entire care cascade: late diagnosis, treatment interruptions, and rising drug resistance; roughly 2 billion people harbor latent Mycobacterium tuberculosis globally. In Brazil, poverty, HIV, diabetes, malnutrition, smoking, stigma, and barriers like distance to care drive poor adherence to the standard six-month antibiotic regimen under SUS. Promising research includes MTB-targeting antibiotics via the ClpC1 recycling pathway (Nature Communications, Jan 2026) and shorter regimens, though costly and demanding monitoring. Diagnostic advances include AI-assisted radiology, oral swab tests, and portable X-rays. A Goias-based project uses AI to triage chest radiographs, enabling earlier detection in underserved areas.

triage.headline_ja: テクノロジーと新たな戦略は結核との戦いを加速させる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの結核とHIV共感染に関する記事だが、新規アウトブレイク、疫学的転機、または急性の健康危機を示す具体的な証拠がない。むしろ、既知の地域的課題と解決策についての総説的記事と考えられる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazil (3469034) が含まれているが、記事サマリーは既知の地域的結核対策の進展状況に関する一般的な情報報道であり、新規の感染症イベント（新規患者集積、アウトブレイク、異常な疫学的変化）の報告ではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。WPRO基準で3項目該当しているが、社会的・政治的関心が確認できず、IHR基準をすべて満たさないため、PICKUPではなくWATCHと判定した。

article.articleHeadline: У Кенії на протестах проти американського центру для ізоляції контактних з Еболою загинули двоє людей
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people were killed at protests in Kenya against an American center for isolating people who had contact with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Two people were killed in Nanyuki, Kenya, during protests against a planned U.S. quarantine center at the Laikipia Air Base for Americans who may have been exposed to Ebola in Uganda or the Democratic Republic of Congo. Organizers say both died from gunshot wounds after police opened fire; authorities have not officially confirmed. Protests followed disclosures of a 50-person facility, fueling public concern over health risks. Kenya’s High Court extended the ban on construction and operation of the center until the case is resolved, with the next hearing set for June 23. President William Ruto defended the project, saying it would strengthen the country’s readiness for potential infectious disease outbreaks. Ebola, identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the DRC, is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted via blood and bodily fluids, with symptoms including fever, fatigue, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, and possible bleeding and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ接触者隔離のための米国センターに対する抗議デモで2人が殺害される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病という高危険度病原体に関連するイベントですが、本イベントの主題は隔離施設への政治的抗議デモであり、実際の感染症の発生・拡大ではありません。ただし、社会的・政治的関心が高く、エボラの潜在的リスクに関連しているため経過観察が必要です。
triage.notes: 本イベントは感染症の実発生ではなく、政治的抗議デモです。ただし、エボラウイルス病という高危険度病原体に関連し、隔離施設の設置に対する公的・政治的関心が極めて高く、複数国が関連しています。実際のエボラ発生状況の監視継続が重要です。

article.articleHeadline: ÚLTIMA HORA: Suspenden el partido Chile vs RD del Congo por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: Chile vs DR Congo match suspended due to Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: June 3, 2026 – Authorities in La Línea de la Concepción, Cádiz, Spain canceled a planned June 9 friendly between Chile and the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to public health concerns linked to an Ebola outbreak currently affecting DR Congo. Mayor Juan Franco said authorization was not granted because the information and documentation provided did not fully rule out potential health risks. The Chilean Football Federation is pursuing a behind-closed-doors option, with talks among Chile, DR Congo, the event organizers, and the stadium owner. The DR Congo national team is slated to face Denmark on June 3 at Stade Maurice Dufrasne, kickoff at 12:00 local time. The report does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmations, or specific infection details, underscoring ongoing public health considerations surrounding the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：エボラ熱の流行のためチリ対コンゴ民主共和国の試合が中止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、対象国（DRC）での確認されたエボラ発生がフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン・アンダルシア州での試合中止を報じているが、エボラ発生は記事サマリーでコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）に明記されている。スペインは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外。DRCでの実際の患者数、確認検査数などの詳細情報は記事に含まれていない（「not provide case counts」と明記）が、公式なエボラ流行として存在することが前提とされている。対象国DRCでのシグナルとして PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉病毒可能致命，但治疗和疫苗研发的迅速进展带来希望
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus may be fatal, but rapid progress in treatment and vaccine development brings hope.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, drawing attention. No cure exists and there is no approved vaccine for this strain, at least to date, and symptoms—like malaria—complicate early detection. Dr. Marie-Rosaline Bailizer, WHO Africa Emergency Director and Ebola Incident Manager, says the response hinges on early case finding, rapid isolation, robust clinical care, infection prevention and control, and intensified contact tracing. With WHO support, governments have deployed more than 52 experts across technical fields, activated a 70-bed rehabilitation treatment center, and expanded laboratory testing and epidemiological surveillance. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus remains cautiously optimistic, citing past containment success. While vaccines for Bundibugyo Ebola are not yet available, the Pandemic Preparedness Innovation Alliance and partners are accelerating three candidate vaccines. The United States has pledged funding for up to 50 treatment clinics in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスは致命的である可能性があるが、治療とワクチン開発の急速な進歩が希望をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（致命的なエボラ出血熱の発生）、異常性（新規Bundibugyo株の流行）、国際的拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの流行、米国の支援関与）の3項目が該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（高い致命率）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染、早期発見困難）、管理可能性（国際的支援が必要）が明らかで、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づいて、エボラ出血熱の実際の発生はDRC（民主共和国）とウガンダで確認されています。しかし対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外されています。米国は治療資金援助を表明しているが、発生地ではなく支援国であるため除外されています。Bundibugyo株のエボラ出血熱は高い致命率を持ち、ワクチンが未承認であることから、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念が存在します。

article.articleHeadline: J&K steps up Ebola preparedness, surveillance amid global concerns
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) preparedness is intensified across Jammu and Kashmir, with no cases reported in India. The Union Health Ministry issued a fresh advisory as the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and nearby Uganda is monitored. Districts have strengthened surveillance and health staff have been briefed on symptoms and response; DDSOs have been alerted. SKIMS, Soura, formed a dedicated Ebola preparedness committee chaired by Prof Ashraf Ganaie, with Dr Ghulam Hassan Yattoo as nodal officer coordinating with the Director Health Services, Kashmir. GMC Jammu conducted a mock drill and established a 28-bed isolation ward; Rajiv Gandhi Hospital, Gangyal, holds additional quarantine facilities. Travelers from affected countries in the past 21 days should monitor for fever, headache, vomiting, or diarrhoea and isolate if symptoms arise; helpline 1075 is active.

triage.headline_ja: J&K steps up Ebola preparedness, surveillance amid global concerns（ジャンムー・カシミール州がグローバルな懸念の中でエボラ対策と監視を強化）
triage.triage_reason: DRCおよびウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラ流行が進行中であり、インドが公式に準備と監視体制を強化している。IHR基準では異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが該当（3/4）し、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・長期曝露可能性・流行リスク・管理可能性が該当（4/5）するため、フルRRAの対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは「ジャンムー・カシミール州がエボラ対策を強化」という内容であり、インド国内での準備体制の強化が主題。DRCおよびウガンダのBundibugyo株アウトブレイクを背景に、インドが監視・準備体制を整備している状況。インド国内での報告例はなく、あくまで準備段階の報告だが、進行中の国際的なEVD流行への対応として重要。Bluedot APIが付与した「Jammu and Kashmir」「Uganda」は記事の主題ではなく、背景情報や地理的参照であるため verified_locations には含めない（インドのDRCはともに該当対象国）。

article.articleHeadline: La respuesta al Ébola debe cruzar las fronteras más rápido que el virus, afirma la OIM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola response must cross borders faster than the virus, says the IOM.
article.articleSummary: Cross-border Ebola response urged as Bundibugyo strain spreads between the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of June 3, 2026, DRC reports 116 suspected cases, 321 confirmed, 48 deaths and 6 recoveries; Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the third largest, unfolding in eastern DRC amid severe humanitarian challenges, with 3.6 million internally displaced nationwide and about 922,000 displaced in Ituri province. Transboundary transmission confirmation underscores regional urgency, especially at key crossings where daily movement sustains trade and livelihoods. Mobility persists across formal and informal routes (Cyanika, Busunga, Bunagana, Mpondwe, Goli, Vurra, Busanza, Ntoroko). The IOM warns that border closures reduce visibility, hindering surveillance, contact tracing and early detection; calls for coordinated border-health operations, mobility mapping, risk communication, and community engagement, while highlighting funding gaps and ongoing US support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応はウイルスより早く国境を越える必要があると国際移住機関は述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRC・ウガンダ間での越境伝播確認、複数の確定症例・死亡、地域的緊急性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の越境フレアアップ。DRCで321確定症例・48死亡、ウガンダで9症例・1死亡が報告されている。多数の非公式国境通過地点での人の移動が継続しており、地域的監視体制の脆弱性が指摘されている。IOMなどの国際機関が調整的な対応を要請。資金不足も課題として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola: forte baisse du nombre de cas suspects suite à des tests de laboratoire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: sharp drop in the number of suspected cases following laboratory tests.
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reported 116 suspected Ebola cases still under investigation, after many were ruled out following lab testing. WHO's Christian Lindmeier explained that during the flare, anyone detected by surveillance or presenting symptoms compatible with Ebola is initially counted as a suspected case pending lab results; many later proved to be malaria, meningitis, or other illnesses. By June 1, the DRC had 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths, with six recoveries and 173 suspected in isolation. In Uganda, six new Ebola cases were confirmed, bringing the national total to 15; all six are contacts of previously confirmed cases. Uganda reports two recoveries, 12 hospitalized, and one death. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国／エボラ：検査検査に続く疑い患者数の大幅な減少
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。DRC及びウガンダでの確認症例・死亡例があり、確認されたヒト-ヒト感染。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）での確認症例（6例、死亡1例）も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国（203312）に該当。WHOのPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により、既に国際的な公式対応が開始されている。Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクで、ワクチンや治療薬が利用不可。

article.articleHeadline: La riposte à Ebola doit franchir les frontières plus vite que le virus, avertit l'OIM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola response must cross borders faster than the virus, warns IOM.
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is active across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In the DRC, there are 116 suspected, 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths (6 recoveries); Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. The outbreak centers in Ituri, a region with high humanitarian needs and about 3.6 million internally displaced people, including roughly 922,000 in Ituri. Cross-border transmission between the DRC and Uganda has been confirmed. The IOM warns that border closures can push movement underground, hindering screening, surveillance, contact tracing, and early detection. It calls for urgent cross-border, data-driven actions: strengthened border health operations, mobility mapping, disease surveillance, risk communication, and community engagement, especially at Cyanika, Busunga, Bunagana, Mpondwe, Goli, Vurra, Busanza, and Ntoroko. Funding gaps persist; coordination with AU, Africa CDC, WHO, and UN partners is essential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応は、ウイルスよりも早く国境を越える必要がある、とIOMが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラの確認症例と死亡例を伴う進行中の国際的多国家アウトブレイク（DRC-ウガンダ）であり、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返したロケーションリストに複数国（ウガンダ、ジョージア、ルワンダ）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は『DRCとウガンダの間での確認されたエボラアウトブレイク』である。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。DRC内の複数州（Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Western Province等）での活動が報告されており、国際的な死傷者（DRC: 321確認例48死亡、ウガンダ: 9確認例1死亡）と国境を越えた感染確認が存在する。国連機関（IOM, WHO, Africa CDC）による国境越境対応の必要性が強調されており、極めて高いシグナル指標を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Timnas Kongo Tersandung Jelang Piala Dunia 2026, Laga Uji Coba Dibatalkan Gegara Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo National Team Stumbles on the Eve of the 2026 World Cup, Friendly Match Canceled Due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: June 9 friendly between the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DR Congo) and Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain, was canceled amid an Ebola outbreak affecting DR Congo. La Linea mayor Juan Franco signed a decree banning the match after health authorities advised against it to protect public health, following recommendations from the Andalusia Regional Health Service. The decision comes despite the DR Congo national team implementing travel protocols as part of World Cup 2026 preparations. DR Congo qualified for the World Cup for the first time since 1974 (as Zaire). Owing to the outbreak, domestic training camps were canceled, and the squad is now based in Belgium, set to face Denmark in a friendly in Liège. The DR Congo Football Federation stated all players and staff adhered to the health protocols laid out by the World Cup host nations—USA, Canada, and Mexico.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップを控えたコンゴ民主共和国代表が挫折、エボラのため親善試合がキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：エボラの公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（複数国での試合キャンセル決定）、渡航制限リスク。対象国DRCにおけるエボラ発生。
triage.notes: エボラ発生地はDRCであり、スペイン・ベルギー・デンマークでの試合キャンセルは二次的影響。記事では患者数や死者数など重症度の詳細は不明だが、IHR基準を十分に満たしており、フルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 52년만에 월드컵 진출 콩고민주공화국, 에볼라에 발목 '어쩌나' - 동행미디어 시대
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo, which qualified for the World Cup for the first time in 52 years, is hamstrung by Ebola — Donghaeng Media Era.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo hamstrings the national team ahead of the 2026 World Cup. By June 3, 2026, Ebola has caused over 150 deaths in the DRC, prompting cancellation of the opening ceremony and training camp in Kinshasa. A planned European-friendly schedule and a move to the United States were disrupted when a match in Spain's Andalusia was canceled following guidance from the regional health authority. The squad is required to undergo a 21-day self-quarantine before entering the United States for the tournament, limiting prep time. The DRC will face Portugal on June 18 at 2:00 a.m. local time in the first group-stage match of the 2026 North/Central American World Cup. The outbreak has caused travel and scheduling disruptions for the team.

triage.headline_ja: 52年ぶりのワールドカップ出場を果たしたコンゴ民主共和国、エボラで足止め「どうしよう」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行により150人以上の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスク（複数国への渡航制限影響）が該当。WPRO基準でも重症度と長期曝露が明確で、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはスペイン・ポルトガル・米国も記載されているが、記事サマリーでは実際のエボラ流行の発生地はDRC（キンシャサ）のみ。スペイン・ポルトガル・米国は試合キャンセル等の二次的影響を受けた国であり、エボラ発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため検証地域として採用。

article.articleHeadline: Bilim İnsanlarına Maymun Çiçeği Suçlaması
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Accusation of Monkeypox Against Scientists
article.articleSummary: Two U.S.-based scientists, Vincent Munster, head of the Virus Ecology division at Rocky Mountain Laboratories, and Claude Kwe, are indicted in Detroit for allegedly transporting vials containing inactivated monkeypox (mpox) virus into the United States without authorization and lying to investigators at Detroit Metropolitan Airport. The indictment, announced by authorities, says the pair traveled from Paris and spent nine days in the Republic of the Congo before being stopped in Detroit. Tests reportedly confirmed vials of inactivated mpox, but they did not disclose them or obtain required permits. They face charges of knowingly concealing and transporting biological materials to the U.S. without authorization, risking public safety. They are due to appear in Missoula, Montana federal court on Wednesday. Mpox symptoms include rash and fever; most patients recover. In the Central African Congo region, mpox has been linked to over 2,000 deaths, with a two-year outbreak ending in April.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らに対するサルポックス（エムポックス）の告発
triage.triage_reason: 生物学的物質の違法輸送事件であり、密輸されたのは不活化mpoxウイルスの試験管であることから、直接的な感染症発生イベントではなく規制・刑事事件である。ただしmpoxの国際移動に関わるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症発生ではなく、不活化mpoxウイルスの違法輸送に関する刑事事件である。記事サマリーでは米国（Detroit、Montana）とコンゴでの活動を言及しているが、実際の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）の発生報告ではない。DRCにおける過去のmpox流行（2000死亡以上）への言及はあるが、本記事の主題ではない。対象国リストではUSおよびDRCが該当するが、アウトブレイク関連シグナルではないため慎重な評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie de Ebola se extinde. Cel mai îngrijorător aspect evidențiat de medici este bariera culturală și psihologică
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is spreading. The most concerning aspect highlighted by doctors is the cultural and psychological barrier.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread, with 321 cases and 48 deaths in the DRC; neighboring Uganda reports at least 15 cases and one death. Doctors warn that community fear, misinformation, and insecurity impede control efforts. Delays in seeking care, difficulty identifying contacts, and restricted access in some areas hinder surveillance and rapid clinical management. Treatment centers are strictly monitored, with personnel in full PPE and at least 125 patients in centers. UNICEF cautions that fear and misinformation reduce acceptance of decontamination and patient isolation. The agency works with local and religious leaders, women groups, transporters, and healthcare workers to convey information via trusted community structures. The crisis is amplified by armed conflict, population displacement, poverty, and fragile health infrastructure, which limit service access and complicate contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大。医師が指摘する最も懸念される側面は文化的・心理的障壁である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を持ち、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境確認）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。WPRO基準も全て該当し、死亡例を伴う重症例、高い流行可能性、管理困難性が認められる。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの確認事例が主題であり、ウガンダへの国際的拡大リスクはIHR基準評価に反映されている。治療センター運営、物資供給、連絡先追跡、コミュニティ受容性の課題が管理困難性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: La esperanza contra el brote del ébola en el Congo: tres vacunas en desarrollo y pastillas experimentales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hope against the Ebola outbreak in the Congo: three vaccines in development and experimental pills.
article.articleSummary: On 3 June 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda remains volatile. The World Health Organization reports suspected cases dropped from 906 to 116, with 330 confirmed infections and 49 deaths; the DRC warns of potentially hundreds of additional deaths. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, with up to 50% mortality and currently lacking approved vaccines or treatments, originated in Ituri Province, an area with significant urban movement. Authorities are exploring cross-immunity using existing Zaire and Sudan vaccines, while pursuing variant-specific candidates such as rVSV-Bundibugyo (IAVI) and ChAdOx1 (Oxford/Serum Institute India). CEPI has committed over €60 million to vaccine development, including Moderna’s mRNA program. Experimental therapies MBP134, maftivimab, and remdesivir are recommended only within clinical trials or tightly supervised programs. MSF urges preparedness of neighboring health systems to prevent broader spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行に対する希望：開発中の3つのワクチンと実験的な錠剤
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の確認された発生、死亡者、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの拡大報告）、および高い社会的・政治的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「DRCとウガンダに残る」との記載があり、ウガンダでの確認事例の存在が示唆される。ただし、主要な発生と報告の詳細はDRCに集中しており、対象国リスト（別途指定）に照らしウガンダは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱の50%死亡率、Bundibugyo亜種の出現、治療法の不足、ワクチン開発進行中など、多くのリスク要因が確認される極めて重要な信号。

article.articleHeadline: China joins DRC's fight against Ebola with expert medical delegation
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues as China dispatches a three-month expert mission to bolster the response as of 2026-06-03. The delegation includes epidemiologists, clinicians, laboratory specialists, and traditional Chinese medicine experts, reflecting a multidisciplinary approach to containment, patient care, and diagnostics. The mission aims to strengthen epidemic surveillance, diagnostic capacity, clinical management, and overall outbreak response in the DRC. The report does not provide case counts, death tolls, or symptom details. The international collaboration underscores capacity-building and cross-border support in outbreak settings, with a three-month timeframe intended to augment local authorities’ ability to detect, confirm, and interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ対策で専門家医療団を派遣してコンゴ民主共和国を支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は高い公衆衛生影響と国際拡大リスクを有する指定感染症であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRA対象。DRCでの発生継続と中国からの国際支援派遣が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは症例数・死亡数を明記していないため、現在の流行規模は不明だが、エボラウイルス感染症の固有の危険性と、中国からの正式な国際支援派遣によるシグナル確実性の上昇を考慮。DRCの発生継続とChinaの国際支援協力の両方が記事主題のため両国を verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: 2026 Ebola Outbreak: Mobility and Health System Vulnerabilities in Eastern DRC and Bordering Areas | Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, South Sudan (29 May 2026)
article.articleSummary: 2026 Ebola outbreak in Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring areas. Mobility data from five provinces not deemed high-risk—Haut-Uele, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Maniema, Tanganyika—plus Health Zones in Nord Kivu and Sud Kivu show regular population exchange with areas where cases have been confirmed, implying these zones should be targeted for enhanced surveillance, Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE), and preparedness if undetected transmission persisted. The DRC-Uganda border sustains dense economic and social ties, and historical patterns show that restricting formal crossings can drive movement to informal routes, hampering transmission visibility and increasing risks for border communities. As of 29 May, the DRC-Uganda border is closed to all civilian traffic. The report underscores mobility and health-system vulnerabilities shaping outbreak response in Eastern DRC and border regions.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年エボラ出血熱の流行：東部DRCおよび隣接地域における人口移動と保健システムの脆弱性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、複数のIHR基準を満たす。東部DRCでの流行は既に確認されており、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ、南スーダンとの国境での感染リスク）、深刻な公衆衛生影響、および渡航制限実施（DRC-ウガンダ国境閉鎖）が明記されている。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてウガンダ（226074）と南スーダン（366755）がリストアップされているが、記事サマリーでは主なイベント発生地はDRCの東部地域であり、ウガンダと南スーダンは「隣接地域」「国境コミュニティ」として言及されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ただし、国境閉鎖措置やウガンダ国境での感染リスク言及から、これは実質的には地域多国的イベントである。

article.articleHeadline: On the front lines of the Ebola crisis in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Front-line coverage of an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows clinicians battling the virus inside an Ebola treatment hospital. CNN's Clarissa Ward gains extraordinary access to the epicenter, detailing doctors and nurses working around the clock as they strive to contain transmission. Inside the hospital’s red zone, patients and staff confront the virus amid limited resources, with grief, fear, and fragile hope shaping daily life on the front lines. The report highlights the toll on healthcare workers as they cope with patient suffering, infection prevention challenges, and the emotional strain of caring for those affected. While specific case counts are not provided, the scene conveys the ongoing, intense struggle of the Ebola crisis in the DRC on 2026-06-03.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機の最前線
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症はハイリスク病原体であり、DRCでの流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は国際保健規則(IHR)の重要病原体。DRCでの治療施設での流行報告であり、医療従事者の感染リスク、資源不足、感染管理上の課題が明示されている。ただし具体的な症例数は記事に記載されていない。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Вирус изменился: ученые назвали причину вспышки Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The virus has mutated: scientists identified the cause of the Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak in Africa linked to a mutated Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain transmitted from an animal reservoir to humans. The Lancet published the findings by Ugandan and Democratic Republic of Congo scientists, who compared the 2026 genome with samples from 2007 and 2012 outbreaks and found substantial genetic differences. Phylogenetic analysis shows 2026 viruses form a distinct cluster, supporting animal-to-human spillover rather than persistence in the human population linked to earlier outbreaks. In DR Congo, authorities reported 282 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths; Uganda has nine confirmed cases as the outbreak continues. The results underscore the role of animal reservoirs in initiating new Ebola waves and distinguish the 2026 event from prior outbreaks in 2007 and 2012.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスが変異：科学者がアフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行原因を特定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。新しいエボラウイルス株の出現、複数国での確認症例・死亡事例、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が示唆される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC（282確認症例、42死亡）とウガンダ（9確認症例）での動物由来の新規エボラウイルス株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の出現・人間感染が確認されている。2007・2012年の過去の流行とは遺伝的に異なる株であり、動物貯蔵池からのスピルオーバーが特定されている。複数の国での同時確認、重症化率の高さ、動物接触による継続的曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性から、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: '에볼라 여파' 민주콩고 대표팀, 칠레와 평가전 취소...미국 일정도 첩첩산중-스포츠ㅣ한국일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Fallout: DR Congo National Team Cancels Friendly Against Chile... U.S. Schedule Also Full of Obstacles - Sports | Hankook Ilbo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa) since May 2026 is prompting the cancellation of DR Congo’s planned June 9 friendly against Chile in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, as a preventive measure under Andalusia health guidance. The DR Congo national team’s World Cup preparations have been disrupted, with training and a June 11 send-off in Kinshasa previously canceled. U.S. authorities have advised a 21-day quarantine for entrants from DR Congo, complicating the squad’s schedule; ESPN notes the final 26-man roster reportedly had no players based in the homeland, potentially avoiding quarantine. DR Congo, returning to the World Cup finals for the first time since 1974, is in Group K with Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan. Their 2026 North/Central America campaign would feature matches in Houston (vs Portugal, June 18), Guadalajara (vs Colombia, June 24), and Atlanta (vs Uzbekistan, June 28), though the Chile game’s cancellation accelerates US entry logistics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの余波：民主コンゴ代表がチリとの親善試合を取消...米国日程も困難ー スポーツ | ハンコック・イルボ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。感染症危機管理・バイオセキュリティの専門家として対象国DRCでのエボラ発生は重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域にはDRCに加えUSA、Spain、Mexico、Chile等多数含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC内でのエボラウイルス疾患の発生であり、他国での実際の発生は記述されていない。これは国際的な渡航制限と競技日程への影響を通じた二次的影響である。DRC（Kinshasa）での2026年5月以降のエボラ発生が核となるシグナル。verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: اتهام عالمين أميركيين بتهريب فيروس جدري القردة إلى الولايات المتحدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two American scientists charged with smuggling the monkeypox virus into the United States.
article.articleSummary: Two American scientists, Vincent Monster, head of the Virus Environment Division at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, and Claude Kui, were charged in a Detroit federal complaint with attempting to smuggle vials of an attenuated monkeypox virus into the United States from Africa and lying to investigators. They were stopped at Detroit Metropolitan Airport after arriving from Paris following a nine-day trip to the Democratic Republic of Congo, a region linked to more than 2,000 monkeypox deaths during a Congo outbreak that was declared over in April. FBI investigators said Monster denied re-entering the United States with materials, but laboratory tests later found vials of the attenuated monkeypox virus that were neither declared nor properly permitted. Marcus Sykes of the HHS Inspector General’s Office called the concealment a public-safety risk. Monster and Kui are due to appear in federal court in Missoula, Montana.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の2人の科学者がサル痘ウイルスの米国への密輸容疑で起訴される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。生物セキュリティ上の重大な懸念事項であり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本事案は米国内での刑事訴追事件であるが、記事の主題である感染症イベント発生地はコンゴ民主共和国である。米国の地域（モンタナ州、デトロイト等）は発症地ではなく事件発生地のため、verified_locationsには含めない。生物防御/バイオセキュリティの重大事案としてフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Lo que necesitas saber de la suspensión del República Democrática del Congo vs Chile por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What you need to know about the suspension of the Democratic Republic of the Congo vs Chile due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts precaution around the RD Congo–Chile friendly ahead of World Cup 2026. No confirmed cases are reported among DR Congo players or traveling fans. The match, scheduled for June 9 in La Línea de la Concepción, Cádiz, Spain, has not been suspended but has not been authorized by local authorities due to health risk. Chile has requested a behind-closed-doors game; relocation would be difficult with only a week’s notice. RD Congo will play other games, including a June 3 friendly against Denmark in Belgium, to avoid Kinshasa where the outbreak occurred. Mexico has instituted entry restrictions for travelers who have been in DR Congo, Uganda, or Sudan within 21 days, lasting 60 days from May 28. Congo also faces Colombia on June 23 in Guadalajara at World Cup 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国対チリの試合中止についての必要な情報 - エボラ流行による
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生（DRC）に対し、複数国で国際的な対応（試合中止、渡航制限）が実施されている。IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限」が該当し、スクリーニング基準では「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱の発生地がDRC（特にキンシャサ）であることを明確に述べている。Spain、Chile、Mexico、Denmark、Belgium等への言及は、国際的な対応（試合中止・渡航制限）の文脈であり、発生地ではない。故にverified_locationsはDRCのみ。スペイン・グアダラハラ等の地名はBluedotから誤って抽出されているが、記事サマリーではこれらは試合会場の言及に過ぎない。メキシコの渡航制限はDRC由来の脅威への対応。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Malaria Menyerang Warga Pesisir Belinyu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria outbreak hits Belinyu coastal residents.
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak hits coastal residents in Belinyu, Bangka Island, Indonesia, as dozens are infected in recent days. After previously being declared eliminated in Bangka, malaria has reappeared, especially around Batu Atap Beach and Bubus Beach in Belinyu district, Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands Province. Common symptoms include high fever, chills, and weakness; some patients have required hospital care. Laboratory confirmation was reported when a blood test at a local community health center (puskesmas) tested positive for malaria, prompting hospital referral. A resident named Wika from South Sumatra reported family members affected, including a child who was hospitalized. Transmission appears to have started with local cases spreading to others, leading residents to limit outdoor activities. While some patients have recovered after treatment, fear persists as new cases continue to be reported as of 3 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア流行がベリニュ沿岸住民を襲撃
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのバンカ島で以前は排除されたマラリアが再出現し、複数の症例が報告されている。ただし、国際的な拡大の明確な兆候や重症度に関する詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: バンカ島で以前排除されたマラリアが再出現した点が異常。複数症例、入院患者、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が確認されている。ただし死亡数、総患者数、重症度の詳細情報が不足。地域検証：サマリーはインドネシアのバンカ島（スマトラ南部地域）に限定された内容であり、インドネシア以外の国への言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Thế giới không thể lơ là trước cuộc chiến chống Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The world cannot ignore the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, Ebola resurges from African forests, with Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo at the epicenter. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. Africa CDC data show over 1,200 confirmed or suspected cases by end-May, with a case-fatality rate near 30%. The Bundibugyo strain, highly dangerous and lacking a vaccine, drives the outbreak. In Uganda, the first death occurred May 14; mobile laboratories shorten diagnosis to hours, and a community-driven strategy of contact tracing and isolation is under way. President Museveni rejects nationwide lockdowns, focusing on blocking transmission. Imported cases have appeared in Berlin and London. The 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic killed over 12,000, with high mortality when health systems collapsed. World Bank funds, USAID support at borders, quarantines, and Sabin vaccine trials, with COVAX delivering to Kampala to accelerate vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 世界はエボラ対策の戦いを無視することはできない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による多国間での確定・疑い例1,200件超、死亡率約30%、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。IHR基準4項目全て該当、国際的拡大が既に発生（ベルリン・ロンドンでの輸入症例）。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、アンゴラ、ドイツ、イギリスなどが含まれているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。記事サマリーではウガンダも主要な流行地として記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リスト（GeoNames ID 226074）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsに追加しない。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）、複数国での輸入症例、高い致死率（約30%）といった複合的な危機指標が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: DRC, Ebola BVD Outbreak Emergency Response - Concept of Operations (ConOPs) - Last updated: 01/06/2026
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola BVD outbreak emergency response Concept of Operations (ConOPs) is a live document guiding ongoing operations as of 01/06/2026. Since the May 2026 Ebola declaration, humanitarian activities are expanding across Ituri, notably in Bunia, Rwampara, and Mongbwalu, heightening the need for reliable, shared connectivity to sustain coordination and operations. The response faces patchy connectivity due to the urban–peri-urban–rural mix, risking delays in case reporting, laboratory results, and contact tracing, which undermines early detection and slows the response. The ConOPs underlines that enabling critical humanitarian movement and response requires dependable communication, coordination, and data reporting mechanisms across affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラBVDアウトブレイク緊急対応 - 作戦概念（ConOPs）- 最終更新：2026年6月1日
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認されたアウトブレイク（2026年5月宣言）であり、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡リスク）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ルワンダ隣接）の複数基準に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度、流行性、管理可能性の複数基準を満たす。
triage.notes: エボラBVD（Bunyamwera virus disease）の誤認の可能性。記事サマリーはエボラウイルス疾患（EVD）を指しており、IturiおよびBunia地域での2026年5月の公式宣言に基づく。ルワンダが発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー主文ではDRCのIturi州（Bunia、Rwampara、Mongbwalu）での活動拡大が主題。隣接するルワンダへの国際的拡大リスクは存在するが、現在の記事では確認事例は記載されていない。連絡・調整インフラの欠陥が対応効率性を損なっており、管理可能性の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Africa Races For Ebola Vaccine As Outbreak Outpaces Response
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) fuels a vaccine race as WHO declares a public health emergency of international concern. CEPI pledges $62 million to fast-track three candidates—IAVI/UTMB (single-dose rVSV), Moderna, and the University of Oxford—with Oxford’s vaccine manufactured at Serum Institute of India. WHO’s Advisory Group identifies IAVI’s rVSV candidate as the most promising, though human testing is seven-to-nine months away; Oxford aims for clinical-grade doses in two-to-three months. By May 29, the outbreak caused 223 suspected DRC deaths and one in Uganda; Uganda added six confirmed cases on June 2 (total 15). Gavi commits $50 million for rapid access; Africa CDC targets a vaccine and treatment for 11 high-risk countries by year’s end, requiring about $319 million in six months. Russia’s Gamaleya vaccine is being evaluated for Bundibugyo adaptation; experimental therapeutics MBP134, Maftivimab, remdesivir, and obeldesivir are under study.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカがエボラワクチンの確保を急ぐ　発生が対応を上回る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のBundibugyo型が民主コンゴで発生し、WHOがInternational Concern (PHEIC) を宣言。IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、死亡例・疑い例が確認され、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も発生している。
triage.notes: Russian Federation はサマリーに記載されているがイベント発生地ではなく、ワクチン評価（Gamaleya）の文脈のみのため除外。Uganda はDRCに隣接し疑い例1件、確定例15件（6月2日時点）が報告されているが、対象国リストに未掲載のため verified_locations から除外。India はSerum Institute of Indiaでのワクチン製造地として言及されており、製造施設所在地として含める。PHEICの公式宣言とIHR基準4項目全該当により、直ちにRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）段階へ進める必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kolong Bekas Tambang Bagian dari Ekosistem Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Abandoned Mine Shafts Are Part of the Malaria Ecosystem
article.articleSummary: Abandoned tin mining ponds near Pantai Batu Atap in Belinyu, Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia, are linked to increased malaria risk. Muhammad Putra Kusuma of IAKMI Bangka Barat argues epidemiologically a strong and significant relationship between unreclaimed kolong and malaria transmission, especially when ponds lie close to settlements or community mining activity. While not the sole cause, these man-made water bodies can create ideal Anopheles mosquito breeding habitats; their larval environments exhibit characteristics that support malaria vectors, making nearby areas more persistent and concentrated in transmission. The risk depends on physical, chemical, and biological conditions of each kolong. However Erpan Muchtedi, head of Mineral Metallurgy at the Bangka Belitung Dinas ESDM, cautions that not all portions of kolong serve as Anopheles habitats. The article emphasizes potential ecological links without reporting specific case numbers.

triage.headline_ja: 廃棄された鉱山跡はマラリアの生態系の一部
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの一般的なリスク要因（廃棄鉱山池）に関する環境・生態学的記事であり、具体的な患者数、異常な発生、国際的な拡大リスク、管理困難性が報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的なマラリア発生ケースを報告していないため、シグナルとして判定しない。廃棄鉱山池がマラリア媒介蚊（Anopheles）の繁殖地となり得ることを述べた生態学的分析であり、公衆衛生上の突発事象ではなく、既知のリスク因子に関する解説。

article.articleHeadline: Warga Takut Keluar Rumah, Wabah Malaria Hantui Pesisir Belinyu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents Fear Leaving Home, Malaria Outbreak Haunts Belinyu Coast.
article.articleSummary: Malaria resurges along the Belinyu coast in Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, with dozens infected in Batu Atap Beach and Bubus Beach. The illness, once declared eliminated in Bangka, prompts residents to restrict outdoor activity as symptoms—high fever, chills, and weakness—appear. Wika, a resident from South Sumatra living in Batu Atap, reports her child tested positive for malaria after blood screening at a community health clinic and was referred to hospital; she herself had malaria previously and recovered. Mawar says two children developed fever and chills after returning from sea and also tested positive. The Bangka Regency government has declared an Extraordinary Event (KLB) due to the rising cases. The report notes laboratory confirmation via blood tests at primary health centers, but does not specify the transmission source or any imported/exported cases; no deaths are mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: 住民が外出を恐れる、マラリア流行がブリニュ沿岸を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バンカ県）でマラリアの再興流行が確認され、複数の症例が発生。地域政府が公式に異常事象（KLB）を宣言し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と予想外の再発が認められるため、IHR基準2つ以上該当。
triage.notes: マラリアは過去に根絶宣言された地域での再出現であり、異常性が高い。複数の確定症例、政府による公式な異常事象宣言、住民の行動制限等から、公衆衛生学的な懸念は明確。国際的な拡大やその他の詳細情報については記事で言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 2 scientists charged with bringing deactivated mpox virus into US
article.articleSummary: Two US government virologists, Vincent Munster (chief of the virus ecology section at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana) and Claude Kwe, were charged with smuggling deactivated mpox virus vials into the United States from the Republic of Congo and lying to investigators. A criminal complaint unsealed in Detroit federal court says they were stopped at Detroit Metropolitan Airport in January after a flight from Paris and a nine-day stay in the Republic of Congo, with tests later showing they carried deactivated mpox samples they did not declare or obtain permission for. The FBI cited Munster’s claim that documents were on his laptop, describing his statements as likely false. Mpox outbreaks in 2022 were the first to spread via sex, triggering cases in more than 70 countries and over 2,000 deaths in Congo. Symptoms include rash and fever; most people recover.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の科学者が不活性化したサル痘ウイルスを米国に持ち込んだとして起訴
triage.triage_reason: 本件は不活性化ウイルス密輸の刑事事件であり、感染症アウトブレイク・拡大のリスクを伴わない。記事は過去の2022年アウトブレイク情報を背景として言及しているが、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。
triage.notes: 本件は不活性化ウイルスの密輸に関する刑事事件であり、感染症の流行・拡大とは無関係。記事中でコンゴでの過去のアウトブレイク(2022年)が背景情報として言及されているが、現在の活動的な感染症イベントではない。刑事司法事件としての側面があり、感染症危機管理のシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 云南39岁网红博主因"恙虫病"不幸离世 被虫子咬后出现"焦痂"赶紧去医院
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39-year-old online influencer from Yunnan dies of scrub typhus after developing an eschar from a bug bite; rushed to hospital.
article.articleSummary: 39-year-old online influencer from Yunnan died of scrub typhus after developing a painless eschar from a bug bite, highlighting the condition's risk if untreated. In Zhejiang Province, 50-year-old rural resident Tang Dajie presented with a 10–14 day history of high fever (around 40°C), extensive red rash, and evolving liver and kidney injury; a leg eschar near the right ankle and a small scar-like lesion supported suspected scrub typhus. Microbial sequencing confirmed Orientia tsutsugamushi, the scrub typhus pathogen. After targeted anti-infective therapy, the Zhejiang patient rapidly improved and was discharged. The Yunnan case, which resulted in death on May 28, underscores the need for early recognition. Experts note scrub typhus is transmitted by mites and other vectors, thrives in southern China May–October with a peak June–August, and has an incubation of 4–20 days. Key features include fever and a painless eschar; exposure history warrants prompt medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 雲南省の39歳ネットインフルエンサーが「恙虫病」で死亡 虫に刺された後に焦痂が出現、病院に急送
triage.triage_reason: 恙虫病による死亡事例と確診例が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露リスク）で該当する可能性があるが、IHR基準は2つ以上該当する証拠が不足している。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 恙虫病は中国南部で5月〜10月に流行し、6月〜8月が最高峰との記載あり。2例（死亡1例、完治1例）が報告されている。人口密集地域での継続曝露リスク（媒介虫との接触）が存在する。ただし、現時点での症例数は限定的であり、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。国際支援の必要性についての情報は記事に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan court halts US plans to open Ebola quarantine facility
article.articleSummary: Kenyan court temporarily halted US plans to open an Ebola quarantine facility in Kenya for American citizens who might have been exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) or Uganda, rather than being flown to the United States. A rights group filed suit, arguing the plan posed 'serious' public health risks. As of June 3, 2026, there have been more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC and nine in Uganda, indicating a persistent regional outbreak. The ruling highlights tensions between establishing domestic containment options and potential cross-border health implications related to Ebola exposure in neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所、エボラ隔離施設のアメリカの計画を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重大な感染症について、DRCとウガンダで900件以上の疑い例が報告されており、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限リスクに該当する。また、隔離施設計画における各国間の対立が国際的関心を集めている。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアの司法判断とアメリカの隔離施設計画を扱うが、実際の疾患発生地はDRCとウガンダ。ケニアは計画地に過ぎず、発病患者数の報告はDRCで900件超、ウガンダで9件。アメリカは計画国であり病原体流行国ではないため除外。対象国リストの中ではDRCとウガンダのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola concerns force cancellation of DR Congo's FIFA World Cup warm-up match against Chile
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo prompted cancellation of a DR Congo–Chile World Cup warm-up in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain, on June 9 after health authorities warned of risks. The decree, issued by La Linea’s mayor, followed advice from regional health services. DR Congo, which had scrapped home-country training and based preparations in Belgium, is preparing for the World Cup with Group K fixtures: Portugal (June 17), Colombia (June 24 in Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (June 28 in Atlanta). The squad will be based in Houston; US entry requires a 21-day isolation period announced May 22. As of mid-May, the hemorrhagic Ebola outbreak was officially declared in eastern DR Congo, prompting precautionary measures and the scrapped pre-tournament friendly against Chile. The cancellation underscores ongoing outbreak concerns impacting international sports travel and scheduling (as of 2026-06-03).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ懸念によるコンゴ民主共和国のFIFAワールドカップ準備試合（チリ戦）中止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の東部コンゴ民主共和国での流行が国際的スポーツイベント（FIFAワールドカップ）の日程変更を強制し、複数国への国際的拡大リスク（ベルギー、スペイン、米国など）を示唆しており、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性、国際拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数の国（スペイン、米国、メキシコ、チリなど）を「発生地域」として付与しているが、記事サマリーは東部コンゴ民主共和国での実際のエボラ流行が主題であることを示している。他の国は試合キャンセルの影響を受けた場所またはワールドカップ準備地点であり、発生地ではない。WPRO対象国リストにはコンゴ民主共和国のみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはコンゴ民主共和国のみとした。2026年と相当未来の日付が記事に含まれており、架空シナリオの可能性が高いが、評価フレームワークの適用に変わりはない。

article.articleHeadline: Minister allays fears over new Covid-19 variant
article.articleSummary: Thailand is monitoring a new Covid-19 variant NB.1.8.1, discovered last week and branched from JN.1, with the original variant mutating locally. NB.1.8.1 is currently the main circulating strain. Infections show cough, fever, and sore throat, with sore throat the most prominent symptom. Officials say there is no evidence the variant is more severe or more rapidly spreading; no large-scale outbreaks detected and most cases are mild. Public Health Minister Pattana Promphat urges calm and continued surveillance; those with fever, sore throat, or cough should wear a mask. Government and the Department of Disease Control emphasize ongoing monitoring and adequate public health capacity. High-risk groups, termed the “608” cohort (elderly over 60, underlying conditions, and pregnant women), should maintain good personal hygiene. No panic, but vigilance remains ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 大臣が新型コロナウイルス変異株への懸念を払拭
triage.triage_reason: 新規変異株（NB.1.8.1）の検出は異常/予想外であり、WPROスクリーニング基準1つ以上に該当するが、公式には重症度・急速な拡大の証拠がなく、大規模流行は検出されていないため、情報が限定的であり経過観察を要する。
triage.notes: 新規COVID-19変異株NB.1.8.1の検出は異常だが、当局は重症度上昇や急速拡大の証拠がないと述べており、大規模流行は検出されていない。症状は軽度が主体。ただし新規変異株の出現自体と監視体制の継続が確認されているため、WATCHとして継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Cancelan amistoso de RD Congo por temor al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo friendly match canceled due to fear of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted Spain to cancel a friendly match between DR Congo and Chile, scheduled for June 9 in La Línea de la Concepción. Mayor Juan Franco issued a decree after health authorities warned of risks and stated the organizers’ documents did not guarantee risk absence. DR Congo’s preparation for the 2026 World Cup was already disrupted, with training moved from Kinshasa to Belgium and no locally based players called up for these commitments. The Denmark friendly in Liege remains on. DR Congo is in World Cup 2026 Group K with Colombia, Portugal, and Uzbekistan, and is slated to face Colombia in Guadalajara, Mexico. The outbreak provides the salient public health context driving scheduling and venue decisions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ恐怖で親善試合がキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生がコンゴ民主共和国で確認されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たし、スポーツイベントのキャンセルなど社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに複数国が列挙されているが、記事サマリー上でエボラの発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみであり、スペイン・チリ・ベルギー・メキシコなどは発生地ではなく影響を受けた国である。国際的な影響（試合キャンセル、代表チーム移動）は認められるが、疾患発生地の検証は対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: 米、エボラ対応でワクチン供給国際組織との連携再開決定＝国務長官
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. decides to resume cooperation with international vaccine-supply organizations in the Ebola response — Secretary of State.
article.articleSummary: U.S. Secretary of State Rex Rubio announced that the United States will resume cooperation with Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, to support vaccine supply to developing countries amid Ebola outbreaks in Africa. Gavi has pledged $10 million for immediate response and $40 million to accelerate the rollout of vaccines under development, totaling $50 million, to address the Bundibugyo strain spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The alliance’s funding was previously cut last year after safety concerns raised by former Health Secretary Kennedy. Rubio said the State Department led the decision to re-engage, seeking a resolution acceptable to Congress and aligned with global health goals, while respecting other agencies’ views. Sania Nishtar, Gavi’s executive director, welcomed the move, underscoring that sustained funding is crucial to counter the Ebola threat.

triage.headline_ja: 米、エボラ対応でワクチン供給国際組織との連携再開決定＝国務長官
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生（Bundibugyo株がDRC・ウガンダで拡大中）は IHR基準を複数満たし、国際的なワクチン供給・資金協力の再開という政治的関心の高いシグナル。深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的対応の必要性が認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラの拡大が明記されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。米国との言及はワクチン外交に関する報道であり、発生地ではない。エボラウイルスBundibugyo株は稀な株系であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 开封2小时，细菌数量暴涨！很多人天天在喝，有人甚至进急诊......
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kaifeng, bacterial counts surge in just two hours! Many people drink it every day, and some even end up in the emergency department.......
article.articleSummary: Kaifeng, Henan, China (Published 2026-06-03) reports that freshly made milk tea can rapidly become contaminated. After just 2 hours, total bacterial counts in milk tea can exceed safety levels, with Escherichia coli detected and some drinkers ending up in emergency departments. A Shanghai Consumer Rights Protection Committee test of four milk teas found that a simpler drink registered about 2,700 CFU/mL at 2 hours, 3,100 at 4 hours, and 6,100 at 6 hours; other varieties reached tens of thousands CFU/mL after 4–6 hours. Even unopened samples showed contamination, with several exceeding 10,000 CFU/mL within 2 hours and some coliforms above 10 CFU/mL. Detected bacteria include E. coli, Salmonella, Listeria monocytogenes, Staphylococcus aureus, and Bacillus cereus. Potential sources are air, raw ingredients, ice water, and utensils, with oral bacteria accelerating growth when sipping. Recommendations: finish within 2 hours, refrigerate after opening, reheat to at least 70°C, and discard after 4 hours or if off.

triage.headline_ja: 開封2時間で細菌数が急増！多くの人が毎日飲んでおり、中には救急車で搬送される人も……
triage.triage_reason: 複数の食中毒菌（E. coli、Salmonella、Listeria等）が検出され、患者の救急搬送報告がある。ただし発生規模、死亡例、国際拡大リスク等の詳細情報が不足しており、フルRRA実施前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 複数の病原菌（E. coli、Salmonella、Listeria monocytogenes等）が検出されており、飲料品の食中毒リスクとして注視が必要。記事サマリーでは開封・開封後の時間経過に伴う急速な細菌増殖と患者の救急搬送が報告されているが、確定症例数、死亡例の有無、流行規模の詳細が不明。今後の患者数動向と関連当局の対応を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: rizospastis.gr - Εκατοντάδες τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα Εμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: rizospastis.gr - Hundreds of confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo, marks the 17th Ebola event in the country and the third-largest. As of June 1, authorities report 1,139 suspected cases and 246 deaths linked to Ebola, with 321 lab-confirmed cases and 48 deaths. Bunia airport has resumed operations after a May 23 suspension for strict health measures. The piece attributes the ongoing vaccine deficit not to scientific barriers but to pharmaceutical monopolies prioritizing profits amid limited disease spread in Africa. In response, the Cypriot EU presidency has convened an extraordinary Health Ministers’ teleconference on June 5 to discuss readiness, information exchange, and inter-member coordination, and the Ebola issue will be deliberated at the EPCSO Council on June 16 to bolster coordinated European action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の確認症例が数百件に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模感染は深刻な公衆衛生影響を持ち、異常かつ予想外であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（特にブニア）でのエボラ発生を主題としており、DRCが対象国であるため verified_locations に含める。キプロスはEU保健相会議の開催地として言及されているが、イベント発生地ではないため除外。IHR基準とWPRO基準の両方で高リスク評価。国際的な政治的関心も高い（EU保健相会議、EPCSO理事会での検討）。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Global Coalition Launches Emergency Ebola Vaccine Development
article.articleSummary: June 3, 2026 — Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has prompted rapid vaccine development as WHO declares a PHEIC. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) strain is the target; 918 suspected cases and 224 deaths reported, making this the third-largest filovirus epidemic. BDBV vaccines have no approved option. CEPI will invest up to $62 million to fund three parallel vaccine platforms: Moderna (up to $50 million) using mRNA, IAVI (up to $3.2 million) using recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV), and the University of Oxford (up to $8.6 million) using ChAdOx1. Trials include non-clinical work and Phase 1 prep, with Moderna pursuing parallel Phase 2/3 if safety is confirmed. The rVSV platform may confer protective immunity after a single dose. Suspected cases outside Africa have raised international concerns as CEPI, Moderna, IAVI, and Oxford accelerate development.

triage.headline_ja: Global Coalition Launches Emergency Ebola Vaccine Development（グローバルコアリション、エボラワクチン緊急開発を開始）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。DRC でのエボラアウトフレイク、918疑似症例・224死亡、WHO による PHEIC 宣言により、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確に存在。
triage.notes: BDBV株によるエボラアウトブレイク。224死亡は重大。WHO PHEIC 宣言済み。CEPI による 62 百万ドルの投資と複数プラットフォームの並行開発進行中。「Suspected cases outside Africa」の記述により国際的拡大懸念が顕在化。フルリスク評価（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Nederlandse viroloog in VS aangeklaagd voor invoer mpox-virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dutch virologist charged in the U.S. with importing the mpox virus
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03, Dutch virologist Vincent Munster, head of the virus ecology section at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana, has been charged in the United States with importing deactivated mpox virus from the Democratic Republic of Congo and lying to investigators at Detroit Metropolitan Airport. Munster and colleague Claude Kwe were stopped after flying from Paris with a nine-day stay in the DRC. Investigators say they carried vials of inactivated mpox material, which they did not declare and for which they had not obtained the necessary permits. The FBI noted Munster initially denied traveling with biological material. Mpox is an infectious disease related to smallpox and can cause fever and skin lesions. The most recent large outbreak occurred in and around the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: オランダの病毒学者、米国でMpoxウイルス輸入で起訴される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常/予想外性（違法な病原体輸入事件）と国際的拡大リスク（複数国関与）の2基準に該当。国際的生物学的リスク管理と公衆衛生規制の重大な違反であり、シグナル対象。
triage.notes: 本件はMpox/Smallpox病原体の違法輸入・不正通関という生物セキュリティ事件。記事の主題発生地はDRC（病原体採取元）。米国（Montana, Detroit）とフランス（Paris）は輸送経路上の地点だが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。CEPR EBS活動では、生物テロ・生物セキュリティ脅威に分類される案件として、RRA段階への進行が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 男子饭后剔牙染破伤风住进ICU 小伤口大隐患
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man contracts tetanus after post-meal tooth-picking and is admitted to the ICU; a small wound, a big hidden danger.
article.articleSummary: An adult man in Wuhan, China, contracted tetanus after a small gum wound caused by a bamboo toothpick following a meal in mid-April 2026. He developed inability to open his mouth, stiffness of the neck and back, then generalized muscle spasms and dysphagia, leading to ICU admission at Wuhan University Zhongnan Hospital. Diagnosis relied on injury history and classic clinical signs, since tetanus toxin binding to neurons makes rapid bacterium detection unlikely. He required endotracheal intubation, later tracheostomy and mechanical ventilation, plus nasogastric feeding. After 36 days of intensive, multidisciplinary care with sedation/analgesia to control spasms, ventilation, nutrition, and complication prevention, he recovered and was discharged. The report notes pulmonary infection and other complications as major mortality risks, highlighting that even small, deep wounds can serve as entry points for tetanus.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が食後の爪楊枝による歯肉損傷から破傷風に感染し、ICUに入院 - 小さな傷、大きなリスク
triage.triage_reason: 破傷風は単一症例報告で、重症度は高いが（ICU入院、挿管、36日間の集中治療）、公衆衛生への広域的影響や国際的拡大リスクは明確でない。医療教育的価値のあるケースレポートとして要経過観察。
triage.notes: 破傷風は単一症例報告であり、集団発生の兆候なし。ただし中国のメディアで配信された医療ニュースであり、公衆衛生啓発の観点から一定の社会的関心あり。IHR基準は『重大な公衆衛生への影響』に該当するが、流行性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。WPROスクリーニング基準では『重症度』に該当。今後同様の発生が報告されるかどうかを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 繃緊神經！伊波拉疫區「逾400人將返台」 新冠後首度祭入境禁令
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On edge! More than 400 people from Ebola-affected regions will return to Taiwan; first entry ban since the COVID-19 pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan will ban entry for residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda for 90 days starting June 2, 2026, due to ongoing Ebola outbreaks and a mid-June international gathering set to draw 30,000–40,000 people. This is Taiwan’s first inbound ban since COVID-19 border reopening; visa issuance to both countries will be suspended. More than 400 participants from DRC and Uganda were planned to travel to Taiwan. CDC Director Luo Yijun said the measure follows international practice to curb border and community transmission amid rising risk. Ebola virus disease presents with fever, severe fatigue, muscle pain, headache, then vomiting and diarrhea, abdominal pain, and bleeding; severe cases may involve liver damage, kidney failure, CNS injury, shock, and multi-organ failure; fatality historically around 50% (range 25–90%). Experts note travel between Taiwan and these countries is limited, suggesting limited impact.

triage.headline_ja: 繃緊神經！伊波拉疫區「逾400人將返台」 新冠後首度祭入境禁令
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、国境規制措置の実施、および台湾への旅行者からの伝播リスクがIHR基準を複数満たし、政府の対応と社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）とウガンダでのエボラ流行が主題であり、台湾への影響（400人以上の入国予定者）が明記されている。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、China（香港・マカオを含む地域）として扱う。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラの致死率（25～90%、平均50%）の高さ、台湾による初の入国禁止令施行、および国際的な集会予定（30,000～40,000人）による拡大リスクが複合的に存在。

article.articleHeadline: 2 researchers charged with smuggling mpox into the US
article.articleSummary: Two NIH researchers, Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, were charged on Tuesday with conspiracy to smuggle deactivated mpox virus into the United States and with providing false statements to CBP. They work in the virus ecology section at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana. The men arrived at Detroit airport in January from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, carrying a large black case they claimed contained diagnostics and testing equipment. CBP and FBI found 113 vials; 20 tested so far, 17 contained mpox (monkeypox), a rash-causing disease. The 2022 mpox outbreak in the United States infected more than 30,000 people and killed 42. The virus Munster and Kwe allegedly carried had been deactivated; one vial contained chickenpox, and two vials contained human DNA. The maximum penalty is five years in prison. NIH said it conducted biosafety measures and inventory reviews, and that there was no risk to staff or the public.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の研究者がエムポックスを米国に密輸した罪で起訴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。生物学的脅威の直接的な事案であり、バイオセキュリティリスク管理の観点から重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 本件はMpox密輸事案であり、感染症発生シグナルではなく生物セキュリティ侵害事案。ただし、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。米国の発生地域（Montana、Michigan、Ohio、Detroit、Hamilton）は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。サマリーによると搬入されたウイルスは不活化済みで、public health riskは低いと判断されているが、密輸の事実そのものがバイオセキュリティ上の懸念を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Membuka kembali Bandara di Pusat Penyebaran Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Reopens Airport at the Epicenter of the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, led to Bunia airport closure; air travel resumed on 3 June 2026 with phased, safe operations. Kinshasa had previously halted passenger flights to Bunia, allowing only humanitarian/medical flights with approvals. New health precautions require temperature checks pre-departure and on arrival and mandatory handwashing; passengers with fever are barred from flying. Africa CDC flagged the Bundibugyo strain on 15 May; WHO later designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Official data show 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths, with transmission across 15 of 36 health zones in Ituri, and spillover into North Kivu and South Kivu; cases have been detected in Uganda. The International Rescue Committee cautions the true scale may be larger, suggesting up to three months of undetected transmission. WHO Director-General Tedros praised initial response while urging expanded testing, treatment capacity, and community trust.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱の流行中心地の空港を再開
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態。IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WHO/Africa CDCによる公式認定と複数国への波及が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダでの症例検出の記載があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主要な発生地。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱は2024年以降報告されている新規株で、公式確認症例321名・死亡48名、15の健康地域に波及。WHO PHEIC指定済み。

article.articleHeadline: Nederlandse viroloog in VS aangeklaagd voor invoer mpox-virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dutch virologist in the United States charged with importing mpox virus
article.articleSummary: Dutch virologist Munster, head of the virus ecology section at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana, and colleague Claude Kwe were stopped at Detroit airport after a January trip from Paris and a nine-day stay in Congo. A US court and the FBI allege they imported mpox material, specifically bottles containing inactivated mpox, which they did not declare and for which they lacked the necessary permits. They deny bringing biological material back to the United States, but subsequent tests confirmed travel with the inactivated mpox. Mpox (monkeypox) is a poxvirus-related infection that can cause fever and skin lesions; the article notes the most recent large outbreak occurred in and around Congo. The case underscores import/export controls for pathogenic material and potential mpox-related exposures entering the US.

triage.headline_ja: オランダの病毒学者、米国でMpoxウイルス輸入容疑で起訴される
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの国際的な輸送・違法輸入という異常で重大な事象であり、複数国（米国、フランス、DRC）が関与している。ただし公衆衛生的な患者発生や流行ではなく、法的・規制上の事案が中心であるため、情報追跡が必要。
triage.notes: イベントは米国・フランス・DRCに関連するが、記事の主題は違法なMpox輸送に関する法的事案である。実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、バイオセキュリティ・規制問題が中心。対象国リストでは DRC(203312) のみ該当。継続監視により患者発生や追加の違反事案報告がないか確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疑似病例数大幅下调
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo significantly reduced.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) had 116 suspected Ebola cases under investigation, markedly down from earlier totals; WHO spokesman Lindmeier attributed this to laboratory confirmation excluding many initial suspected cases with malaria-like symptoms. May 26 totals showed 1,077 cumulative suspected cases. Cumulative confirmed cases in the DRC stood at 344 with 60 deaths and 6 recoveries. In Uganda, 6 new confirmed cases were reported on June 2, all among contacts of existing patients, bringing Uganda’s total to 15; 2 have recovered, 12 are hospitalized, and 1 has died. On May 17, WHO designated the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment at present.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑似病例数が大幅に減少
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。PHEIC指定、確認患者と死亡者が存在し、ウガンダへの拡大を示す。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ outbreak の最新状況（疑似病例数の下方修正）を報告している。ウガンダへの拡大言及があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCはリスト対象国であり、PHEIC指定、死亡者・確認患者の存在、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療法なし）など重大な懸念事項が存在。

article.articleHeadline: जबलपुर का वेटरनरी विवि बना रहा आधुनिक किट, दो घंटे में होगी मुर्गियों में खतरनाक वायरस की पहचान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jabalpur's Veterinary University develops an advanced kit to identify a dangerous virus in chickens within two hours.
article.articleSummary: Jabalpur's Veterinary University in Madhya Pradesh is developing a rapid diagnostic kit to identify Inclusion Body Hepatitis Virus in chickens within two hours, replacing current lab confirmations that take 2-3 days. The three-year project, led by Dr. Mohan Singh Thakur under the Madhya Pradesh Council of Science and Technology, targets immunodominant capsid epitopes to enable quick onsite detection, particularly in 3- to 5-week-old birds. If successful, it could mitigate outbreaks that have caused hundreds of deaths and significant losses for the state's more than 100,000 poultry farms. The initiative aims to test millions of chickens and may extend to other livestock diseases, with field-ready kits for farm use upon completion and potential broader applications.

triage.headline_ja: ジャバルプール獣医大学が現代的キットを開発、2時間以内にニワトリの危険なウイルスを特定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は動物疾病（包含体肝炎ウイルス）の診断キット開発に関する研究・技術ニュースであり、既存のヒト感染症アウトブレイクやリスクの報告ではない。公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すイベント情報ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく、獣医学的診断キット開発プロジェクトの進捗報告である。過去のニワトリ死亡事例への言及はあるが、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや緊急公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報ではない。EBS監視対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Expands in Eastern Congo as Contact Tracing Deteriorates Amid Attacks on Burial Teams
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak expands in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with the disease reaching a health zone more than 100 miles from the mining town where the outbreak is believed to have begun. In Ituri province, responders say contact tracing is deteriorating, with fewer than 40% of known contacts being tracked in the hardest-hit area. Attacks on burial teams and related security concerns are cited as key factors undermining the response and impeding containment as transmission continues. Although the piece highlights Ituri as a focal area, it does not provide detailed case counts or laboratory confirmation within the excerpt. The situation underscores the critical need to safeguard responders and revive tracing to interrupt transmission chains and prevent further spread across eastern Congo. Published 2026-06-03.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ東部で拡大、埋葬チームへの攻撃の中で接触者追跡が悪化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、東部コンゴでの地理的拡大、接触者追跡の機能不全、セキュリティ上の課題により国際的拡大リスクと貿易制限リスクが存在。
triage.notes: 記事は民主共和国コンゴ（DRC）のイトゥリ州での進行中のエボラ発生を明確に報告。採掘町から100マイル以上離れた地域への地理的拡大、接触者追跡能力の低下（40%未満）、埋葬チームへの攻撃によるセキュリティ上の懸念など、複数の増幅要因が指摘されている。サハラ以南アフリカでのエボラ発生は常に高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: 防汛救灾，提防病从水入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flood control and disaster relief: Beware waterborne diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03, floods in parts of China persist, challenging disaster relief efforts and soldier health. Water safety is paramount: floodwaters contaminate wells and supplies with fecal matter, chemicals, and decaying organics, risking cholera (Vibrio cholerae), typhoid fever (Salmonella Typhi), hepatitis A and E, norovirus, and rotavirus if ingested. Use traceable, sealed bottled or barrel water; cooking water must meet drinking-water standards. In-water work carries wound risks: prolonged immersion can cause skin infections; contaminated water can cause purulent wound infection, necrotizing fasciitis, and tetanus. Before entering water, seal wounds with waterproof dressings; wear long boots, gloves, and waterproof pants; rinse wounds with clean water or saline and disinfect with iodine. Seek medical care for swelling, pain, pus, or fever. After tasks, wash exposed skin and hands; manage waste and wastewater; eliminate mosquito and fly breeding; ensure safe drinking water by boiling or disinfection.

triage.headline_ja: 防汛救灾，提防病从水入（洪水対策と災害救援：水を介した病気に注意）
triage.triage_reason: 中国での洪水による複数の水系感染症（コレラ、チフス、A型肝炎、ノロウイルス、破傷風）のリスク警告。IHR基準3項目該当、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当。重症度が高く、人口密集地での長期曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（ノロウイルス）がある。
triage.notes: 洪水による水汚染が複数の水系感染症のリスクを高めている。記事は予防措置と対応策に重点を置いており、軍人・災害救援従事者の健康リスクが明記されている。破傷風、ノロウイルスはヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、集団発生の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: 抗击埃博拉疫情，中国总是伸出援手_杭州网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the fight against the Ebola outbreak, China is always ready to lend a helping hand.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization on May 17 declared the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)—the third Bundibugyo outbreak in history. Africa CDC later called it a regional outbreak, designating 11 neighboring countries as high risk. In response to the Congolese government, China dispatched a five-member anti-epidemic medical expert group to the DRC on June 2, to work with existing Chinese teams and strengthen outbreak control. Led by Lu Ming, the group will coordinate with the Chinese embassy, Congolese health authorities, and international organizations; adapt surveillance, clinical pathways, and infection control; and train frontline staff while informing Chinese enterprises and expatriates to prevent importation. As of May 30, WHO stated no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists; containment relies on case finding, clinical management, and infection prevention. China has a long history of African Ebola response, deploying about 26,000 medical personnel to 48 African countries and treating roughly 230 million patients since 1963.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症との戦いにおいて、中国は常に援助の手を差し伸べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。WHO により PHEIC 宣言されたブンディブギョウエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の流行で、DRC とウガンダで確認、11 の隣接国が高リスク指定されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威となっている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで DRC とウガンダでのブンディブギョウエボラウイルス流行が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙した。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていない。中国（1814991）は援助派遣国として言及されているが、イベント発生国ではないため除外した。WHO による PHEIC 宣言（2026年5月17日）と Africa CDC による地域流行指定により、国際的な公衆衛生上の関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疑似病例数大幅下调_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola suspected cases in DR Congo down sharply.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 116 Ebola-suspected cases under investigation as of June 1, a sharp drop from earlier totals after lab confirmation ruled out many cases with initial Ebola-like symptoms. By May 26 the cumulative suspected cases reached 1,077, with some later confirmed and many ruled out as malaria, meningitis, or other illnesses. DR Congo’s cumulative confirmed Ebola cases stand at 344, with 60 deaths and 6 recoveries as of June 1. Uganda adds 6 new confirmed cases on June 2, all among contacts of known cases, bringing its total to 15; 2 recoveries, 12 hospitalised, 1 death. The World Health Organization declared this outbreak an International Public Health Emergency on May 17. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment available at present.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑似患者数が大幅に減少
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響・予想外の発生・国際的拡大・WHO緊急事態宣言）。スクリーニング基準も全項目該当し、WHOによる国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言が発出されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認患者数増加（15例、死亡1例）も報告されているが、Bluedotの発生地域リストにウガンダが含まれているものの、ウガンダは提供された対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO緊急事態宣言（5月17日）により国際的な対応が既に開始されている。ワクチン・特異的治療法未開発の状況が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Foreign Researchers Charged With Allegedly Smuggling Monkeypox Virus Into US
article.articleSummary: Two foreign NIH researchers were charged on June 2, 2026, with conspiring to smuggle vials containing mpox virus into the United States and making false statements after arriving from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, where a monkeypox outbreak was underway. Vincent Munster, 53, of the Netherlands, chief of the Virus Ecology Section at the Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Hamilton, Montana, and Claude Kwe, 38, of Cameroon, a research fellow in Munster's section, allegedly transported 113 vials in Styrofoam coolers in a large black case, claiming diagnostic equipment. CBP and FBI discoveries: 20 vials tested; 17 contained deactivated mpox virus, 1 contained chickenpox virus, and 2 contained human DNA. The Rocky Mountain Laboratory houses a BSL-4 facility. Monkeypox/mpox spreads among animals and people; most infections resolve in 2-4 weeks, but high-risk groups include infants, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. A vaccine is available. The defendants face serious charges.

triage.headline_ja: 外国人研究者がサル痘ウイルスを米国に密輸した疑いで起訴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスクが該当（2/4）。さらにWPRO基準で異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当し、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。生物兵器・バイオセキュリティに関わる重大インシデント。
triage.notes: 本イベントはMpoxの密輸という犯罪行為・バイオセキュリティ侵害であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク直結ではないが、DRCからの病原体持ち込み企図であり国際的危機管理上重要。米国の検出によって阻止されたが、潜在的なバイオセキュリティ脅威として極めて高い警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 疑找到伊波拉「零號病人」！死前傳染8醫護　病毒恐擴散4個月│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola 'Patient Zero' Found! Eight Healthcare Workers Infected Before Death; Virus Could Spread for Four Months
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola patient zero identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo, signaling a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak that could be the third-largest in the country. The health ministry reports at least 282 laboratory-confirmed cases, with suspected Bundibugyo infections exceeding 1,000 and nearly 250 deaths. Authorities warn the outbreak may have circulated undetected for months; the index patient reportedly fell ill in January and died in February after infecting eight healthcare workers. May 15 marked the first official confirmation; prior WHO estimates located the index case in Bunia in late April. No licensed vaccine or specific antiviral exists; response centers on rapid isolation, contact tracing, and protective measures, plus safe burials. Five patients have recovered. An imported suspected case from Uganda prompted a high-level European public health alert in Austria.

triage.headline_ja: 疑找到伊波拉「零號病人」！死前傳染8醫護　病毒恐擴散4個月
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の大規模アウトブレイク（確認282例、疑い1,000例以上、死亡250例近く）であり、複数国での確認と無検出期間の長期化が特徴。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてDRCでの大規模Ebola（Bundibugyo型）アウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダでの輸入症例とオーストリアでの公衆衛生警報の記載があるが、実際の感染症イベント（大規模アウトブレイク）の発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCを記載。ワクチン・特異的抗ウイルス薬が存在せず、4か月の無検出期間が指摘されている点でマネージャビリティ（制御困難性）が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil descarta casos sospechosos de ébola, pero mantiene la alerta sanitaria - HSB NOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil rules out suspected Ebola cases, but maintains the public health alert - HSB News
article.articleSummary: Brazil ruled out suspected Ebola cases after investigations, confirming no Ebola cases in the country as of 2026-06-03. Authorities maintain an active public health alert and keep enhanced surveillance protocols in place due to an Ebola outbreak in parts of Africa. Airport, hospital, and international entry controls persist, with ongoing monitoring of travelers from risk areas. Health officials reiterate that there are currently no confirmed Ebola infections domestically, though epidemiological surveillance remains reinforced to ensure a rapid response to any eventuality. The measures emphasize early detection of imported infections and prevention of domestic transmission, aligning Brazil’s vigilance with the regional outbreak context.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラ疑い例を除外、しかし公衆衛生警戒体制を維持
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで疑い例が否定されたため現在の直接的リスクは低いが、アフリカでのエボラ流行を受けた国際的警戒体制が確認されており、情報の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルでの疑い例否定と警戒体制維持。アフリカでのエボラ流行は背景情報であり、検証対象地域リストに「Africa」は含まれないため verified_locations はブラジルのみ。現在のブラジル国内での確定患者なし。

article.articleHeadline: Spanish Mayor Cancels Congo-Chile Friendly Over Ebola Fears
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus Bundibugyo variant in eastern DR Congo prompted cancellation of DR Congo–Chile friendly in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, after mayor Juan Franco issued a preventive ban. DR Congo also cancelled its Kinshasa training camp, relocating to Belgium amid fears, while some staff and supporters would travel to Spain, raising health concerns. The United States imposed a travel ban on non-American travelers who have visited DR Congo, Uganda or South Sudan within the prior 21 days. WHO notes no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; development could take up to nine months. DR Congo has scheduled World Cup base in Houston; Group K opener vs Portugal in Houston on the 17th, then Guadalajara against Colombia, and Atlanta against Uzbekistan. All players are overseas-based with no recent home visits reported.

triage.headline_ja: スペインの市長がエボラ懸念によりコンゴ-チリ親善試合をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo亜型の東部コンゴ民主共和国での流行に対して、複数国での渡航制限実施、国際的な移動制限が発生しており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には米国・スペイン・メキシコなど非流行国が多数含まれているが、記事の主題は東部DRC（特にKinshasa）でのエボラ流行であり、他国への波及（渡航制限）を招いた事象。WHO予防接種なし、開発に最大9ヶ月要するBundibugyo亜型。対象国リストはWPRO地域が主であるためDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'OMS revoit largement à la baisse le nombre de cas suspects en RDC et en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the WHO significantly revises downward the number of suspected cases in the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On June 2, 2026, the WHO sharply reduced the estimated suspected Ebola Bundibugyo cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda from 906 to 116, with 330 confirmed infections (321 in the DRC). This downshift reflects improved case knowledge after Bunia received 2,000 tests and reagents last week, enabling rapid analysis and ruling out Ebola in many patients who had other illnesses or only a fever. Lab in Bunia analyzed 18 of 65 samples on June 1, finding 12 positives, illustrating persistent testing capacity constraints. Despite tests' central role in revealing the true spread and lethality, capacity remains insufficient in the DRC. Obstacles include community resistance to contact listing in Fizi, near Bunia, and weak alert reporting from health zones across three affected provinces, delaying confirmation and care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOが民主共和国とウガンダの疑い例を大幅に下方修正
