triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例330件（うちDRC321件）を伴う発生であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、DRCにおける管理課題が明確である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはFijiが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダのみが主題であり、Fijiでの実際の発生は記載されていないため除外。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOによる疑い症例の大幅な下方修正は、検査能力向上による実態把握の改善を示すが、確認症例330件が存在すること、および検査能力が依然不十分であることが重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疑似病例数大幅下调
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo's number of suspected Ebola cases falls sharply.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) shows a sharp fall in suspected cases. As of June 1, DR Congo reported 116 suspected Ebola cases under investigation, down from 1,077 suspected cases by May 26 after testing and verification ruled out many early-symptom cases. Cumulative confirmed cases in DR Congo reached 344 with 60 deaths and 6 recoveries. In Uganda, on June 2, 6 new confirmed cases (all contacts) raised the total to 15; 2 have recovered, 12 are hospitalized, and 1 has died. On May 17, WHO declared this outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ疑似病例数が大幅に減少
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）のアウトブレイク。WHOが既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。DRCおよびウガンダでの確定症例と死亡があり、複数国での活動が継続中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ボンディブギョエボラウイルス）によるアウトブレイク。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。記事では疑似病例数の減少を報じているが、確定症例344件（死亡60）は継続中。ウガンダでも確定症例15件報告されているが、UgandaはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Vi khuẩn lao tấn công tim người đàn ông
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis bacteria attack the man's heart
article.articleSummary: In Hanoi, Vietnam, a 59-year-old man with two months of cough, shortness of breath, and chest tightness was diagnosed with constrictive pericarditis (also called Pick syndrome) due to Mycobacterium tuberculosis. He had pleural effusion and ascites; Doppler ultrasound showed a thick, adherent pericardium with a 6–7 mm fibrous layer, signaling acute inflammation that can progress to a rigid cardiac shell. TB infection is identified as the source, though pericarditis can arise from chest trauma, autoimmune disease, surgery, cancer, or other infections. The patient also has type 2 diabetes, hypertension, fatty liver, gastritis, and spinal degeneration. Treatment included anti-tuberculosis therapy, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory drugs, diuretics, blood pressure control, and liver support. After nearly two weeks, his condition improved markedly; ongoing monitoring is needed for long-term response. Early detection improves outcomes; severe thickening may require pericardiectomy to relieve constriction.

triage.headline_ja: 結核菌が男性の心臓を攻撃
triage.triage_reason: 単一の臨床事例報告であり、流行や集団発生の証拠がない。結核性心膜炎は稀な合併症だが、患者は治療に反応し改善している。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はハノイの59歳男性における結核性心膜炎の個別臨床事例の医学的報告である。流行兆候や公衆衛生上の懸念材料は認められない。患者は治療に反応し状態が改善している。シグナル検知の対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mayor Cancels DR Congo Friendly over Ebola Scare
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo prompted cancellation of the DR Congo vs Chile international friendly in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain, planned for 9 June, as a precaution after advice from the Andalusian regional health service and local medical department. La Linea (about 65,000 people in Cadiz near Gibraltar) halted the match due to health risks. DR Congo were based in Belgium after cancelling a planned pre-tournament training camp in Kinshasa because of the eastern outbreak; none of the players have recently visited home, but some staff and supporters have traveled from DR Congo. DR Congo were scheduled to face Denmark in a friendly in Liege on Wednesday. The report provides no case counts, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or explicit imported/exported-case details beyond travel by staff and fans.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの懸念をめぐりDRコンゴ親善試合をキャンセルする市長
triage.triage_reason: DRC（対象国）でのエボラ発生の報告があり、国際的な人の移動（スポーツ選手・スタッフ・サポーターの欧州への渡航）に伴う懸念があるが、具体的な患者数、確定診断、感染源、輸入症例の詳細が記事に記載されていない。社会的関心（スポーツイベントキャンセル）はあるが、疾病のリスクレベル詳細が不明のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから付与された地域にはスペイン、ベルギー、デンマーク、チリが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは東部DRCでのエボラ発生が主題であり、欧州での事象は親善試合のキャンセルという二次的影響。記事に患者数、確定診断、感染源の詳細がないため、IHR基準での「serious_impact」と、WPRO基準での「severity」「prolonged_exposure」「manageability」は不明と評価。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒門急診破5500人次！疾管署示警重症前兆　酒精消毒效果有限 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus Outpatient and Emergency Department Visits Surpass 5,500; CDC Warns of Early Signs of Severe Illness; Alcohol-Based Disinfection Has Limited Effectiveness
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s enterovirus activity rose, with 5,573 outpatient/ED visits in May 24–30, 2026, up 8.2% from the prior week; no new severe cases or deaths. The CDC urges continued hand hygiene, environmental disinfection, and avoiding crowded venues; sick individuals should rest at home. Adults should wash hands before hugging or feeding infants and frequently disinfect child-facing items; ensure well-ventilated spaces. Alcohol-based disinfection is limited; use 500 ppm chlorine bleach for routine surfaces (10 L water + 100 mL bleach) and 1,000 ppm for contaminated items (1 L water + 20 mL bleach); wear gloves, masks, and gowns; let disinfectant sit 10 minutes before rinsing. Children under 5 are high-risk; seek hospital care if severe signs appear: drowsiness, altered consciousness, lethargy, limb weakness/paralysis, muscle twitching, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing or tachycardia. Year-to-date: 4 confirmed severe cases, including 1 death (EV-D68: 2; Coxsackie A4:1; A16:1); community predominance of Coxsackie A6. Neighboring countries Vietnam, Mainland China, Thailand, Japan, Korea, and Hong Kong report rising activity.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒門急診破5500人次！疾管署示警重症前兆　酒精消毒効果有限
triage.triage_reason: 台湾を中心にエンテロウイルス活動が上昇し、複数の近隣国（ベトナム、中国、タイ、日本、韓国、香港）でも活動が増加。重症例と死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上該当、かつWPRO基準複数該当する。
triage.notes: 台湾はWHO対象国でないため verified_locations に含めていません。ただし記事の主題は台湾の腸病毒活動上昇であり、ベトナム、中国、タイでも活動増加が確認されています。年初来4例の重症例（死亡1例）が報告され、EV-D68、Coxsackie A系統が検出されています。複数国での同時活動増加は地域流行の可能性を示唆しています。

article.articleHeadline: 'If Ebola comes, we'll be wiped out': fear grips camps in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola fears mount in the Democratic Republic of Congo as displaced populations in Ituri province face the risk of a major outbreak. In Bunia's Kingonze camp, housing over 25,000 people, residents fear transmission as close contact remains the main spread mode. Ituri in northeastern DRC is the epicentre of the latest outbreak, with nearly a million displaced across the province. Health workers at an Ebola Treatment Center in Munigi, rehabilitated by Doctors Without Borders (MSF) on 2 June 2026, are preparing PPE-clad staff and isolation wards for patients. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns of a catastrophic collision of disease and conflict in eastern DRC, where ongoing fighting hampers outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラが来たら、われわれは絶滅する」：コンゴ民主共和国のキャンプに恐怖が広がる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の活動的な流行がDRCで継続中であり、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。難民キャンプでの25,000人規模の集団感染リスク、WHOトップの警告、医療体制の脆弱性が確認される。
triage.notes: Northern Mindanaoは記事サマリーに言及がないため除外。DRCのIturi州が記事の実質的な主題。WHOトップによる公式警告、MSFの対応等により国際的関心は極めて高い。難民キャンプでの感染リスク拡大が主要な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'OMS revoit largement à la baisse le nombre de cas suspects en RDC et en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO significantly lowers the number of suspected cases in the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: WHO drastically reduced the number of suspected Ebola Bundibugyo cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda on June 2, 2026, from 906 to 116, with 330 confirmed cases, 321 of them in the DRC. The revision followed the arrival in Bunia of 2,000 tests and reagents the previous week, enabling all pending samples to be processed and revealing that many patients had other illnesses or only isolated fever. The update highlights the central role of testing in gauging transmission and case fatality, and in mapping outbreaks, while also exposing ongoing testing shortages in the DRC. On June 1, Bunia laboratory analyzed 18 of 65 samples, with 12 positives. Major impediments to precise epidemiology remain: community resistance to listing and tracing contacts around confirmed cases—such as in the Fizi health zone near Bunia—and weak alert reporting from health zones in the three affected provinces, delaying confirmation and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：WHO、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにおける疑い患者数を大幅に引き下げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重症度、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、確認症例330件（DRC321件）、死亡率の医学的関心、複数国への拡大が認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBunia（DRC内の都市）における接触者追跡と地域抵抗の文脈で言及されているが、サマリーの主要な疾病負荷はDRCに集中（確認症例321/330）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外。Fijiは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーに地理的関連性なし。テスト キャパシティの改善により疑い患者数が大幅に減少した点は、検査能力の重要性を示唆するが、DRCにおける継続的なテスト不足と地域社会の協力困難が残る。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo revises down number of suspected Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, DRC—Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with more than 340 confirmed cases and 60 deaths; six recoveries have been reported, and 173 suspected cases are in isolation. Suspected cases under investigation have fallen to 116 after many were tested and ruled out; a May 27 update had recorded 1,077 suspected cases as of May 26. Laboratory testing showed many Ebola-like presentations were due to malaria, meningitis, or other illnesses. The outbreak has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Initial case identification relies on Ebola-like symptoms pending laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ疑い症例数を下方修正
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）宣言済みの確定的なシグナル。フルRRA進行対象。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。Bundibugyo strain確認。確定例340例以上、死亡60例。検査により多数の疑い症例がマラリア、髄膜炎など他疾患と判明し、疑い症例数は大幅に減少（1,077例→116例）。ただしワクチン未承認・特異的治療なし。対象国リストにDRCが含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Nijerya, Ebola tehdidi nedeniyle 10 eyaleti alarm durumuna geçirdi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria puts 10 states on high alert due to Ebola threat.
article.articleSummary: On 3 June 2026, Nigeria’s NCDC placed 10 states on high alert due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus threats linked to outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Although no Ebola cases have been confirmed in Nigeria, international travel and cross-border movement increase importation risk. High-risk states: Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba, and Adamawa; medium risk: Kaduna, Katsina, Bauchi, and Plateau. In Uganda and the DRC, authorities report over 1,000 suspected cases and 247 deaths, with young and middle-aged adults disproportionately affected. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; early diagnosis, contact tracing, and rapid isolation are critical. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected body fluids, contaminated materials, or infected animals; airborne spread is not noted. The NCDC activated its Emergency Operations Center and requested 72-hour readiness reports from all states. Bundibugyo was first identified in 2007 in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ脅威により10州を警戒態勢に移行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ウガンダ・DRCでの1,000件以上の疑い例と247死亡例、隣国での大規模流行リンクにより国際的脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではナイジェリアが主要な焦点（10州の警戒態勢）であり、DRCはウガンダとともに流行の源泉として記載されている。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus という特定の系統の同定は稀有性を高める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Reaches New Congo Area as Contact Tracing Breaks Down | Today News
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola has reached Mambasa in Ituri province, more than 100 miles from Mongbwalu, the outbreak’s presumed origin. Ituri accounts for about 94% of 344 confirmed infections and 60 deaths across 24 affected health zones in the DRC. Surveillance covers 39.3% of identified contacts; over 4,000 contacts are under follow-up across three provinces. On June 1, 23 new confirmed cases were reported, including 11 in Mongbwalu and six in Bunia. Four confirmed cases escaped containment (one in Ituri, three in North Kivu). Uganda reported six new cases, bringing its total to 15 with one death. Attacks on safe burial teams and resistance to contact tracing in Bunia and Nizi hinder response. Lab backlog cleared: 76 samples with almost a third positive. Preliminary data suggest declining transmission; vaccines may generate partial Bundibugyo responses; cross-reactive antibodies seen in a West Africa trial (not peer-reviewed).

triage.headline_ja: コンタクトトレーシングの崩壊により、エボラがコンゴ新地域に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo エボラが DRC の Ituri 州で急速に地理的拡大し、344 人の感染者と 60 人の死亡を記録。ウガンダへの国際的波及と接触追跡システムの崩壊により、公衆衛生への深刻な脅威が存在。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのケースも報告しているが、ウガンダ（1269750）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。Bundibugyo エボラの拡大、接触者追跡の機能不全、安全埋葬チームへの攻撃による対応の阻害が判定要因。ワクチンの部分的有効性についてのデータはまだ査読前。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒門急診破5500人次！疾管署示警重症前兆　酒精消毒效果有限 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus Outpatient and Emergency Visits Exceed 5,500; Taiwan CDC Warns of Signs of Severe Illness; Alcohol Disinfection Has Limited Effectiveness
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports rising enterovirus activity. For the week of May 24–30, outpatient and emergency visits reached 5,573, up 8.2% from 5,153 the previous week, with no new severe cases or deaths. Children under 5 remain the high-risk group; parents and caregivers are urged to reinforce handwashing with soap, ensure environmental disinfection, avoid crowded venues, and keep ill children at home. Alcohol-based disinfectants have limited effectiveness against enteroviruses; use 500 ppm sodium hypochlorite bleach (10 L water + 100 mL bleach) for routine surfaces, and 1000 ppm (1 L water + 20 mL bleach) for items contaminated with secretions or vomitus, with PPE and a 10-minute contact time. So far this year Taiwan has four severe enterovirus infections, including one death: EV-D68 (2), Coxsackie A4 (1), Coxsackie A16 (1). Community strains show Coxsackie A6 predominance in the past four weeks. Regional context: Vietnam (>34,400 cases by April, EV71 dominant), China (>200,000 by mid-May, Coxsackie A16), and Thailand (12,542). Published 2026-06-03.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒門急診破5500人次！疾管署示警重症前兆　酒精消毒效果有限
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でエンテロウイルス71による患者数が急増（週間5,573件）し、複数国での地域流行が確認されている。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・重症化の可能性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・流行しやすさが該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はTaiwan発の報告だが、Taiwanは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし、記事サマリーで Thailand、Vietnam、China の3カ国における同時流行が明記されており、これらは対象国リストに含まれるため対象とした。エンテロウイルス71は小児に対する重症化リスクが高く、複数国での同時流行は地域的な関心の高まりを示している。

article.articleHeadline: Cinq détenus suspectés d'Ebola s'évadent des centres de traitement en
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five detainees suspected of Ebola escape from treatment centres in.
article.articleSummary: Five detainees in Ituri, suspected of Ebola, escaped from treatment centers in Bunia and Rwampara between May 30 and June 1, 2026. Detected at Bunia Central Prison, the prisoners were moved to Bunia General Reference Hospital (two) and the Rwampara treatment center (three). A security lapse—no guards assigned to prevent contamination—enabled the escape; all five remain at large as of 2026-06-03, raising fears of community transmission in Bunia’s districts. The detainees had been relocated for medical care, with no confirmed Ebola diagnosis announced. The Bunia prison, with CICR support, has chlorine, handwashing stations, and infrared thermometers. MONUSCO plans a transit center for future suspected cases; CARITAS will train 25 peer educators among detainees to reinforce barrier precautions. Authorities prioritize rapid localization of the fugitives.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ地域でエボラ疑い患者である容疑者5名が治療センターから脱獄
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性と国際拡大リスク（2つ以上）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、流行可能性、管理可能性に複数該当。エボラウイルス病の疑い患者の脱獄による社会防御面での懸念が高く、早期のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い患者5名の脱獄事案は公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。セキュリティの失敗による脱獄であり、地域社会での感染拡大リスクが具体的に存在する。DRCはイトゥリ地域での過去のエボラ流行経験があり、国際的な支援が必要。記事サマリーではルワンダのキガリ州も地理的に言及されているが、記事の主題はDRC内でのイベントであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒門急診破5500人次！疾管署示警重症前兆 酒精消毒效果有限
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus Outpatient and Emergency Visits Exceed 5,500; Taiwan CDC Warns of Early Signs of Severe Illness, Alcohol-Based Disinfection Has Limited Effectiveness.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan: Enterovirus activity remains elevated. In week 21 (May 24–30, 2026), outpatient and emergency visits totaled 5,573, up 8.2% from 5,153 the prior week; no new severe cases or deaths were reported. Year to date, four enterovirus–associated severe cases have been confirmed, including one death: Enterovirus D68 (2), Coxsackie A4 (1), and Coxsackie A16 (1). Coxsackie A6 is the predominant community serotype, followed by A4 and D68. Children under 5 are the high‑risk group; parents and childcare workers should monitor for warning signs—lethargy, altered consciousness, reduced activity, limb weakness or paralysis, muscle twitching, persistent vomiting, or rapid breathing/tachycardia—and seek hospital care promptly. Prevention emphasizes handwashing and disinfection with 500 ppm sodium hypochlorite for general surfaces, and 1000 ppm for surfaces contaminated with secretions, with a 10‑minute contact time. Nearby Vietnam (>34,400 EV71 cases), Mainland China (>200,000, mainly A16), and Thailand (12,542) are also experiencing rises, with additional increases in Japan, Korea, and Hong Kong.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒門急診破5500人次！疾管署示警重症前兆 酒精消毒効果有限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。アジア地域での広域的エンテロウイルス流行の報告で、公衆衛生上の重要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはタイワンの状況を主題としているが、タイワンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ベトナム（EV71 34,400例以上）、中国本土（200,000例以上、主にA16）、タイ（12,542例）の広域的流行が報告されており、これら対象国3カ国を含める。日本、韓国、香港での増加も報告されているが、ここでは対象国のみ抽出。エンテロウイルス71および腸病毒症候群がアジア太平洋地域で多発している重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 2 Researchers Accused of Trying to Smuggle Mpox Virus Through U.S. Airport
article.articleSummary: Two NIH researchers, Vincent Munster (53, Netherlands) and Claude Kwe (38, Cameroon), are charged with conspiracy to smuggle mpox vials into the United States and giving false statements. They allegedly traveled from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, and on Jan. 25, 2026, attempted to bring 113 vials in a large case through Detroit Metropolitan Airport amid an active mpox outbreak there. CBP/FBI investigators found 113 vials in Styrofoam coolers; tests showed 17 contained deactivated mpox, one contained chickenpox, and two contained human DNA. Both worked for NIH at the Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Hamilton, Montana, in a Biosafety Level 4 lab studying emerging viral pathogens. They face up to five years in prison per count if convicted. Mpox spreads via close contact; there is no cure; vaccines and self-isolation are preventive.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の研究者が米国の空港でエムポックスウイルスを密輸しようとしたとして告発
triage.triage_reason: バイオセキュリティ脅威（感染症病原体の違法な国際移動）であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的懸念・規制措置のリスク）。米国でのエムポックス発生背景との組み合わせで高いシグナル価値。
triage.notes: 記事は米国での違法な病原体密輸未遂事件であり、発生地域としてDRCが確認（ブラザビル経由の密輸経路）。バイオセキュリティ・公衆衛生脅威として高いリスク。米国内での発生ではなく、DRCからの不正搬入未遂が主要なシグナル。対象国リスト外の米国での事件だが、DRCとの関連で該当。

article.articleHeadline: The secret code of defence: how our genes dictate who gets sick with tuberculosis - Doherty Institute
article.articleSummary: TB susceptibility linked to human genetic variation. In a Genome Medicine study, researchers pooled data from 12,736 pulmonary TB patients and 673,864 controls across East Asian and European populations, uncovering a susceptibility signal on chromosome 22q12.2. The sentinel variant rs6006426 relates to TB risk in both groups, a notable cross-ethnic replication given prior TB genetics issues. The team identified candidate genes SF3A1 and OSM; to test function, they used CRISPR-Cas9 to knock down osm in zebrafish embryos, which, after infection with a Mycobacterium tuberculosis relative, showed a significantly reduced burden, offering functional evidence of host-pathogen interaction. The work highlights the global underrepresentation of non-European populations in TB genomics, and points toward host-directed therapies and vaccines as future avenues. TB remains a major global burden, with rising drug-resistant strains exacerbating treatment challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 防御の秘密コード：我々の遺伝子が結核の発症を決定する方法 - ドーハティー研究所
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核の遺伝的易感染性に関する基礎研究論文の紹介であり、具体的な感染症の流行イベント、患者数の急増、アウトブレイク、または新規発症地域の報告ではない。学術的な知見提供が目的で、公衆衛生上の急性な対応を要しない。
triage.notes: 記事はゲノム研究の進展を扱う学術コンテンツであり、現行の感染症流行イベントではない。シャンハイは単に研究データセットに含まれる地域の参考情報として言及されているのみで、そこでの新規アウトブレイクや患者急増の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Duale to Explain Ebola Preparedness, US Deal Before National Assembly plenary
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale will brief the National Assembly on the country’s Ebola preparedness and clarify a reported U.S. arrangement on quarantining Americans exposed to the Ebola Bundibugyo virus. Duale and senior Health Ministry officials will address the government’s readiness and the proposed isolation centre in Nanyuki, Laikipia County, on June 3, 2026 at 2:30 P.M. Local time. Hundreds protested the Laikipia Airbase facility on June 1. The U.S. government has committed about $13.5 million toward Kenya's Ebola preparedness. On May 29, the High Court halted establishment, operation, or facilitation of Ebola exposure, quarantine, isolation, or treatment facilities in Kenya under arrangements with the U.S. pending a petition by Katiba Institute. U.S. CMS Administrator Mehmet Oz says diplomacy aims to secure medical support near the DRC, where the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak shows 321 confirmed cases, 116 suspected, and 48 confirmed deaths."} } } }}}} } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } }} } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } }

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ、国民議会本会議前にエボラ準備態勢と米国取引について説明へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo種）がDRC（対象国）で実際に発生しており、321確定例・48死亡が報告されている。ケニアはDRC隣接国として国際的なリスク軽減体制を検討中。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラBundibugyo種アウトブレイク（321確定例、48死亡）が記事の主題の感染症イベント。ケニアはDRCに隣接し、国際的な対策・米国支援を含む準備体制が進行中。ケニア国内での確定症例報告なし。米国はサポート国としての役割。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا المؤكدة في أوغندا إلى 15 حالة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda rise to 15.
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Ministry of Health reports six new laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, bringing the national total to 15 since the outbreak began in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. A single Ebola-related death has been recorded to date. The new cases indicate ongoing transmission linked to the cross-border outbreak, with authorities continuing containment and surveillance measures to prevent further spread within Uganda. The update, dated 3 June 2026, underscores ongoing public health actions including case finding, contact tracing, isolation, and risk communication to communities.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの確認されたエボラ患者数が15例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定的。エボラウイルス病は重篤度が高く、国際的拡大リスク・貿易制限リスクを有する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの確認患者数増加を主題としており、DRCからの国境を超えた患者流入を示唆している。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに直接含まれていないが、DRCは含まれている。ただし記事の主要な発生地はウガンダであるため、照会時点での注意が必要。エボラは世界保健機関の最優先病原体であり、IHR報告義務対象。

article.articleHeadline: 江西疾控联合南昌海关发布埃博拉健康提示：避免前往高风险地区
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jiangxi CDC and Nanchang Customs Issue Ebola Health Advisory: Avoid Travel to High-Risk Areas.
article.articleSummary: On May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. To prevent Ebola from entering Jiangxi Province, China, the Jiangxi Center for Disease Prevention and Control and Nanchang Customs issued a health advisory with four measures: 1) travelers from or with recent residence in affected countries should proactively declare health status and report travel and contact history at entry, and cooperate with temperature screening, epidemiological investigations, and medical checks if symptoms such as fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, rash, or unexplained bleeding appear; 2) 21-day self-monitoring for inbound travelers, including daily temperature checks and minimizing close contact; 3) seek prompt medical care, preferably after calling local CDC or community health centers; 4) avoid high-risk destinations and check current risk levels with customs or travel health services. China reports no Ebola cases and urges following official guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 江西疾控联合南昌海关发布埃博拉健康提示：避免前往高风险地区（江西疾病対策予防センターと南昌税関がエボラ出血熱の健康勧告を発表：高リスク地域への渡航を回避）
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO既に PHEIC 宣言済みであり、中国の対応通達として国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する中国（江西省）の対応通達。Bluedot APIが誤ってNanchang（南昌市）とJiangxi Sheng（江西省）を「発生地域」として付与しているが、実際のエボラ発症はDRCとウガンダであり、中国はまだ患者がいない状況。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。中国（1814991）はこの対応報告が出されている国として含める。WHO PHEIC 宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。

article.articleHeadline: Từ công cụ dò đường, Google Maps thành giải pháp giám sát dịch tễ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From a route-finding tool, Google Maps becomes an epidemiological surveillance solution.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever surveillance in Hanoi is enhanced by a pilot using Google Maps-based mapping and analytics to delineate outbreak areas, track case distribution, and monitor real-time trends. Begun July 2025 across 16 commune/ward health stations, the approach leverages free platforms Google Maps, Google My Maps, Google Sheets—so frontline staff can collect geolocated case data, classify risk areas, and share maps across units. Time to define outbreak boundaries fell from 2–4 hours to about 10–15 minutes, with satellite maps aiding identification of households, streets, and risk factors, enabling targeted vector control (larviciding), environmental sanitation, and insecticide spraying, and health education. It also supports rapid epidemiologic investigations and data export. The program led by Hanoi CDC included training at Long Biên Ward and has been shared with Cao Bằng Province for scaling, with plans to extend to additional diseases and broader city-wide surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 経路案内ツールから疫学的監視ソリューションへ：Google Mapsがベトナムのデング熱対策に活用
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのハノイでデング熱監視システムが強化されている技術的取り組みが報告されているが、新規発生やアウトブレイク、国際的な拡大リスクについての具体的情報が記事に含まれていない。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の監視システム改善に関する技術導入の報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや急激な患者増加の報告ではない。ただしデング熱は流行しやすい感染症であり、ベトナムにおいて継続的な曝露リスクがあることから、WPROスクリーニング基準2つに該当。ハノイおよびカオバン省での実施が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: فضيحة تهريب فيروس "جدري القردة" من إفريقيا إلى أمريكا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox virus smuggling scandal from Africa to America
article.articleSummary: Two American scientists, Vincent Monster, head of the Virus Environment Division at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, and Claude Kui, were charged in a Detroit federal complaint for conspiring to smuggle samples of Monkeypox virus from Africa to the United States and lying to airport investigators. They were halted at Detroit Metropolitan Airport in January after arriving from Paris following a nine-day trip to the Republic of the Congo. The case ties a Congo Monkeypox outbreak to more than 2,000 deaths in Congo, though authorities had earlier declared the two-year outbreak over in April. FBI investigators say Monster initially denied returning to the U.S. with materials or biological samples. Lab tests later showed vials containing inactivated Monkeypox virus, carried without disclosure or the required permits. An HHS OIG official warned that deliberate concealment of biological materials risks public trust and public safety.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカからアメリカへのサル痘ウイルス密輸スキャンダル
triage.triage_reason: 密輸事件として報道されているが、実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく刑事事件。対象国DRCでの現在の流行状況は不明で、米国での流行リスクも明示されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はサル痘ウイルスの違法密輸事件（刑事事件）であり、既存のアウトブレイク対応ではない。DRCでは過去に大規模流行があったが、当該記事では2024年4月に終息宣言されていると述べられている。インストゥティューショナルな生物防御・セキュリティ上の懸念は存在するが、感染症シグナルとしての優先度は相対的に低い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" المؤكدة في أوغندا إلى 15 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda to 15.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Uganda's Ministry of Health announced six newly confirmed Ebola virus disease infections, raising laboratory-confirmed cases in Uganda to 15 since the outbreak began in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. One Ebola-related death has been reported in Uganda to date, according to the ministry. Health authorities emphasise that containment and prevention of further transmission within the country remain a priority, with ongoing surveillance and response activities. The outbreak originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which borders Uganda, and the latest update reflects the continuing situation. No further details on case demographics or exposure settings were provided.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの確認済みエボラ患者数が15例に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は国際的に懸念される感染症であり、IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の国境越境拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、死亡者を伴う確認例の増加は重大なシグナルとしてフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認例が15例に増加し、死亡者が報告されている。DRCからの国境越境拡大が継続中であり、エボラウイルス病の高い伝播性と重症度を考慮するとリスク評価の優先順位が最も高い。ただし対象国リストでウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）が明示的に列挙されていないため、verified_locationsではDRC（203312）のみに限定することも考慮されるべき。しかし記事サマリーでウガンダが主題であり、確認例が報告されているため、同等のリスク地域として記載する。

article.articleHeadline: NIH Researchers Charged With Smuggling Monkeypox Vials Into US on Commercial Flight
article.articleSummary: NIH researchers Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, both based at Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Hamilton, Montana, were charged with conspiracy to smuggle monkeypox viral pathogens into the United States and lying to federal agents. They were intercepted at Detroit Metropolitan Airport on January 25, 2026, after arriving from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, where a monkeypox outbreak was active. Investigators found 113 vials packed inside Styrofoam coolers in a large black case. Of 20 vials tested by the FBI, 17 contained deactivated monkeypox virus, one contained chickenpox virus, and two contained human DNA. Both work in a Biosafety Level 4 lab researching emerging viral pathogens. Munster and Kwe each face a maximum five-year prison term; the investigation is led by the FBI Detroit Field Office with CBP assistance.

triage.headline_ja: NIH研究者がMonkeypoxバイアルを民間航空便で米国に密輸した罪で起訴
triage.triage_reason: Mpox（猿痘）の病原体密輸事件であり、バイオセキュリティ上の深刻な懸念、国際的な拡大リスク、異常事象が複合的に存在する。フルのRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はMonkeypox密輸事件であり、米国内での逮捕を主題としているが、出発地がコンゴ民主共和国（Brazzaville）の活発な猿痘アウトブレイク地域であるため、対象国はDRCのみに限定。バイオセキュリティ侵害、BSL-4施設での不正な病原体取扱い、国境を越える危険物輸送が複合的に関わっており、重大な感染症危機管理上の脅威と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria places 10 states on high alert over Ebola risk
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03, ten Nigerian states have been placed on high alert for Ebola virus disease due to ongoing outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) notes that Nigeria is at risk through international travel and cross-border movements associated with those outbreaks. No confirmed Ebola cases have been detected in Nigeria so far. In response, the federal government has instructed all state governments to intensify surveillance activities and strengthen emergency preparedness. The update underscores vigilance for potential imported cases and the need for rapid detection and response if suspected cases arise.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラウイルスのリスクを受け10州を高度警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響の可能性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準でも複数該当し、ウガンダ・DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクに対する地域的警戒体制の構築は重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではナイジェリアが主題だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。同様にウガンダ（226074）も対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。該当する対象国はDRC（203312）のみ。ただしナイジェリアでのアウトブレイク確認はまだ報告されていない一方で、地域的な警戒態勢構築は重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: House Raises the Alarm Over NCDC Funding Crisis, as Ebola Threat Looms
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s House of Representatives raises alarm over a crippling funding crisis at the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), warning preparedness to respond to Ebola and other epidemic-prone diseases is dangerously weakened. The motion cites that NCDC received no operational funding in 2025 and has not recorded capital releases against its 2026 budget, with irregular overhead and dwindling donor support. Vendors unpaid for over a year have stalled critical projects, including zonal laboratories, treatment centres, and isolation facilities, while resources for simulations, drills, and after-action reviews are exhausted. Amid a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Ituri Province, DRC, Africa CDC issued a May 15 warning; NCDC had placed Nigeria at high risk of Ebola importation on May 25, 2026. WHO’s Chikwe Ihekweazu said Nigeria is at low risk of an outbreak, with strengthened surveillance; no confirmed Ebola case has been registered in Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア下院、エボラ脅威が迫る中、NCDC資金危機について警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的拡大リスク（DRCでの発生、ナイジェリアへの侵入リスク）と、ナイジェリアの対応能力の深刻な低下が認識されており、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州でBundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）が発生中。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし、DRCからのウイルス侵入リスクの増加とナイジェリアの対応体制の著しい脆弱化が指摘されており、地域的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／防伊波拉新措施　石崇良：即起疫區2國入境可「免費採檢」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: New Ebola Prevention Measures — Shi Chongliang says entrants from two Ebola-affected countries can receive free testing, effective immediately.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan, in response to WHO declaring Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern since May 17, 2026, announces enhanced border measures. From 2026-06-03 to 2026-06-30, four international airports—Taipei Songshan Airport, Taoyuan International Airport, Taichung Airport, and Kaohsiung Airport—will offer free voluntary Ebola testing (5 ml of whole blood) to asymptomatic residents and inbound travelers with recent travel histories to DRC or Uganda. A 90-day entry ban for residents of the two countries remains, and entrants from affected regions must complete 21 days of self-health management. Symptomatic arrivals will be referred to contracted hospitals for medical evaluation with expedited border clearance. Daily health reporting via the national self-reporting system is required during the 21-day period. Violators face penalties under Taiwan’s Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Act.

triage.headline_ja: 速報／エボラ予防の新措置　石崇良：即日からエボラ流行地域の2国からの入国者は「無料検査」を受けられる
triage.triage_reason: DRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクがWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当。台湾が検疫強化措置を導入した国際的な対応事例として、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要イベントはDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクであり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。台湾の検疫措置は対応事例であり、台湾はWPRO対象国ではないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）が確認されており、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: AS lengkapi bandara dengan alat uji Ebola jelang Piala Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. equips airports with Ebola testing equipment ahead of the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: US equips airports with Ebola testing equipment ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026, co-hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico from June 11 to July 19, 2026. White House remarks by Administrator Mehmet Oz say testing tools and procedures have been installed at key airports to prevent Ebola transmission. Oz expressed confidence in Jay Bhattacharya’s ability to prevent Ebola entry and infection in the US. On May 15, WHO declared Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a health emergency of international concern. As of May 31, DRC had 210 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, about 350 suspected cases under investigation, and 16 health workers infected. Ebola is a zoonotic disease that spreads to humans via contact with blood, secretions, or contaminated materials; fatality averages around 50%, historically up to 90%. The 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic infected over 28,600 people and killed 11,325. Source: Sputnik.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がワールドカップ前に空港にエボラ検査機器を配備
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが5月15日にDRC・ウガンダのエボラ発生を国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言しており、米国・カナダ・メキシコでのワールドカップ開催に伴う国際的な拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生が明記されており、米国・カナダ・メキシコでの検査機器配備は予防措置。Bluedot APIから取得した発生地域にはAngola、Uganda、Canadaも含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ発生とその国際的影響であるため、verified_locationsはDRC(203312)のみを列挙。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Quarantines 37 Returnees From DRC as Ebola Preparedness Enters High Alert
article.articleSummary: Kenya raises Ebola preparedness to high alert after quarantining 37 Kenyans returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Contingency measures include shared quarantine facilities, strengthened surveillance, isolation capacity, and coordination with international partners to prevent importation of Ebola. The Laikipia Ebola facility will function as a quarantine site for Kenyans and foreigners, not only Americans, and will expand Kenya’s overall response capacity. Authorities quarantined 37 travelers from Congo amid sustained concerns about Ebola transmission in the DRC; several are business executives involved in mining and logistics with Kenyan banks operating in the DRC. More than 2,200 health workers have received training to respond to possible Ebola cases; Oluga noted his own 2013 training at the Rwanda-DRC border alongside 90 Kenyan doctors. He urged public reporting of suspected cases and dismissed worries about the US-Kenya Ebola arrangement as exaggerated.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがコンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者37名を隔離、エボラ対策が高度警戒態勢へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国境を超えた移入リスクが現実化しており、複数国での予防的対応が実施されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCでのエボラ感染が継続中であり、ケニアが帰国者隔離と高度警戒態勢を発動している。米国は発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事の主題はDRCとケニアの状況であるため、米国は除外した。ルワンダも地域リストに含まれているが、サマリーでは過去の訓練例言及のみで、現在の発生地域としては言及されていないため除外した。国際的なパートナーシップ動員も確認され、緊急対応が進行中である。

article.articleHeadline: 'If Ebola comes, we'll be wiped out': fear grips camps in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province near Bunia, threatening the Kingonze displacement camp of 25,000+ residents. As of May 31, the World Health Organization reports 321 confirmed DRC cases with 48 deaths, and nine confirmed Ugandan cases including one death. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or treatment; containment hinges on protective measures and rapid contact tracing. Camp conditions heighten transmission risk: a single borehole with limited water, scarce soap and protective gear, no isolation tents, and crowded tarpaulin shelters. The outbreak was declared May 15 in DRC and neighboring Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros warned of a catastrophic collision of disease and conflict, urging urgent international aid. With nearly 970,000 displaced in Ituri across about 61 camps, authorities stress rapid deployment of equipment and qualified medical staff to prevent further spread, including cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが来たら、私たちは滅びるだろう：コンゴ民主共和国の難民キャンプに広がる恐怖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外のイベント、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべて該当。エボラアウトブレイクは最高リスク疾患であり、複数国での確認、死亡例、難民キャンプという脆弱環境での急速な拡大リスク、国際支援の急務が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの事例は9件と限定的であり、主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）である。Bundibugyo株はワクチンや治療法が存在しないため、リスクが特に高い。難民キャンプ（25,000人以上）での水・衛生・医療リソースの極度の不足により、急速な拡大と制御困難性が懸念される。WHOレベルでの警告と国際支援要請が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Trump Asked, I Said Yes": Ruto Explains Why He Approved the Laikipia Ebola Quarantine Deal
article.articleSummary: Kenya's President William Ruto defended hosting a U.S.-backed Ebola quarantine/isolation center at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki, arguing the move strengthens long-standing partnership as Ebola vigilance rises beyond DRC and Uganda where cases have been detected. Ruto notes Kenya operates 23 emergency response facilities nationwide to screen, isolate, and treat suspected Ebola cases to prevent spread. Meanwhile, protests in Nanyuki over the planned facility led to clashes reportedly causing two deaths (one gunshot near Laikipia Airbase; another death announced by hospital). The High Court issued conservatory orders blocking establishment or operation of any Ebola exposure, quarantine, isolation, or treatment facility involving the United States or foreign entity, requiring full disclosure of terms, protocols, and approvals. The court will hear the petition.

triage.headline_ja: 「トランプが尋ねた、私はイエスと言った」：ルト大統領がラキピア・エボラ隔離施設承認の理由を説明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的に最も重大な感染症の一つであり、DRC及びウガンダでの事例検出に続き、ケニアが隔離・治療施設を整備している状況は異常かつ予想外である。国際的な拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、政治的関心が高く、IHR基準及びWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域フィールドには複数国（ケニア、ウガンダ、米国を含む）が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題は『DRC及びウガンダでのエボラ事例検出に対応したケニアの隔離施設整備』である。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ケニア、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。地域検証ルールに基づき verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。エボラ出血熱の重大性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、政治的関心の高さからPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Today's Disease Outbreaks Are Warnings Local Leaders Can't Ignore
article.articleSummary: South Atlantic cruise hantavirus cluster killed three passengers and is being traced across 20 countries, while the WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. The piece argues these emergencies reveal deep cracks in the health system, worsened by proposed or debated CDC budget cuts that critics say erode prevention and shift risk to states and localities. It urges local leaders to act with four steps: restructure the command chain so the emergency manager reports to the chief executive; merge emergency management with public health leadership to enable real-time decisions; fill the information void with clear, timely messaging through trusted channels; and ensure genuine community engagement, especially for rural, older, low-income, disabled and immigrant communities. It notes misinformation is a major problem (70% of Americans) and calls for preparedness and risk communications to earn trust before crises.

triage.headline_ja: 今日の感染症アウトブレイクは地域リーダーが無視できない警告である
triage.triage_reason: EbolaMajor Outbreak宣言（PHEIC）による国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念、及びハンタウイルス感染症の多国間での拡大（20ヶ国での追跡）により、IHR基準を複数満たし、国際的な対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRCとウガンダのEbolaアウトブレイクがPHEIC宣言されたと述べられている。ハンタウイルスはニュージャージー州での船舶関連クラスターと記載されるが、発生地域としてはUSAであり、対象国リストにはUSAが含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。ウガンダも同様に対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCのみを対象国として認定。両疾患とも重大な国際的懸念を示しており、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 衛福部部長石崇良視察桃園國際機場邊境檢疫聯防作業 宣布自6月3日起至6月30日 提供剛果民主共和國及烏干達入境無症狀旅客免費採檢 - 政府消息新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minister of Health and Welfare Shih Chung-liang Inspects Taoyuan International Airport Border Quarantine Joint Defense Operations, Announces Free Testing for Asymptomatic Travelers Entering from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda from June 3 to June 30 - Government News - PChome Online News
article.articleSummary: Taiwan expands border Ebola surveillance following WHO's May 17 PHEIC for Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. From June 3–30, 2026, asymptomatic travelers with travel history to DRC or Uganda at four international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung—are offered free, voluntary Ebola testing. Tests involve a 5 ml whole-blood sample collected in HEPA-equipped rooms by quarantine officers in PPE. Symptomatic travelers will be directed to contracted hospitals for medical care with expedited clearance. The measure, guided by a June 2 expert meeting, aims to enhance border monitoring and early case detection. Incoming travelers are advised to avoid Ebola-affected regions and to daily self-report health status for 21 days via the national e-reporting system; contact 1922 if symptoms develop. Non-compliance may incur penalties under the Infectious Disease Control Act.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾衛生福祉部長が桃園国際空港の国境検疫共同防御業務を視察、2026年6月3日から6月30日までコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダからの入国無症状旅客への無料検査提供を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のWHO PHEIC発表に基づく台湾の能動的な検査拡大措置であり、スクリーニング基準（異常/予想外の対応、ヒト-ヒト感染対応）に該当。ただし台湾は対象国外であり、実際の発生国（DRC、ウガンダ）での新規事例や重症度の情報が記事に欠けているため、フルRRA前の継続観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダのエボラ発生に対する台湾の国境検疫強化策を報道しているが、記事本文がないため詳細不明。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国外であるため除外。台湾での実際の患者発生報告はない（検査拡大のみ）。WHO PHEIC発表（2026年5月17日）の記述があり、グローバルレベルでの関心が確認できる。続報での DRC/ウガンダでの新規患者数、死亡数、重症度情報の入手が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Le conseil santé - Ebola en RDC : qu'est-ce que la souche Bundibugyo implique en termes de symptômes ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health advice - Ebola in the DRC: what symptoms are associated with the Bundibugyo strain?
article.articleSummary: On May 15, the Democratic Republic of Congo declared its 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak, centered in Ituri province in the northeast near the Ugandan and South Sudanese borders. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no approved vaccine. The discussion asks whether this strain changes case management and when a vaccine might be available. Dr. Christophe Rapp, an infectious disease specialist at the American Hospital of Paris and president of the French Society of Travel Medicine, is featured in the interview. The piece centers on symptoms associated with Bundibugyo and the public health response, with considerations for transmission control and outbreak management. The full program is linked under the title Ebola outbreak in DRC: breaking the transmission chain.

triage.headline_ja: 保健助言 - コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：ブンディブギョ株はどのような症状を引き起こすか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱の新規アウトブレイクで、複数国への二次感染リスクあり。
triage.notes: フランス・パリの地理情報が含まれているが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国のアウトブレイクであり、パリでの実際の発生を示唆する情報はない（医療専門家の所在地であるため除外）。ウガンダは接する隣国で二次感染リスクがあるが、記事サマリーでは実際の確認例は述べられていないため verified_locations には含めない。ブンディブギョ株はエボラウイルスの稀な株で、ワクチン未承認という点で管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Reopens Bunia Airport As Ebola Screening Measures Begin
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, DR Congo, with Bunia airport reopened as screening begins. Flights resume with health screening at departure and arrival; passengers subjected to temperature checks; those with fever barred. Outbreak has spread across several health areas in Ituri; 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths; virus reaches 15 of 36 health zones. WHO director-general visited; noted some progress including recoveries, but called for more testing and treatment capacity. Health workers say outbreak started weeks before confirmation; aid groups warn transmission may be wider than reported; International Rescue Committee says transmission may have continued for months before detection. Authorities continue monitoring movement and health conditions as response continues. As of 3 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がブニア空港を再開、エボラ出血熱スクリーニング対策開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例321例・死亡48例を含む進行中の大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、管理可能性の問題（WHO介入、国際支援要請）が顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイトゥリ州（Ituri）ブニア（Bunia）地域におけるDRコンゴ領内のエボラアウトブレイクを報告。確認症例321例、死亡48例、15/36保健地域に拡大。空港再開に伴う国際往来の再開がリスク増加要因。WHO事務局長が現地訪問し、検査・治療能力の強化を求めている点から国際的な支援ニーズが明確。

article.articleHeadline: Corrientes coordina acciones de prevención y vigilancia del Ébola por un caso compatible en Santa Fe Argentina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Corrientes coordinates Ebola prevention and surveillance actions for a suspected case in Santa Fe, Argentina.
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Corrientes (Argentina) coordinates prevention and surveillance for a suspected case in Santa Fe, following a foreign-ship crew member who presented Ebola-compatible symptoms on arrival at San Lorenzo port. A working meeting led by Health Minister Emilio Lanari Zubiaur focused on updating infection-control guidelines and strengthening epidemiological surveillance to prepare the health system for international contingencies. Authorities reviewed stocks of supplies, transport logistics, and care protocols, and established specimen referral and treatment circuits pending national directives. Epidemiology Director Angelina Bobadilla stated that the Americas’ alert level is currently low and reviewed the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, reiterating notification, isolation, and triage criteria under OPS guidelines. Ebola is a viral disease with a 2–21 day incubation; transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; management relies on isolation and supportive care, with no mass-usable vaccine or universally approved specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コリエンテス州がエボラ対策の予防・監視活動を調整。サンタフェ州で疑い患者が発見（アルゼンチン）
triage.triage_reason: 異国の船員による疑い患者の報告により異常/予想外性とIHR基準における国際的拡大リスクが示唆される。しかし確定患者ではなく、確認できる追加情報（死亡、重症者数、ヒト-ヒト感染の実証）が限定的であり、アメリカ大陸では警戒レベルが低いとの公式見解があるため、現段階では継続的な監視が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域のうち、DRC（203312）とウガンダは参考情報（既存のエボラ発生状況の言及）であり、本記事の主題ではない。アルゼンチンはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。外国船員による輸入例の可能性があり、IHR基準・スクリーニング基準で複数該当するが、疑い患者段階であること、および地理的リスクが対象地域外であることから、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola....
article.articleSummary: Climate change expands disease vectors into new regions, including Spain, where five deaths have occurred from Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever transmitted by Hyalomma marginatum ticks. Lyme disease caused by Borrelia burgdorferi is now reported in Galicia, linked to Ixodes ricinus ticks, a shift from previously southern areas. The author warns that malaria could re-emerge, alongside risks of dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and other tropical pathogens. Ebola remains a major concern: Congo is experiencing renewed outbreaks with the virus spreading to more parts of Africa; in one major outbreak, Ebola reached a city with an international airport, heightening global spread risk, and about 80% of contacts cannot be located. Marburg fever is also noted as a high-lethality hemorrhagic disease. The piece emphasizes the need for investment in research and public health, even when not immediately profitable.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ... （気候変動と感染症ベクターの拡大に関する意見記事）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイク、国際空港での確認、接触者追跡困難（80%未発見）は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン（Galicia、CCHF症例5名、Lyme病の出現）やアフリカ全域の事例を言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。エボラの「再発生（renewed outbreaks）」、国際空港への到達、接触者追跡の失敗（80%未発見）は、国際的な感染リスクが極めて高い状況を示唆している。スペインでの疾患出現（CCHF、Lyme）は気候変動による媒介生物の地理的拡大を示しており、今後のグローバルリスク評価に重要だが、現時点の対象国リストではスペイン（EU）は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Government signs off a plan to wipe out bovine TB from New Zealand cattle and possums by 2040 - NEWS WIRE
article.articleSummary: New Zealand will eradicate bovine tuberculosis from cattle, deer, and wild brushtail possums by 2040 under a National Pest Management Plan approved 3 June 2026. Only 16 infected herds remain nationwide, down from thousands in the 1990s. Possums are the main wildlife reservoir; plan targets eradicating TB from possums and livestock in hot spots: central North Island, Hawke's Bay, Otago. Annual cost about NZ$60 million for five years, funded 60% by farmers and 40% by government; administered by OSPRI through its TBfree programme. A shift to targeted surveillance replaces blanket herd testing, using data and technology to focus testing where risk is highest, reducing farmer disruption. Progress will be reviewed before 2031 to determine funding for later stages. Reaching 2040 milestone would position NZ among a few countries TB-free in wildlife; importance for export values and farm livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: ニュージーランド政府、2040年までに牛TB（ウシ結核）を家畜とオポッサムから撲滅する計画に署名 - NEWS WIRE
triage.triage_reason: 動物の牛結核の撲滅管理計画であり、公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響（ヒト感染）は記事に示されていない。撲滅計画段階であり、異常な疾病流行ではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippines(1694008)とNew Zealand(2186224)が記載されているが、記事サマリーはニュージーランドの牛結核撲滅計画に焦点を当てており、フィリピンは主題ではない。ニュージーランドは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。本件は動物疾病の管理計画であり、ヒト感染症の危機対応ではないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا يلغي مباراة ودية في إسبانيا!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus cancels a friendly match in Spain!
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, Ebola forces Spain to cancel a June 9 friendly between Chile and the Democratic Republic of Congo in La Línea de la Concepción, Andalusia, as a precaution amid an Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Mayor Juan Franco cites a health department report and regional guidance. The Congo squad, gearing up for World Cup 2026 in the United States, Mexico and Canada, had planned another Europe warm-up and was scheduled to play Denmark in Liège, Belgium. In the World Cup, DRC is in Group 11 with Colombia, Portugal and Uzbekistan. May 21 report notes Congo scrapped its Kinshasa training camp and moved to Belgium. May 23, the White House said the team would enter a 21-day isolation bubble to avoid Ebola if traveling to the United States. Mexican airlines joined US-Canada precautionary travel restrictions for travelers from Ebola-affected African nations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがスペインの親善試合をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当（2つ以上）。エボラ出血熱の発生国（DRC）からの国際的な人の移動に伴う感染リスク管理が国際的な関心を呼んでおり、複数国での予防措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主な関心事はDRCでのエボラ流行。スペイン、ベルギー、米国、カナダ、メキシコなど複数国が記載されているが、実際の感染発生地はDRCであり、他国は予防的な旅行制限・隔離措置の実施国。対象国リストからDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تسجّل 15 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس 'إيبولا'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda records 15 confirmed cases of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports 15 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases as of 3 June 2026, with six new infections today and one death to date, in an outbreak linked to the neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Ministry of Health says containment is being intensified through enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and heightened preparedness at health facilities to prevent further spread. Cross-border transmission concerns remain due to recurring Ebola activity near Uganda and the DRC. Ebola is described as a viral disease with high fatality, transmitted by direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces. The report notes ongoing monitoring of contacts and readiness in facilities; there are no details on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラウイルスの確認症例15件を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラは高致命率のシグナル疾患であり、DRCとの境界での発生のため国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例報告が主題だが、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダはEBOs活動対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただし、DRC関連イベントとしてシグナル価値は高い。エボラ発生（特にDRC関連）は高い社会的・政治的関心と国際的サポート需要を持つ。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉防疫再升級！ 全台4國際機場即起提供「免費採血」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola prevention measures upgraded again! Four international airports across Taiwan will begin offering free blood sampling immediately.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan upgrades Ebola border controls. From June 3–30, four international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan International, Taichung International, and Kaohsiung International—will offer free whole-blood Ebola testing (5 mL) to asymptomatic travelers with travel history to the Democratic Republic of Congo or Uganda. Testing is voluntary and conducted by quarantine officers in PPE in HEPA-equipped rooms. This follows WHO declaring Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda a PHEIC on May 17, with Taiwan tightening border measures since May 27. Previously, entry of residents with travel history from the DRC or Uganda was suspended for 90 days, with 21 days of self-health management required. Symptomatic returnees will be referred to contracted hospitals; asymptomatic travelers must report daily health status via the Public Active E-Reporting System during the 21-day period. Suspected cases should contact quarantine staff or call 1922. Legal penalties: NT$10,000–150,000 fines.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱防疫対策が再度強化！台湾の4つの国際空港で無料採血検査を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱は重要な感染症だが、記事の主題は台湾の検疫強化措置であり、実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストに台湾は含まれず、DRCは対象国だが記事の主眼は台湾の対応であるため、情報不足で経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾の検疫強化措置であり、実際のエボラ熱発生地はDRCとウガンダ。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれる。WHO PHEIC宣言（5月17日）後の周辺国の対応事例であり、本体イベント（DRC/ウガンダでの発生）の詳細情報が不足しているため、WATCHレベルの判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情升溫！2國旅客入境 4大機場即起免費採血篩檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak intensifies! Free blood testing and screening at four major airports for inbound travelers from two countries, starting immediately.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak intensifies in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. WHO designated a PHEIC on May 17. Taiwan’s CDC announced border measures from today through June 30: at four international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan International, Taichung, and Kaohsiung—for asymptomatic travelers with travel histories to DRC or Uganda. In addition to the Self-Health Management advisory, free whole-blood testing (5 ml) will be offered on a voluntary basis in HEPA-equipped testing rooms. Symptomatic travelers from these regions will be referred to contracted hospitals for medical evaluation with expedited border clearance. The national travel advisory level remains Level 3 “Warning”; avoid travel to Ebola-affected areas. Returnees must report daily health status for 21 days via the E-Return system; if fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or bleeding occurs, contact the 1922 hotline. Penalties for non-compliance: NT$10,000–NT$150,000 under the Infectious Disease Prevention Act.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が加熱！2カ国からの来航者に4大空港で無料採血スクリーニングを即座に実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC指定済みのDRC・ウガンダのエボラ感染症の継続流行に対し、台湾が国境検疫措置を講じている状況。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の流行地域（DRC、ウガンダ）からの輸入症例防止を目的とした台湾の対応策を報じている。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはIHR基準3項目以上該当し、WHO PHEIC(2026年5月17日指定)が既に発令されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค ยัน ไม่พบสัญญาณบ่งชี้ โควิด NB.1.8.1 รุนแรงกว่าสายพันธุ์ที่เคยระบาด ก่อนหน้านี้
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Department of Disease Control confirms that there are no signs indicating that COVID-19 NB.1.8.1 is more severe than previously circulating strains.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Department of Disease Control reports no evidence that the SARS-CoV-2 NB.1.8.1 variant causes more severe COVID-19 than previously circulating strains. As of 2 June 2026, 4,156 new COVID-19 cases and 1 death were recorded; the most affected age group is 30–39, followed by those 60+ and 20–29. Genomic surveillance (Jan 1, 2025 to Apr 23, 2026) shows NB.1.8.1 as the dominant lineage in Thailand (50.95%), with JN.1 (24.97%) and XEC (9.14%) also present; NB.1.8.1 has mutations that may enhance transmissibility and immune evasion. Current data do not indicate more severe disease or higher mortality risk compared with earlier strains. Most infections resemble common respiratory illness (fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose). Thailand uses 26 hospital surveillance units; samples are analyzed, and Department of Medical Sciences conducts further lineage and risk assessments. Public health measures emphasize hygiene, masks in crowded places, and protection for high-risk groups; hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省、COVID-19 NB.1.8.1変異株が従来株より重症化するという兆候はないと確認
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるCOVID-19 NB.1.8.1変異株は、従来株と比較して重症度の上昇は認められず、公衆衛生上の新たな脅威を示していない。感染症管理は継続されており、制御可能な状況である。
triage.notes: タイでの定期的な感染者報告（日々4,156件の新規感染）は既知の継続流行であり、NB.1.8.1が優位株（50.95%）であることも報告されているが、記事の主要メッセージは「より重症ではない」という安心情報である。これは新規シグナルではなく、既知のウイルス系統の監視継続報告と位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria put 10 states on alert due to the Ebola threat
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo has prompted Nigeria to place 10 states on high alert as of 2026-06-03. No confirmed Ebola cases have been detected in Nigeria to date, but authorities have ramped up surveillance and emergency preparedness. The outbreak has recorded over 1,000 suspected cases and 247 deaths, with young and middle-aged individuals most affected. The Bundibugyo strain carries no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission is via contact with the blood and other body fluids of infected people, not airborne. Nigeria's state-of-alert includes Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba, and Adamawa (high risk) and Kaduna, Katsina, Bauchi, Plateau (moderate risk). The Emergency Operations Centre is activated; states must submit preparedness reports within 72 hours. Early diagnosis, contact tracing and rapid isolation are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラの脅威により10州にアラートを発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の流行がウガンダとコンゴで発生し、ナイジェリアが10州に高度警戒態勢を敷いている。IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（247死亡、1,000以上の疑い例）・流行リスク（ヒト-ヒト感染）に該当する。フルRRAの実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ（Bundibugyo株）の複数国流行。ナイジェリアでは確認患者なしだが、10州への警戒態勢と対応体制の整備が進行中。DRCとウガンダでの確認患者・死亡報告あり。Emergency Operations Centreが起動しており、政府対応が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: В США двум исследователям предъявили обвинения в контрабанде вируса оспы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the United States, two researchers were charged with trafficking the smallpox virus.
article.articleSummary: Two NIH lab personnel, Vincent Munster (Dutch) and Claude Kwe (Cameroonian), based in Montana, were charged with conspiring to import deactivated smallpox (variola) virus and giving false statements. Prosecutors say they traveled on a commercial flight from Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo, to the United States, arriving at Detroit Metropolitan Airport with a black plastic case claimed to hold diagnostic equipment. Border officers found 113 vials; FBI says some contained variola virus, one contained varicella (chickenpox) virus, and two contained human DNA. The virus reportedly was deactivated and could not infect cells. If convicted, the researchers face up to five years in prison. NIH says it is cooperating with investigators and has implemented safety measures. The incident underscores the importance of strict import controls and lab biosafety when handling potential pathogen materials.

triage.headline_ja: 米国で2人の研究者がウイルス密輸容疑で起訴—天然痘ウイルスの違法持ち込み事件
triage.triage_reason: 天然痘ウイルスの違法密輸という異常・予想外かつ深刻なバイオセキュリティインシデント。複数のIHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当し、国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 天然痘ウイルスはWHO規制病原体であり、その違法密輸・不正取扱いは極めて重大なバイオセキュリティ脅威。記事サマリーでは米国Montana州のNIH研究員によるコンゴ共和国Brazzaville発米国Detroit到着での密輸事件を報道している。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。事件地がMontana（米国）であるが、米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に追加されない。ただし事件の重大性、公開情報の拡散、バイオセーフティ上の懸念は明白であり、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تسجّل 6 إصابات جديدة بالإيبولا والإجمالي يرتفع إلى 15 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda records 6 new Ebola cases, total rises to 15.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Uganda reports six additional lab-confirmed Ebola cases, bringing its total to 15 since the outbreak began in neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC); one death has occurred in Uganda. In the DRC, health authorities confirm 321 Ebola cases and 48 deaths, with 116 suspected cases under investigation. World Health Organization spokesperson Christian Lindmeinier warns that a decrease in suspected cases in eastern DRC does not necessarily reflect full outbreak control, noting it may reflect improved surveillance and greater care-seeking. The WHO has indicated the eastern DRC outbreak likely started about two months before detection, with the circulating strain identified as Bundibugyo, a rare form of Ebola. The report underscores cross-border transmission risk and the ongoing containment efforts across Uganda and the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラの新規感染6件を報告、累計15件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。確認患者数321件、死亡48件、複数国への越境感染、WHOの警告あり。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは発生地がDRC（321例、48死亡）でありウガンダへの越境感染（15例、1死亡）を明確に述べている。対象国リストではDRCは203312、ウガンダは1269750として認識。Bundibugyo株（珍しい型）が確認され、2ヶ月前の潜在的な開始を示唆。WHOは監視改善による疑い例減少の警告を発している。

article.articleHeadline: IOM serukan penguatan koordinasi lintas batas tekan wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IOM calls for strengthening cross-border coordination to contain the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompts IOM to urge stronger cross-border coordination. As of 2 June 2026, Congo reports over 300 confirmed Ebola cases and 48 deaths, while Uganda has 15 confirmed cases and 1 death. The DRC outbreak, announced on 15 May, is the 17th documented there and the third-largest on record, underscoring its persistent threat. IOM warns that border closures risk driving people into informal, less-monitored travel, hampering health checks, surveillance, contact tracing, and early detection. It advocates coordinated action that maintains mobility with visibility and safety at crossings. Several countries have restricted travel/visa access for residents from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; Rwanda and Uganda have also limited cross-border movement with neighboring states. The message: a unified, cross-border response is essential.

triage.headline_ja: IOM、エボラ出血熱の蔓延を抑制するための越境調整の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持つ既知の脅威であり、複数国での確認例、国際的な渡航制限措置、越境感染リスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、エボラ出血熱の主要な発生地はDRC（300例以上、48死亡）およびウガンダ（15例、1死亡）である。Bluedot APIはウガンダ、スーダン、ルワンダも発生地域として列挙しているが、サマリーではDRCとウガンダが主要な発生地であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsではDRCのみを記載。スーダンとルワンダも対象国リストに含まれていない。複数国での越境感染リスク、各国による渡航制限措置の実施、IOMによる国際的調整呼びかけなど、国際対応が既に動いている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Afrika sərhədlərini aşdı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola crossed Africa's borders.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Cumulative figures show 282 infections and 42 deaths, with Africa CDC reporting over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. WHO notes there is currently no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; however, strong supportive care and early intervention improve survival. Four nurses and one laboratory worker treated in the outbreak have recovered and been discharged. Cross-border concerns led Brazil and Italy to activate special health protocols after travelers with potential exposure returned from the DRC. In Brazil (São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro), two febrile patients initially suspected of meningitis or malaria remain under Ebola investigation. In Italy’s Sardinia, a returnee with Ebola symptoms prompted urgent protocols; tests were negative but monitoring continues. The episode—DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak and among the largest—highlights delayed international response and border risks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカの国境を越えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも3項目該当（重症度・長期曝露・流行可能性）。DRC発のエボラ流行が複数国に波及する国際的事象であり、WHO報告の大規模流行である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはブラジル（São Paulo、Rio de Janeiro）とイタリア（Sardegna）も含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらは「DRCからの帰還者の接触調査」であり、確認された流行地ではない。検査結果は陰性またはなお調査中で、患者数の確定もない。したがってverified_locationsはDRC（対象国リスト）のみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉 具疫區2國旅遊史無症狀入境者免費採檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To prevent Ebola: Free testing for asymptomatic entrants with travel history to two outbreak countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) prevention in Taiwan: from June 2 to June 30, 2026, free testing is offered at four international airports (Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung) to asymptomatic residents or incoming travelers with travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda. Health Minister Shih Chung-liang announced the measure during an inspection at Taoyuan Airport; the activity is voluntary, with quarantine officers using HEPA-equipped rooms to collect 5 ml of whole blood for testing. Entrants who are symptomatic will follow an established medical pathway with contracted hospitals and border agencies to expedite care and clearance. Separately, since May 29, the government has suspended entry for residents of DRC and Uganda for 90 days, with four humanitarian exemptions. The program aims to strengthen border surveillance as the Ebola outbreak worsens.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの防止：2つの流行国への旅行歴を持つ無症状入国者向けの無料検査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは高い致死率を持つ感染症であり、国際的拡大リスクも潜在的に高い。しかし記事サマリーは台湾の予防的措置（スクリーニングと入国制限）に焦点を当てており、台湾内でのエボラ患者の実際の発生やアウトブレイクは報告されていない。記事は対象国（DRC、Uganda）での流行の悪化を述べているのみで、対象国リスト外である台湾での対応を記述している。情報が限定的であり、実際の患者発生状況が不明なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾の予防対策の実施を報告しているが、台湾は評価対象国リストに含まれていない。実際のエボラ発生地は対象国リスト内のDRCとUgandaであり、これらは記事サマリーで流行の悪化が述べられている。台湾内での患者発生報告はなく、台湾は入国者スクリーニングの強化を実施している段階。IHR基準では複数該当するが、実患者情報の不足と対象国での実際の状況把握の必要性から、継続的な経過観察が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola: se redujo la cifra de casos sospechosos en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the number of suspected cases in Africa has fallen.
article.articleSummary: WHO reduced suspected Ebola cases in Central Africa from 906 to 116, with 330 confirmed infections. By May 31, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reported 116 suspected cases, down from 906 at the end of the previous week. In total, 321 cases were confirmed in the DRC, including 48 deaths, while neighboring Uganda had 9 confirmed cases with 1 death. Although some suspected cases were confirmed, many were ruled out after testing as symptoms overlapped with other illnesses or non-Ebola fevers. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri province, in northeastern DRC. Bunia airport—the capital of Ituri and the only facility granting humanitarian access to the outbreak epicenter—reopened on Tuesday, enabling a gradual, safe resumption of flights. WHO spokesperson Christian Lindmeier noted that anyone presenting compatible symptoms remains a suspected case pending test results.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：アフリカでの疑い例の数が減少
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCで321確認例・48死亡、ウガンダへの国際的拡大確認。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの拡大が記載されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国である。2026年のイベント日付は未来の仮想シナリオと考えられるが、情報内容に基づき評価を実施。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と感染力を有し、すべての評価基準で懸念が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรคยันโควิด 19 สายพันธุ์ NB.1.8.1 ไม่พบก่อโรครุนแรง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control confirms that the COVID-19 variant NB.1.8.1 does not appear to cause severe illness.
article.articleSummary: Thailand confirms COVID-19 variant NB.1.8.1 has mutations that may increase transmissibility and immune evasion, but epidemiological and clinical data show no evidence of more severe illness or higher mortality than earlier strains. Most cases resemble common respiratory infections: fever, cough, sore throat, and runny nose. Thailand monitors respiratory diseases via 26 hospital surveillance networks, with systematic testing of suspected cases; if unusual signals or viral changes arise, the Department of Medical Science conducts deeper strain typing and risk assessment to guide response. Surveillance tracks cases, clusters, and viral evolution to enable prompt action. No signs of a widescale outbreak or increased severity; COVID-19 remains year-round, especially during the rainy season when indoor gatherings rise. Public guidance: maintain hygiene, wear masks in crowded or when ill, and screen for fever, cough, sore throat, or runny nose; avoid close contact with high-risk groups (608): elderly, those with underlying conditions, and pregnant women.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健当局がCOVID-19変異株NB.1.8.1は重症化しないと確認
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19変異株NB.1.8.1が検出されたが、タイの保健当局が重症化の証拠がないと明確に確認しており、既存株と比較して重大度の上昇は認められない。通常の監視下での情報発表であり、緊急対応を要する基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: タイは通常のCOVID-19監視活動の枠組みで新規変異株を検出・評価している。重症度、入院率、死亡率いずれについても既存株との差異は報告されていない。定期的な疾病監視報告のレベルであり、シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: "에볼라 공포'에 결국..." 스페인 시장, 콩고-칠레 평가전 '전격 취소' 명령...콩고,52년만의 본선행 직후 최악의 상황
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "'Ebola fear' finally... Spanish mayor orders the abrupt cancellation of the Congo-Chile friendly... Congo's worst situation immediately after clinching their first World Cup finals appearance in 52 years."
article.articleSummary: DR Congo and Chile’s scheduled final warm-up in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, was canceled due to Ebola spread concerns in DR Congo. The Spanish mayor prohibited the June 9 match after health authorities flagged infection risks; La Línea de la Concepción—a coastal town of about 65,000 near the Gibraltar border—would have hosted the test before the World Cup. DR Congo canceled its training camp in Kinshasa and established a temporary camp in Belgium; the squad is composed entirely of players at overseas clubs, though some staff and supporters would travel from DR Congo to Spain, prompting the precaution. The eastern DR Congo Ebola strain is Bundibugyo, a rare variant with no available vaccine; the WHO warns vaccine development could take up to nine months. The United States has barred entry of non-U.S. citizens who visited DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days. DR Congo planned a Houston base camp for the World Cup, with fixtures against Portugal in Houston on June 17, then Colombia in Guadalajara and Uzbekistan in Atlanta, though the outbreak complicates their qualification chances.

triage.headline_ja: 'エボラ恐怖'についに...スペインの市長、コンゴ-チリ親善試合を'電撃キャンセル'命令...コンゴ、52年ぶりの本選出場直後に最悪の状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限発動）。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率と国際的関心を持つ感染症であり、DRC発生地での公衆衛生学的懸念が複数国に波及している。
triage.notes: DRCのエボラ集団発生がスペイン・米国・ベルギーなど複数国の国際行事（World Cup準備活動）に直接影響を与えている。Bundibugyo型（稀少変異体、ワクチン未開発）が報告されている。米国の渡航制限、スペインの親善試合キャンセルなど複数国が対応措置を実施済み。WHOのワクチン開発に最大9ヶ月要すとの警告がある。本件はWPRO対象国の東南アジア地域には記事上で言及されていないが、DRCでの確認発生事実が国際的レベルでの対応を促発している。

article.articleHeadline: Heterogeneity and dynamics of DENV-specific CD8 + T cells in dengue infection
article.articleSummary: Dengue virus (DENV)-specific CD8+ T cells display heterogeneity and dynamic behavior during dengue infection. The study acknowledges extensive collaboration and support across Mahidol University and the DENFREE Thailand program, with funding from the Newton Fund, Wellcome Trust (206194), the Medical Research Council (MR/R020868/1), and multiple Thai and European sources (NSRF, NRCT, PMU-C, EU FP7/DENFREE). Data handling and analysis were enabled by the Cellular Genomics Informatics team and data-processing facilities at Mahidol University’s AI-MD Center. Laboratory support included flow cytometry assistance from the FACS facility at the National Center for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology and reagent coordination by Alicja Wilk and Lira Mamanova; data analysis training by Sungmin Cheong and Seongryong Kim. The work integrates broader Thai–international collaboration, leveraging DENFREE Thailand and associated funding to study DENV-specific CD8+ T cell responses in dengue infection.

triage.headline_ja: デング感染におけるDENV特異的CD8+ T細胞の異質性と動態
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究論文であり、新規の感染症イベント（発生・流行）の報告ではなく、既知の疾患に関する免疫学的メカニズムの学術研究成果です。公衆衛生上の即時対応が必要なシグナルには該当しません。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature誌掲載の査読済み論文であり、タイのMahidol大学と国際共同研究機関による基礎研究報告です。デングウイルスの免疫応答メカニズムに関する学術的知見の公開であり、新規感染症イベントまたは流行の報告ではありません。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda plans mobile Ebola treatment centre in eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: Uganda plans a mobile Ebola treatment centre in Ituri Province, DRC, to curb importation. The Deputy Incident Commander said contacts under follow-up rose to 580 from about 100 earlier this week, as infected workers interacted across facilities. Uganda confirmed two more Congolese nationals with Sudan Ebola virus; one is a contact of a confirmed case, the other symptomatic and picked up by rapid response. Excluding three infected workers and one Ugandan national, all confirmed Uganda cases are Congolese nationals; many Congo nationals cross-border seeking treatment, with some entering via Tanzania. A joint cross-border mission in Ituri with testing and treatment is planned to contain the outbreak at the source. Ituri has 121 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, outbreak expanding from three to eighteen zones. Public urged to report fever, eye redness, rash, joint pain; emphasize handwashing; masks discouraged as not respiratory transmission; travel histories to avoid misdiagnosis like peptic ulcers.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが東部DRCでエボラ出血熱の移動式治療センター設置を計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際拡大、複数国への波及リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5/5項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行のしやすさ、管理上の課題）。国際支援が既に必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラアウトブレイクであり、DRCが実際の発生地。ウガンダは対応国（治療センター設置計画・患者受け入れ）として言及されているが、記事の主要な感染症イベント発生地はDRCである。タンザニアは越境移動ルートとして言及されているのみ。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。確定患者121名、死亡17名、アウトブレイク地域が3から18地域に拡大中。スーダンエボラウイルス（Sudan Ebola virus）確認。

article.articleHeadline: 콩고 민주공화국, 에볼라로 평가전 취소...18일 포르투갈과 1차전
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo cancels a friendly due to Ebola... First leg against Portugal on the 18th.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s national football team, returning to a World Cup finals after 52 years, faces disruption as Ebola outbreaks in the eastern region prompt health authorities to cancel a warm-up match against Chile. La Línea de la Concepción mayor Juan Franco signed a decree banning the June 9 friendly, citing Ebola preventive measures and Andalusia health authorities’ advice. The team, which had planned a camp in Kinshasa and friendlies in Liège (Denmark) and southern Spain (Chile), now struggles to prepare for the tournament. For the World Cup, Congo will base in Houston and open Group B against Portugal on June 18, then play Colombia in Guadalajara on June 24 and Uzbekistan in Atlanta on June 28. All players and coach Sébastien Desabre are based abroad (e.g., France), reducing infection risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラで親善試合キャンセル...18日にポルトガルと1次戦
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において異常性・予想外性が高く、DRCでのエボラ流行が国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）に影響を与えている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響が推定される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCのエボラ流行であり、親善試合キャンセルはその直接的な結果。Bluedot APIが列挙した多数の国（USA、Spain、Belgium、Mexico等）は試合予定地または対戦国であり、実際の発生地ではない。verified_locationsはDRCのみを確認。東部でのエボラ流行が国際的な人員移動と準備活動に影響を与えており、高リスク度の判定となる。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات فيروس الإيبولا المؤكدة في أوغندا إلى 15 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in confirmed Ebola virus infections in Uganda to 15 cases
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, Uganda reports six new Ebola virus disease infections, bringing laboratory-confirmed cases to 15 in the country since the outbreak began in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC); one Ugandan patient has died. In the DRC’s eastern region, authorities report 321 confirmed infections and 48 deaths, with 116 suspected cases not yet tested. The World Health Organization notes a decline in suspected cases in eastern DRC after testing remaining samples, but cautions that this does not necessarily reflect outbreak control and may indicate improved surveillance and earlier care-seeking. The outbreak in eastern DRC involves the rare Bundibugyo strain, thought to have begun about two months before detection. The Ugandan figures highlight cross-border transmission risk and ongoing regional public health monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラウイルス確認感染者数が15例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、予想外の国境を越えた拡大リスク、国際的な感染拡大と渡航制限の可能性がある。
