article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts scaled-down Uganda Martyrs' Day observances at Namugongo, Wakiso District, with Ebola prevention measures in place. Pilgrims attending the Catholic Shrine face strict health screening, temperature checks, hand washing, sanitising and social distancing SOPs; lakeside activities are cancelled and water collection prohibited. Prayers are confined to the Basilica; lakeside attendance is barred, with Masses at 6:30am, 8am, 10am, 12pm and 5pm to manage crowds. No handshakes during the sign of peace; worshippers will depart promptly after Mass. Dignitaries and government officials will not attend; nearby health facilities are on standby. Anglican site allows only 200 participants for a single service, following Ministry of Health guidelines. National observances were cancelled and Museveni postponed the celebration on May 17 to protect health. Pilgrims from Kenya, Tanzania and the DRC are discouraged from traveling to Namugongo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの影：ナムゴンゴで何が予想されるか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行により公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスク（ケニア、タンザニア、DRCからの渡航制限）が認められ、IHR基準2つ以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダのナムゴンゴでのエボラ流行によるカトリック礼拝活動への影響を主題とし、ケニア、タンザニア、DRCからの渡航制限を記述。対象国リスト内で実際に流行・影響が報告されているのはウガンダとDRC。発生地域フィールドのタンザニアとケニアは記事で渡航制限対象として言及されているのみであり、イベント発生地として検証されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Standing Watch: Nigeria's frontline battle against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC's Ituri Province sparked international alarm as cases spilled into Uganda; by May 21, 2026, 746 suspected and 176 deaths in DRC, with 85 confirmed and 10 deaths (case fatality 12%); by May 29, at least 1,262 suspected/confirmed cases and 241 deaths. The virus is spreading from Ituri into North Kivu and South Kivu, regions already battered by conflict and weak health systems. Notably, Bundibugyo lacks an approved vaccine and licensed treatment; management relies on supportive care and contact tracing. On May 17, 2026, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after consultations with DRC and Uganda ministers. Nigeria, 2,500 km away, recalls 2014 Lagos case Patrick Sawyer; Dr. Ameyo Adadevoh quarantined him, saving lives; Nigeria Ebola-free by Oct 20, 2014, and on May 24, 2026 intensified preparedness amid the current threat.

triage.headline_ja: 立ち入り監視：ナイジェリアのエボラ熱との最前線での戦い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、致死率12%の深刻な健康被害、ワクチン/治療法の不在、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、およびナイジェリアの準備態勢強化が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ県からの発生）とウガンダへの拡大が中心。ナイジェリアは2014年の事例との歴史的比較および準備状況の言及のみであり、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言を行っており、極めて高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 利菁吃氂牛大餐緊急送醫？ 醫：牛肉別只涮10秒 夏天生食恐讓細菌下肚
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Li Jing Eats a Yak Meat Feast, Rushed to the Hospital? Doctor: Don’t Just Rinse Beef for 10 Seconds—Eating Raw Beef in Summer Could Let Bacteria Into Your Stomach
article.articleSummary: Yak meat consumed during a Xinjiang trip led to vomiting and diarrhea, signaling acute gastroenteritis. Dr. Zhu Guang'en, director of Xinxin Smart Clinic, warns that undercooked meat and improper handling can harbor bacteria (Escherichia coli, Salmonella, Staphylococcus aureus) and viruses such as norovirus, risking dehydration or shock, especially in people with weakened immunity. While hotpot and barbecue diners prefer rare cuts, color change does not guarantee safety; meat should be fully cooked and kept in boiling broth for 15–30 seconds before eating. Other risky foods include raw eggs, sashimi, and undercooked poultry or pork. Immunocompromised individuals—dialysis patients, diabetics, those with cardiovascular disease, liver cirrhosis, or kidney dysfunction—face higher risk of severe gastroenteritis or septic complications. Emphasize hand hygiene, clean water and utensils, and avoiding prolonged storage in hot weather. Location: Xinjiang, China; Date: 2026-06-03.

triage.headline_ja: 李晶がヤク肉大食を食べて緊急搬送？医師：牛肉は10秒の涮だけではダメ、夏生食は細菌を摂取するリスク
triage.triage_reason: 単一事例の食中毒イベント（原因：加熱不十分なヤク肉）の報道記事。集団発生や公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がなく、医学的な警告記事の性質が強い。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準に該当する要件がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は新疆でのヤク肉摂食による単一の食中毒事例を報道しており、医学的な食品安全に関する警告・啓発記事である。複数事例の集団発生を示唆する記述がなく、感染症イベントとしてのシグナル価値は低い。サマリーに列挙されている病原体（ノロウイルス、大腸菌、サルモネラ、黄色ブドウ球菌など）は食中毒の一般的なリスク要因としての説明であり、実際の流行状況を示していない。

article.articleHeadline: World News | Indian Air Force's C-17 Globemaster III Delivers Critical Medical Aid for Ebola Treatment to Uganda
article.articleSummary: India delivers critical medical aid to Uganda amid the Ebola outbreak via an IAF C-17 Globemaster III. The first tranche, about 2.5 tons, was dispatched on 24 May to Kampala, including protective gear, medical monitoring equipment, essential medicines and supplements. A larger second tranche of 43 tons was mobilised, comprising protective gear, diagnostic and monitoring devices, sample transport kits, infection prevention supplies, medicines and supplements, and is due to reach Kampala on 2 June 2026 for handing over to Africa CDC. The aid supports Africa CDC’s Ebola response and strengthens regional public health preparedness, with New Delhi coordinating through Africa CDC and the African Union Commission. Africa CDC welcomed the emergency diagnostics and therapeutics; India said it remains ready to deploy further assistance as the situation evolves, including via Uganda to support eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: インド空軍のC-17グローブマスターIII、ウガンダへのエボラ治療用医療支援物資を納入
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生地域（ウガンダ・DRC）での確認、国際的な支援体制の構築、複数国間の公式な対応が進行中であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ発生地はウガンダとDRCであるが、本記事の主題はインドによる医療支援の提供である。Bluedot APIが付与したウガンダは発生地として正確だが、本トリアージでは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めない。インドは支援国として記載され、DRCは発生地として明示されている。両国とも対象国に含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: FG Boosts Land Border, Airport Surveillance, Screening
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak, Bundibugyo strain, in central Africa. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths; neighboring Uganda has nine confirmed cases with one death. Nigeria reports no confirmed cases but has tightened health screening and surveillance at land borders, airports, and seaports. WHO says, as of May 31, suspected cases in central Africa fell to 116, with 330 confirmed cases overall. The outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri province, northeastern DR Congo. Nigeria’s measures include mandatory infrared temperature checks, health declaration forms, travel history assessments, enhanced entry-point risk profiling, and secondary screening with isolation and referral for travellers showing Ebola-like symptoms. Public Health Emergency Operations Centres activated; Rapid Response Teams on standby; surveillance networks—Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response and community-based systems—reinforced. Citizens urged to maintain hand hygiene and avoid bushmeat; report unusual illnesses promptly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：FG（ナイジェリア連邦政府）が陸上国境、空港での監視・スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた多国拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア）、死亡例を含む重症度、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性があり、IHR基準3つ以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ出血熱発生（321確定例、48死亡）とウガンダ、ナイジェリアの対応措置について報じている。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo strain、2026年5月15日にIturi州で宣言された outbreak。複数国への国際的な拡大リスクが明確に存在。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴのエボラ感染確認、３４４人に　「疑い例」は減少、サッカー試合中止も：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections confirmed in Congo, reaching 344 people; suspected cases have declined, and soccer matches have been canceled.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 344 confirmed infections with 60 deaths, the most severe in the DRC (formerly Zaire). Uganda reports 15 cases and 1 death, border closures intended to curb spread, though cross-border movement persists, raising risk per the IOM. In Congo, suspected cases declined to 116 as of May 31, down from 906 the prior week, with some Ebola-like early symptoms later attributed to other illnesses after testing progress cited by the WHO. The impact extends to sports, with a planned June 9 football friendly in southern Spain between Congo and Chile canceled by a mayor after health authorities’ advice as a preventive measure. No detailed infection source or imported/exported cases are provided; emphasis remains on enhanced surveillance and testing to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染確認、３４４人に　「疑い例」は減少、サッカー試合中止も
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の確認感染者344名、死亡60名という深刻な公衆衛生影響。国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境感染）と国境閉鎖・国際スポーツイベント中止による渡航制限の実際の発生。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認されている感染イベントはDRCが主体。ウガンダでの15例の報告もあるが、サマリーの文脈ではDRCの流行からの越境感染として記述されており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。スペイン・チリは試合中止の舞台であり、本来の感染症発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola di Kongo Tembus 300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Kongo exceed 300.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 300 confirmed cases and 48 deaths as of June 1, 2026, with 23 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu affected. Ituri province accounts for more than 260 confirmed cases, the highest in the outbreak. Community resistance, rumors, and misinformation hinder field response, notably in Bunia and Nizi. Four patients at Evangelical Medical Center, Bunia, recovered and were discharged. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ended his visit after meeting President Felix Tshisekedi to discuss containment of the Bundibugyo Ebola variant currently circulating. Authorities and partners opened a new 60-bed treatment center in Bunia; vaccine trials continue. Bunia Airport has reopened to flights with health monitoring devices installed at departure and arrival areas. The outbreak was officially announced on May 15, and response efforts are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例が300件を突破
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模集団発生であり、300例超の確認例と死亡例を伴う深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が明白である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の大規模集団発生。300例超の確認例、48名の死亡、23の保健地域に拡大。Ituri州が260例以上と最多。コミュニティ抵抗と誤情報が対応を阻害。WHOトップが訪問し大統領と協議。新規治療センター開設、ワクチン試験進行中。2026年5月15日に公式発表。国際的な注視が集中しており、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が急速に必要。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情当前，美国"重新对接"全球疫苗免疫联盟_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With the Ebola outbreak ongoing, the United States re-engages with Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance.
article.articleSummary: With Ebola outbreaks ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, the United States re-engages with Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance. Senator Marco Rubio said the State Department has decided to restart engagement and is considering appointing a dedicated coordinator for the U.S. Ebola response. Previously, HHS Secretary Robert Kennedy Jr. announced last June that the United States would suspend its $300 million annual contribution to Gavi, citing vaccine safety concerns without presented evidence. The Trump administration had blocked funding for 2025–2026; senators, led by Susan Collins, urged release. On May 17, the WHO designated the Congo (Kinshasa) and Uganda Ebola outbreaks as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. On May 27, a cabinet meeting stated that no Ebola case should enter the United States. The United States plans to relocate at-risk citizens abroad to a temporary isolation facility in Kenya, a plan blocked by the Kenyan High Court.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が続く中、米国がGavi（ワクチンアライアンス）との関係を再構築
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHOがPHEIC指定済み。複数国での同時流行とシステマティックな国際対応が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ流行は「Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda」で確認されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当（GeoNames ID: 203312）。Ugandaは対象国に含まれていないため除外。米国とケニアは政策・対応国として言及されているが、発生地ではないため除外。WHOはすでに2026年5月17日にPHEIC指定しており、高度の国際的関心と複数政府レベルでの対応が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات 'إيبولا' المؤكدة في أوغندا إلى 15 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda to 15.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03, six new laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections in Uganda raise the national total to 15, with one death. The Ministry of Health stated that these six cases bring the laboratory-confirmed count to 15 since the outbreak began in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. One fatality has occurred to date. Authorities are maintaining containment efforts to prevent further transmission within Uganda, including enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and public health messaging in border regions affected by the Congo outbreak. The cross-border link underscores ongoing regional transmission risk and the need for continued vigilance to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで確認されたエボラ感染者数が15件に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが高く、IHR基準を複数満たしており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも列挙されているが、記事サマリーはウガンダでの症例数増加を報道しており、DRCからの越境感染として文脈化されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。本イベントはエボラウイルス感染症であり、死亡例が報告されており、越境感染が発生している状況であるため、PICKUP判定は妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, Governo e Oms rafforzano la risposta all'epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: Government and WHO Strengthen the Epidemic Response.
article.articleSummary: DRC government and the World Health Organization intensify the response to Ebola Virus Disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain in Ituri and neighboring North and South Kivu. A high-level mission to Bunia with Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba and WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus underscores transmission across multiple health zones and boosts surveillance, laboratory analysis, and patient care. The strategy relies on close coordination among national, provincial, and international partners, with additional resources and active community engagement with leaders, youth, religious groups, and local networks. There is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola; core measures, including case isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and infection control, remain central. The plan also contemplates clinical studies of potential vaccines and treatments while reinforcing essential health services, laboratories, and workforce, and ensuring that border controls do not impede medical supplies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、政府とWHOが対策強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ワクチンなし、複数地域での伝播、WHO事務局長の現地訪問により高度な国際的関心があり、フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行。複数の県（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で伝播。ワクチン・特異的治療法なし。WHO事務局長による高官級現地訪問は国際的関心の高さを示唆。南隣接国への拡大リスク存在（WPRO対象外だが地域的脅威）。

article.articleHeadline: Acusan a dos virólogos en EEUU de intentar entrar en Denver con varios viales del virus de la viruela del mono traídos desde África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two US virologists accused of attempting to enter Denver with several vials of the monkeypox virus brought from Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two US virologists affiliated with the NIH were formally charged for attempting to bring monkeypox virus (mpox) into the United States after being intercepted at Detroit airport in January while returning from Congo with 113 vials. Investigators said 17 of 20 vials analyzed by the FBI contained inactivated mpox virus. The defendants, Vincent Munster (Dutch) and Claude Kwe (Cameroonian), work at a Montana lab with Biosafety Level 4 facilities and face up to five years in prison after allegedly lying about their luggage contents. The case follows mpox outbreaks and rising case counts; the African Union health agency had declared mpox no longer an African public health emergency. Worldwide, the WHO reported over 34,000 mpox cases and 138 deaths between January and July 2025. Symptoms include high fever and vesicular skin lesions.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の米国ウイルス学者がアフリカから持ち込まれたサル痘ウイルスの複数のバイアルを携えてデンバーに入ろうとしたとして告発される
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの国際的な病原体輸送に関する異常で予想外の事件であり、バイオセキュリティリスク、刑事訴追、およびNIH関連施設との関連性から深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。IHR基準を複数満たし、スクリーニング基準も満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴからの違法な病原体輸送事件（米国での逮捕）であるが、対象国リストではコンゴDRCのみが該当。バイオセキュリティ違反、密輸、不正申告、および113個のバイアル（分析結果17個が不活性化Mpoxを含有）という異常な要素が含まれている。2025年1月から7月の間にWHOが報告した世界的なMpox事例は34,000件超、死亡者138人。アフリカ連合は2025年にMpoxを公衆衛生上の緊急事態から除外しているが、この違法な病原体輸送事件はバイオセキュリティと国際保健規則の重大な違反を示している。

article.articleHeadline: EBOLA: "NO ALLARMISMO, MA MASSIMA PREVENZIONE", GRIMALDI, "NON C'È VACCINO, MENO CONTAGIOSO COVID"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: "No Alarmism, But Utmost Prevention", Grimaldi, "There Is No Vaccine, Less Contagious Than COVID"
article.articleSummary: 2026-06-03: Ebola, specifically Bundibugyo virus (BVD), prompts high vigilance but not alarm, with authorities stressing prevention to prevent cross-border spread. In the Africa region, Congo and Uganda report about 1,100 suspected Ebola cases, 263 confirmed, and over 50 deaths. Italy has instituted preventive measures: mandatory reporting for travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; five risk levels; Fiumicino airport as a national health hub; regional infectious-disease reference centers and a national reference center at Spallanzani Hospital in Rome. In Abruzzo, hub centers are in Pescara and Avezzano-Sulmona-L’Aquila; spokes are Lanciano-Vasto-Chieti and Teramo. A patient returning from Congo in Sardinia tested negative; overall risk in Italy remains very low. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola; vaccines for other strains exist but are not applicable to BVD. Therapeutics are mainly supportive (rehydration); antivirals like Remdesivir are used in some contexts, with monoclonal antibodies in development pending trials. Ebola transmission is via close contact with fluids or contaminated objects, not aerosols; incubation 2–20 days (mean 8–9).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：「警戒心は必要だが過度な警戒は不要」、グリマルディ知事「ワクチンはない、COVID-19より感染性は低い」
triage.triage_reason: イタリアでのエボラ対応状況の報道だが、実際の発生地はコンゴとウガンダに限定。イタリアの患者は陰性で、現在のイタリアのリスクは「非常に低い」と評価されている。スクリーニング基準は部分的に該当するが、情報が限定的であり、続報による状況変化を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にはイタリアの多数の都市が含まれているが、記事サマリーからはアフリカ地域（コンゴとウガンダ）での実際のエボラ発生が主題であり、イタリアは対応・予防措置の記事であることが明確。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。イタリアも対象国外のため除外。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で該当するが、対象監視地域外での発生のため、現段階では WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Комары в ЮАР заразили туристку из Подмосковья опасным вирусом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquitoes in South Africa infected a tourist from the Moscow region with a dangerous virus.
article.articleSummary: An imported dengue fever case in Russia: A 38-year-old woman from Khimki, Moscow region, returned from Africa with dengue after visiting South Africa, Zambia, and Zimbabwe in May, including Kruger National Park and Victoria Falls, where she attributes mosquito bites. She arrived home on May 18; five days later fever and fatigue emerged, followed by a fever spike to 38.7°C, headaches, myalgias, and a widespread rash. Initial suspicions included malaria or hepatitis, but comprehensive testing confirmed dengue fever. She is receiving prescribed treatment. Since the start of 2026, Africa has reported 658 dengue cases in Mauritania, Mali, Senegal, and the Central African Republic. The report notes that Aedes mosquitoes capable of transmitting dengue are present in South Africa and Zimbabwe, raising travel-related risk and potential for further transmission in southern Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカの蚊がモスクワ地域の観光客に危険なウイルスを感染させた
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の輸入症例であり、アフリカでの局所流行背景（2026年に658例報告）と、南アフリカ・ザンビア・ジンバブエでの蚊媒介感染拡大リスクが明確。国際旅行に関連した病原体輸入事例として、さらなる伝播の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、患者がザンビアとジンバブエを訪問し、それらの地域でAedes蚊による感染が確認されている。ザンビアは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に加える。南アフリカも感染発生地であるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アフリカ全域での658例のデング報告（モーリタニア、マリ、セネガル、中央アフリカ共和国）も記載されているが、これら国は対象国リストに含まれない。IHR基準で2つ該当し、WPRO基準でも3つ該当するため PICKUP 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: У россиянки, вернувшейся из Африки, нашли смертельно опасный вирус
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Russian woman who returned from Africa was found to have a deadly virus.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever diagnosed in a 38-year-old Russian woman after returning from Southern Africa. She traveled in May to South Africa (including Kruger National Park) and to Zambia and Zimbabwe, where Aedes mosquitoes were prevalent near Victoria Falls. After returning to Moscow, she developed high fever, rash, severe headaches, and bone pain; initial tests suggested malaria or hepatitis before repeat analyses confirmed dengue fever. She is currently receiving treatment in Moscow. Since the start of the year, Africa has recorded 658 dengue cases in Mauritania, Mali, Senegal, and the Central African Republic. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, common in tropical and subtropical zones. The article also notes 2025 reports of dengue among Russian tourists in Bali, underscoring travel-associated risk.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカから帰国したロシア人女性に致命的なウイルスが見つかった
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。デング熱の輸入症例であり、ベクター媒介性感染症の国際的拡散を示唆。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはザンビア・ジンバブエ・南アフリカでの感染源、モスクワでの診断、バリでの過去事例を記述。対象国リストではザンビアとインドネシア（バリ）のみが該当。南アフリカは対象国外だが、感染源として機能。デング熱のアフリカでの増加（658症例）とロシアへの輸入、さらにアジア（バリ）での継続的報告により、多地域にわたるシグナル特性を持つ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus can linger in body for hundreds of days, doctor warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus can persist in the body for hundreds of days after infection, per Washington State University research cited by Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong of ImmunityBio, with persistence detected in breast milk and semen—raising concerns that the standard 21-day monitoring window may be insufficient. The warning coincides with an ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ituri region has about 980,000 displaced people, complicating containment. WHO director-general emphasizes scaling up access to clean water, sanitation, and contact tracing amid continuing transmission. Health workers report high community awareness but ongoing challenges, and officials say response efforts will continue until the outbreak is over. The article also notes that US Ebola risk remains low, according to the NIH director.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスは感染後、数百日間体内に残存する可能性がある、医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。進行中のDRC/Ituri地域でのエボラ流行と関連し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの進行中エボラ流行に関連した科学的警告（ウイルス体内持続期間の延長）を報道。Ituri地域での980,000人の国内避難民、接触者追跡やWHOの対応強化が述べられており、公衆衛生上の関心は高い。USの言及はリスク低減評価であり、主題の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mizoram detects 370 TB cases during 100-day screening campaign
article.articleSummary: TB detected 370 cases in Mizoram during the Centre's intensified 100-day TB campaign, Mar 24–May 24, under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) and National Health Mission (NHM). Across Mizoram, 340 screening camps were held; 25,509 people underwent X-ray screening, leading to 370 TB detections. TB Preventive Treatment (TPT) was provided to 488 household contacts of TB patients. The campaign covers all districts with a focus on high-risk villages and wards, prioritising malnourished individuals, seniors over 60, smokers, alcohol users, people with hypertension, and household TB contacts. Initiatives aim to accelerate early detection and strengthen preventive measures as part of broader TB elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ミゾラム州、100日間のスクリーニングキャンペーン中に370件のTB症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: 結核の検出は公衆衛生的意義があるが、本イベントは計画的なスクリーニングキャンペーンによる発見であり、予期しない集団発生ではない。情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 本件は国家TB排除プログラム（NTEP）による意図的なスクリーニングキャンペーンの成果報告であり、予期しない集団発生ではない。ただし結核の長期曝露リスクと流行リスクは存在する。死亡率や重症度の具体的情報が不足しており、より詳細な疫学情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: New Ebola vaccine in the works: Soumya Swaminathan says India should be alert
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as of 3 June 2026 involves 321 confirmed cases, 116 suspected cases, and 48 deaths. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for this strain, which differs antigenically from Zaire Ebola. Three vaccine candidates are in development: Moderna's mRNA vaccine, an IAVI recombinant VSV platform, and Oxford University's ChAdOx platform (same as Covishield). If trials succeed, Serum Institute of India could manufacture rapidly under GMP, but safety and efficacy must be demonstrated; regulatory approval would likely take six to nine months even with accelerated development. The region's conflict, displacement, and weak health infrastructure complicate response. Emphasis on case finding, contact tracing, testing, and isolation. Bundibugyo appears to have a lower fatality rate than Zaire; early supportive care improves outcomes. Funding cuts (USAID) strain preparedness; about $500 million mobilized globally. India should bolster surveillance, port-entry awareness, and Bundibugyo-specific diagnostics.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラワクチンが開発中：スワミナサン氏がインドは警戒すべきと述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。進行中の確認された多数の死亡事例を伴うエボラアウトブレイク、承認されたワクチン/治療がない新しいストレイン、複数国への拡大、インドを含むアジア地域への潜在的脅威のため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダで発生中のBundibugyo型エボラアウトブレイク（321確認例、48死亡）を報じている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドは対象国であり、記事で「インドは警戒すべき」と具体的に言及されているため included。新規ワクチン開発段階、治療法なし、新興ストレイン、地域不安定、資金不足などの重大な懸念要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 확산 속 월드컵 개최 앞둔 美..."주요 공항 검사체계 구축
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid the Ebola outbreak, the U.S. gears up to host the World Cup, building a major airport screening system.
article.articleSummary: Amid the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring African nations, the U.S. government announced preemptive airport screening systems for the World Cup host period. Memet Oz, head of the CMS, stated that screening tools and systems would be deployed at major U.S. airports used by foreign visitors. The 2026 World Cup runs June 11–July 19 across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, amplifying concerns about Ebola entering host nations. DR Congo’s national team—its first World Cup appearance in 52 years—has seen opening ceremonies and scheduled warm-up matches canceled; rumors of a 21-day U.S. quarantine for entrants circulated. The Bundibugyo variant of Ebola currently has no proven treatment or vaccine. WHO regards the outbreak as unlikely to become a COVID-19-like pandemic; initial suspected cases exceeded 1,000 with 224 deaths, now around 400 suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の拡大の中で、2026年ワールドカップ開催を控える米国、主要空港検査システムを構築
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当（重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）。大規模国際イベント（ワールドカップ）を背景とした社会的・政治的関心の高まり。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の流行を主題としており、2026ワールドカップを契機とした米国の対策実施を報じている。米国・カナダ・メキシコはワールドカップ開催国だが、エボラ発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。初期疑い例1,000例超、死亡224例から現在約400例に減少している状況が報じられている。治療法・ワクチン未確立という点も重症度評価に含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: 影音／伊波拉奪逾百命！台灣祭機場新防疫措施　│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: Ebola Claims More Than 100 Lives! Taiwan Unveils New Airport Epidemic-Prevention Measures — TVBS News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is ongoing in Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda reporting more than 100 deaths. Taiwan announces strict entry controls to prevent virus importation ahead of a mid-June international private gathering expected to involve over 400 foreigners from Congo and Uganda. The Taiwan CDC imposes a 90-day entry ban for residents of the two countries and suspends previously issued visas. For travelers with Congo/Uganda travel history, authorities will conduct liquid-based screening and require 21 days of self-health management, plus voluntary on-arrival testing as an initial screen. Ebola symptoms include fever, muscle pain, and headache, followed by vomiting and diarrhea; severe cases can cause liver damage, kidney failure, and multi-organ failure, with a fatality rate up to 50%. These are Taiwan’s first strict border controls since COVID border reopening.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが100人以上を奪う！台湾が空港で新しい防疫対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラウイルス疾患の流行（DRC・ウガンダで100人以上の死亡）が報告され、台湾が国際的な境界管理措置を講じている。IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的な拡大リスク」「異常性」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「管理可能性」に加え、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行が主題であり、台湾の防疫対策はこれへの対応である。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。タイワンも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラ流行は現在進行中（ongoing）で、死亡者100人以上と重症度が高く、国際的な感染拡大リスクが明確に存在する。

article.articleHeadline: ഉഗാണ്ടയിൽ വീണ്ടും എബോള ഭീതി; ആറ് പേർക്ക് കൂടി രോഗം സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു | Ebola Cases In Uganda Rise To 15 After 6 New Confirmed Cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola scare in Uganda again; six more cases confirmed.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Uganda reports six more Ebola cases in Kampala, taking the national total to 15. All new infections involve individuals with direct contact to previously confirmed patients. Twelve patients remain in treatment centers, two have recovered and been discharged, and one death was reported earlier in May among travelers arriving from abroad. Health authorities have traced 668 contacts under surveillance and urge prompt reporting of Ebola-like symptoms to centers, noting better recovery with early care. India has sent a second batch of medical supplies (about 43 tonnes) to Africa CDC, including PPE, diagnostic equipment, essential medicines, and nutritional supplements, to bolster Africa’s Ebola response. The Ugandan government continues collaboration with WHO and other international agencies, prioritizing surveillance, contact listing, and public awareness to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで再びエボラウイルス感染の恐れ。6人の新たな患者が確認され、国内の患者数は15人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確認患者数の増加（新規6例、計15例）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示す。また、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続的な可能性と国際的な拡大リスク（インドからの医療支援送付）が明白であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにて、ウガンダでのエボラウイルス患者の新規確認と累積患者数の増加が明記されている。インドが医療支援を送付していることが述べられているが、インドは発生地ではなく支援国であるため、verified_locationsにはウガンダのみを含める。記事の発生地域フィールドに含まれるインドは、サマリーの主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: How conflict has complicated Congo's battle against the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri and North Kivu has infected over 1,000 and killed at least 246; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern in mid-May as the Bundibugyo virus, which has no vaccine, drives rapid spread and kills about a third of those infected. The response is hampered by conflict in eastern Congo, where four million need urgent aid, two million are displaced, and ten million face acute hunger. Attacks on health facilities since 2019—about 300 incidents with six deaths and 70 injuries—weaken surveillance and response; 2023 saw 115 obstruction cases, 41 doctors kidnapped, and looting of medicines and equipment. Militant groups such as the FDLR, M23, and Allied Democratic Forces operate in the region, risking spread to displacement camps near Bunia. Authorities warn against burial protocols and community mistrust.

triage.headline_ja: 紛争がコンゴのエボラ流行対策を複雑化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。WHO公開衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み、国際的感染拡大あり（ウガンダで確認例）、高致命率・ワクチンなし、武装勢力による医療施設攻撃により対応不可能。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは二次的な報告のみ（9例、1死亡）であり、主要な流行地はコンゴ（Ituri州、North Kivu）。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみに該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO PHeIC宣言済み、高致命率（約33%）、Bundibugyo Ebola virus（ワクチンなし）、紛争による医療施設攻撃（約300件）、医療従事者への暴力により対応が著しく阻害されている。

article.articleHeadline: Испански кмет отмени мач на ДР Конго заради страх от ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spanish mayor cancels DR Congo match due to fear of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain — a friendly match between the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) and Chile, scheduled for 9 June ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, has been canceled by Mayor Juan Franco amid serious concerns about the Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The organizers are seeking an alternate venue just days before kickoff. DR Congo has halted domestic preparations and is reportedly training in Spain under full isolation as the Ebola epidemic rages in the country. The World Health Organization has deemed the situation 'extraordinary' but has not declared a pandemic. In the 2026 World Cup, DR Congo is in Group K with Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan.

triage.headline_ja: スペインの市長がエボラウイルス感染への懸念からコンゴ民主共和国との試合をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生地であるDRCにおいて、WHOが「異常な状況」と評価し、国際的なスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ関連試合）がキャンセルされるなど、公衆衛生および国際的関心の基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラ流行が主題であり、スペインでの試合キャンセルはその二次的影響。スペイン、ポルトガル、チリは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsから除外。WHOが状況を『異常』と評価し、国際スポーツイベントの中止という社会政治的インパクトあり。

article.articleHeadline: 'If Ebola comes, we'll be wiped out': fear grips camps in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola raises alarm in the Kingonze camp near Bunia in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where more than 25,000 displaced people live in tarpaulin and tent lines. Residents fear the crowded camps could be wiped out if transmission continues through close contact in a region long destabilized by conflict. Ituri, home to nearly a million displaced people, is a focal point of the outbreak. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of a catastrophic collision of disease and conflict hampering response, calling for greater international support and funding to counter distrust and misinformation. The outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda was officially declared on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラが来たら、我々は一掃される」：コンゴ民主共和国のキャンプに恐怖が広がる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な宣言済み流行（DRC・ウガンダで5月15日官報告知）。難民キャンプという高リスク集団での伝播リスク、WHO事務局長による国際支援と資金調達の呼びかけ、IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）でも確認されているが、記事の主題は DRC 内の Ituri 州 Bunia 地域。WHO 事務局長による明示的な国際支援要請があり、紛争と感染症の複合危機が指摘されている。難民キャンプという脆弱な環境での高い伝播リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Health Warning Over Ebola Spread
article.articleSummary: On 3 June 2026, Bahrain's Ministry of Foreign Affairs warned citizens to exercise caution and consider postponing travel to Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid ongoing Ebola virus disease activity in parts of the region. The advisory notes the continued presence of Ebola virus disease and urges travelers to take preventive measures, adhere to health guidance, and monitor updates from international health organizations before planning travel. It underscores the importance of staying informed and following official recommendations to reduce risk of exposure, while emphasizing vigilance for symptoms consistent with Ebola and seeking medical advice if travel is necessary. The warning reflects public health authorities’ stance to mitigate cross-border transmission amid regional Ebola activity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の拡大に関する衛生警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて深刻で、国際的拡大リスクが高く、既に複数国での活動が確認されており、渡航制限が発令されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はフィロウイルス科の極めて危険な病原体であり、高い致死率を有する。DRCおよびウガンダでの継続的な活動が記事で明記されている。バーレーン外務省による公式渡航警告は国際的な関心と当局の懸念を示唆する。ただし、バーレーンはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めず、DRCのみを確認位置として記載した。ウガンダは対象国リストに該当なしのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Нобелов лауреат: Епидемията от ебола в Конго и Уганда може да стане най-смъртоносната някога
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nobel laureate: The Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda could become the deadliest ever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda, involving Bundibugyo virus strain; as of 2026-06-03, DRC reports 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths, with 116 suspected cases under investigation; Uganda reports 15 confirmed cases and 1 death; infections centered in Ituri province, with cases also in North and South Kivu; Bunia airport reopened with enhanced screening and hand hygiene measures. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; risk remains high due to regional insecurity, population movement, informal health systems, and lack of a licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. Nobel Peace Prize laureate Denis Mukwege warns this could become the deadliest Ebola outbreak, urges ceasefires to allow response, emphasizes safety, trust, rapid contact tracing, and humanitarian access; calls for increased funding and international assistance.

triage.headline_ja: ノーベル賞受賞者：コンゴとウガンダのエボラ流行は過去最大の致死数になる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による国際的な二国間流行で、死亡率が高く、WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: DRC内での発生が主流。ウガンダは隣国として記載されているが、記事の主要焦点はDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）。Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの一種で重篤性が高い。WHOによる国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言により、スクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。ノーベル平和賞受賞者による警告により社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянка поехала в Южную Африку и стала первой заразившейся лихорадкой денге
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Russian woman who went to South Africa became the first to contract dengue fever
article.articleSummary: A Russian tourist, 38-year-old Nina from Khimki, became the first confirmed dengue fever case in South Africa in 2026, linked to travel across Southern Africa. In May she visited South Africa, Zambia, and Zimbabwe, including Kruger National Park and Victoria Falls, where mosquito bites occurred. After returning home on May 18, she reported no symptoms for several days. On May 23 she developed marked weakness and high fever; the fever briefly improved, then recurred with 38.7°C, headaches, bone pains, fatigue, and a rash on the arms and back. Emergency services initially suspected malaria and hepatitis, but comprehensive testing confirmed dengue fever. She is currently on treatment. The report highlights travel-associated dengue acquired during African travel, with no further local transmission details provided.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人女性が南アフリカを訪問してデング熱に感染、初確認例となる
triage.triage_reason: 南アフリカでのデング熱初確認例であり予想外性が高いが、記事は輸入症例（旅行関連）である点が明確であり、現地での流行・二次感染の詳細情報が不足している。対象国はザンビアのみ確認できるため、引き続き経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は旅行者が南アフリカ・ザンビア・ジンバブエを訪問した際にデング熱に感染した輸入症例を報告している。対象国リストではザンビア（ID: 895949）のみ該当。南アフリカはデング熱初確認例という点で注目すべきだが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。発生地域に記載されたロシア（モスクワ州、フドゥ州）は患者の帰国地であり疾病獲得地ではないため除外。記事に現地での流行状況や追加症例情報がないため、国際的拡大リスク・流行可能性についての確実な情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Инвестират 60 млн. долара за създаването на ваксина срещу вируса Ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Invest 60 million dollars to develop a vaccine against the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: CEPI will provide about $60 million to accelerate vaccines against Ebola Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Roughly $50 million will go to Moderna, with two smaller groups receiving additional tranches. No approved vaccines or treatments for BDBV exist yet. CEPI’s funding targets preclinical and early clinical development, production, and progression to later-stage trials if early data are favorable, with trials expected in Africa in the coming months. The Congo outbreak has 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with about 1,100 suspected cases; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. Separately, CEPI will invest up to $8.6 million for a vaccine from Oxford University produced by the Serum Institute of India, and an initial $3.2 million for an IAVI vaccine candidate.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスワクチン開発のため6000万ドルを投資
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（Bundibugyo virus）の急速拡大とWHOによる国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）宣言。コンゴで282確認症例・42死亡、ウガンダで9確認症例・1死亡。DRCはIHR基準4項目全て該当し、国際支援（CEPI資金）が進行中。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）はBluedotから提示されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは二次的な国境外感染として記述されており、主要な発生地はDRCコンゴ東部。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるためDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo virus (BDBV)は承認済みワクチン・治療法がない新興脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Allarme Ebola. Pubblicate le procedure operative per Como
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert. Operating procedures published for Como.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) alert issued for Como, Italy, with new operating procedures. Under a Health Ministry ordinance, ATS Insubria requires travelers entering Italy from the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda to self-report to the competent ATS within 24 hours, even if asymptomatic, and also for those who were in these countries up to 21 days before returning. Self-reporting includes sharing information about suspected contacts or proximity to people who have contracted similar illnesses, as every detail is considered valuable for public health surveillance. The measures, already applied in Lombardy, aim to enable early detection and robust contact tracing to prevent potential transmission, linking international travel alerts to local public health actions. No reported cases are detailed; the article focuses on adherence to reporting procedures for imported exposure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報。コモのための運用手順が公開された
triage.triage_reason: DRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生に対応したイタリアの予防的措置。実際の症例報告はないが、スクリーニング基準（異常性・長期曝露）に該当。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ症例ではなく、DRC・ウガンダからの旅行者に対するイタリアの予防的報告手順の実施を報告している。Lombardia（イタリア）はスクリーニング対象国ではないため除外。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。IHR基準は2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も3つ該当しているが、実症例の報告がなく情報が不足しているため、フルRRAの前に続報確認が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情升公衛緊急事件！石崇良赴桃園機場視察：6月起4機場提供免費採檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak escalates into a public health emergency! Shi Chongliang visits Taoyuan Airport for inspection: Starting in June, four airports will offer free testing.
article.articleSummary: From 2026-06-03 to 2026-06-30, Taiwan’s CDC will offer free voluntary Ebola virus disease testing at four international airports for asymptomatic travelers with travel histories to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) or Uganda. WHO declared the Ebola outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17. The airports are Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan International, Taichung, and Kaohsiung. Asymptomatic entrants will receive a self-health management notice and may opt for testing; samples are 5 mL of whole blood collected in HEPA-equipped rooms by quarantine officers. Symptomatic individuals will be fast-tracked to contracted hospitals for evaluation. All inbound travelers must complete 21 days of health reporting via the online system; violations carry penalties from NT$10,000 to NT$150,000 under infectious disease laws.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が公衆衛生上の緊急事態に昇格！施行良が桃園空港を視察：6月から4空港で無料検査を提供
triage.triage_reason: WHOが5月17日にエボラのPHEICを宣言しており、台湾がDRC/ウガンダからの渡航者に対して4空港での無料検査を実施する対応措置が講じられている。国際的な広がりのリスク、渡航・貿易制限の実施という観点でIHR基準を満たし、公式な公衆衛生上の緊急対応が開始されているため。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾のエボラ対応措置を報じており、実際の発生地はDRC/ウガンダであるが、WHOによるPHEIC宣言により国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が確立されている。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、記事の主題である疫学的関連地域（DRC）と、台湾が中国の一部と見做される地政学的観点から China を含める。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Tĩnh tăng cường các giải pháp phòng, chống bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ha Tinh Province strengthens measures to prevent and control rabies.
article.articleSummary: Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, on 3 June 2026 tightens rabies prevention amid persistent risk. Nationwide, 77 rabies deaths were recorded in 2025; from January 2026 to date, 30 deaths. Key drivers are inadequate management of dogs and cats, roaming animals, and vaccination gaps. Following Directive 5010/BNN-MNT-CNTY (19 May 2026) from the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment, Ha Tinh's People's Committee orders the Department of Agriculture and Environment, with the Health Department and local authorities, to enforce registration, confinement, muzzle use in public, and strict penalties for roaming or unvaccinated dogs. Vaccination coverage should reach at least 80% of the dog and cat population, prioritizing high-risk or densely populated areas. Authorities will strengthen checks on transport, trade, and slaughter of dogs and cats and ensure veterinary-public health coordination for tracing, outbreak response, and post-exposure prophylaxis. Public awareness campaigns and prompt medical treatment after bites are emphasized; rabies remains nearly 100% fatal after onset but preventable through vaccination and timely care.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省が狂犬病の予防・抑制対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの狂犬病による継続的な死亡（2025年77件、2026年1月以降30件）が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、長期的曝露、流行しやすさ）に複数該当するが、現段階では情報が予防強化措置を中心とした管理対応であり、新規発生による急激な拡大の直接的な証拠は不明確であるため。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は既知の風土病であり、予防措置強化は管理対応の延長線上にある。ただし、2025年77件、2026年上期30件の継続的死亡報告は重症度とリスク継続性を示唆している。今後の感染増加動向・国際的拡大の兆候を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO thông báo số ca nghi nhiễm Ebola tại CHDC Congo giảm mạnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports a sharp drop in suspected Ebola cases in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) total 321 with 48 deaths; 116 suspected cases remain after extensive testing and elimination of hundreds of suspects. The outbreak, the 17th Ebola event in the DRC, began mid-May and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for this strain, complicating response. Most suspected cases initially presented with Ebola-like symptoms such as fever, diarrhea, or bleeding, but testing and contact-tracing ruled out many. Uganda reports 15 confirmed infections and 1 death, mainly among close contacts. Six patients have recovered. Health workers remain at risk; authorities warn it may take more than six months to contain without intensified case finding, isolation, and laboratory capacity. Response focuses on three affected provinces; border surveillance and international travel restrictions, including measures by the United States, are underway.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRコンゴでのエボラ疑い患者数が大幅に減少と報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルの公衆衛生脅威であり、複数国での確認例と米国の渡航制限により国際的懸念が顕在化している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとUnited Statesが含まれているが、記事サマリーではUgandaは15例の確認例と関連し、USは渡航制限措置のみ記載。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが確認された発生国。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・特異的治療なし）による第17次エボラ流行。最大6ヶ月以上の封じ込め期間予想。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 'ليس لدينا بلد آخر نلجأ إليه': الكينيون يخشون من خطة الولايات المتحدة لإنشاء موقع حجر صحي للإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'We have no other country to turn to': Kenyans fear the United States' plan to establish an Ebola quarantine site.
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, Ebola virus disease cases persist in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, while Kenya has no confirmed infections. The DRC reports 60 deaths and 344 confirmed cases; Uganda reports 1 death and 9 confirmed cases; the outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The United States plans a Laikipia Air Base-based Ebola quarantine facility in Nanyuki, Laikipia County, housing 50 beds and staffed by roughly 30 medical personnel. The plan sparked protests in Nanyuki, including the deaths of two protesters during a protest; Kenya’s Supreme Court temporarily blocked the entry of exposed individuals and ordered disclosure of all agreements; next hearing set for June 23. President William Ruto defends the plan as national health readiness, while U.S. officials emphasize keeping Ebola patients out of the United States. A U.S. doctor with Ebola was moved to Germany earlier.

triage.headline_ja: 「頼る他の国がない」：ケニア人がエボラ隔離施設の米国計画を恐れる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は国際保健上の重大な脅威であり、DRC・ウガンダでの確認症例、ケニアへの米国隔離施設計画による国際的波及、およびケニア国内での社会的・政治的関心（最高裁判決、国民抗議）により、IHR基準3項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーではエボラ症例の確認地域はDRCとウガンダのみ。ケニアはEbola隔離施設計画の対象地だが、確認感染者なし。米国・ドイツは対象国外のため除外。国際的な懸念は高い（米国-ケニア間の対立、最高裁の一時差止め、国民抗議により）。

article.articleHeadline: Puskesmas Betun Layani Vaksin Rabies 24 Jam, Masyarakat Diminta Segera Berobat Setelah Digigit Hewan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Betun Public Health Center Offers 24-Hour Rabies Vaccination, Public Urged to Seek Immediate Treatment After Being Bitten by an Animal
article.articleSummary: Betun Public Health Center (Puskesmas Betun) in Malaka Regency provides 24-hour rabies vaccination daily, with a dedicated vaccination team on call even after official hours. Head of Puskesmas Betun, Hardiana P Atty, says vaccination services operate round the clock to ensure rapid access after animal bites, which can occur at any time. Vaccine stock is routinely kept full; if levels dip, stocks are obtained from the Malaka Health Office. Rabies, transmitted by infected animals such as dogs and cats, remains deadly and has no cure, so first aid is crucial: wash the bite with running water and detergent, then immediately seek medical care for vaccination. Usually, patients receive three vaccine doses per the healthcare schedule, though dogs account for most bite cases.

triage.headline_ja: ベトゥン保健センターが24時間狂犬病ワクチン接種を提供、動物に咬まれた後は速やかに医療機関を受診するよう市民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の予防接種体制整備に関する情報提供記事。新規の狂犬病発生アウトブレイク報告ではなく、既知の流行地域における保健サービス強化の通知。IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア東ヌサ・テンガラ州マラカ県ベトゥン地区における狂犬病ワクチン接種サービスの24時間提供体制に関する公衆衛生情報。新規ケース報告やアウトブレイクの通知ではなく、既存の狂犬病リスク地域での予防対策強化のお知らせである。シグナル化の要件を満たさない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Global Push for New Ebola Strain Vaccine Intensifies
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with nearly 250 suspected deaths and more than 1,100 infections; true scope may be larger. This is the third Bundibugyo outbreak, with no approved vaccines or therapies. Global response accelerates vaccine development: WHO identifies a single-dose rVSV-based vaccine as the leading candidate, developed by IAVI and UTMB. CEPI funds fast-tracked candidates, including the rVSV vaccine and a ChAdOx1-based vaccine from Oxford, to be manufactured by Serum Institute of India; trials could begin in 2–3 months. CEPI also backs a Moderna mRNA vaccine with $50 million; Gavi pledges up to $50 million for production and deployment. INSERM is evaluating whether the licensed Zaire vaccine could protect against Bundibugyo. Treatments under evaluation include remdesivir, obeldesivir, and MBP134 monoclonal antibody. Tedros visited the outbreak epicenter; trials in conflict zones and community trust remain challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 新種エボラウイルスワクチン開発への世界的な推進が加速
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの流行がDRCとウガンダで継続し、約250人の死亡と1,100人以上の感染が報告されている。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・管理可能性が該当するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUK・Oxford・Englandが含まれているが、これらは記事の主題（ワクチン開発の国際的推進）の拠点であり、実際の流行地ではない。実際の発生国はDRCとウガンダ。Indiaは対象国リストに含まれており、Serum Institute of Indiaがワクチン製造に関与するため含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情升公衛緊急事件！石崇良赴桃園機場視察：6月起4機場提供免費採檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak escalates into a public health emergency! Shi Chongliang visits Taoyuan International Airport: starting in June, four airports will provide free testing.
article.articleSummary: WHO declared the Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. From June 3 to June 30, 2026, Taiwan will offer free voluntary Ebola testing at four international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung—for asymptomatic travelers with travel history to DRC or Uganda. Tests use 5 mL of whole blood collected in HEPA-equipped sampling rooms and are voluntary, with ongoing review of procedures. Inbound travelers must complete a 21-day self-health management plan and daily self-report via the public health system. Symptomatic individuals will be fast-tracked to contracted hospitals; border agencies and health authorities will coordinate rapid medical care. Noncompliance can incur NT$10,000–150,000 fines. The public is advised to avoid travel to these countries. Ebola symptoms may be mild early on.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が公衆衛生上の緊急事態に！石崇良が桃園空港を視察：6月から4つの空港で無料検査を提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO が2026年5月17日にコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラを国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と宣言しており、台湾が対応措置を実施している。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な内容はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ PHEIC 宣言に対する台湾の対応である。DRC はスクリーニング対象国に含まれるため PICKUP。台湾は対象国でないが、中国領域（香港・マカオに相当）として China (1814991) に含める。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Penonton Konser F4 Datang saat Campak, Dokter: Bisa Tularkan hingga ke 18 Orang : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: F4 Concertgoers Attended While Having Measles, Doctor: Could Transmit to Up to 18 People: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia — A concertgoer attended an F4 concert while reportedly suffering from measles (campak). A Threads user, theolawp, claimed the individual had measles three days before the show, then recovered and attended, posting photos of a rash. The post drew sharp online criticism, and the user later deleted it. Doctor and health educator Adam Prabata responded via X with a strongly worded message. The article notes the post’s claim that measles could be transmitted to up to 18 people at the concert. The report centers on public reaction and professional commentary rather than clinical confirmation or outbreak data. Published 2026-06-03.

triage.headline_ja: F4コンサート来場者が麻疹患者、医師「最大18人に感染させる可能性」：オケゾーン・ウーマン
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の潜在的な集団曝露イベント（コンサート）が報告されているが、臨床確認やアウトブレイク確認データがなく、ソーシャルメディア投稿に基づく報告のため情報の信頼性が不確定。スクリーニング基準への該当可能性はあるが、詳細な公衆衛生上の影響や実際の感染確認が不明であるため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事はソーシャルメディア投稿に基づく報告であり、公式な保健当局による確認やアウトブレイク調査の報告がない。麻疹患者の身元確認、検査確認、実際の二次感染者の有無など、疫学的詳細が欠落している。医療従事者の発言は推定値であり、実際の感染状況の公式確認が必要。今後の公衆衛生機関からの発表を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Afrika'da ebola alarmı! Aşısı ve tedavisi yok: O ülke teyakkuza geçti!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in Africa! There is no vaccine or treatment: That country has gone on high alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, threaten Nigeria amid cross-border movement and international travel. Nigeria's federal government activated nationwide emergency plans as border areas face elevated risk. No confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in Nigeria, per the NCDC, but authorities issued a regional risk map: High-risk states Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba, and Adamawa; Medium-risk Kaduna, Katsina, Bauchi, Plateau. The outbreaks in Uganda and DRC have generated over 1,000 suspected cases and 247 deaths. Bundibugyo ebolavirus currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; control relies on early detection and rapid response. Transmission is not airborne; it occurs via contact with infected body fluids, contaminated materials, or infected animals. The Emergency Operations Center is fully activated, with a 72-hour deadline for states to submit readiness reports.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ警報！ワクチンと治療法がない：その国が警戒態勢に入った
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での流行、死亡者多数、ナイジェリアでの緊急体制発動により、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ流行はウガンダとDRCで確認されており、ナイジェリアは脅威下の警戒段階。対象国リストではDRCとナイジェリアのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療法なし）による急速な拡大リスク、国家レベルの緊急体制発動は高リスク指標。

article.articleHeadline: تفاصيل رصد الصحة العالمية لانخفاضاً حاداً بحالات إيبولا في الكونغو.. فيديو - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Details from global health surveillance of a sharp decline in Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Video - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began mid-May, marking the country’s seventh Ebola outbreak. In the DRC, suspected cases fell to 116, while laboratory-confirmed infections reached about 321–330, with 48 deaths reported as of 31 May. Across the border in Uganda, WHO records 9 confirmed cases and 1 death; Uganda’s Ministry of Health later added 6 more infections among contacts, bringing total confirmed in Uganda to 15. Diagnostic challenges persist for Bundibugyo, as conventional tests are not consistently effective in early detection, and there is no licensed vaccine for this strain. Authorities continue intensified surveillance and containment efforts to halt transmission within the DRC and to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス感染者数が急激に減少との世界保健機関の監視詳細。ビデオ - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）の確定症例321-330件、死亡48件、国際的な越境感染（ウガンダで15例確認）、診断上の課題、ワクチンなし。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する高リスクシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による第7次エボラ流行。DRC内での感染者減少傾向が報告されているが、確定症例数は依然として高い。ウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されており、国際的な懸念が高い。診断上の課題（従来検査の不十分性）とワクチン非存在が管理上の困難性を増加させている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola alert as Hurungwe activates emergency preparedness
article.articleSummary: Hurungwe district in Zimbabwe activated emergency Ebola preparedness as the Bundibugyo strain sparks concern along the regional transport corridor. A risk-management meeting in Karoi linked district hospitals, health teams and ministries after confirmation by the DRC and WHO of an Ebola outbreak in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Bundibugyo, unlike other strains, has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment, making surveillance crucial. An isolation centre has been established at Chirundu Border Post, about 180 km from Karoi, and travellers are being screened at Chirundu as cross-border movement rises risk. Karoi sits near Chirundu and lies along a corridor from South Africa toward Zambia, DRC, Tanzania and Uganda. Tobacco-season movement increases exposure; calls for a Karoi isolation centre and ongoing port-health operations with trained staff. Community advocates urged stronger coordination, enhanced surveillance, diagnostics, case management, logistics, border health services, and clear public communication.

triage.headline_ja: Ebola警戒：フルングウェがエマージェンシー対応態勢を発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクの3項目が該当。エボラ出血熱の準備態勢発動であり、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で複数該当。対象国ザンビアに関連した地域的脅威。
triage.notes: 記事はジンバブエ・フルングウェ地区のエボラ準備態勢発動が主題だが、対象国リストに照合するとジンバブエは該当しない。ただし地理的に関連するザンビアおよびDRCが確認され、DRCではIturi・North Kivu・South Kivu州でエボラアウトブレーク確認済み。Bundibugyo株は治療法・ワクチンなし。Chirundu国境（ザンビアとの境界）での隔離・スクリーニング実施。対象国ではザンビアとDRCのみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO và EU tăng cường hợp tác ứng phó
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO and the EU step up cooperation in response.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda trigger intensified global response led by WHO and the European Union. The EU has allocated 15 million euros (about 17.4 million USD) for emergency measures, with 5 million euros earmarked for WHO, to strengthen surveillance, prevention, infection control, community engagement, and maintenance of essential health services. The EU’s Humanitarian Air Bridge is delivering 100 tons of emergency supplies to eastern DRC, including sampling kits, viral hemorrhagic fever response equipment, medicines, and expert personnel. China will dispatch medical experts to the DRC, per a 1 June Foreign Ministry statement. India has sent a second large aid consign­ment (43 tons) to Africa CDC in Kampala, Uganda, complementing a 24 May shipment, comprising PPE, diagnostics, sample-transport kits, infection-control supplies, medicines, and food. Ghana’s Health Minister announced on 2 June that travelers from high-risk Ebola areas will be screened to curb importation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHOとEUが協力対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。DRC及びウガンダでのエボラ流行は重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有し、複数国による国際的対応が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事では主にDRC及びウガンダでのエボラ流行が主題。発生地域にUganda(226074)が含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。中国、インド、ガーナは対応国として言及されており、記事の文脈上、これらは対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に含める。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、記事の主題であるため含める。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค ยัน โควิด NB.1.8.1 ยังไม่พบ สัญญาณบ่งชี้ เกิดความรุนแรง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Department of Disease Control confirms that COVID NB.1.8.1 has not yet shown any signs of increased severity.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Disease Control reports the SARS-CoV-2 lineage NB.1.8.1 remains the dominant strain with no signs of increased severity or mortality. As of 2 June 2026, 4,156 COVID-19 cases and 1 death were recorded nationwide. NB.1.8.1 accounts for about 50.95% of detected sequences, followed by JN.1 (24.97%) and XEC (9.14%), with NB.1.8.1 circulating continuously since mid-2025. Despite some mutations that may enhance transmissibility or immune evasion, current epidemiologic and clinical data show no higher risk than previous strains. Most patients exhibit typical respiratory symptoms: fever, cough, sore throat, and runny nose. Thailand maintains a 26-hospital respiratory surveillance network with systematic testing of suspected cases. If anomalies or significant mutations arise, the Medical Science Department will conduct further analyses to classify strains and assess risk. Public health guidance emphasizes hand hygiene, masking in crowded or ill settings, and protecting high-risk groups; hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省、COVID-19の変異株NB.1.8.1は重症化の兆候を示していないと確認
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内でのCOVID-19監視報告であり、NB.1.8.1変異株について重症化の兆候がないと報告されている。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、社会的・政治的な緊急性も認められない。
triage.notes: これは定期的な感染症監視報告であり、NB.1.8.1変異株についてタイ保健省が重症化の兆候がないことを確認している。死亡は1件（4,156症例中）で、既知の呼吸器症状を示している。現在の流行状況は管理下にあると判断される。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला संकट में युगांडा के साथ खड़ा भारत, IAF ने पहुंचाई बड़ी मेडिकल सहायता
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India stands with Uganda in the Ebola crisis; IAF delivered substantial medical aid.
article.articleSummary: India dispatched essential medicines and medical supplies to Uganda to help quell the Ebola outbreak, with an IAF C-17 Globemaster-III leaving New Delhi on 2 June 2026. The mission supports Uganda's response as Bundibugyo virus–driven Ebola spreads across the region, with ongoing concerns in DR Congo and Uganda. As of 27 May, DR Congo reported 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths; by 29 May, 134 confirmed cases across both nations, including 9 in Uganda, with 18 deaths among confirmed cases. Post-21 May, 49 new confirmed cases, 8 new deaths, 160 new suspected cases and 47 suspected deaths. Cross-border movement fuels transmission in border areas. Ebola is a severe, often fatal disease transmitted from wildlife (fruit bats, hyraxes, non-human primates) to humans, and via contact with infected blood or bodily fluids; average fatality about 50%, historically 25–90%. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak was the largest since Ebola's 1976 discovery.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機の中、ウガンダと共に立つインド。IAFが医療支援物資を配送
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の多国にまたがる流行。DRC・ウガンダで確認された感染者・死亡者の報告、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事主題はウガンダのエボラ流行に対するインドの支援である。DRC・ウガンダで発生した流行の報告があるが、対象国はインドのみ。対象国リストに含まれる203312(DRC)と226074(Uganda)も発生地域に記載されているが、記事の主題はインドの支援活動であり、サマリー上で流行の詳細はウガンダ・DRCで発生していることは確認されるが、実際の感染症イベント発生地域は対象国外。ただしインドが支援派遣国として関与しており、準地域的な影響の可能性があるため、インドを verified_locations に含める。高い重症度（致死率約50%）、複数国での確認例、国境越え感染リスク、国際的な医療支援の必要性から、フルRRA対象案件。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Wanita di Jakarta Nonton Konser Saat Sakit Campak, PAPDI: Masih Menularkan!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Woman in Jakarta Attends a Concert While Sick with Measles, PAPDI: Still Contagious!
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia: a woman attended a concert while reportedly suffering from measles. On Threads she claimed a rash appeared three days before the event and that she was 'highly contagious.' PAPDI Vaccination Task Force chair Dr. Sukamto Koesnoe, SpPD K-AI FINASIM, said measles remains transmissible from about four days before rash onset to about four days after, with peak contagion around rash appearance. Therefore, attending the concert would likely have occurred during the period of maximum infectiousness. The post was later deleted, though screenshots circulated, drawing social media concern about possible exposure, particularly to pregnant women. The report provides no laboratory confirmation, case counts, or explicit outbreak details. Dated 2026-06-03, the piece highlights the public health risk when contagious measles intersects large gatherings in Jakarta.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタで麻疹患者が演奏会に出席、ウイルス化 PAPDI：まだ感染力がある！
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の感染力期間中の大規模集会参加という異常な公開保健リスクが識別されたが、ラボ確認がなく患者数・アウトブレイク規模が不明。スクリーニング基準では異常性・流行性が該当するが、確認情報が限定的であるため経過観察判定。
triage.notes: 記事は個別の麻疹患者がコンサート参加時に最大感染力期間にあった可能性を報告。ラボ確認、患者数、二次感染の有無が記載されていない。社会メディアで関心が高いが、公式なアウトブレイク宣言ではない。インドネシアにおける麻疹の流行状況に関する背景情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: 致死率最高90%！伊波拉疫情升溫奪百命　衛福部急撤兩國已發簽證
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Up to 90% fatality rate! Ebola outbreak intensifies, claiming hundreds of lives; MOHW urgently revokes visas already issued by two countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks in Africa (Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda) prompt Taiwan to tighten travel controls. The Ministry of Health and Welfare notes mortality can reach 90%, with global average around 50% and no widely available vaccine or definitive cure. Starting June 2, 2026, visas for residents of Congo DR and Uganda are suspended for 90 days, with exceptions for students, relatives, and medical travelers. From June 3 to June 30, four international airports in Taiwan—Songshan, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung—offer free on-site testing for asymptomatic travelers who have traveled to either country within the previous 21 days, using 5 mL of whole blood collected in HEPA-equipped facilities. All inbound travelers from these countries must undertake 21 days of self-health management after arrival and report health status; symptomatic individuals should call 1922 for medical assistance.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率最高90%！伊波拉疫情升溫奪百命　衛福部急撤兩國已發簽證
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ）におけるエボラ大流行で数百人の死亡が報告され、対象国（DRC）を含む。複数国の検疫体制発動により国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはTaiwan、China、Zhejiang等複数の場所が含まれているが、記事サマリーは「アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ）でのエボラ流行」が主題であり、台湾は対応国として言及されている。対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。エボラウイルス疾患は高い致死率（50～90%）と国際的危険性のため、迅速なフルRRA進行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Spain ta dakatar da wasan sada zumunci tsakaninta da Congo saboda cutar Ebola
article.articleSummary: 3 ga Yuni 2026: Spain ta dakatar da wasan sada zumunci tsakaninta da Demokratik Republic of Congo sakamakon barkewar Ebola a Gabas na Afirka. Shawarwarin jagoranci na La Linea de la Concepcion, Juan Franco, ya bayyana janyewar ‘yan wasa daga wasan don hana yaduwar cutar. Jami’an kiwon lafiya na yankin, wanda yawan mutanen sa kusan 65,000, sun bada shawarar dakatar da wasan a matsayin matakin kariya. Ƙungiyar kwallon kafa ta DR Congo, wadda ta kai kasar ga gasar cin kofin duniya karo na farko tun 1974 (lokacin da ake kira Zaire), za ta buga wasantar sada zumunci da Denmark a Belgium a ranar Laraba. Ƙungiyar ta DR Congo ta dakatar da atisaye a gidansu; a yanzu suna atisayen a Belgium don kare ‘yan wasa daga kamuwa da Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: スペインがエボラ出血熱のため、コンゴとの親善試合を中止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は深刻な国際的公衆衛生脅威であり、複数国での関連性（DRC での流行、スペインでの懸念）が報告されている。IHR基準で3つ該当し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはハウサ語で記述されている。DRC でのエボラ流行が国際試合中止の主因であり、対象国内では DRC のみが該当。スペイン・ベルギー・デンマークは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。エボラ出血熱の疑い例または確定例が DRC で発生していることが暗示されており、これは深刻な国際的公衆衛生イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia di Ebola in Congo: 344 casi confermati, 60 morti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: 344 confirmed cases, 60 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths as of June 3, 2026. The epidemic began in eastern DRC on May 15, with the Ituri province as the epicenter, reporting 322 confirmed cases and 46 deaths. The outbreak has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu provinces and crossed the border into Uganda, where 15 cases and 1 death have been recorded. A bulletin published on X shortly before midnight and updated on Monday provides these figures. The report notes ongoing transmission across multiple provinces and cross-border risk to Uganda, with data reflecting the latest public update.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ流行：確認症例344件、死亡60件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。エボラウイルス病は高致死率かつ国際的懸念であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu各州での流行および隣国ウガンダへの越境例言及があるが、ウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれない）は検証対象外。DRC内での多州にわたる流行拡大とウガンダへの二次的拡大が確認されている。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率（約17.5%）を示す最優先監視対象疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Demam Berdarah Di Manggarai Timur Sudah Berakhir April 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Cases in East Manggarai Regency Have Ended as of April 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in East Manggarai Regency (Manggarai Timur), Indonesia ended by April 2026. The Manggarai Timur Health Office reported 13 dengue cases in April 2026, with 10 clinically diagnosed as dengue fever (DD) and 3 as dengue hemorrhagic fever (DBD). Most cases occurred at Sampek Health Center in Lamba Leda Utara District. All cases were treated successfully with no deaths. There was no uptick in 2026; cases actually declined from the previous year. The outbreak is linked to insufficient community participation in mosquito breeding site elimination (PSN) and lack of Jumantik cadres at every household. Authorities urged weekly PSN activities by all Puskesmas heads and engagement from camats and cross-sector partners to sustain PSN and reduce DBD risk.

triage.headline_ja: 東マンガライ県のデング熱患者は2026年4月に終息
triage.triage_reason: 既に終息した過去のデング熱小規模アウトブレイク（4月に13件、死亡なし）の報告。発生地域は限定的で、2026年と比較して症例数の減少を報告。国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は既に完全に終息したデング熱の小規模アウトブレイク（13件）の過去報告。患者数は前年比で減少し、死亡者がなく、治療成功している。リスク評価対象となるような現在進行中の懸念事項はない。

article.articleHeadline: 防伊波拉境外移入！「台灣4大機場」即起免費採檢 返國後追蹤21天
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Ebola importation from abroad! Free testing starts immediately at Taiwan's four major airports; 21-day post-arrival follow-up.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have been designated by WHO as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Taiwan strengthens border surveillance from June 3–30, offering free Ebola testing at four international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan International, Taichung, and Kaohsiung International—for travelers with travel history to DRC or Uganda who are asymptomatic. Tests involve a voluntary 5 mL whole-blood sample collected by quarantine personnel in a HEPA-filtered space. On arrival, travelers presenting fever or Ebola-like symptoms proceed to medical evaluation through port-based channels; hospitals will assess and treat as needed, with government support for containment. Returnees must undergo 21 days of post-arrival health monitoring with daily self-reports via the Public E-Reporting System; noncompliance may incur fines up to NT$150,000. For assistance, call 1922.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの境外移入を防止！台湾の4大空港で無料検査を即開始、帰国後21日間の追跡調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行がWHOからPHEICとして認定されており、台湾が国境防疫強化と監視体制を導入している。ただし、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは対象国のみとなる。IHR基準では国際的拡大リスク（Yes）が該当し、スクリーニング基準でも長期曝露・流行可能性が該当する可能性がある。情報は十分だが、実際の感染事例報告がないため、続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで台湾地域が発生地域として付与されているが、記事サマリーにおいて台湾での実際のエボラ症例発生の報告はなく、台湾は国境防疫強化を実施している国として記載されている。実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダであることが明記されており、DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。IHR基準は全て該当する重大なシグナルであるが、本シグナルは対象国の実際の発生状況のリアルタイムモニタリング対象としてはすでに把握済みの可能性があるため、WATCHレベルの継続監視として判定。

article.articleHeadline: Acusan a dos científicos de introducir viales de la viruela del mono a EE.UU. obtenidos en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two scientists are accused of introducing monkeypox vials into the United States that were obtained in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two NIH-linked scientists, Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, were charged with bringing unauthorized mpox vials from Africa into the U.S., risking public health. They were detained in January at Detroit Metropolitan Airport on a flight from Paris after a nine-day stay in the Republic of the Congo. The scientists deny bringing materials or biological samples into the United States, contrary to FBI evidence indicating entry with inactivated mpox vials. At customs they allegedly claimed they transported no pathogens, with a senior official saying he did this 'all the time' and that permits were stored on his laptop. Government filings do not explain why they would want inactivated mpox at their lab; the FBI says they are veterans of mpox research. They are due to appear in federal court in Missoula, Montana on Wednesday, June 4, 2026. U.S. federal law requires CDC import permits for any mpox variant, which the scientists did not have.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の科学者がアフリカで入手した痘瘡ウイルスのバイアルを米国に持ち込んだとして起訴
triage.triage_reason: 無許可の感染性物質（不活性化Mpoxバイアル）の国際的な密輸事件であり、IHR基準の「異常・予想外（Yes）」「国際的拡大リスク（Yes）」「渡航制限リスク（Yes）」に該当し、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念と社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 本事件は感染症の『流行』ではなく、政治的・刑事的性質の『密輸事件』であるが、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、無許可の病原体国際移動という公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項。米国・フランス・DRCの複数国が関与する国際的インシデント。記事サマリーの主題はアメリカ国内での起訴だが、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCであり、そこからの密輸が主眼である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, guariti quattro infermieri infettati dal virus. L'Oms: "L'epidemia può essere ancora fermata"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: four nurses infected with the virus have recovered. WHO: "The epidemic can still be stopped."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri region, Bunia) caused by Bundibugyo strain. By June 2, the WHO Africa region reported 344 laboratory-confirmed cases and 60 deaths; as of May 31, 210 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, with 349 suspected cases, and 16 healthcare workers positive. Five healthcare workers (four nurses and a laboratory technician) infected in early May have recovered and were discharged from Bunia hospital. WHO is expanding clinical capacity, renovating a Bunia Ebola treatment center to 24 beds (expandable to 60) and adding a separate wing up to 42 beds to be ready in coming weeks. During a May 30 visit, Tedros urged continued effort, noting that there are no licensed vaccines or treatments yet for Bundibugyo, but several candidates show promise and are being fast-tracked in collaboration with DRC and Uganda. CEPIs funds back three candidate vaccines from IAVI, Moderna, and University of Oxford.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウイルスに感染した4人の看護師が回復。WHO：「流行はまだ止められる」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、ブンディブギョ株による確認症例344件・死亡60件の大規模エボラ流行。国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダでの感染者報告）、ワクチン・治療法未承認による管理困難性、WHO事務局長の緊急対応声明など。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda(Republic of Uganda)が含まれているが、記事サマリーでウガンダでの実際の症例発生は明確に記述されていない（Tedrosが「DRCとウガンダと協力」と述べているが、これはワクチン開発協力の文脈）。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。医療従事者16名の感染と回復報告があり、感染経路の継続的な管理が必要。ブンディブギョ株は稀なエボラ亜種で、ワクチン・治療法未承認の点が管理困難性を増す。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam clarifies ruminant DNA testing for imported animal bone meals to prevent mad cow disease
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Agriculture and Environment clarifies that imported animal protein meals must be tested for ruminant DNA to prevent bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE, mad cow disease). The guidance follows Circular No. 01/2026 on quarantine regulations; embassies of Australia, Brazil, Italy, Germany, South Korea, New Zealand, and the United States raised concerns. Vietnam employs real-time PCR testing with follow-up verifications when positive, referencing EU protocols; results accompany veterinary certifications declaring no ruminant-derived materials. The risk-based measure aligns with WOAH Terrestrial Animal Health Code and international practices in the EU, Australia, and the U.S. to prevent cross-contamination in feed. Since January, 21 shipments from eight exporting countries were found contaminated with ruminant DNA. The regulation aims to safeguard health while avoiding trade barriers, upholding non-discrimination, WTO notification, and a reduced inspection regime for WOAH-negligible risk countries (one in five consignments), with enhanced checks for violations."

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム、狂牛病予防のための輸入動物骨粉のウシDNA検査を明確化
triage.triage_reason: BSE（狂牛病）は人獣共通感染症であり公衆衛生上の関心があるが、本記事はベトナムの輸入検疫措置に関する規制の説明であり、実際の感染症発症事例ではない。ただしBSE汚染飼料の流通リスクが示唆されており、継続的な監視が必要である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数国（米国、イタリア、オーストラリア、ニュージーランド、ドイツ、韓国）を発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーの主題はベトナムの輸入検疫規制であり、汚染が検出された8カ国からの輸入品の検査が対象である。対象国リストに含まれるのはベトナムとブラジルのみ。実際の感染症事例ではなく規制措置であるため、IHR基準は限定的であるが、飼料汚染を通じた長期曝露リスクと国際貿易制限のため注視継続が適切。

article.articleHeadline: I DR Congo spreder ebola-myterne sig lige så hurtigt som virussen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, Ebola myths are spreading as quickly as the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues, centered in Ituri province, with the outbreak persisting for months. More than 1,000 people are suspected to be infected and over 200 deaths attributed to the disease; neighboring Uganda reports 15 Ebola cases. Health workers suspect the outbreak began as early as January and was only detected in mid-May, complicating containment amid armed conflict, testing shortages, and insufficient protective equipment. Survey data cited by ActionAid via Danwatch indicate about one-third of Ituri residents believe Ebola is a myth, with beliefs labeling it satanic or manufactured to profit, undermining surveillance and care-seeking. Anthropologist Karen Lauterbach (University of Copenhagen) notes that while epidemiological explanations exist, religious and spiritual interpretations drive community responses and must be acknowledged to effectively counter transmission. The report emphasizes local beliefs shaping outbreak management.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴではエボラウイルスと同じくらい速くエボラに関する神話が広がっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）、かつ国境を越えた事例（ウガンダでも確認）あり。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRコンゴ東部のイトゥリ州での主要な流行に焦点を当てており、ウガンダは15例の確定事例が報告されているものの、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。1000人以上の感染が疑われ、200人以上の死亡報告、武力紛争による複雑な状況、不十分な検査・防護装備の中での長期的曝露リスク、コミュニティの信頼不足による対応困難が認識されている重大な事態。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉疫情 6/3起自疫區返臺可免費採檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Free Ebola testing for people returning to Taiwan from Ebola-affected areas starts June 3.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan will offer free Ebola testing for asymptomatic travelers from Ebola-affected areas from June 3–30 at Taiwan’s four international airports. Following the WHO’s May 17 PHEIC declaration for Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, border surveillance is strengthened and there is no effective vaccine or treatment currently. Asymptomatic individuals are generally noninfectious; testing is voluntary with traveler consent. About 5 mL of blood will be drawn in approved rooms and sent to the National Defense Medical Center for Ebola testing; results are available in 1–3 working days. Travel advisories for Congo and Uganda have been raised to Level 3 (Warning); avoid nonessential travel and cooperate with quarantine. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or bleeding; report to quarantine staff or call 1922.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の疫情を防止 6月3日から疫区から台湾に帰国する者は無料検査が可能
triage.triage_reason: WHOが2024年5月17日にコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラアウトブレイクについてPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。エボラは極めて重大な感染症であり、IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」「国際的に拡大するリスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾の防疫対応措置を報じているが、実際の感染症イベント発生国はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダ。対象国リストからはDRCのみが該当。台湾は対象国外であるが、Chinaの一部として扱うため中国を含める。WHOのPHEIC宣言により国際的な重要性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Doi cercetători au fost puși sub acuzare după ce au fost prinși încercând să treacă frontiera cu peste 100 de fiole care conțineau un virus din Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two researchers have been charged after being caught trying to cross the border with over 100 vials containing a virus from Congo.
