article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) samples from the Republic of Congo (Congo-Brazzaville) were seized at Detroit airport in January when two NIH-affiliated virologists returning to the United States with 113 vials were detained. Vincent Munster, a Dutch citizen and section chief at an NIH virology lab, and Claude Kwe, a Cameroonian researcher, are charged with importing biological samples under false pretenses and with lying about contents; 17 of 20 vials tested by the FBI contained inactivated mpox virus. They face up to five years in prison. The case underscores biosecurity concerns around imported materials from Africa. The African Union had earlier said mpox was no longer a public health emergency in Africa, while WHO reported over 34,000 mpox cases and 138 deaths globally from January 2025 through July 2025. Mpox typically presents with high fever and skin lesions.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の研究者がコンゴのウイルスを含む100以上のバイアルを携帯して国境を越えようとしたとして起訴された
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxウイルスサンプルの国際的な違法輸送事件であり、バイオセキュリティ上の重大な懸念を示している。IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・長期曝露・管理可能性が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ由来のMpoxサンプルの違法輸送事件である。検査地点がデトロイト（米国）であり、容疑者のうち1名がカメルーン国籍であるが、記事の焦点はコンゴからの違法搬出事件であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。カメルーンは発生地域リストに含まれていることを確認したが、記事サマリーではカメルーンでのMpox発生は主題ではなく、研究者の国籍として言及されているのみ。Mpoxは既に対象国リストに含まれる複数の国で流行しており、このバイオセキュリティ侵害は国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le recours précoce aux soins recommandé pour sauver des vies (Institut national de santé publique) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Early access to care recommended to save lives (National Institute of Public Health) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Early access to health facilities is essential to improve survival and limit Ebola virus disease spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to a joint Government-INSP report released 3 June 2026. Prompt care at symptom onset and rapid case identification help interrupt transmission chains and strengthen response efforts. As of 3 June 2026, 344 cumulative confirmed Ebola cases (23 new in the last 24 hours) and 60 deaths have been reported across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. There are 116 suspected cases under investigation and 173 suspected cases in isolation. Ituri remains the epicenter with four active foci: Bunia (80 confirmed, 8 deaths), Rwampara (65/13), Mongbwalu zone (47/10), and Mambasa (2/1). Surveillance, contact tracing and community outreach continue to contain the outbreak; Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted mainly through contact with infected fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：生命を救うために推奨される早期医療へのアクセス（国立公衆衛生研究所）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。確認患者344名、死亡60名の進行中のエボラ流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、イベントはDRC内のIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州で発生しており、ルワンダは地理的に隣接しているが、サマリーではDRCのみが主題。Machupo（ボリビア由来）とEbolaの両方が疾患名として記載されているが、サマリー内容はEbolaのみを扱っている。進行中の大規模流行（344確認患者、60死亡）で、複数焦点が活動中。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Şüpheli Ebola Vakalarının Sayısı Laboratuvar İncelemelerinin Ardından 1.077'den 116'ya Düştü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Congo, the number of suspected Ebola cases fell from 1,077 to 116 after laboratory investigations.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), suspected Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases declined to 116 as of June 3, 2026, after laboratory investigations ruled out Ebola for most who presented with Ebola-like symptoms. The Ministry of Health also reports over 340 confirmed EVD cases and 60 deaths, with 6 recoveries and 173 suspected cases still in isolation. WHO spokesperson Christian Lindmeier said the drop results from many suspected cases not being Ebola upon testing, with some individuals found to have malaria or meningitis. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026, and monitoring continues in the DRC, with ongoing efforts to isolate and test suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで疑い例のエボラ患者数が検査後に1,077人から116人に減少
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的懸念、異常・予想外）。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済みの活発なエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 確定症例340名、死亡60名、回復6名の報告あり。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療法なし）による進行中の公衆衛生上の緊急事態。WHO PHEC宣言済み。マラリア・髄膜炎も検出されている。

article.articleHeadline: ÜST-dən Ebola ilə bağlı XƏBƏRDARLIQ: Yoluxanların sayı kəskin artır
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Ebola alert: the number of infections is rising sharply.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains active, with 282 confirmed infections and 42 deaths, and more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. For the Bundibugyo strain, there is currently no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral treatment; however, early case finding and supportive care are emphasized as increasing survival chances. Brazil reports two suspected Ebola cases, though initial laboratory results point to meningitis and malaria rather than Ebola. Italy reports a negative test result for a passenger who had returned from the Congo. The World Health Organization cautions that the risk of further international spread persists, underscoring the need for vigilant surveillance and rapid responses to suspected cases in multiple countries.

triage.headline_ja: WHO エボラアラート：感染数が急増している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ確定症例282件（死亡42件）と疑似症例1,100件以上という重大な公衆衛生上の影響、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、予想外の国際的な感染事例報告により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: ブラジルおよびイタリアで報告された事例は検査結果により髄膜炎およびマラリアなど他疾患と特定されたため、主要な発生地域はDRCに限定。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチンや特異的抗ウイルス治療が利用不可という管理上の課題がある。WHOによる警告が発出されており、国際的な感染事例確認が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 致死率最高90%！伊波拉疫情升溫奪百命 衛福部急撤兩國已發簽證
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Up to 90% fatality rate! Ebola outbreak intensifies, claiming hundreds of lives. The Ministry of Health and Welfare urgently revokes visas issued by two countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks intensify in Africa with hundreds of deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, where case fatality can reach 90% (global average ~50%); no effective vaccine or definitive cure cited. Taiwan’s Ministry of Health and Welfare and CDC report border tightened measures: visa suspension for residents of DR Congo and Uganda for 90 days starting May 2–3, with prior visas canceled; exemptions for students, relatives (spouses/children), and medical travelers. From June 3 to June 30, four international airports (Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan, Taichung, Kaohsiung) offer free 5 mL whole-blood testing for asymptomatic travelers with travel history to either country within 21 days, in HEPA-equipped rooms. Inbound travelers must 21 days self-health-manage and complete health declarations; contact 1922 if symptoms arise. Measures aim to block imported risk with potential extensions if the outbreak persists.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率最高90%！伊波拉疫情升溫奪百命 衛福部急撤兩國已發簽證
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では公衆衛生への深刻な影響（数百人の死亡、高い致死率）と国際拡大リスク（複数国での発生、台湾の入国制限措置）が認められ2基準以上該当。WPROスクリーニングでも異常性、重症度、流行性、管理可能性の複数基準が該当し、政府・社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはTaiwanやアフリカ全体が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC、ウガンダでのエボラ発生である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。台湾の入国制限措置は二次的対応であり、一次発生地ではない。アフリカ大陸での発生激化と高い致死率が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: WM 2026 im Live-Blog: Wegen Ebola: WM-Test der DR Kongo in Spanien abgesagt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026 live blog: Due to Ebola, DR Congo's World Cup warm-up match in Spain has been canceled.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared May 15 in Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, prompted cancellation of DR Congo's World Cup warm-up against Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain (June 9). No case or death tallies are given. La Linea's mayor cited health precautions following Andalusia regional health-service recommendations. DR Congo coach Sébastien Desabre said alternatives—other venues or behind-closed-doors play—are possible, with FIFA guidelines followed. The team plans to base in Houston for the World Cup (June 11–July 19); entry to the United States could require a three-week bubble, per White House WM official Andrew Giuliani. In Group K, DR Congo meets Portugal on June 17 in Houston; other fixtures include Colombia in Guadalajara (June 24) and Uzbekistan in Atlanta (June 28). Mexico also restricted entry for travelers who recently visited Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ ライブブログ：エボラ熱の影響でDRコンゴのワールドカップ準備試合がスペインで中止に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の国際的な感染症イベント（DRC発生、複数国への国際的拡大リスク）であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。国境を越えた渡航制限（米国への入国制限、メキシコへの入国制限）が実施されており、国際的影響が明確。
triage.notes: 2026年ワールドカップに関連する記事だが、中心的な感染症イベントはDRCのイツリ州で発生したエボラ熱である。複数国への渡航・貿易制限が実装されている（米国、メキシコ）。記事サマリーに基づき、実際の発生地はDRCのみ；他の場所（スペイン、米国など）は二次的な影響地域。死亡者数や症例数の詳細が記載されていない点は注意。

article.articleHeadline: Nederlandse viroloog in de VS vervolgd om smokkel van het mpox-virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dutch virologist in the U.S. prosecuted for smuggling the mpox virus.
article.articleSummary: 53-year-old Dutch virologist working at a Rocky Mountains laboratory in the United States was arrested at Detroit Metropolitan Airport for smuggling the mpox virus. He and a colleague were found with 113 vials packed in foam coolers after returning in January from the Republic of Congo, where mpox was in outbreak. Mpox, also called monkeypox, is highly contagious and presents flu-like symptoms with skin lesions; most patients recover within a few weeks. U.S. prosecutors say the virologists violated laws by transporting viral pathogens on a crowded commercial flight from an outbreak region, and that they misrepresented the contents of the package. They argue public trust and citizen safety were endangered. The research institution involved declined to comment.

triage.headline_ja: オランダの医学博士、米国でmpoxウイルス密輸罪で起訴
triage.triage_reason: Mpox（Clade IおよびII）の国際的な違法輸送事案。発生地域がDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）と米国の両国に及び、バイオセキュリティ侵害と公衆衛生上の懸念が存在。IHR基準の異常性・予想外性および国際的リスク、ならびにWPRO基準の流行しやすさと管理可能性に該当。
triage.notes: 本事案はMpox Clade I/IIの国際的な違法輸送・バイオセキュリティ侵害であり、公衆衛生上および法執行上の重大な関心事である。発生地域にはUSAとMichiganも含まれるが、米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。DRCはMpox流行地域として記事の主題の核となっている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva a 344 los casos confirmados de ébola, con 60 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises confirmed Ebola cases to 344, with 60 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists with 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths as of the latest update. Ituri province remains the epicenter, reporting 322 cases and 46 deaths; the outbreak began there on May 15 and has spread to North and South Kivu, with spillover into Uganda (15 cases, one death). Six recoveries reported. Suspected cases under investigation per WHO: 116; Congolese authorities report 173 suspected in isolation. Bunia airport reopened after closure due to the crisis. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, with a case fatality rate estimated by WHO between 30% and 50%; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; the virus likely circulated in Ituri about two months before declaration.

triage.headline_ja: DRC raises confirmed Ebola cases to 344, with 60 deaths.
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の爆発的流行で344確定例・60死亡を報告。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国への波及（ウガンダ15例）と高い致命率（30-50%）を示す。IHR基準4項目全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの波及が記載されているが、主要な流行はDRC（Ituri, South Kivu, North Kivu）であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダはスピルオーバー2次例。WHOのPHEIC宣言、高い致命率、ワクチン/治療法の不在、複数州での持続的伝播がフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Postimi përhap dezinformata rreth hantavirusit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The post spreads disinformation about the hantavirus.
article.articleSummary: Online posts claim the U.S. Army patented a hantavirus vaccine in 1991–1997, implying a lab-created virus and a Pfizer-listed vaccine adverse event. Hantaviruses occur naturally in rodents; documented since the Korean War. There is a patent US5614193A for a hantavirus vaccine concept, owned by the U.S. Army, but no licensed vaccine exists. Local experimental vaccines (e.g., Hantavax) have been tested in Korea and China, but are not globally approved. Pfizer’s FOIA materials mention Hantavirus pulmonary infection among Adverse Events of Special Interest (AESI); AESI is a monitoring category, not proof of causation. The WHO Polaris II exercise (April 22–23) was a routine pandemic drill, not evidence of an imminent outbreak. Reports from the MV Hondius note no vaccine or specific treatment. Conclusion: the claim is partially false, dependent on misinterpretation of science and regulatory language.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスに関する誤情報を拡散する投稿
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は誤情報の検証・否定内容であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。シグナル定義に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は誤情報の分析・反論記事である。ハンタウイルスの実際の発症報告、アウトブレイク、流行の報告は含まれていない。Bluedot APIが韓国・米国・中国を抽出したが、記事サマリーはこれらの国での現在進行中の病原体感染イベントを述べていない。検証可能な対象国はサマリー内で言及される実験ワクチン（Hantavax）の試験国として中国のみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: WHO declares mpox a global health emergency
article.articleSummary: Mpox has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by WHO on 2026-06-03 as Africa's mpox surge becomes a global threat. The emergency committee advised that the situation constitutes a PHEIC, a view accepted by Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The decision follows the African Union's own emergency declaration and centers on the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where mpox (monkeypox) was first identified in humans in 1970, with over 14,000 cases and 524 deaths reported in the DRC this year, exceeding last year’s total. The more severe clade 1b, spreading largely through sexual networks, has been detected in four neighboring countries—Burundi, Kenya, Rwanda, and Uganda—adding about 90 cases in the past month. Mpox transmits from animals to humans and via close human contact; symptoms include fever, muscular aches and large boil-like skin lesions. Two vaccines are recommended; WHO aims to coordinate a response with partners including Red Cross/IFRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがサル痘をグローバルヘルスエマージェンシーとして宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、アフリカにおける大規模流行、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率を特徴とする。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはRwanda、Kenya、Burundi、Ugandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主要な発生地域はDRCであり、他国は隣接国での限定的な検出として言及されている。WPRO対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOによるPHEIC宣言は国際的対応を要する重大事象。

article.articleHeadline: Ứng dụng công nghệ số để kiểm soát, đẩy lùi dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Using digital technology to control and curb epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Digital tools streamline dengue fever surveillance in Hanoi using Google Maps, Google My Maps, and Google Sheets to map case coordinates, delineate risk zones, and monitor outbreaks in real time. Hanoi CDC piloted the approach from July 2025 in several communes and wards, aiming to strengthen local public health response and accelerate data sharing across units. The initiative, rooted in the 2024 Resolution 57-NQ/TW on science, technology, and digital transformation, reduces outbreak delineation time from 2–4 hours to 10–15 minutes and provides color-coded risk maps highlighting households and neighborhoods with higher risk. Training sessions for Long Biên ward health stations improved data management, mapping, area classification, and trend tracking of dengue cases. Data sharing supports targeted interventions (entomological investigations, vector control, environmental sanitation, and health education). Hanoi CDC also transferred knowledge to Cao Bằng Province to scale the model across the region.

triage.headline_ja: デジタル技術を用いた感染症の制御と蔓延防止
triage.triage_reason: 記事は既存のデング熱監視システムにおけるデジタルツール活用の事例報告であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、患者数急増、重症化の報告ではない。公衆衛生対応の技術的改善に焦点があり、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はハノイにおけるデング熱サーベイランスの技術的改善事例であり、具体的な新規アウトブレイク報告、患者数の増加、重症度の上昇を示すシグナル情報は含まれていない。政府主導のデジタル変革イニシアティブの実装報告である。

article.articleHeadline: Nederlandse viroloog in VS aangeklaagd voor smokkelen mpox-virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dutch virologist in the U.S. charged with smuggling mpox virus.
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, a Dutch virologist, Munster, head of the virus ecology section at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana, is charged after attempting to smuggle mpox virus samples into the United States. In January 2026, he and colleague Claude Kwe arrived at Detroit Metropolitan Airport on a flight from Paris, after spending nine days in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Customs found vials in their baggage; Munster had denied traveling with biological material. An FBI investigation and U.S. court filings later revealed the vials contained deactivated mpox samples, the virus formerly known as monkeypox.

triage.headline_ja: オランダ人ウイルス学者、米国でムポックスウイルスの密輸で起訴
triage.triage_reason: ムポックスウイルスの違法な国際輸送事案であり、バイオセキュリティ上の懸念はあるが、本イベントは犯罪事案の報道であり、感染症の流行・発生ではなく、公衆衛生への直接的な影響は限定的。情報不足の部分も多く、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事案は感染症発生ではなく、ウイルスサンプルの違法輸送に関する犯罪事案である。サマリーによれば搬入されたサンプルは「不活化」されており、活性のあるウイルスではない。米国（Montana、Detroit、Michigan）およびフランス（Paris）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。DRCは記事で言及されているが、この事案における感染症の流行地としての役割は明確でない。バイオセキュリティ観点での関心は高いが、IHRスクリーニング基準における公衆衛生的な流行リスクは低いと評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Experten: Tidsfråga innan ebola sprids över världen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert: A matter of time before Ebola spreads across the world.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the third-largest on record, with more than 1,200 infections and about 250 deaths, according to BMJ. Emergency medicine consultant Simon Mardel warns it is 'only a matter of time' before Ebola spreads to other continents and countries with under-resourced health systems. Aid organizations, including the IRC, fear many cases remain undetected, with contact tracing capturing only roughly 20% of potential exposures. The outbreak was officially confirmed on 15 May but is believed to have begun in January, allowing months of uncontrolled transmission. The report underlines rising global risk and highlights the need for intensified surveillance, swift laboratory confirmation, and expanded public health response to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家：エボラがオランダ全土に広がるまで時間の問題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。コンゴにおける過去3番目の規模のエボラ流行で、1,200以上の感染と約250の死亡があり、国際的な懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行は過去3番目の規模。記事は5月15日の正式確認前から1月からの流行を示唆しており、数ヶ月間にわたる検査されない伝播が懸念される。接触追跡の有効性は約20%に限定されており、管理可能性が低い。国際的な拡大リスクが高いとの専門家警告が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, 344 casi confermati e 60 decessi nella Repubblica democratica del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Large Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15. The outbreak has reached 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths, according to the WHO; six confirmed cases have recovered. Transmission occurs through close contact and body fluids and can cause a fatal hemorrhagic fever. While earlier WHO figures counted 223 deaths suspected to be Ebola, these cases are no longer included in current tallies, as some deaths occurred long ago and remains could not be exhumed for testing, introducing uncertainty into the count. Laboratory confirmation has been performed on suspected cases; many were excluded after testing. The Ituri region is war-torn, complicating outbreak response. The article notes ongoing infection, with confirmed recoveries among those infected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ民主共和国で344例の確認症例と60例の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は致死的で公衆衛生への影響は深刻、国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限リスクもある。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則で最高レベルの懸念疾患。Ituri州は紛争地域であり、感染症対応が複雑化している。344例の確認症例と60例の死亡は深刻な流行の指標。WHOが公式にカウントしており、国際的な関心も高い。ザンビア・フィリピン・タイ等の他対象国への言及はないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情当前 美国"重新对接"全球疫苗免疫联盟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid the Ebola outbreak, the United States re-engages with the Global Alliance for Vaccines and Immunisation.
article.articleSummary: Amid Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, the United States will re-engage with the Global Alliance for Vaccines and Immunisation (GAVI). Senator Marco Rubio told a June 2 Senate Foreign Relations Committee hearing that Washington decided to restart engagement and may appoint a coordinator for the U.S. Ebola response. Previously, HHS Secretary Robert Kennedy Jr. announced last June that the United States would stop funding GAVI’s roughly $300 million annual pledge, citing vaccine safety concerns without evidence. The Trump era withheld allocations approved by Congress for FY2025 and FY2026; bipartisan senators urged release. The WHO on May 17 declared the Congo (Kinshasa) and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Rubio said on May 27 that no Ebola case would enter the United States. The United States plans to relocate at-risk Americans abroad to a temporary Kenyan facility, which Kenya’s courts halted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行下で、米国は世界ワクチン予防接種同盟と「再びつながる」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公式にPHEIC宣言済みの多国間エボラ流行に関する記事であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているエボラ流行発生国はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみがWPRO対象国として検証。ただしウガンダでの流行に対する米国の対応（ケニアへの一時施設への計画）も記事の主要な内容であることに注意。米国の意思決定と国際的なエボラ対応に関する政策変更が主テーマ。PHEC宣言は2026年5月17日で確認済み。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية ترصد انخفاضاً حاداً بحالات إيبولا المشتبه فيها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization monitors a sharp decline in suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports a sharp decline in suspected Ebola cases in Central Africa. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), suspected cases dropped to 116 as of May 31, 2026, from 906 the prior week. Total confirmed Ebola cases in the region reached 330, with 321 confirmed in the DRC and 48 deaths there; neighboring Uganda reported 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. As of May 31, the drop in suspected cases contrasts with the rising confirmed tally, indicating ongoing diagnostic updates and continued cross-border risk with Uganda. The report underscores ongoing monitoring of an Ebola outbreak centered in the DRC, with cross-border transmission to Uganda noted among confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ出血熱の疑い例の急激な減少を監視
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行（確定例330例、死亡48例）に加え、コンゴ民主共和国からウガンダへの越境感染が確認されており、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、越境拡大）も満たすため、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が記載されているが、対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを列挙。ウガンダは対象国外。疑い例の減少は報告されているが、確定例330例（DRC 321例、死亡48例）の継続的な増加と越境感染の存在により、アウトブレイクは進行中と評価。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo elevó a 344 los casos confirmados de ébola por brote del virus Bundibugyo: 60 personas han muerto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 344 in Bundibugyo virus outbreak: 60 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo concentrates in Ituri province, with 344 confirmed cases and about 60 deaths as of June 3, 2026. The Ituri epicenter accounts for 322 cases and 46 deaths; 116 suspects under investigation and 173 suspects in isolation. Six recoveries have been reported. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri near the Uganda-South Sudan border and has spread to North and South Kivu provinces and into Uganda, which has 15 confirmed cases and one death. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% case fatality rate; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO designated the event a public health emergency of international concern, elevating risk to very high. Bunia’s airport was reopened, and surveillance in Mambasa continues as containment efforts proceed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ブンディブギョウイボラウイルスの流行で確認症例数を344に引き上げ：60人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象(PHEIC)指定、WPRO基準全項目該当
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウ株イボラウイルスの大規模流行。344確認症例、60死亡、30-50%の症例致命率。ウガンダへの越境伝播あり（15確認症例、1死亡）。WHOがPHEIC指定。ワクチンおよび特異的治療法なし。Ituri省が流行中心（322症例、46死亡）。South KivuおよびIturi省で確認。地域検証：記事の主題は全てDRCでの流行のため、DRCのみverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Assures Travellers of Safety Amidst Ebola Concerns
article.articleSummary: Six new Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases were reported in Uganda on June 2, raising the cumulative total to 15 with one death. The outbreak, declared May 15, centers on Kampala after a Congolese national died in a city hospital; additional cases involve Congolese nationals treated in Ugandan facilities. Over 100 health workers have been identified as contacts, with a few testing positive while in quarantine, and some individuals on a no-fly list. The incubation window is 2–21 days. By June 2, about 12 patients were being treated at the Mulago Ebola Treatment Centre, with two discharged after recovery. Uganda has closed the DR Congo border and intensified community sensitization and contact tracing, while officials insist the country remains safe for travelers and that the outbreak will be brought under control soon.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ懸念の中で旅行者の安全を保証
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の二国間での発生が確認されている。ウガンダでは6月2日に新たに6例が報告され、累計15例、死亡1例。DRC国籍者がウガンダの医療施設で治療を受けており、国境間での感染伝播の可能性がある。100名以上の医療従事者が接触者として特定されており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Disengat Tawon hingga Infeksi, Jemaah Haji Asal Empat Lawang Dipulangkan Lebih Awal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wasp Stings Leading to Infection, Empat Lawang Hajj Pilgrims Sent Home Early
article.articleSummary: 443 Hajj pilgrims from Palembang’s Kloter 2 arrived home safely on June 3, 2026, including Lismawati (63) of Empat Lawang who was sent home early due to a serious infection from a wasp sting. She had been moved from Kloter 12 to Kloter 2 for health reasons; the sting occurred just before departure to Saudi Arabia, with swelling and hand infection worsening during the pilgrimage, and she has a history of diabetes. Despite the infection, she completed the Hajj rituals. Public Health authorities confirmed tanazul (early repatriation) due to her condition; her hand infection and diabetes were noted, but she is stabilized and sent home. Four other South Sumatra pilgrims remain under care in Saudi Arabia—one with a thigh fracture from a fall and others with heart disease—all stable and expected to return with their kloter as scheduled.

triage.headline_ja: スズメバチに刺され感染症、エンパッラワン出身の巡礼者が早期帰国
triage.triage_reason: 個別の医学的事象（蜂刺傷による感染）であり、公衆衛生上の広がりや異常性は認められない。感染症の通常の感染症監視対象ではなく、巡礼者個人の健康問題である。
triage.notes: Unknown Illness（不明疾病）として分類されているが、サマリーから明確に蜂刺傷による二次感染（手の感染）であり、感染症の自然発生流行ではない。個別の医学的管理事象であるため、シグナルとしてピックアップせず。

article.articleHeadline: WHO And EU Ramp Up Ebola Response: Why The Disease Remains A Concern
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-03, WHO and the EU escalate Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda amid a Bundibugyo-strain outbreak. The eastern DRC outbreak centers in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with hundreds of confirmed cases and dozens of deaths; Uganda reports infections linked to cross-border transmission from DRC. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment, increasing reliance on rapid diagnosis, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, surveillance, and community outreach. Symptoms begin with fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain, then vomiting, diarrhoea, organ dysfunction, and sometimes bleeding; early detection is critical due to similarity with malaria or typhoid. WHO and EU have designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC); EU provides 15 million euros in humanitarian aid; genomic sequencing and supplies are being scaled up, though ongoing conflict and displacement hinder access.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとEU、エボラ対応を強化：なぜこの病気は懸念の対象であり続けるのか
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のPHEIC宣言、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、WHOとEUによる大規模対応、及びIHR基準4項目すべてに該当するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ(Republic of Uganda)が含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは「DRCからの越境感染」に関連する二次的な事例として述べられており、主な発生地はDRC東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク、PHEIC宣言、ワクチンなし、複数死亡者、紛争と人口移動による対応困難という複合的リスク要因を認識。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Experts explain why this strain is different
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola involving the rare Bundibugyo strain, which is associated with severe disease and has no approved vaccine, heightens reliance on surveillance, early detection, and rapid response. Reported and discussed on June 2, 2026, by Kenya Medical Research Institute Ebola coordinator Wallace Bulimo, the strain’s severity underscores differences among Ebola variants. The situation shows rising infections and deaths over a short period, raising regional concern about neighboring countries, notably the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, which remain on high-risk alert due to regional movement and trade links. Common symptoms include fever, severe fatigue, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain; severe cases may involve unexplained bleeding. Diagnosis requires laboratory testing, and once confirmed, a case is officially recorded as Ebola. Public health emphasis remains on preparedness and relying on official guidance to limit panic and spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：専門家がこの株が異なる理由を説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の流行で、ワクチンなし、高い重症度、複数国への拡大リスク、地域内の渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケニアでの検出報告が述べられているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダも記事中で「高リスク警戒」として言及されているが、実際の発生地域として明記されていないため除外。DRCのみが明確な発生地域として確認される。Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルス種の中でも特に稀で高い致命率を示す株であり、承認ワクチン不在という点で重大な公衆衛生リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Dutch, Cameroonian charged with smuggling monkeypox into U.S.
article.articleSummary: Munster, Vincent (53, Netherlands) and Claude Kwe (38, Cameroon)—researchers with the NIH at Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Hamilton, Montana—were charged with conspiracy to smuggle monkeypox into the United States and making false statements to authorities. Working in a Biosafety Level 4 lab studying emerging viral pathogens, they traveled from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, where monkeypox outbreaks were occurring, to Detroit's McNamara Terminal on January 25, 2026. Customs officers observed a large black case; they claimed it contained diagnostics equipment. FBI and CBP investigations revealed the case held 113 vials in Styrofoam coolers. Of 20 vials tested, 17 contained deactivated monkeypox virus, one contained chickenpox virus, and two contained human DNA. They face up to five years' imprisonment.

triage.headline_ja: オランダ人とカメルーン人の研究者がサル痘を米国に密輸した容疑で起訴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で『異常/予想外』『国際的拡大リスク』『渡航制限リスク』の3項目該当。BSL-4施設の研究者による意図的な病原体密輸事件であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念と国際的なバイオセキュリティインシデントとして認識される。
triage.notes: 本件はバイオセキュリティ違反に該当する重大インシデント。NIH傘下のBSL-4施設の研究者が関与しており、FBI・CBPの刑事捜査対象。113vialのサル痘ウイルス（うち17vialが確認）および水痘ウイルスの密輸で、流行可能性を有するMpox Clade I/IIの関連性は確認されていないが、バイオテロ・バイオセキュリティリスク評価が必要。DRC・Republic of Congo・Cameroonの3つのアフリカ国は現在もMpox流行地域であり、国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dünya Kupası öncesi ABD'de Ebola önlemi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola measures in the United States ahead of the World Cup
article.articleSummary: Ebola screening centers will be established at U.S. airports expected to see heavy international traffic ahead of the 2026 World Cup, with heightened public health measures to prevent importation of Ebola. Medicare and Medicaid Services Administrator Dr. Mehmet Öz said at a White House briefing that a well-structured plan coordinates agencies including the National Institutes of Health to ensure preparedness during the tournament, which begins June 11. NIH Director Jay Bhattacharya is cited as playing an active role in managing the Ebola process. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever first identified in 1976 at Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, Democratic Republic of the Congo; named after the Ebola River. The West Africa outbreak from 2013–2016 affected Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, with tens of thousands infected and more than 11,000 deaths. The new U.S. measures aim to curb risks associated with international mobility and potential imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ前のアメリカでのエボラ対策
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は米国の予防的対策についての報道であり、実際のエボラ発生イベントではない。対象国内での感染症発生事例ではなく、歴史的背景情報と将来の準備態勢を述べているのみ。
triage.notes: 記事は米国でのエボラスクリーニング施設の設立を述べた予防措置の報道であり、アクティブな感染症発生イベントではない。DRCは歴史的背景（1976年のエボラ初確認地）として言及されているのみで、現在の発生状況ではない。Bluedotが提供した多数の発生地域は、主に歴史的参照またはコンテキスト情報であり、実際のシグナルイベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Déplacés en RDC : "Si Ebola arrive, nous serons exterminés" - Le Soleil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Displaced in the DRC: "If Ebola arrives, we will be exterminated" - Le Soleil
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is confronting its 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, declared on May 15, 2026. By 3 June 2026, authorities report over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, concentrated in Ituri province around Bunia. Nearly 1 million people are displaced in Ituri across 61 camps housing more than 970,000 individuals; at Kigonze camp near Bunia, more than 25,000 displaced residents live in tarps and tents, with no confirmed Ebola cases yet, but conditions include poor sanitation, scarce clean water, and lack of protective kits. There is no specific treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola; outbreak response hinges on barrier measures and rapid case detection. The WHO warns the outbreak is accelerating, and Congolese authorities face critique for a delayed response. Bunia airport has limited operation, aiding humanitarian flights amid displacement being a key risk factor.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の国内避難民：「エボラが来たら、我々は絶滅する」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。現在進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（1,000件以上の疑い患者、246人の死亡、WHO警告）であり、避難民キャンプという脆弱な環境での急速な感染拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるアウトブレイク。治療法・ワクチンなし。避難民97万人以上の劣悪な衛生環境（水不足、防護具欠乏）が急速な感染拡大の主要リスク。WHO が加速を警告。対象国リストに DRC（203312）が含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: فريق من الخبراء الصينيين يصل إلى الكونغو الديمقراطية للسيطرة على فيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A team of Chinese experts arrives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to control the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, a team of Chinese epidemiology experts arrived in Kinshasa, the capital of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, for a three-month mission to bolster local efforts to control the Ebola virus outbreak. Led by Lou Ming, the team will work immediately with Congolese authorities and local medical institutions to safeguard lives and strengthen outbreak prevention, control, and treatment. Loko Malio Marius, spokesperson for the DRC Ministry of Health, welcomed the timely Chinese assistance and expressed hope this mission will enhance the country's capacity to prevent and manage epidemics and to curb Ebola transmission promptly. The move follows the World Health Organization's 17 May declaration of Ebola as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, indicating international concern and urgency.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の専門家チームがコンゴ民主共和国に到着し、エボラウイルスの制御に当たる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)における届出対象疾患であり、WHOが5月17日にPHEIC宣言を行った国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態である。記事はDRCでの流行の深刻性と国際的対応の活発化を示唆する情報を含む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのキンシャサでのエボラ流行が主題であり、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。中国が援助チームを派遣する主体として言及されているが、エボラ流行の発生地はDRCであり、記事の重点はDRCでの流行対応にある。Bluedot APIが中国を発生地域として含めているのは誤りと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: House Raises Alarm Over NCDC Funding Crisis As Ebola Risk Emerges
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s House of Representatives warns that chronic underfunding at the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) jeopardizes preparedness for Ebola and other epidemic-prone diseases, urging immediate federal funding. Africa CDC warned on May 15 of a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Ituri Province, DR Congo; Nigeria was placed at high risk of importation as of May 25, 2026. Bundibugyo has no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment, making prevention and rapid response essential. Nigeria’s NCDC has activated preparedness and the National Emergency Operations Centre, with no confirmed Ebola case to date. WHO’s Chikwe Ihekweazu said Nigeria is less likely to witness another outbreak, citing strengthened surveillance and lower cross-border exposure than Uganda and DR Congo. Persistent funding gaps: 2025 operational funding absent, 2026 capital and overhead releases irregular; vendors unpaid for over a year, stalling laboratories, treatment centres, isolation facilities, and exhausting reagents, undermining disease detection and response.

triage.headline_ja: NCDC資金危機が深刻化する中、エボラ出血熱のリスクが浮上—下院が警告を発動
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC→ナイジェリアへの輸入リスク）があり、IHR基準2つ以上該当。ナイジェリアの感染症対応能力の著しい低下（資金不足による検査・隔離施設の機能停止）がスクリーニング基準複数項目に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRCで確認されたBundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）がナイジェリアへの輸入リスクの高い状態。ナイジェリアの国家感染症対応機関（NCDC）の深刻な資金危機により、検査・隔離施設の機能停止が報告されており、対応能力の著しい低下が懸念される。一方、WHOはナイジェリアでの二次感染リスクは比較的低いと評価している。Uganda（226074）も発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは対象国リストに非該当のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola Bundibugyo en RDC alcanza los 344 casos y 60 fallecidos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC has reached 344 cases and 60 confirmed deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 344 confirmed cases and 60 confirmed deaths (case fatality 17.4%). Ituri is the epicenter with 322 cases and 46 deaths, including Bunia (80 cases, 8 deaths); Rwampara (65 cases, 13 deaths); Mongbwalu (47 cases, 10 deaths). Kivu Norte reports 19 cases and 13 deaths; Kivu Sur 3 cases and 1 death. New foci include Mambasa with 2 cases and 1 death. A total of 173 suspected cases are in isolation and 116 are under investigation; six patients have recovered. Africa CDC notes about 3,200 contacts identified in DRC, 967 under active follow-up by end-May. Health workers infected: 26 with 6 deaths. Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death, underscoring cross-border risk. Response includes surveillance, rapid isolation, and logistics support such as 15 motorcycles in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: DRCにおけるブンディブギョエボラ流行が344例60例の確認死亡に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolaは致命的な新興感染症で、DRC、ウガンダでの複数国発生、国際的拡大リスク、高い死亡率を示す。スクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威と判定される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでも9例1死亡が報告されているが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCが主要な発生地で対象国に含まれるため PICKUP 判定。Bundibugyo Ebolaは高い死亡率（17.4%）、医療従事者への感染（26例、6死亡）、国家間の移動リスク（ウガンダへの拡大）、3,200人以上の接触者を特徴とする。

article.articleHeadline: Goma bishop calls for aid and prayer in face of Ebola crisis
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Goma, DRC, is amid Ebola’s 17th outbreak in 50 years. The outbreak was declared 15 May; the WHO designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. About 250 deaths have occurred, with over 1,000 suspected cases. The crisis unfolds amid ongoing civil conflict and mistrust; Goma has seen heavy fighting with M23 rebels. The World Council of Churches has urged a ceasefire, while local churches counter misinformation and promote hygiene. Bishop Martin Gordon appeals for continued prayer and international financial support to equip medical facilities and educational programs. Last outbreak included nearly 500 attacks on health facilities and 25 killed frontline workers, with two Ebola treatment centers burned. The CMS highlights the church as a frontline safety net and seeks protection and swift medical resources.

triage.headline_ja: ゴマ司教、エボラ危機に直面し援助と祈りを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上重大な影響、異常な多数の死亡・患者、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを示す。現在進行中のWHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（ゴマ、北キブ州）でのエボラ第17次流行を扱う。2026年6月3日時点で約250人の死亡、1,000人以上の疑い例を報告。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。武装勢力M23との紛争下での発生で、保健医療施設への攻撃リスクが高い。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Всыпшка Эболы: закроет ли Казахстан границы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Rash: Will Kazakhstan Close Its Borders?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 3 June 2026. Uganda reports six new cases on 2 June, for 15 total; 668 contacts under surveillance, two discharged, 12 hospitalized, one death. In the DRC, WHO reported 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths as of 27 May; later authorities said 282 lab-confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new positives recently. Kazakhstan says it will not close borders in response to the outbreak, aligning with WHO guidance against travel bans; there is no direct air link to affected countries, and airport/land border screening continues under existing measures. The National Center for Public Health assesses Kazakhstan’s importation risk as low but notes that complete exclusion is unlikely amid international mobility.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：カザフスタンは国境を閉じるか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。複数国での確認症例と死亡者が報告されており、国際的な懸念を生じている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としているが、対象国リストはDRCのみを含む。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。カザフスタンは対象国ではないため除外。DRCでの282確認症例、42死亡、ウガンダでの15総症例、1死亡が報告されており、深刻性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, contagi in aumento: 344 solo in Congo (erano 220 pochi giorni fa)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, cases on the rise: 344 in Congo alone (there were 220 a few days ago).
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is rising: 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths as of 2026-06-03, up from 220 days earlier. The outbreak began in eastern DRC on May 15, with 322 confirmed cases and 46 deaths in Ituri province, the epicenter; transmission has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, and to neighboring Uganda, which has recorded 15 cases and 1 death. Public health measures reflect precautionary responses: a Spanish city, La Linea de la Concepcion, cancelled a June 9 friendly between Chile and the DRC due to safety concerns. Separately, Kenya’s president defended opening a U.S.-built Ebola quarantine center at Laikipia Air Base to isolate Americans from DRC; the facility would have 50 beds, about 200 km from Nairobi, managed by U.S. personnel, amid protests; President Ruto frames it as part of national preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、感染が増加：コンゴだけで344例（数日前は220例）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への重大な影響、予想外の発生地域への拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、国際的拡大リスク（スペイン・チリの国際試合キャンセル）、渡航制限リスクを示す。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはケニア、ウガンダ、スペイン、チリなど複数国が含まれるが、記事サマリーの主要な感染症イベント（確認例344例、死亡60例）はDRC東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州）が震源。ウガンダへの越境感染（15例、1死亡）も確認されているが、サマリー上では隣国への拡大として記述されており、本イベントの主体はDRCである。ケニアとスペインは予防措置・政治的対応に関連した言及のため除外。対象国リストにDRCとウガンダが含まれるが、サマリーではウガンダは「隣国」として言及されているため、明確な越境感染の確認はあるものの、主要な発生地はDRCに限定。ウガンダについては記載があれば別途検討が必要だが、記事の焦点はDRCのアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Nairobi Among 25 counties on High-risk Surveillance for the Ebola Virus - Ghetto Radio
article.articleSummary: Kenya has placed 25 counties on high-risk Ebola surveillance after regional alerts from Uganda and the DRC, with Nairobi among very high-risk areas. Other very high-risk counties include Mombasa, Uasin Gishu, Busia, Kisumu, Bungoma, Trans-Nzoia, Siaya, West Pokot, Turkana, Homa Bay, and Migori; high-risk counties include Vihiga, Kakamega, Nakuru, Kericho, Nandi, Kiambu, Machakos, Kilifi, Makueni, Taita Taveta, Isiolo, Elgeyo Marakwet, and Garissa. As of June 1, Kenya has no confirmed Ebola cases; 22 suspected samples tested, all negative. In the last 24 hours, 13,548 travellers were screened; cumulative screenings exceed 66,000. Testing capacity includes the National Public Health Laboratory, KEMRI (Nairobi and Kisumu), and a mobile lab in Busia. Ports of entry will screen and enforce exit surveillance; 10 countries are in pre-entry screening. Surge capacity: 118 healthcare workers on standby; 90 trained, with 70 recently trained; over 1,000 healthcare workers trained. A Turkish national with Ebola-like symptoms remains under close observation at AAR Hospital, Kiambu Road.

triage.headline_ja: ナイロビを含む25の郡がエボラウイルスの高リスク監視対象に指定 - ゲットラジオ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準で複数該当（異常性、流行可能性、管理性への懸念）。対象地域での活発な監視体制と複数国の関連アラートがあり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるエボラ監視体制の確立であるが、対象国リストにはケニアが含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCおよびウガンダからのアラートがケニアの対応をトリガーしており、これらの国が対象国リストに含まれるため記載。ケニアでの確認患者はなく、現在は疑い患者1名を監視中。複数国にわたる流行の可能性と広範な監視体制の構築が、シグナルピックアップの判断根拠。

article.articleHeadline: Pre-World Cup friendly cancelled by mayor over Ebola outbreak concerns
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's World Cup warm-up in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain, was cancelled over Ebola outbreak concerns. The decision followed health officials' advice and a report from the local health service, citing risks from Bundibugyo Ebola—a rarer strain for which no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. DR Congo had already scrapped a Kinshasa training camp and will base in Belgium, with a 17 June Group K opener against Portugal in Houston later before travel to Guadalajara (Colombia) and Atlanta (Uzbekistan). Denmark in Liege is on the schedule prior to the tournament. The outcome underscores how public-health risks can disrupt preparations ahead of the World Cup. Some staff and traveling DR Congo supporters were still en route from the country. The United States has introduced entry restrictions for non-Americans who have been in DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ前哨戦、エボラアウトブレイク懸念により市長が中止決定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の確認による重大な公衆衛生影響と、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、各国の渡航制限措置により、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてBluedotが多数の地点を抽出しているが、記事サマリーの検証により実際のエボラアウトブレイク発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のみ。スペイン（La Línea）、ベルギー、米国などは選手団移動・キャンプ地や試合会場であり、ウイルス発生地ではない。ウガンダ、南スーダンは米国の渡航制限対象となっているが、記事では具体的な発生確認は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: L'epidemia mortale di Ebola si sta rivelando difficile da tenere sotto controllo - MIT Technology Review Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly Ebola epidemic is proving difficult to contain.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is caused by Bundibugyo virus. Alarm was sounded on May 5; by May 24 the World Health Organization reported about 223 deaths and more than 900 suspected cases, with current numbers likely higher. There is no vaccine or specific antivirals for Bundibugyo, and it is unclear whether vaccines approved for the Zaire virus would work. Transmission routes include wildlife-to-human spillover from fruit bats, chimpanzees, and gorillas, and human-to-human spread via contact with bodily fluids, notably during families, healthcare settings, and funeral rites. Containment relies on isolating patients in treatment centers, safe burials, and community education. Violence, misinformation, and attacks on facilities, plus aid cuts, hinder response. The outbreak risks cross-border spread to Uganda (seven confirmed cases, one death) and South Sudan, which has yet to report cases. Vaccines are in development but months away from trials.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なエボラ出血熱の流行が制御困難であることが判明 - MIT Technology Review Italia
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo）の流行により、DRCで223人以上の死亡と900人以上の疑似患者が報告されており、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認。暴力と医療施設への攻撃が対応を阻害。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCのイトゥーリ州でのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus）流行が主題。ウガンダへの越境感染（7例確認、死亡1例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。南スーダンは現在のところ症例報告なし。暴力、誤情報、医療施設への攻撃、援助削減が対応を著しく阻害している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Amerika Serikat Lengkapi Bandara dengan Alat Uji Ebola Jelang Piala Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United States to Equip Airports with Ebola Testing Equipment Ahead of the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: US equips all major airports with Ebola testing devices ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026, hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico (June 11–July 19, 2026). CMS Administrator Mehmet Oz says testing apparatus and procedures are installed at airports to prevent Ebola introduction, praising NIH Director Jay Bhattacharya. On May 15, WHO declared Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as public health emergencies of international concern. As of May 31, the DRC reports 210 laboratory-confirmed cases and 17 deaths, with 350 suspected cases under investigation and 16 health workers infected. Ebola transmits from wildlife such as bats and primates to humans, then via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or fluids of infected people, or contaminated materials. Fatality averages around 50%, up to 90% in past outbreaks; Ebola was identified in 1976, and the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak involved 28,600 cases and 11,325 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱検査装置の導入：米国、ワールドカップ2026開催に向けて空港に装備
triage.triage_reason: WHOが2026年5月15日にエボラ出血熱の国際的懸念事項を宣言（DRC及びウガンダ）。記事は大型国際イベント（ワールドカップ）開催国による検査体制強化を報じており、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが存在。IHR基準2項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、実際のエボラ出血熱の発生地域はDRC及びウガンダ。米国・カナダ・メキシコは防御的対応を実施している地域。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当（ウガンダは対象外）。WHO宣言の日付（2026年5月15日）と記事配信日（2026年6月3日）から、これは進行中の国際的懸念事項。大型国際イベント開催との関連性が社会政治的関心を高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: Reps lament, say NCDC is unprepared for approaching Ebola threat
article.articleSummary: June 3, 2026: Nigeria's House of Representatives warns that the NCDC lacks operational funding, with 2025 funds unprovided and 2026 allocations inadequately released, jeopardizing outbreak response, diagnostics, surveillance, logistics, and frontline readiness. Amid a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak confirmed in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo (update May 15, 2026), Nigeria faces elevated importation risk due to regional travel; an May 25 high-alert status had been issued. Parliament calls for immediate release of appropriated funds, enhanced port health screenings, and accountable deployment by the Infectious Diseases and Legislative Compliance committees. The crisis includes unpaid contractors, stalled isolation and lab projects, biosafety gaps, and shortages of reagents and testing equipment, contrasting with Nigeria's 2014 success in containing Ebola after an infected Liberian traveler.

triage.headline_ja: 下院議員が嘆く、NCDCはエボラの迫る脅威に対する準備ができていないと述べる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認事例がDRCで発生しており、ナイジェリアが高い輸入リスクに直面している。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（即応体制の不備）、国際的拡大リスク（地域的な渡航）、および政府・議会レベルの高い関心が複数の基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCのイトゥリ州でBundibugyo Ebolaウイルスの発生が確認されており、ナイジェリアが地域的な輸入リスクに直面していることが明記されている。Liberiaは記事中で過去の事例（2014年）として言及されているため、現在の発生地として verified_locations に含めない。Ghanaは対象国リストに含まれる西アフリカ国であり、地域的な渡航リスク考慮時に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Отмениха контрола на ДР Конго заради страх от ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo border control was canceled due to fear of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Fear of Ebola prompted the cancellation of a friendly football match between the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Chile, set for June 9 in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain. The mayor, Juan Franco, banned the match over Ebola-related concerns. The two federations seek a new venue. DR Congo players had planned a home training camp, but it was canceled due to hundreds dying from the deadly virus, leading the team to train in Spain in isolation. The DR Congo national team is slated to participate in the World Cup hosted by the United States, Mexico and Canada, where they will face Portugal, Colombia and Uzbekistan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱への懸念によりDRコンゴの国境管理がキャンセルされた
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はエボラ熱の実際の発生ではなく、その懸念に基づくサッカー親善試合のキャンセルである。公開情報としては疾患の流行状況や死亡数等の具体的な疫学情報を含まず、スポーツイベント中止の報道である。
triage.notes: 記事はスポーツイベント（サッカー）の中止を報じており、公衆衛生イベント（新規発生、アウトブレイク）ではない。DRコンゴでのエボラ熱の具体的な流行状況、死亡数、新規症例等の疫学的情報は提供されていない。Bluedotの発生地域フィールドに多数国が含まれているが、これらは記事内で言及されているだけで、実際の疾患発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola SOPs ignored at Kampala bus terminals
article.articleSummary: Ebola SOPs ignored at Kampala bus terminals as Uganda tightens containment. The government suspended cross-border movements with the Democratic Republic of Congo amid Bundibugyo strain concerns, and concerts in Kampala/metropolitan areas were halted. Despite handwashing facilities and temperature guns at Kisenyi, Namayiba, YY Coaches, Global Bus, Jaguar Buses, Link, Arua Park, and Bombo Road terminals, spot checks show widespread non-compliance and little enforcement. Saturday Muhwezi, manager of Kisenyi, acknowledged lax enforcement and pledged stronger measures. Namayiba official Hakim Kizza said passenger numbers are down about 30% since the outbreak and cross-border travel has declined. Some boda boda riders resist screening, hindering enforcement. Alfred Kabalega of Global Bus Terminal cited traveler skepticism that Ebola is real and urged intensified public-awareness campaigns. Health experts warn transport hubs are high-risk for transmission and call for strict, visible enforcement of hand hygiene and temperature screening.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：カンパラのバスターミナルでエボラ対策が無視されている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的に重要な病原体であり、ウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国間の国境を越えた移動制限が実施されている。公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、および渡航制限に関する基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダで進行中のエボラ流行を扱っており、Bundibugyo株の懸念が言及されている。コンゴ民主共和国との国境制限が実施されているが、記事の主題はウガンダでの対策遵守の問題である。交通ハブでの感染リスク、遵守率の低さ、強制力の欠如が指摘されており、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: મોરબી જેલમાં ટીબી સ્ક્રીનિંગમાં 5 શંકાસ્પદ કેસ મળ્યા: હેન્ડ હેલ્ડ એક્સ-રે મશીનથી બંદીવાનોનું નિદાન કરાયું
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Morbi Jail, Five Suspected TB Cases Found During TB Screening: Inmates Diagnosed Using a Handheld X-ray Machine
article.articleSummary: During the TB Free India campaign at Morbi Sub-Jail in Morbi district, 55 inmates were screened; five were identified as suspected tuberculosis cases using a handheld chest X-ray machine. The joint effort by the District AIDS Prevention and Control Unit (DAPCU), jail administration and partners conducted the Intensified Case Finding camp to enable early detection of tuberculosis, HIV, and syphilis. The five suspected TB samples have been sent to the District TB Center for further testing. Going forward, the jail plans daily health checkups for all inmates as part of routine health surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: モルビ刑務所のTBスクリーニングで5件の疑い患者が発見：ハンドヘルドX線機を使用して受刑者を診断
triage.triage_reason: TB/HIV/梅毒の複合スクリーニング活動での疑い患者検出は異常ではなく、対象地域（モルビ刑務所）は限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はTB Free Indiaキャンペーンの一環として、モルビ刑務所での定期的なスクリーニング活動を報道しているもの。5名の疑い患者は予期される検出率の範囲内と考えられ、組織的な対応（確認検査・監視体制の強化）が既に進行中。シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準には該当しないが、刑務所内での複数疾病の同時スクリーニング結果であり、今後の確認検査結果に注視の価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Çin, Ebola salgınının yaşandığı Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'ne sağlık ekibi gönderdi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sent a medical team to the Democratic Republic of the Congo where the Ebola outbreak is taking place.
article.articleSummary: China has dispatched a five-person medical team to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support Ebola response efforts in its eastern Ituri region. The three-month mission, arrived in Kinshasa, comprises epidemiology, clinical diagnosis and treatment, research, and traditional Chinese medicine specialists who will collaborate with local authorities, health institutions and international organizations, and provide outbreak prevention and treatment training to local facilities, Chinese-financed companies, and Chinese communities. The outbreak in eastern DRC’s Ituri Province began after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths were reported, with the outbreak declared on May 15. The World Health Organization subsequently declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The current outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists, with reported case counts exceeding 1,000.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ出血熱が発生している コンゴ民主共和国に医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。1,000例超の確認症例と65以上の死亡が報告され、Bundibugyo型で治療法・ワクチンなし。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR附属書2の対象感染症。WHOがPHEIC宣言した重大な国際公衆衛生上の脅威。Bundibugyo型は治療法・ワクチンなし。複数国からの支援（中国医療チーム派遣）が実施中。Ituri地域での流行は2026年5月15日に正式宣言、報告症例1,000超。記事サマリーに基づきDRCのみverified_locationsに含める（Chinaは支援国として記載されるが、発生地ではない）。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy cơ từ phế cầu và RSV: Vì sao cần bảo vệ trẻ từ sớm?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Risk from Pneumococcus and RSV: Why Protect Children Early?
article.articleSummary: At the International Scientific Conference PediaConnect 2026 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnamese pediatric experts warned that Streptococcus pneumoniae (pneumococcus) and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) drive rising pediatric hospitalizations and long-term sequelae. Pneumococcal disease can cause pneumonia, sepsis, and meningitis in children, with antibiotic-resistant strains and co-infection with RSV complicating treatment and prolonging hospital stays. Data from Southeast Asia, including Vietnam, show serotype replacement as vaccines cover only some strains. RSV remains a leading cause of illness and death in infants under 6 months, especially in low- and middle-income countries, imposing a lasting health burden. Organizers—Vietnam Pediatric Association and National Hospital of Pediatrics, in collaboration with Pfizer Vietnam—advocate shifting from treatment-centric to proactive prevention, supported by surveillance and official public messaging. Climate change, urbanization, and air pollution amplify transmission of respiratory infections; digital media and trusted sources are emphasized to raise awareness, with Indonesian expert Dr. Kanya Ayu Paramastri contributing.

triage.headline_ja: 肺炎球菌とRSVのリスク：なぜ早期に子どもを守る必要があるのか？
triage.triage_reason: 小児呼吸器感染症（RSV・肺炎球菌）に関する専門家会議報告で、地域的な重症化傾向と公衆衛生メッセージの強化が言及されているが、具体的な集団発生事例や急速な感染拡大の明確な証拠に欠ける。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術会議に基づくエキスパートウォーニングであり、既知の疾患の地域的重症化トレンド報告と予防啓発が主体。集団発生の急速進展、国際的な感染拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の必要性は明記されていない。RSVと肺炎球菌の小児感染症は東南アジアで恒常的な課題であり、「予想外」とは言えない。インドネシアの専門家が言及されているがインドネシアでの具体的イベント詳細は記事サマリーに含まれていない。続報により具体的な流行データ、死亡数増加、新規病原体特性などが明らかになれば判定変更の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, investimenti su 3 vaccini sperimentali contro virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: investments in three experimental vaccines against the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with cases also reported in Uganda. Cepi will invest in three experimental vaccines to accelerate development and regulatory approval: IAVI's candidate, Moderna's vaccine, and the Oxford University vaccine produced by Serum Institute of India. Cepi will also launch a 'Call for Proposals' to evaluate additional promising candidates. WHO has recently reduced the number of suspected cases in the region. The outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by WHO and a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security (PHECS) by Africa CDC. Separately, four nurses in Bunia, Ituri, have recovered after caring for patients since early May; more recoveries are expected with early diagnosis and access to care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：3つの実験的ワクチン候補への投資
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。ブンディブギョ・エボラアウトブレイクがコンゴ民主共和国で進行中で、ウガンダでも症例報告あり。WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態(PHEIC)として宣言済み。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記事に記載されているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州ブニアでの継続的なアウトブレイク。WHOおよびアフリカCDCの両者によるPHEIC/PHECS宣言済み。ワクチン開発への国際的投資が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ、コンゴ民主共和国で確認された症例344件、死亡者60人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak data for the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of yesterday's update, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, citing the DRC Ministry of Health, reports 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the DRC, with 0 estimated cases and 0 estimated deaths, and 116 suspected cases (0 suspected deaths). In Uganda, the Ministry of Health records 15 confirmed cases and 1 death, plus 1 estimated case and 1 estimated death. The figures indicate an ongoing cross-border Ebola outbreak in the region, with case classifications including confirmed, suspected, and estimated, and underscore continued regional surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ民主共和国で確認された症例344件、死亡者60人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は致死率の高い重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCとウガンダでの越境流行は国際的な拡大リスクが極めて高く、渡航・貿易制限の可能性も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例（15確定、1死亡）が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。エボラ出血熱は IHR Annex2 基準および WPRO スクリーニング基準に全項目該当する極めて高リスクのシグナルであり、迅速なフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak data for the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda: DRC has 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths, 0 probable cases/deaths, and 116 suspected cases (0 suspected deaths). Uganda has 15 confirmed cases, 1 confirmed death, 1 probable case, and 1 probable death. The figures are announced by the African Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, based on updates from the Ministries of Health of the DRC and Uganda, with the update dated June 2, 2026 (published June 3, 2026). The report provides no information on infection sources, laboratory confirmation methods, or details of imported or exported cases. These data reflect the current Ebola situation in the region and underscore ongoing public health surveillance needs.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で344例の確認患者と60人の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱は最優先度の病原体であり、DRCで344例の確認患者・60例の死亡、ウガンダでの国際的な波及が報告されている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクすべてが認められる。
triage.notes: 本発生地域フィールドにはウガンダ(226074)も含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはリスト内(203312)に含まれるため登録。エボラ出血熱は最高優先度の公衆衛生脅威であり、複数国での確認患者・死亡者の報告は顕著なシグナル。アフリカ疾病管理予防センターの公式発表に基づく信頼性の高い情報。

article.articleHeadline: 赴非洲「這2國」注意！台灣4機場啟動伊波拉免費篩檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Heading to Africa? Take note of these two countries. Four Taiwan airports launch free Ebola screening.
article.articleSummary: From June 3 to June 30, Taiwan’s CDC launches free Ebola testing at four international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung—for asymptomatic inbound travelers who have recently visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) or Uganda. The program follows WHO’s May 17 declaration of Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Testing is voluntary and conducted by quarantine officers in HEPA-equipped rooms using whole-blood samples. In addition to testing, returnees must complete 21 days of self-health management and report daily health status via the public E-reporting system; non-compliance may incur penalties up to NT$150,000. Symptomatic returnees (fever, headache, muscle pains, nausea, diarrhea, or bleeding) will be managed under existing medical transfer arrangements. Travel advisories for DRC and Uganda are Level 3: avoid nonessential travel.

triage.headline_ja: 赴非洲「這2國」注意！台灣4機場啟動伊波拉免費篩檢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において国際的な拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでのエボラWHO PHEIC宣言）、WHOによる公式認識、台湾での検疫対応強化が確認されており、アジア太平洋地域の公衆衛生上の重要な対応イベントである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCおよびウガンダのエボラ患者からの帰国者を対象とした台湾での検疫対応を報じているもの。台湾はWPRO対象国ではないため検証対象地域に含めず、DRCのみを実際の発生国として含めた。記事言及のウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはエボラアウトブレイク（PHEIC）の発生地であり国際的に重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 快新聞／赴非洲「這2國」注意！台灣4機場啟動伊波拉免費篩檢 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: When traveling to Africa, beware of these two countries — Four Taiwanese airports launch free Ebola screening
article.articleSummary: Free Ebola screening is launched at four Taiwan international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung—for travelers who have recently visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda, from June 3 to June 30, following WHO’s PHEIC designation. Asymptomatic entrants may opt to take a voluntary Ebola virus test (blood sample) in HEPA-equipped examination rooms, with 21 days of self-health management and daily status reports via the Public Active E-Reporting System. Noncompliance may incur penalties up to NT$150,000. If return travelers develop fever, headache, or other Ebola-like symptoms, they will be referred to contracted hospitals under existing guidelines. DRC and Uganda travel advisories remain at Level 3 (Warning). The program involves cross-agency collaboration among CIQS units, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Immigration, Civil Aviation Administration, Tourism Bureau, airport operators, and airlines.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：アフリカへの渡航時は「この2カ国」に注意！台湾の4空港がエボラ無料検査を開始
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での検査態勢強化は公衆衛生対応を示すが、記事は実際のエボラ症例発生ではなく予防的措置の報道。対象国はDRC・ウガンダだが、台湾での患者確認情報がないため、フルRRA前に続報を待つべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行に対する台湾の予防的検査態勢を報道。実際の症例発生地はDRC（対象国）だが、本記事では台湾での患者確認や地域内での流行拡大は記載されていない。WHO PEICの指定を受けた対応であることから、エボラ流行は確認されているが、本記事単体では台湾への実質的な影響は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya : deux morts lors de manifestations contre un centre Ebola américain
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: Two Dead During Protests Against an American Ebola Center
article.articleSummary: Two people died in Nanyuki, central Kenya, amid protests against a US-backed 50-bed Ebola isolation center to be built at a Laikipia military base, with investigations into the circumstances ongoing. One victim died after hospital transfer, the other on arrival, both with unclear causes; one identified as 27-year-old Charles Mang'aro Mwangi, though family says he was not participating in demonstrations. Hundreds demonstrated, roads blocked, tires set alight, police used tear gas. The Ebola center would treat patients from the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak; Kenya has reported no Ebola cases to date, though residents fear spread. Kenya's High Court suspended the project, extended the suspension, and sought more health impact details. President William Ruto defended the accord with Washington, asserting safety measures, while doctors' unions and public watchdogs pressed for guarantees before implementation. Preparations continue at Laikipia airbase despite opposition.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：米国支援エボラセンターへの抗議デモで2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは公衆衛生上重大な脅威だが、本イベントの主体はDRCのアウトブレイク対応施設建設への社会的抗議であり、エボラ感染症イベント自体ではない。ケニアでのエボラ症例報告はなく、施設完成前での社会政治的懸念が主焦点。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントはDRCのエボラアウトブレイク対応施設（ケニアに建設予定）への抗議であり、ケニア自体のエボラ症例報告はない。死亡2件の原因は不明で、エボラ感染との直接的関連は確認されていない。Laikipia（ケニア）での施設建設が焦点だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Heboh! Wanita Nonton Konser F4 Saat Sakit Campak, Kemenkes Peringatkan Soal Penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sensational! Woman Attends F4 Concert While Sick With Measles, Health Ministry Warns About Transmission.
article.articleSummary: A measles exposure risk in Jakarta, Indonesia, following a woman attending the FForever F4 reunion concert (May 28–30, 2026) while diagnosed with measles. She posted red skin rash photos and claimed she had been infected days before the show, noting her condition was highly contagious. The post was deleted after widespread public condemnation. Health authorities warned that attending a mass gathering while contagious can transmit measles, which is described as highly contagious; Dr. Adam Prabata stated a single case can infect 12–18 others. The article provides no laboratory-confirmed case counts or documented secondary transmissions, and details about the infection source or imported/exported cases are not specified. This incident highlights public health concerns about transmission risks at large events in Jakarta. Published date: 2026-06-03.

triage.headline_ja: 騒動！麻疹に感染したまま女性がF4コンサートに参加、保健省が感染に関する警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の集団発生リスクが示唆されているが、確認された症例数や二次感染の確実な報告がなく、情報が不足している。社会的関心は高いが、公式な疫学的データが欠落しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はジャカルタでの麻疹曝露リスクに関するもの。確認された症例数や二次感染の文書化された報告がないため、公式な疫学的データが不足している。大規模集会での感染伝播の可能性が懸念されているが、実際の流行の規模は不明。続報でケース確認数や接触者追跡結果の報告を待つべき。

article.articleHeadline: तेज गर्मी के बाद बारिश से बढ़ी ह्यूमिडिटी, हवा में तैर रहे बैक्टीरिया और वायरस; तीन महीने रहें संभलकर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Humidity rises after intense heat due to rain, with airborne bacteria and viruses; exercise caution for the next three months.
article.articleSummary: As humidity rises after intense heat and rain, airborne bacteria and viruses proliferate, making dengue and other viral infections a rising concern in the city and surrounding areas. Doctors at Jayarogya Hospital warn that high moisture and dampness double the activity of pathogens, rendering the next two to three months (June to August/September) especially challenging healthwise. Common viral symptoms include cough, cold, sore throat, and fever. Mosquito-borne diseases such as malaria, chikungunya, and especially dengue may spread in humid, waterlogged conditions. Waterborne illnesses—diarrhea, vomiting, and typhoid—rise due to contaminated water. Children and the elderly, with weaker immunity, are most affected. In Gwalior, outpatient departments are already seeing more seasonal illnesses. Public health measures emphasize diet, hygiene, and sanitation; August-September demand heightened vigilance to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 激しい熱と雨による湿度上昇により、空中の細菌とウイルスが増加；今後3ヶ月間注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: Chikungunya、Malaria、Dengueの3疾患が報告されており、季節的な懸念が存在するが、現在のところ具体的な集団発生（outbreak）の報告は記事に明記されていない。予測的警告が主体であり、深刻度と国際的拡大リスクの評価が不明である。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・グワリオール地域における季節的な蚊媒介感染症（dengue、malaria、chikungunya）の予測的警告であり、具体的な発生数や死亡例は記載されていない。医療機関が外来患者の増加を報告しているが、集団発生レベルか散発例か不明。6月～9月の高湿度期における予防的注意喚起が主体。地域限定的な記事であり、国際的拡大の直接的なリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: "Gidebilecek başka ülkemiz yok": Kenya, ABD'nin kurmak istediği Ebola karantina merkezine direniyor - Medyascope
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We have nowhere else to go": Kenya resists the Ebola quarantine center that the US wants to establish - Medyascope.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola quarantine center planned by the United States at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki, Kenya, to house exposed American citizens began sparking protests after two people died; Kenya's High Court temporarily halted the project and ordered disclosure of secret agreements with the US within seven days, with the next hearing on June 23. President William Ruto called the plan politicized but said it aimed to protect public health. Locals criticized the arrangement as treating Kenya as a quarantine colony. US officials, including Senator Marco Rubio, vowed Ebola would not enter the United States, while Jeremy Lewin said authorities were in contact with Kenyan counterparts. Separately, Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (about 344 cases, 60 deaths) and Uganda (9 cases, 1 death) are under concern; first known case April 24, confirmed three weeks later; no targeted vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 「行く場所がない」：ケニア、米国が設立しようとしているエボラ隔離センターに抵抗
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）がDRC、ウガンダで発生中（344件、60件の死亡を含む）。Bundibugyo株に対する標的化ワクチンや治療法が存在しないため重症度が高い。ケニアでの隔離センター計画は国際的政治的関心と公衆衛生の深刻な影響を伴う。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラ発生が記事の主要なシグナル。ケニアはセンター計画の政治的背景であり、実際の発生地は対象国リストではない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるためverified_locationsに含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。344件、60件という死亡数はWHO通知基準を大きく超える。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン・治療の不在は管理可能性を低下させる。

article.articleHeadline: 「偷死野田村病毒」潛服養殖水產　醫衞局稱影響公共衞生程度極低
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Stealth-Death Ye Tian Village Virus" latent in farmed aquatic products; Health and Medical Bureau says its impact on public health is extremely low.
article.articleSummary: Covert Mortality Nodavirus is latent in farmed aquatic products, and Hong Kong’s Health and Medical Bureau says its public health impact is extremely low, with the Centre for Health Protection not planning to list it as a notifiable disease. The virus affects farmed shrimp and crabs, with reported infection in Antarctic krill up to 35.5%. It can cause seafood to die without obvious symptoms, hindering detection; human infection after consuming contaminated seafood may trigger eye disease, including high intraocular pressure–related anterior uveitis, potentially leading to blindness, per Nature Microbiology. The Centre notes the main transmission route is improper handling of seafood and consumption of raw products; no confirmed HK human cases have been recorded. Authorities will monitor developments, issue guidance, and reinforce health education. FEHD tested over 8,000 seafood samples last year, including about 940 shrimp tests; sources included Mainland China, Thailand, Japan, Vietnam, and France.

triage.headline_ja: 「隠密死亡野田村ウイルス」が養殖水産物に潜伏　衛生局は公共衛生への影響は極めて低いと述べる
triage.triage_reason: 未知の病原体（Covert Mortality Nodavirus）が複数国の水産物に関連し、人間への感染リスクが理論的に存在するが、香港当局は公共衛生への実際の影響は極めて低いと評価。確認された人間の症例がなく、情報が限定的であるため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事は香港でのニュース報道であり、Covert Mortality Nodovirusが中国、タイ、ベトナム、日本、フランスの水産物に検出されている。香港当局は確認された人間感染例がなく、公共衛生への影響が極めて低いと評価しているが、理論的な人間感染リスク（眼疾患を含む）が報告されている。対象国リスト内の中国、ベトナム、タイの3国で実際の発生が記録されている。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتفشى في مناطق جديدة بالكونغو.. وشائعات تصعّب حملات التطعيم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to new areas in Congo, and rumors hinder vaccination campaigns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo to new areas more than 160 km from the epicenter. Ituri Province accounts for about 94% of confirmed infections as health zones including Mambasa and Mongbwalu expand to 24 zones. The outbreak stems from Bundibugyo ebolavirus. More than 4,000 contacts across three provinces are under follow-up, but only about 39% of identified Ituri contacts have been reached. On June 1, 23 confirmed cases were reported: 11 in Mongbwalu and 6 in Bunia. The DRC has 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, up from 48 due to delays in treatment and patient escapes. Uganda reports 6 new cases (total 15, including 1 death). Four escaped (1 Ituri, 3 North Kivu). Resistance to vaccination and isolation, plus rumors of plant-based cures, hinder control. Vaccines may offer only partial immunity to Bundibugyo; cross-reactive antibodies seen in a West Africa trial, not peer-reviewed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴの新しい地域に拡大、ワクチン接種キャンペーンを妨げるうわさ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認、多数の死亡者、ワクチン有効性の懸念が存在し、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、ウガンダでの症例報告もあるが、主要な流行はコンゴDRCで発生。Bundibugyo ebolavirus亜種による流行で、ワクチン有効性の限定性とコミュニティの抵抗が管理課題。344確定例・60死亡、接触者フォローアップ率39%と対応能力の制約が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: India Sends 45.5 Tonnes of Medical Aid to Africa for Ebola Outbreak Response
article.articleSummary: India dispatched 45.5 tonnes of medical aid to Africa to support Ebola outbreak response, following a request from the African Union Commission and coordination with Africa CDC. In the first phase, about 2.5 tonnes of emergency medical supplies arrived in Kampala, Uganda, on May 24, including protective gear, medical monitoring equipment, essential medicines, and nutritional supplements. A second, larger shipment of 43 tonnes was sent and reached Kampala on June 2, comprising personal protective equipment, diagnostic tools, sample transport kits, infection prevention materials, medicines, and other health supplies. The aid aims to strengthen public health preparedness and frontline response capacity in affected countries. India's External Affairs Ministry notes ongoing collaboration with African missions and Africa CDC for distribution. WHO reports Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with surveillance and containment steps ongoing to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: インド、アフリカのエボラ出血熱対策に医療支援物資45.5トンを送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的に高リスクな感染症であり、DRCとウガンダでの確認事例、アフリカ全域への国際的な支援活動という文脈から、IHR基準3項目以上該当し、かつ複数国への拡大リスクとWHO関与が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ確認を報告しており、ウガンダはBluedot発生地域に含まれているが対象国リストに未含。インドは医療支援国として重要な役割を果たしており、国際的なハイリスク感染症対応の文脈において verified_locations に含める。本件はシグナルピックアップ対象であり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Soccer-DR Congo hope to go ahead with Spain fixture despite Ebola cancellation
article.articleSummary: DR Congo hopes to proceed with a World Cup warm-up against Chile in Spain next week despite La Línea de la Concepción mayor canceling the match over Ebola fears in the DRC. The team, training largely in Europe after prep in Belgium, had planned a Liège friendly with Denmark on Wednesday and a second Spain game before the World Cup co-hosted by Canada, Mexico and the United States. Mayor Juan Franco cited the Ebola situation and insufficient risk documentation as the reason for the ban. FECOFA says the squad complies with health, sporting and regulatory requirements and is negotiating with authorities and the Spanish Football Federation to find a solution, with coach Sebastien Desabre hopeful for an alternative venue. The DR Congo squad, appearing at its first World Cup in 52 years, will base in Houston and face Portugal (June 17), Colombia (June 23, Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (June 27, Atlanta).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症のキャンセルにもかかわらず、サッカー・DRコンゴがスペイン戦での進出を望む
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はDRコンゴのサッカーチームのワールドカップ準備であり、実際のエボラウイルス病の発生や症例報告ではなく、単なるスポーツイベントの日程調整問題である。公衆衛生上の具体的な脅威情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: この記事はスポーツ関連のニュースであり、感染症の実際の発生や患者情報を報じたものではない。DRコンゴのエボラ状況への言及は背景情報に過ぎず、記事の主題はサッカーイベントの日程変更である。感染症イベント監視の対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Development and validation of an explainable model for Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection in children
article.articleSummary: Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection in children: An explainable early diagnostic model was developed and validated using data from Linyi Maternal and Child Healthcare Hospital and Shanghai Children's Medical Center in 2023, with temporal validation on 2024 data. The study defines MP infection serology with a fourfold or greater change in MP-IgM/MP-IgG titers. Seven models were built; the best performing one, using 11 features, achieved an AUC of 0.89 in internal test and 0.84 in temporal validation. TNFβ and IL-2 emerged as high-impact features. Separate models were created for under and over 60-month-old children. Models were deployed via Streamlit, and clinician feedback was surveyed before and after three months of use, with trust increasing after deployment (P<0.001) and usage frequency correlating (P<0.01). PCR testing was not systematically available and not used as a comparator; the authors call for PCR-based validation and mechanistic studies.

triage.headline_ja: 小児マイコプラズマ・ニューモニエ感染症の説明可能な早期診断モデルの開発と検証
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医学的診断モデルの開発に関する学術論文であり、感染症の新規発生・流行や公衆衛生上の危機的な状況を報告するものではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、シグナルとして識別する必要性はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2023～2024年に実施された回顧的な診断モデル開発研究であり、現在の流行または新規の感染症危機を報告するものではない。中国（上海・山東省）の小児医療施設でのデータを用いた研究報告であるが、イベント検出・トリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: East African Community ministers hold urgent talks on Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-03, East African Community health ministers convened an extraordinary virtual session from Arusha to coordinate regional Ebola response to the Bundibugyo strain, declared on 2026-05-15. The outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), notably Ituri (epicentre, Mongbwalu) and North Kivu/South Kivu; Uganda reports seven confirmed cases and one death, with two cases linked to travel from the DRC for treatment. As of 2026-05-31, DRC reported 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths (two recoveries), with 220 suspected cases under investigation; Uganda has had one death.
