The EAC aims to strengthen surveillance, laboratory diagnosis, infection prevention and control, risk communication, and rapid response, in collaboration with Africa CDC, WHO, Germany, and the EU. Nine mobile laboratories will be deployed at cross-border sites: Beni (DRC), Busia (Kenya), Nimule-Elegu (South Sudan), Kobero (Burundi), Kagera and Kigoma (Tanzania), Kisenyi and Kihundwe (Rwanda), and Bwera Hospital (Uganda). The Uganda Virus Research Institute and EAC Virology Centre will serve as regional referral labs, with BNITM support and KfW funding for the network.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカ共同体閣僚がエボラ流行に関する緊急協議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、ハイリスク病原体（エボラ）の多国間流行で国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、重症度（死亡者あり）、地域管理能力不足が確認されるため。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域には複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRCを中心としたエボラ流行に対するEAC地域統合対応」である。記事では、DRCで282確定例・42死亡、ウガンダで7確定例・1死亡、その他隣接国での監視体制強化が述べられているが、実际の流行が確認されているのはDRCが明確である。ウガンダは7確定例・1死亡が報告されているが、対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの流行、320+例の確定ケース、複数国での死亡者、国際的な対応体制の構築が確認されており、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当するため、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Pre-World Cup friendly cancelled over fears it could spread eye-bleeding disease
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak prompts cancellation of a June 9 pre-World Cup friendly against Chile in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, after the town mayor followed health-service advice. Ebola—an incurable hemorrhagic fever causing bleeding from ears, eyes, nose, mouth, gums, jaundice and death—has killed over 220 in DR Congo, with Uganda also affected; WHO has raised Congo’s outbreak risk to 'very high'. DR Congo, returning to the World Cup after 1974 as Zaire, paused a home training camp and must isolate 21 days before entering the United States for the tournament. They will base in Houston for June 17 vs Portugal, then Guadalajara on June 24 vs Colombia, and Atlanta on June 28 vs Uzbekistan. A US medic treating Congo patients tested positive and received care in Germany, illustrating cross-border import/export risk. Authorities urge screening of travelers from affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 目からの出血疾患の感染を懸念し、ワールドカップ前のプレマッチが中止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死亡者220人以上、WHO が「非常に高い」リスク評価、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、米国、ドイツでの患者検出）、渡航制限（DRC代表チームの隔離措置）、国際大会への影響など、IHR基準4つ全て該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した発生地域には米国、スペイン、メキシコ、チリなども含まれているが、これらは患者発生地ではなく、DRC代表チームの渡航先（ワールドカップ開催国）である。記事の主題は『DRCのエボラ流行』であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCおよびウガンダのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。本イベントは査定対象国以外での国際的な影響も極めて大きく、国際的早期警戒の観点から最優先のシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Cupa Mondială 2026: Din cauza epidemiei de Ebola, un primar spaniol a interzis un meci de pregătire între RDC şi Chile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA World Cup 2026: Due to the Ebola epidemic, a Spanish mayor banned a friendly match between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Chile.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, banned a 9 June friendly between DR Congo and Chile due to prudence amid an Ebola outbreak in DR Congo. Mayor Juan Franco cited a city health service report warning of potential health risks. The DR Congo–Chile match would have been the second European-friendly in DR Congo’s World Cup 2026 preparation. DR Congo will instead face Denmark in Liège, Belgium, while preparing for Group K games against Colombia, Portugal and Uzbekistan at the World Cup in the United States, Mexico and Canada. The Congo team had relocated its training camp from Kinshasa to Belgium. Separately, three Mexican airlines announced travel restrictions for passengers from Ebola-affected African countries, coordinated with the United States and Canada, less than two weeks before the World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年FIFAワールドカップ：エボラ流行のため、スペインの市長がコンゴ民主共和国とチリの親善試合を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の活動的な流行がDRC（対象国）で発生しており、国際的な影響（複数国の旅行制限、スポーツイベント中止）と社会的関心が確認される。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限の3項目該当、またWPRO基準で重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行（Kinshasa周辺）を主題としており、スペイン・ベルギー・メキシコなど複数国の対応も記載されているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみと判定。複数の航空会社による旅行制限（メキシコ）やスポーツイベント中止（スペイン）が報道されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Forscher warnen vor neuen Hitzerekorden und steigendem Infektionsrisiko
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers warn of new heat records and rising infection risk.
article.articleSummary: Rising global temperatures threaten a northward expansion of the Chikungunya virus, potentially reaching Europe. A new Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology study combines IPCC climate projections with vector and virus distribution data, indicating 139 countries or regions—about 21.3% of global land area—could host transmission risk, with Central Europe, the Northeast of North America, and East Asia projected hotspots by 2100. Italy, France and Spain have reported cases in recent years. Separately, the World Meteorological Organization warns a new heat-record year is likely; 2026–2030 could see mean temperatures 1.3–1.9°C above preindustrial levels, with 86% chance at least one year surpassing the 2024 record and a 75% probability all five years exceed 1.5°C. Climate change may also accelerate antibiotic-resistance gene increases in Salmonella across 82% of countries, driven largely by antibiotic misuse; Salmonellosis is reportable in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Combined, these trends signal rising infection risk in a warming world.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者が新たな熱波記録と感染症リスク上昇を警告
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱やサルモネラ症などの感染症が気候変動に伴い欧州・東アジアまで拡大する可能性を警告する科学的シミュレーション研究。現在の実患者数や確定例は限定的だが、予測モデルに基づく潜在的なリスク評価であり、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動に関連した感染症リスクの将来予測を扱う科学レポート。現在の実発生イベントではなく、2100年までのシミュレーション結果が主体。チクングニア熱の北方拡大やサルモネラ属菌の抗生物質耐性化が長期的な曝露リスクとして評価される。対象国リストではChinaのみが記事サマリーで具体的に言及されている（East Asiaの投影ホットスポット）。欧州諸国（イタリア、フランス、スペイン、オーストリア、スイス、ドイツ）は記事の発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Autoritățile spaniole au anulat partida amicală dinaintea Campionatului Mondial " Focarul de Ebola, principalul motiv
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spanish authorities have canceled the friendly match ahead of the World Cup: the Ebola outbreak, the main reason.
article.articleSummary: Spain canceled the June 9 friendly between the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion, near Gibraltar, due to health concerns tied to an Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The 10,000-seat stadium match was halted by a decree from mayor Juan Franco after health authorities’ recommendations. Chile favored a closed-door option, which was not approved. The disruption affects DRC’s World Cup preparations; the country is contesting its first World Cup since 1974 (then Zaire). WHO had declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, noting 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths in the DRC as of May 27, with transmission extending to Uganda. With plans in the DRC altered, the team trained in Belgium and was to play Denmark in Liège at 21:00 local time.

triage.headline_ja: スペイン当局がワールドカップ前の親善試合をキャンセル：エボラ流行が主な理由
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病による公衆衛生上の重大な影響、異常・予想外性、国際的拡大のリスク、および渡航制限の可能性があり、IHR基準を複数満たしている。WHO公式の国際懸念事項として宣言されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数の欧州各国・チリを発生地域として付与しているが、実際のエボラ流行はDRC（2026年5月27日時点で906疑い例、223死亡）とウガンダで報告されている。欧州各国は試合キャンセルの対応国であり、エボラの発生地ではない。チリはDRC代表チームとの試合対象国であるが、エボラ流行地ではない。記事サマリーで明記されている実際の流行地はDRCとウガンダのみを verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 39岁自媒体博主被虫咬后去世，恙虫病为何如此致命？_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 39-year-old self-media blogger dies after an insect bite; why is scrub typhus so deadly?
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) transmitted by chigger mite bites caused a fatal outcome in a 39-year-old Chinese self-media blogger. The disease is endemic to southern China and parts of central/eastern regions, with Guangdong showing year-round activity (south of 25°N). Incubation is 4–21 days, commonly 7–10 days. Fever spikes to 39–41°C (up to 42°C) with severe headache, fatigue, and nausea; an eschar at the bite site is seen in >70% of patients, and rash, lymphadenopathy, and hepatosplenomegaly may occur. Untreated scrub typhus has a case-fatality rate of 30–70%, and death can occur in weeks 3–4 due to multi-organ involvement such as toxic hepatitis, pneumonia, myocarditis, meningitis, GI bleeding, and acute kidney failure. Early diagnosis and prompt antibiotics are crucial; prevention focuses on protective clothing and hygiene after outdoor activity to avoid bites.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳の自媒体ブロガーが虫刺されで死亡；恙虫病がなぜこれほど致命的なのか？
triage.triage_reason: 恙虫病による死亡事例は中国で報告されており、未治療時の高い致命率（30～70%）と多臓器不全のリスクが示されている。ただし個別症例報告の段階であり、集団発生や国際的拡大の兆候がないため、現時点では情報追跡が必要である。
triage.notes: 記事は広東省（中国南部）での致死的な恙虫病事例を報告している。恙虫病は中国の風土病であり、地域によっては年間を通じて活動している。個別症例であるが、未治療時の高い致命率と多臓器不全の可能性が強調されている。集団発生の報告はないため、PICSUPではなくWATCHとした。継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: بررسی ۳ واکسن ابولا در بحبوحه شیوع بیماری
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Examining three Ebola vaccines amid the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda spurs development of three vaccines targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The DRC reports more than 1,000 suspected cases and Uganda 9 confirmed; the outbreak has caused roughly 250 deaths and could rival West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis (nearly 29,000 infections, over 11,000 fatalities). IAVI is adapting a licensed Ebola Zaire vaccine to address Bundibugyo, with preclinical monkey data showing rapid immune training and near‑100% protection; it estimates 7–9 months to clinical trials. Oxford University and Moderna are pursuing Bundibugyo vaccines using distinct platforms; Oxford aims for a candidate ready for trials in 2–3 months. All efforts focus on presenting Bundibugyo glycoprotein to the immune system. Cepi funds early studies; authorities warn of ongoing animal‑to‑human spillover and human‑to‑human transmission via bodily fluids and contaminated objects, with wildlife reservoirs (bats) implicated.

triage.headline_ja: 流行中の疾病対策の一環としてエボラウイルスの3つのワクチンを検査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。1000件以上の疑い患者、250名の死亡、国際拡大（DRC、ウガンダ）、過去の西アフリカ危機との比較から深刻性が明らかで、シグナルとして優先度が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はペルシャ語のイランメディアから配信。DRC、ウガンダ、アンゴラが発生地域として識別されているが、記事サマリーで詳述されているのはDRCとウガンダ（隣国）。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当（GeoNames ID: 203312）。ウガンダとアンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス亜種）の大規模流行、動物由来感染の継続的リスク、複数製薬企業によるワクチン開発進行など、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 嘴歪脸僵硬引中风疑云 刘玲玲：耳朵细菌感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facial droop and a crooked mouth raise suspicions of stroke; Liu Lingling: bacterial ear infection.
article.articleSummary: Liu Lingling, known as the 'queen of the stage,' said a June 2 livestream showed her mouth drooping and facial stiffness, prompting stroke concerns. She clarified that the symptoms are due to a left-ear bacterial infection affecting the facial nerve, not a stroke. The infection reportedly began after a March volunteer trip in Thailand; after returning home she developed swelling and malaise. An April medical visit diagnosed left-ear bacterial infection. She received about 10 days of steroids, and doctors noted that facial nerve involvement can cause temporary droop, with accompanying eye dryness and tearing. She paused volunteer activities for roughly six weeks and has since resumed, taking precautions such as masks, gloves, and hand hygiene. She appeared on May 8 for a Mother’s Day event at a hospital, and on June 2 resumed livestreams while volunteering, removing her mask and prompting concern. Fans are advised she is recovering.

triage.headline_ja: 口が歪み顔が硬直して脳卒中の疑い 劉玲玲：耳の細菌感染
triage.triage_reason: 個人の健康問題であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生ではない。未知の疾患ではなく、左耳の細菌感染が原因と特定されている。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクなし。
triage.notes: 疾患は『Unknown Illness』として分類されているが、記事サマリー上では『左耳細菌感染による顔面神経障害』と医学的に診断・特定されている。これは公衆衛生上の感染症イベント（集団発生、異常な感染パターン）ではなく、個人の医学的事例報告である。タイでの感染は記事に言及されているが、これは個人の既往歴情報であり、タイでの現在の集団発生が報告されているわけではない。

article.articleHeadline: NIH Researchers Charged After Allegedly Smuggling Monkeypox Vials Into United States " American Greatness
article.articleSummary: Two NIH researchers charged with conspiracy to smuggle monkeypox into the United States from the Republic of Congo and with making false statements. Vincent Munster, 53, a Dutch citizen, and Claude Kwe, 38, a Cameroonian citizen, work at NIH’s Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Hamilton, Montana, a Biosafety Level 4 facility studying emerging viral pathogens and zoonotic transmission. They arrived Jan. 25, 2026 at Detroit Metropolitan Airport from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, where a monkeypox outbreak had been reported. Customs officers found a large black case; officials say they claimed it contained diagnostic/testing equipment, but investigators found 113 vials stored in Styrofoam coolers. FBI testing of 20 vials found 17 contained deactivated monkeypox virus, one contained chickenpox virus, and two contained human DNA. They face a maximum five-year prison term if convicted. Investigation by FBI Detroit Field Office, CBP, and HHS OIG underscores border-security protocols and that researchers are not above the law.

triage.headline_ja: NIH研究者がサルポックスウイルスを米国に密輸した容疑で起訴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的リスク、渡航制限リスク）。バイオセキュリティレベル4施設の研究者による病原体密輸事件であり、公衆衛生への潜在的脅威と異常性が認められる。
triage.notes: 本イベントは疾病感染ではなくバイオセキュリティインシデント（病原体密輸）である。米国での検出・逮捕のため、対象国リスト内での実際の発生地はDRCのみ（Brazzavilleからの密輸元）。バイオセーフティレベル4施設の関与およびウイルス113本の密輸は、感染症危機管理の観点から極めて重大なシグナルであり、フルRRA対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola blochează un amical pentru CM 2026. Meciul Congo - Chile, interzis în Spania din "prudenţă"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic blocks a friendly for the 2026 World Cup. The Congo-Chile match is banned in Spain as a precaution.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Spain’s La Línea authorities banned the June 9 friendly between DR Congo and Chile on sanitary precaution, citing health-service advice. The same DR Congo squad, preparing for the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, Mexico and Canada (June 11–July 19, 2026), will instead face Denmark on June 3 in Liège, Belgium. In the World Cup, DR Congo is in Group K with Colombia, Portugal and Uzbekistan. The team had canceled its Kinshasa training camp to relocate to Belgium. Separately, three Mexican airlines announced travel restrictions for passengers from Ebola-affected African countries, in coordination with the United States and Canada, less than two weeks before kickoff. Ongoing outbreak-related precautions continue to affect friendly matches and international travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が2026年ワールドカップ親善試合をブロック。コンゴ-チリ戦はスペインで「予防措置」として禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、国際的な移動制限の現実化）。対象国DRCにおけるエボラ流行が国際的なイベント・移動に具体的な影響を与えており、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、国際的な移動制限（航空会社の乗客制限）と世界的なスポーツイベント（2026年ワールドカップ）への影響が現在進行中。複数の先進国（スペイン、ベルギー、米国、カナダ、デンマーク、メキシコ）が言及されているが、実際のエボラ発生はDRC内のみと判断。Bluedot APIが過剰に多くの地域を報告している可能性があるが、サマリーに基づきDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Coup dur pour la RDC avant le Mondial 2026 : l'Espagne interdit un match des Léopards à cause d'Ebola - Cameroun24.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Heavy blow for the DRC ahead of the 2026 World Cup: Spain bans a Leopards match over Ebola
article.articleSummary: June 3, 2026 – an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts Spain's La Línea de la Concepción to cancel DR Congo's June 9 friendly against Chile. Mayor Juan Franco issued a municipal decree citing health precautions after guidance from the local health chief. The cancellation comes just weeks before DR Congo's first World Cup appearance since 1974. The Leopards will still face Denmark on June 3 in Liège, Belgium, while their World Cup Group K includes Portugal (June 17, Houston), Colombia (June 23, Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (June 27, Atlanta). The ban deprives DR Congo of a key warm-up ahead of traveling to North America, as the team prepares for its historic return to the world stage.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ前のコンゴ民主共和国への打撃：エボラ感染症を理由にスペインがレオパーズの試合を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスクが該当（2つ以上）。対象国DRCでエボラ発生が確認され、複数国での国際的な影響（試合キャンセル、移動制限）が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC内のエボラ発生であり、スペイン等での対応はその二次的影響。Bluedot APIが多数の外国地域を付与しているが、実際のイベント発生地はDRCのみ。発症者数・死亡数等の具体的重症度情報は記事サマリーに記載なく「不明」と評価。ただしIHR基準4項目すべてに該当することから、フルRRA実施の必要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ο Έμπολα συνεχίζει να απειλεί... το ποδόσφαιρο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to threaten... football.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease threatens the upcoming World Cup and football in general, and the full scale of the risk remains unknown. The article notes that the safety and scheduling of international football may be affected by the outbreak. A friendly match between Chile and the Democratic Republic of the Congo is described as precarious, 'hanging by a thread,' due to the rising Ebola epidemic in the African nation. The piece underscores how a health emergency in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could disrupt sporting events and international fixtures, highlighting the broader public health implications of outbreaks for global sports calendars.

article.articleHeadline: 永州疾控：流脑"健康刺客"大揭秘！看完这篇，家长秒懂怎么防！_健康_永州站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yongzhou CDC: The Meningococcal Meningitis 'Healthy Assassin' Exposé! Read This and Parents Will Instantly Know How to Prevent It — Yongzhou Health Station
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis) is highlighted in Yongzhou, Hunan Province, China, with rapid progression and a mortality rate over 10%. The article notes meningococcal meningitis causes acute purulent meningitis and involves serogroups A, B, C, W, Y, and X. Incubation is 1–7 days, and many infections may be asymptomatic carriers. Classic presentation includes sudden high fever, severe headache, vomiting, and within hours a non-bleeding purpuric rash; severe cases can be fatal. Among survivors, 10–20% experience permanent sequelae such as hearing loss or neurological impairments. High-risk groups include students in dormitories, infants under 1 year, adolescents, and immunocompromised individuals or travelers to high-risk areas. Prevention centers on vaccination: free National Immunization Program vaccines and self-funded meningococcal vaccines (MenACWY and ACYW135). Daily measures include handwashing and good ventilation; seek urgent care for persistent high fever, severe headache, vomiting, altered mental status, or purpura. Published June 3, 2026 by Yongzhou CDC, source RedNet.

triage.headline_ja: 永州疾病管理予防センター：髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎『健康の刺客』徹底解説！この記事を読めば、保護者は即座に予防方法がわかります！—永州健康ステーション
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は高い死亡率（10%超）と深刻な後遺症リスク（10-20%）を呈する予想外のリスク疾患だが、記事は公式保健機関による予防啓発・教育的性質であり、具体的な集団発生（アウトブレイク）や国際的拡大の証拠が提示されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提示した地域（永州市、湖南省）は中国の対象国リストに含まれるため、China (1814991) として verified_locations に含める。記事は永州疾病管理予防センターによる公式な予防啓発である。具体的なアウトブレイク報告、症例数、流行の確認は記事に明記されていない。IHR基準では「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常性」の2項目に該当するが、フルRRA前のシグナルとしては情報不足が多く、続報や症例数・流行の確認を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: No cause for alarm: Suspected Ebola case in Kiambu cleared
article.articleSummary: Lab tests confirmed no Ebola Virus Disease in a Turkish national who checked into AAR Hospital on Kiambu Road with Ebola-like symptoms, arriving around 11 pm Monday. National Public Health Laboratory analyzed samples; 18 Ebola-alert samples from Nairobi, Kiambu, Uasin Gishu, Nyeri, Nakuru, Nyamira, West Pokot and Kisumu were negative. Public Health Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni said investigations and laboratory findings show the case is not Ebola, and authorities tracked the patient before clearance. Kenya has activated its national incident management system due to Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with rapid response teams on 24/7 standby. Twenty-five counties are at elevated risk, with 12 very high risk, including Nairobi, Mombasa, Uasin Gishu, Busia, Kisumu, Bungoma, Trans-Nzoia, Siaya, West Pokot, Turkana, Homabay and Migori. Separately, the High Court ordered disclosure of details of a proposed United States-linked Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base amid protests in Nanyuki.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒の必要なし：キアンブの疑いエボラ症例が陰性と判明

triage.notes: 発生地域にDRC（GeoNames ID 203312）が含まれているが、記事の主題はケニアにおける疑い事例の陰性判明である。ケニアはDRCおよびウガンダのエボラ流行に対応して警戒態勢を敷いているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。DRCは対象国として含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCでの新規発生ではなく、隣国ケニアでの防疫対応が主題であるため除外。米国（Laikipia Air Baseの隔離施設に関連）も記事の付随的な内容であり、感染症イベント自体が米国で発生しているわけではない。継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Spania: amicalul Chile-RD Congo a fost anulat din cauza temerilor legate de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spain: the Chile-DR Congo friendly match was canceled due to fears surrounding Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 3 June 2026, a World Cup warm-up match in Spain between Chile and the Democratic Republic of Congo was canceled due to precautionary health concerns linked to the Ebola epidemic in Central Africa. La Línea's mayor said the move followed guidance from regional health authorities. Kinshasa officials expressed regret, stating they had fulfilled all health and travel requirements. The cancellation highlights precautionary public health measures around international sports events amid Ebola fears; the game would have taken place in Spain ahead of the World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: スペイン：エボラの懸念によりチリ対コンゴ民主共和国の親善試合が中止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高リスク疾患で国際的な懸念があるが、本記事は実際の感染事例ではなく予防的措置としてのスポーツイベント中止報告である。情報不足により詳細なリスク評価が困難。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行に関連した予防措置としてのスポーツイベント中止を報告している。実際の感染事例数、発症者、死亡者等の詳細情報がないため、流行の規模・重症度は不明。スペイン（対象国外）で試合が予定されていたが、イベント中止自体が国際的な行動制限（travel_trade_restriction）に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: 防伊波拉境外移入！「台灣4大機場」即起免費採檢 返國後追蹤21天 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Ebola importation from overseas! Free testing starts now at Taiwan's four major airports; 21-day post-arrival monitoring.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda have drawn WHO’s PHEIC attention. Taiwan, from 2026-06-03 to 2026-06-30, tightens border quarantine with free voluntary whole-blood testing (5 ml) at four international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan International, Taichung, and Kaohsiung—for travelers with travel history to the DRC or Uganda. Tests are conducted by quarantine staff in HEPA-equipped spaces using standard precautions. Suspected cases at ports of entry trigger medical escalation, with partner hospitals evaluating and treating affected individuals. Travelers returning from outbreak regions must observe 21-day autonomous post-arrival health monitoring and submit daily health Status via the Public Active E-Return Reporting System; if symptoms appear, they should contact quarantine personnel or call 1922. Non-compliance with health monitoring can incur penalties up to NT$150,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の境外移入を防止！台湾の4大空港で即時無料検査開始、帰国後21日間追跡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はWHO PHEIC指定疾患であり、DRCおよびウガンダでの流行が記事の背景。台湾が公式な検疫・監視措置を導入する異常事態であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当（国際的拡大リスク、異常性）、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行を背景としているが、本イベントの主体は台湾での検疫・監視措置である。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみを記載。エボラはWHO PEHICで厳密に監視対象疾患であり、DRCでの継続的流行の存在が重要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo World Cup warm-up match in Spain called off over Ebola concerns - Spain in English
article.articleSummary: On 3 June 2026, DR Congo’s World Cup warm-up against Chile in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, was canceled as a precaution amid an Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo. Mayor Juan Franco cited guidance from Andalusia health authorities and his own medical staff, who advised against hosting the match. DR Congo, appearing at their first World Cup since 1974 (as Zaire), had abandoned a home pre-tournament camp and trained in Belgium ahead of a Denmark warm-up in Liège. The Ebola outbreak was officially declared in mid-May. On 22 May, US authorities required Congo players to complete a 21-day isolation before entering the United States for the World Cup, which runs 11 June–19 July and is hosted by the US, Canada, and Mexico. Congo plans to base in Houston; Group K schedule: Portugal on 17 June (Houston), Colombia on 24 June (Guadalajara), Uzbekistan on 28 June (Atlanta).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のワールドカップ前哨戦がスペインで中止 エボラ懸念により

triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCの東部でのエボラ流行に基づく国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）への影響。DRCは2026年ワールドカップ参加予定国で、米国への入国前に21日間の隔離措置が課せられている。Bluedot APIが付与した多くの地域（スペイン、ベルギー、米国、メキシコなど）はこの流行への反応地であり、発生地はDRCに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: 夏季高溫多雨、登革熱風險升溫！雨後這些地方最易積水　防蚊4步驟不可少 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A hot, rainy summer raises dengue fever risk! After rain, these areas are most prone to standing water—four steps to prevent mosquitoes are essential | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk in Taiwan rises with hot, rainy weather and the upcoming monsoon, as Aedes albopictus mosquitoes breed in standing water. As of May 25, 2026, Taiwan reports 64 confirmed dengue cases: 1 locally transmitted and 63 imported from Southeast and South Asia, with Indonesia contributing 19, Maldives 14, and Vietnam 8. New Taipei City warns that common outdoor breeding sources around homes include flower pot saucers, discarded containers, water barrels, tires, and outdoor drainage, necessitating regular inspection and cleaning. Public health guidance urges residents to apply four steps: inspect, drain, clean, and scrub to eliminate breeding sites and egg remnants. In addition to environmental management, individuals should wear light-colored, long-sleeved clothing and use approved mosquito repellents. Community collaboration is essential to prevent outbreaks during the summer travel season.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季高温多雨、デング熱のリスク上昇！雨後のこれらの地域は最も水が溜まりやすい　蚊対策4ステップは欠かせない
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でデング熱の確定症例64件（うち地域内感染1件、輸入症例63件）が報告されており、モンスーン時期による流行リスク上昇、複数国からの輸入事例が示唆する国際拡大の可能性、環境要因による継続的なベクター媒介感染リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事では台湾でのデング熱報告が主題だが、輸入症例の供給源国としてインドネシア（19件）、ベトナム（8件）が確認された。モルディブ（14件）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。複数国からの輸入事例は地域レベルの感染症監視関心と一致。

article.articleHeadline: 夏季高溫多雨、登革熱風險升溫！雨後這些地方最易積水 防蚊4步驟不可少
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer heat and heavy rains raise dengue fever risk! After rain, these areas are most prone to standing water. Four essential steps to prevent mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk rises in Taiwan with summer heat and heavy rains, as standing water promotes Aedes mosquito breeding. By May 25, 2026, Taiwan reported 64 lab-confirmed dengue cases: 1 indigenous case and 63 imported from Southeast Asia and South Asia, notably Indonesia (19), Maldives (14), and Vietnam (8). New Taipei City authorities urge household and community vigilance, highlighting common breeding sources around homes (flower pot trays, discarded containers, water buckets, tires, and outdoor drainage). Prevention centers on four steps: Inspect for standing water; if found, drain and pour onto dry ground to evaporate rather than into drains; remove unused containers and debris; scrub container inner walls to remove eggs. For outdoor activities, wear light-colored long-sleeved clothing and use approved mosquito repellents. The most effective defense remains source reduction and coordinated community efforts to curb transmission during the upcoming rainy season and travel period.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季の高温多雨がデング熱リスクを上昇させる！雨後のこれらの地域は最も水たまりが溜まりやすい 蚊対策4ステップは欠かせない

triage.notes: 台湾での土着症例が1件報告されており、地域内での継続的な曝露リスクがある。記事では予防対策に重点が置かれており、現在の管理状況は不明。ただし輸入症例が多数（63/64）であり、局地的な流行の初期段階と判断される。今後の土着症例の増加傾向に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : cinq patients d'Ebola guéris et nouveau centre de traitement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Five Ebola patients cured and a new treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Five initial Ebola patients have been cured in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), as authorities address an outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the cures and a new 60-bed Ebola treatment center to be built in Bunia after a June 1, 2026 meeting with the Congolese president. The statement highlights Congo’s globally recognized expertise in combating Ebola, developed through managing 17 outbreaks since 1976. The article focuses on the milestone of patient recoveries and expanded treatment capacity and notes no detailed laboratory confirmation or broader case counts. The Bunia facility aims to strengthen care and support the national and international response to this Bundibugyo-strain Ebola situation in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ患者5名が治癒、新しい治療センター開設
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認事例が報告され、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上（重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさ）に該当し、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の事例が確認されている。記事は患者の治癒と治療施設の拡充を強調しており、新規の大規模発生というより進行中の局所的な流行への対応と解釈される。WHOトップによる公式発表かつDRC政府首脳レベルの会議が実施されており、国際的関心が高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: El Instituto Pasteur de Dakar advierte de la "explosividad" del brote de ébola en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Pasteur Institute of Dakar warns of the 'explosiveness' of the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province, is described as highly explosive by the Pasteur Institute of Dakar on June 3, 2026. The DRC government reports 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, with suspected cases previously exceeding 1,000. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, where 15 cases and one death have been confirmed. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, with a case fatality rate estimated between 30% and 50%; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The Pasteur Institute is conducting rapid diagnostic efforts, deploying field kits and mobile units, but no rapid tests exist for this strain. Security challenges, armed groups, mining activity, and population displacement in Ituri hinder control, including transmissions within health facilities. Community engagement is emphasized, and exact case counts and geographic mapping are needed for projection.

triage.headline_ja: ダカール・パスツール研究所、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の「爆発的」性質について警告

triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはダカール（セネガル）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国(Ituri州)が流行の中心地であり、ウガンダへの国際的拡大を報告している。パスツール研究所(ダカール)は診断支援機関として関与しているが、流行の主発生地はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。セネガルは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: The Tribune Impact: Rights panel seeks report on 10,100 HIV cases in Bathinda since 2019 - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Bathinda district, Punjab, reported 10,100 HIV cases between 2019 and April 2026, according to RTI-derived figures cited by a The Tribune report. The 2025 tally alone was 1,358 cases, with 475 new cases up to April 2026. The Punjab State and Chandigarh (UT) Human Rights Commission took suo motu cognisance of the Tribune article and directed a report from the Civil Surgeon, Bathinda. The bench, consisting of Justice Sant Parkash, Justice Gurbir Singh, and Justice Jitender Singh Shunty, ordered the report to be submitted at least one week before the next hearing on 11 August 2026. The commission also sent a copy of the order and the news report to the Civil Surgeon Bathinda for compliance and to the Director, Health and Family Welfare, Punjab, for information.

triage.headline_ja: トリビューン・インパクト：人権委員会が2019年以来のバティンダ地区HIV10,100件に関する報告書を求める
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるHIV感染の持続的な曝露と重症度が示唆されるが、記事は行政的対応に焦点を当てており、公衆衛生危機として急速に拡大する国際的なリスクの兆候は明確ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: バティンダ地区（パンジャブ州、インド）で2019年以来10,100件のHIV症例が報告されている。2025年だけで1,358件、2026年4月までに475件の新規症例が報告されている。人権委員会による行政的対応が進行中。記事はHIV管理体制の対応を示唆しているが、国際的な流行拡大のリスク或いは急速な公衆衛生危機の兆候は明確に述べられていない。WPROスクリーニング基準は3つ該当するがIHR基準は1つのため、より詳細な疫学情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch sốt xuất huyết đáng lo ngại ở Đồng Tháp, có bệnh nhân tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerning the dengue fever outbreak in Đồng Tháp Province, there has been a death.
article.articleSummary: From January to mid-May 2026, Dong Thap Province, Vietnam, recorded over 3,400 dengue fever cases, a 2.9-fold increase versus the same period last year, including 88 severe cases (2.6%) and 1 death. Nearly 1,700 dengue outbreak clusters were identified, up 3.1-fold. Mỹ Tho Ward reported 28 cases across 7 clusters, up 4.6-fold. The surge is attributed to dense canal networks and variable early rainy-season weather that favor Aedes mosquito transmission. Authorities launched a dengue-control campaign, with Deputy Director Pham Thi Ngoc Thu urging the CDCs and primary health stations to sustain surveillance and eradicate all foci to prevent overlooked outbreaks. The health sector will strengthen diagnostic and treatment capacity to minimize progression and fatalities. Youth volunteer teams will conduct door-to-door vector-control, educating residents to eliminate breeding sites (emptying containers, releasing larvivorous fish) and will expand digital prevention messaging.

triage.headline_ja: ドンタップ省のデング熱流行が懸念事項、死亡患者あり
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。前年同期比2.9倍の急増、死亡事例、重症化率2.6%、ベクター媒介感染の環境的要因が存在することから、シグナルとしてフルRRA進行を推奨。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年1月～5月中旬のドンタップ省（ベトナム）のデング熱流行について報告。症例数の急増（前年同期比2.9倍）、死亡1件、重症88例、流行クラスター1,700以上と、明らかな異常な増加パターン。ベクター媒介感染の環境的促進要因（運河ネットワーク、早期雨季の気象）が明記されており、持続的曝露リスクが高い。当局の積極的対応（サーベイランス強化、ベクター制御キャンペーン）が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: L'OIM appelle à une coordination transfrontalière renforcée face à l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC et en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IOM calls for strengthened cross-border coordination in response to the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) calls for strengthened cross-border coordination to curb the Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak spanning the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In the DRC, 321 confirmed cases, 116 suspected, 48 deaths, and 6 recoveries; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. Transmissions across the border have been identified, underscoring the need for regional cooperation. Field operations rely on specialized teams with PPE for the red zone and community surveillance by the Provincial Health Division’s surveillance commission, which investigates alerts and directs confirmed cases to care facilities. IOM notes that viruses do not respect borders, and border closures can obscure population movements and weaken testing, tracing, and early detection. The region hosts about 3.6 million internally displaced people in DRC, including ~922,000 in Ituri, the outbreak’s epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: IOM、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行に対応した国境を越えた調整強化を呼び掛け
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国にまたがる確認患者および死亡が報告されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づいてDRCで確認患者321例、死亡48例が報告されている。ウガンダも記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。IOM による国境調整強化の呼び掛けおよび地域的な患者移動リスクから社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo World Cup warm-up match in Spain cancelled over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: Ebola fears trigger cancellation of a Democratic Republic of Congo World Cup warm-up in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain, as authorities cancelled the Congo–Chile friendly next week. The mayor cited the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and risk documentation as reasons. FECOFA said the squad meets health, sporting and regulatory requirements, with ongoing talks with authorities and the Spanish Football Federation to find a solution. Congo coach Sebastien Desabre expressed surprise but said the team respects the decision and could relocate within Spain. The DR Congo squad will play Denmark in Liège as a final tune-up before the World Cup, co-hosted by Canada, Mexico and the United States. In Group K, they face Portugal on 17 June, Colombia on 23 June in Guadalajara, and Uzbekistan on 27 June in Atlanta; the tournament runs 11 June–19 July, opening Mexico vs South Africa, final in New Jersey.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのワールドカップ準備試合、エボラ懸念によりスペインでキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生は確認されるが、記事の主焦点はスポーツイベントのキャンセルであり、感染症の流行拡大や重症度に関する具体的情報が不足している。公式な感染症クライシスではなく行政対応の報告に留まっている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を背景としているが、スペイン当局が試合をキャンセルした対応を報じている。DRC内での具体的な症例数、死亡者数、発生地域、感染拡大の危険性など感染症疫学情報は記載されていない。継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: مخاوف من تفشي إيبولا.. الكونغو الديمقراطية تتمسك بخوض ودياتها استعدادًا للمونديال - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fears of an Ebola outbreak... the Democratic Republic of the Congo insists on playing its friendlies in preparation for the World Cup - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Fears of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted Spain’s La Línea de la Concepción to cancel a planned friendly against DR Congo (against Chile) due to health concerns and lack of guarantees. DR Congo’s World Cup preparations continue with a scheduled friendly vs Denmark in Liège, Belgium, before the team travels to the United States. FECOFA says the squad adheres to health, regulatory, and sporting protocols and is negotiating with the Spanish Football Federation to host the match. Coach Sébastien Desabre expressed surprise and is exploring alternatives, including moving the match within Spain or rescheduling. DR Congo competes in World Cup Group K, opening vs Portugal on June 17, followed by Colombia on June 23 and Uzbekistan on June 27. As of 2026-06-03.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染の懸念...コンゴ民主共和国がワールドカップ準備のため親善試合の実施を主張 - ショルークポータル

article.articleHeadline: Thailand's dominant Covid strain not more severe, DDC says
article.articleSummary: NB.1.8.1 remains Thailand’s dominant Covid-19 variant as of June 3, 2026, with no evidence of increased severity. The DDC reports 4,156 new Covid-19 cases and 1 death on June 2. Surveillance shows NB.1.8.1 accounts for 50.95% of detected strains (Jan 1, 2025–Apr 23, 2026), followed by JN.1 at 24.97% and XEC at 9.14%. Most infections resemble routine respiratory illness (fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose). Thailand uses 26 sentinel hospitals to monitor Covid-19, influenza, and other viral respiratory infections; samples meeting criteria are tested, with unusual findings sent to the Department of Medical Sciences for variant ID and risk assessment. No signs of widespread outbreaks beyond seasonal trends; Covid-19 remains year-round, with indoor transmission during the rainy season. Public guidance urges hand hygiene, masks in crowded places or when symptomatic, and testing; hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: タイの優位なCOVID-19株はより重症ではないとDDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: NB.1.8.1変異株がタイで優位だが、重症度の増加を示す証拠がなく、死亡数も1件で季節的傾向の範囲内。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的なCOVID-19サーベイランス報告であり、既知の流行株の監視に関するルーチン情報。DDCのサーベイランスシステムが機能していることを示す。国内での季節的COVID-19流行であり、国際的懸念事項ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridades espanholas cancelam amigável de adversário de Portugal devido ao ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spanish authorities cancel Portugal's opponent's friendly due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak led to the cancellation of a scheduled Chile vs. DR Congo friendly in La Línea de la Concepción, southern Spain, planned for June 9, due to health concerns and a local health authority decree. DR Congo, Portugal’s Group K opponent at the 2026 World Cup, has faced prep disruptions including a canceled training camp and a Kinshasa game, with the squad training in Belgium and a June 3 match against Denmark in Liège. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. As of May 27, DR Congo reported 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths from Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with cross-border transmission to Uganda noted. The DR Congo–Chile clash remains unresolved; teams are scheduled to meet within 14 days, ahead of Portugal’s June 17 opener."

triage.headline_ja: スペイン当局がエボラのためポルトガルの対戦相手との親善試合をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（重大な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WHO宣言済みの国際的関心事象。DRコンゴのブンディブギオエボラ発生は複数国に波及し、スポーツイベント中止など社会的影響も発生している。

article.articleHeadline: Can deforestation predict Ebola outbreaks? Q&A with CDC's Carson Telford
article.articleSummary: The 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Central and East Africa has killed at least 49 people, with transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. A CDC-led study by Carson Telford trained a machine-learning model on 24 Ebola spillover events (2001–2022) to predict high-risk areas using forest cover change, deforestation, and population density. The analysis found a strong link between forest loss and spillover, especially in remote, sparsely populated zones. Retrospective tests linked a DRC town to the top 0.1% of predicted risk before a 2022 outbreak; a Ugandan district reached the top 6% of national risk and showed a year-to-year risk increase in the top 1%. The aim is improved communication and early detection—alerting physicians and high-risk communities—rather than pinpointing precise outbreak timing, to guide targeted surveillance around deforestation-driven risk.

triage.headline_ja: 森林破壊はエボラ出血熱の発生を予測できるか？CDCのカーソン・テルフォードとのQ&A
triage.triage_reason: 2026年ブンディブギョ・エボラ発生で少なくとも49人の死亡が確認され、DRCおよびウガンダで人間から人間への伝播が発生。IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年ブンディブギョ・エボラの現在の発生状況を報告しており、DRCでの確定的な伝播が記述されている。ウガンダはBluedotで列挙されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの現在の発症者は記述されておらず、機械学習モデルの検証事例としてのみ言及されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。対象国リストに含まれないUgandaは評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: China dispatches medical experts to DRC as Ebola outbreak declared global health emergency
article.articleSummary: Three-month Chinese anti-epidemic medical expert team arrived in Kinshasa to bolster the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola response, focusing on prevention, treatment, surveillance, and outbreak containment. The deployment follows the World Health Organization’s designation of the Ebola outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern and Beijing’s commitment to emergency humanitarian aid. The mission advances China-Africa cooperation, with expanded ties to the African Union Commission and Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention to strengthen regional capacity. The initiative is part of Beijing’s broader effort, which has dispatched 45 medical teams (over 900 personnel) to 44 African countries. It aligns with the 2024 Forum on China-Africa Cooperation Beijing Summit health and emergency-response priorities. Several countries have tightened border health inspections to curb cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中国が医療専門家をDRCに派遣、エボラアウトブレイク世界保健上の緊急事態と宣言
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの流行が公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象(PHEIC)として宣言され、複数国が国境検査強化など対応を実施。IHR基準3つ以上該当、国際的な懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが主題。中国が医療専門家を派遣していることが述べられているが、中国での発生は記載されていない。サマリーに基づき、実際の流行地はDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOによるPHEIC宣言により、国際的な関心が最高レベルにある。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疑似病例大減　因大量個案經核查後被排除
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Significant decline in Ebola suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after numerous cases were ruled out following verification.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports that as of Monday, 116 Ebola suspected cases remain under investigation, a sharp drop from earlier totals. WHO spokesperson Christian Lindmeier said the decline results from many cases initially listed due to early, non-specific symptoms being ruled out after testing and verification. In this outbreak, surveillance or patients with Ebola-like symptoms are labeled suspected cases and sent for laboratory testing; some suspected cases are confirmed as Ebola, while many prove to be malaria, meningitis, or other illnesses, removing them from the tally. The update highlights ongoing monitoring and the importance of laboratory confirmation in distinguishing Ebola virus disease from other febrile illnesses in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑似病例が大幅に減少 多数の症例が検証後に除外される
triage.triage_reason: エボラとマラリアの2疾患が報告されているが、今回のニュースは疑似病例の減少（制御される兆候）を示唆しており、急速な悪化や国際的拡大の切迫した兆候は見られない。ただし継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はエボラ疑似病例の減少というポジティブな進展を示唆している。ただしエボラは高病原性疾患であり、116件の疑似病例がなお調査対象であることから、継続的な監視が必要。マラリア、髄膜炎等との鑑別が進行中であることが記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda (Bundibugyo virus)
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda caused by Bundibugyo virus. The WHO designated the outbreak as a PHEIC on 17 May 2026; UK risk is low and imported cases are extremely rare. Clinicians should consider Ebola in acutely unwell patients with fever who left DRC or Uganda in the past 21 days, while testing for malaria and other infections proceeds in parallel. Transmission is via direct contact with blood, secretions or contaminated materials; there is no evidence of airborne spread. Incubation is 2–21 days (usually 4–10). Early symptoms include fever, malaise, myalgia and headache; some may not have fever; progression may include vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, multi‑organ failure and bleeding. Notifiable to the local UKHSA health protection team by telephone. Isolate suspected cases, limit contacts, consult infection specialists, use the Imported Fever Service, and ensure PPE stocks and staff training per Ebola/Marburg guidance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生：コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダ（ブンディブギョウイルス）
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC指定済み。エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率を持つNPIP対象疾患。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)の指定疾患（Annex2）。WHOによるPHEIC指定（2026年5月17日）は既に公式認定。ブンディブギョウウイルスによる発生で、多臓器不全・出血などの重症症状が報告されている。対象国外（ウガンダ）も含まれるが、DRCが発生地として特定されているため両国を列挙。英国への輸入症例リスクは低いとの評価だが、国際的監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: AB ve Dsö, Ebola Salgınlarına Karşı İşbirliğini Güçlendirdi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU and WHO Strengthened Cooperation Against Ebola Outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: EU and WHO deepen cooperation to tackle Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The European Union allocates 15 million euros in humanitarian aid and 100 metric tons of emergency relief supplies, including sample collection kits, viral hemorrhagic fever kits, and medicines, to bolster field response and regional preparedness. Five million euros of the total is designated to WHO. The assistance supports surveillance, infection prevention and control, community engagement, and the uninterrupted delivery of essential health services, enabling national authorities to rapidly curb transmission, protect communities, and strengthen cross-border readiness with neighboring countries. The Humanitarian Air Bridge will deliver the 100 tons to eastern DRC. EU-WHO will continue collaboration to control outbreaks and build resilience against future health emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: EUとWHOがエボラウイルス病の感染拡大に対する協力を強化

triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行対応を主題としている。Ugandaは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリー本文ではDRCが主な対象であり、Ugandaは『neighboring countries』との文脈で言及されるのみであるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。また、本イベント情報は対象国リスト（GeoNames ID）内でDRCが含まれているため、シグナル対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Đưa trái phép virus đậu mùa khỉ vào Mỹ, hai nhà nghiên cứu bị truy tố
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two researchers indicted for illegally bringing the monkeypox virus into the United States.
article.articleSummary: Two NIH researchers at the Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, have been indicted in federal court for conspiring to bring deactivated mpox (monkeypox) virus samples into the United States and for making false statements to customs officials. Vincent Munster, a Dutch national and head of virus ecology, and Claude Kwe, a researcher, allegedly traveled from Congo to Detroit in January with a large black plastic suitcase. CBP and FBI report they falsely claimed the case contained diagnostic equipment; 113 sample vials were found, with 20 tested and 17 containing mpox. The samples were inactivated. The case is described as a breach of public trust; NIH says it is cooperating with law enforcement. Background: mpox was first identified in 1958 with early cases in Central and West Africa; in 2022 it spread to over 70 countries via sexual transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の研究者がサル痘ウイルスを不正に米国に持ち込んだとして起訴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスクに該当。生物セキュリティ侵害と公衆衛生への信頼問題として重要。
triage.notes: 記事は米国での違法輸入事案であり、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは病原体の出所として言及されており、実際のイベント発生地としてカウント。生物セキュリティ・バイオセーフティ侵害案件として、感染症の公衆衛生リスク評価を超えた重要性がある。サンプルは不活化されていたため直接的な感染リスクは低いが、バイオセキュリティの重大な懸念を構成する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, le procedure operative del Ministero: ecco le nuove misure | Farmacista33
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the Ministry's operational procedures: here are the new measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) prompts Italy's Health Ministry to implement traveler measures for arrivals from Uganda or the Democratic Republic of Congo. Arrivals after visits to these areas must self-report within 24 hours to the local ASL prevention department, even if asymptomatic, for an initial risk assessment (travel history, exposures, symptoms) possibly conducted by phone or video. A five-tier risk system guides surveillance: very low (information only); low (self-monitoring for 21 days); areas of attention (active prevention surveillance); high risk (quarantine with daily health monitoring); very high risk (close contact with cases, exposure to infectious fluids, participation in funeral rites, or contact with wildlife) requiring quarantine. If symptoms arise during flight, the aircraft must land exclusively at Fiumicino Airport; suspected cases managed by Usmaf-Sasn. Diagnosis centralized at Spallanzani in Rome; contact tracing via 112/118.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、保健省の運用手順：新たな措置はこちら
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（BDBV）のウガンダおよびコンゴでの発生に対し、イタリアが国際的な感染対策を実施している。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性が該当する懸念事例。

article.articleHeadline: 8 Balita di Tangerang Terjangkit HIV, Faktor karena Orang Tua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8 Toddlers in Tangerang Infected with HIV, Parental Factors
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, Tangerang Regency Health Office reports 203 HIV cases, with the highest concentration detected at Curug, Kelapa Dua, Kosambi, and Cikupa community health centers. Of these, 167 cases are adults aged 21–55, 28 are adolescents, and 8 are toddlers. Transmission among adults and teens is attributed to needle sharing, sexual intercourse, and deviant sexual behavior. Toddlers infections occur because their parents are living with HIV. Authorities urge safer sex with a spouse in a legally recognized marriage and consistent antiretroviral therapy to prevent progression to AIDS. The figure indicates ongoing HIV spread across multiple clinics in the district, highlighting the need for prevention, treatment adherence, and public education to reduce incidence.

triage.headline_ja: タンゲラン県の8人の幼児がHIVに感染、両親が原因
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）でのHIV集団感染事例（203例）であり、小児への垂直感染を含む異常な状況を示しているが、IHR基準2つ以上の明確な該当、または社会的・政治的関心の具体的な証拠が記事サマリーには記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: IHR基準は2つ該当（serious_impact、unusual_unexpected）し、WPRO基準も4つ該当している。ただし記事サマリーには国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク、国際支援要求の明示がなく、また社会的・政治的関心についても具体的な記載がない。タンゲラン県でのHIV 203例検出は深刻だが、詳細な疫学情報と対応体制の評価待ちが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tự điều trị bằng thuốc nam, người đàn ông tử vong nghi do bệnh dại sau 5 tháng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man dies after five months of self-treatment with herbal medicine; rabies suspected.
article.articleSummary: Rabies suspected in a fatal case in Bạch Hà commune, Đô Lương District, Nghệ An Province, Vietnam. A man born 1957 (N.V.V.) was bitten by his family dog about five months prior; the dog died five days later. He did not receive post-exposure rabies vaccination, instead self-treated with traditional herbal medicine. Approximately five months after the bite he developed vomiting, hydrophobia, and agitation, was hospitalized, and died on 3 June 2026. Local health authorities, in coordination with Bạch Hà authorities, reviewed exposure risks and intensified rabies prevention messaging. Officials warn that rabies is nearly 100% fatal after symptom onset but can be prevented with timely post-exposure vaccination. A separate report from the same outlet notes a 14-year-old boy in Thai Nguyen presenting with rabies after a six-month dog bite, underscoring ongoing risk.

triage.headline_ja: 漢方薬で自己治療した男性が5ヶ月後に死亡、狂犬病の疑い
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける確定的な狂犬病死亡事例（症状発現後の致死性確認）と、複数事例の報告により、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・流行しやすさが明確に該当。同時に異常/予想外な臨床経過（5ヶ月の潜伏期）も認められ、シグナルとしてフルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベトナム（Nghệ An Province、Thai Nguyen地域）における確定的な狂犬病死亡2例を報告。第1例は5ヶ月の潜伏期間を経て発症・死亡し、その間にヒトへの医療アクセス欠如による防止失敗を示している。第2例の報告も同じ期間内での発症を示唆。狂犬病は症状発現後の致死率がほぼ100%であり、ワクチン未接種での家畜咬傷が主要なリスク。当地での公衆衛生対応と啓発活動が報告されており、当局の関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Sem vacina e sem tratamento: o desafio da nova cepa do ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No vaccine and no treatment: the challenge of the new Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain returns to global concern with no approved vaccine or specific therapy. The Bundibugyo variant is rarer than Zaire and has attracted fewer research investments, leaving populations exposed as outbreaks emerge in affected regions. Existing vaccines do not automatically protect other Ebola variants, and monoclonal antibody therapies that helped against Zaire have not yet shown proven efficacy for Bundibugyo. Healthcare providers rely on supportive care such as fluid and electrolyte replacement, cardiac and laboratory monitoring, respiratory support when needed, and careful symptom management to improve survival, while laboratory confirmation of Bundibugyo remains limited in outbreak areas, hindering case finding and contact isolation. Researchers are advancing candidates such as ChAdOx1 BDBV from University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India, plus antivirals like remdesivir and obeldesivir in early testing. Ongoing surveillance, early diagnosis, and robust clinical care remain essential until vaccines and therapies are validated.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンも治療法もない：新しいエボラ株の課題
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラ株に関する懸念情報であり、予防・治療手段の欠如という重大な公衆衛生課題を指摘している。しかし記事は一般的な啓発性が強く、具体的な現在進行形のアウトブレイク情報、患者数、死亡者、急速な伝播の証拠が記載されていないため、IHR基準やWPRO基準の明確な該当が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラウイルス（特にブンディブギョ株）の医学的課題に関する一般的な啓発内容であり、現在進行形のアウトブレイク情報ではない。イギリスはオックスフォード大学のワクチン候補開発地として言及されているが、感染症の実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。インドはSerum Institute of Indiaがワクチン開発に関与していることで言及されているが、実際の発生地かは不明。ただし対象国リストに含まれるため記載した。具体的な患者数、死亡者、確認されたアウトブレイク地域が不明なため、IHR・WPRO基準の評価に不確実性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Spallanzani experts return to Italy from Ebola-hit Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompted Italy's Spallanzani Institute team, together with civil protection officials and AISE, to return from Kinshasa after a mission to assist the Ebola emergency. There are at least 344 confirmed cases in the DRC, with at least 60 deaths. The mission, the only European response thus far, aimed to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, provide technical assistance, and deliver medicines and medical supplies. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, for which there is currently no vaccine or treatment. Coordination was led by foreign and health ministries, with the civil protection department continuing to offer scientific and operational support for any further DRC requests.

triage.headline_ja: スパランツァーニ研究所の専門家がエボラ発生のコンゴ民主共和国からイタリアに帰国
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認例344件・死亡60件という重大な公衆衛生影響、ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株の流行、国際的な支援活動が進行中である点から、IHR基準2つ以上（重症度・国際的拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ流行であり、イタリアはミッション支援国として言及されているが発生地ではない。Bluedot APIが示す4つの地域情報のうち、DRCのみが実際の発生地域として確認される。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株、344確認例・60死亡という数字から高い重症度が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Cinco presos sospechosos de tener ébola huyen de dos centros sanitarios en el este del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five prisoners suspected of having Ebola flee from two health centers in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Five prisoners identified as suspected Ebola cases escaped from two health centers in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, over the weekend and on Monday. Two escaped during the night from Saturday to Sunday from Bunia General Reference Hospital; the other three fled Monday from a treatment center at Rwampara, about 10 km from the city. The patients were not under police custody to avoid contagion among officers. Authorities, with support from the Red Cross and humanitarian groups, intensified searches and reinforced prevention in Bunia's central prison. Ituri Province concentrates most outbreak cases since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Government data report 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths overall; 322 infections (46 deaths) in Ituri. The outbreak has reached Uganda with 15 infections, including one death, considered an imported DRC case. WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部の二つの保健施設からエボラ疑い患者5人が逃亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の公式宣言済み集団発生であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHO緊急事態宣言済みで、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項。患者逃亡による地域内感染拡大リスク増加。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確定的な集団発生。2026年5月15日に宣言された現在進行中のIturi州での流行。344確定症例、60死亡（全体）、うちIturi州322症例46死亡。ウガンダへの越境感染（15症例、死亡1）も既に確認。WHO PHEIC(国際懸念事項である公衆衛生上の緊急事態)宣言済み。患者逃亡は封じ込めの失敗を示唆し、さらなる地域感染拡大のリスクを高める。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果烏干達入境即起免費採血 石崇良視察桃機防堵伊波拉 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Free blood sampling upon entry for travelers from Congo and Uganda; Shi Chongliang inspects Taoyuan International Airport to curb Ebola
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's Ministry of Health and Welfare announced on June 3, 2026, that free voluntary blood sampling will be offered to travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda through June 30, in addition to the 21-day self-health management requirement. At four international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan International, Taichung, and Kaohsiung—entry screenings will provide free blood tests, with medical assessment arranged for symptomatic arrivals through contracted hospitals. Border and airport authorities will expedite processing for those with symptoms. The Ebola risk is Level 3 (Warning) for the DRC and Uganda; travelers from outbreak areas and returnees must adhere to 21-day self-monitoring with daily self-reports via the Public Self-Reporting System. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or bleeding; suspected cases should contact quarantine personnel or call the epidemic prevention line for medical care. Violations carry fines between TWD 10,000 and 150,000. Minister Shi Chongliang also inspected Taoyuan Airport’s border quarantine measures and interagency defense operations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダからの入国者に無料採血を実施、石崇良が桃機空港を視察しエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生は確認されていないが、台湾がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダからの入国者に対して検疫・監視強化措置を実施しており、リスク認識が高い状況。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾での防疫措置の報道であり、台湾内でのエボラ発生は報告されていない。DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行リスクに対する予防的対応である。対象国はDRC（203312）のみ該当。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Malattia di Chagas spaventa l'America Latina, circa 6 mln convivono con l'infezione parassitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease scares Latin America, about 6 million live with the parasitic infection.
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease, caused by Trypanosoma cruzi, affects about 6 million people across Latin America and is described as a ticking time bomb because roughly 30% will develop serious cardiomyopathy years after infection. Transmission is primarily vectorial, via nocturnal Triatominae kissing bugs that bite exposed skin and deposit feces containing the parasite; other routes include blood transfusion, organ transplantation, congenital transmission, and ingestion of contaminated food or drinks. Most infections start in rural childhoods, but urban migration has broadened transmission. Diagnosis remains limited: WHO estimates that in many countries fewer than 10% of infected individuals are diagnosed, and in some places under 1%. In Brazil, oral transmission accounts for more than half of acute cases; Bolivia has the highest national prevalence (80–115 new cases per 100,000 people annually). Congenital transmission occurs in about 5–10% of infected pregnancies. Early treatment with benznidazole or nifurtimox is nearly 100% effective when given promptly, though about 70% remain unaware of their infection.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病がラテンアメリカを脅かす、約600万人が寄生虫感染と共生
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病は広範な地理的分布と高い罹患数を示す既知の風土病であり、IHR基準の2つ以上に該当する可能性があるが、急速な流行や異常性の指標が記事サマリーに明示されていない。継続的な監視と詳細情報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではボリビアとブラジルが発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。シャーガス病は既知の風土病であり、「スケアスケアケアスケア」的な報道は見られるが、新規の急速な流行事象ではなく診断・治療ギャップの継続的課題が焦点。WPRO基準では3つ該当するが、IHR基準は1つのみであるため、社会的関心を踏まえWATCH判定とした。
