article.articleHeadline: Nova cepa do Ebola sem vacina nem tratamento, desafio para saúde pública
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New strain of Ebola without a vaccine or treatment, a challenge to public health.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus (BDBV) has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. A candidate vaccine, ChAdOx1 BDBV, is under study, developed by the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India, alongside early investigations of antivirals such as remdesivir and obeldesivir. Bundibugyo is less common than the Zaire strain, contributing to slower data collection and no guaranteed cross-protection from vaccines for other Ebola species; each strain requires separate evaluation. Diagnosis hinges on laboratory confirmation identifying the Bundibugyo strain, with limited testing availability in affected areas, complicating contact tracing and isolation. Monoclonal antibody therapies proven against Zaire have not demonstrated efficacy against Bundibugyo. Clinicians focus on supportive care—fluids, monitoring, and respiratory support when needed. Outbreak control depends on surveillance, rapid diagnosis, and timely clinical management while research advances vaccines and therapies.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンも治療法もない新しいエボラ菌株、公衆衛生への課題
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスBundibugyo株（BDBV）は重篤な病原体であり、ワクチン・治療法が限定的である点で異常・予想外性がある。しかし記事は科学的背景・研究状況の説明が主体で、具体的な患者発生・流行の報告がなく、現在の実イベント情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は新しいエボラ株（BDBV）のワクチン・治療法の現状についての一般啓発記事と判断される。具体的な流行事例、患者数、発生地域の詳細報告がないため、実イベントの確認が不足している。インドの血清研究所（Serum Institute of India）がワクチン候補開発に関わっている点から verified_locations に India を含める。イギリスは記事内容に言及なく、Bluedot APIの地域自動抽出の誤りと考えられるため除外した。続報で具体的な患者発生や流行状況が報告される場合は PICKUP に昇格する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola et match RDC - Danemark à Sclessin : risque sanitaire nul selon un infectiologue - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and DRC-Denmark match - Denmark at Sclessin: no health risk according to an infectious disease specialist - RTBF Actus
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is experiencing an Ebola virus disease outbreak. A friendly international between the DRC and Denmark was held at Sclessin (Standard de Liège’s stadium) in Liège, Belgium. An infectious disease specialist told RTBF Actus there is no health risk for spectators or players at the venue. This assessment follows Spain’s cancellation of a similar match between the DRC and Chile on its territory. The report mentions the ongoing Ebola outbreak but provides no case or death counts, transmission details, or laboratory confirmation. No infection source is specified. The article emphasizes that, despite the outbreak in the DRC, the Belgian match carried no indicated health risk according to the expert consulted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとDRC-デンマーク戦 - Sclessinでのリスクなしとは、感染症専門家の見解 - RTBF Actus
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク（既知の深刻な疾患）に加え、国際的な人的移動（国際試合）を伴う報道であり、異常/予想外な公衆衛生関心事項を含む。複数国での関連報道（スペインでの試合キャンセル）があり、国際的広がりのリスク要因を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、DRCでエボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク発生中であることが述べられている。ベルギーで開催されたDRC-デンマーク試合および関連するスペインでのDRC-チリ試合キャンセルは、DRCでの発生を背景とした国際的関心の高まりを示唆する。ただし、具体的な症例数、死亡数、病原体確認情報は記事サマリーに含まれていない。対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Veja como está a decorrer o impacto do surto de Ébola (em mapas e gráficos)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: See how the Ebola outbreak's impact is unfolding (in maps and charts).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO on May 17, 2026. First cases appeared in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with confirmed cases in the DRC and Uganda; the United States imposed travel restrictions on travelers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. Since Ebola’s discovery in 1976, the region has recorded over 15,000 deaths, including more than 11,000 in the 2014 West Africa outbreak and over 3,000 in the DRC. The current outbreak risks becoming among the largest due to rapid case growth. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces, with spillover likely from handling or consuming infected wildlife. Contributing factors include weak rural health infrastructure, regional conflict, an unusual viral strain, and funding cuts; funeral practices and misinformation further heighten transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイクの影響がどのように展開しているかを見る（地図とグラフで）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は2026年5月17日にWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態として指定された。DRCおよびウガンダで確認された症例があり、米国が渡航制限を実施。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域にはSudan、Angola、Ugandaが含まれていますが、記事サマリーの記述に基づき、確認された症例が存在する対象国はDRCのみです。Ugandaは隣接国として言及されていますが、症例確認の明示はないため除外。Sudanはサマリー内で「South Sudan」として参照されていますが、確認された症例は記述されていないため除外。United Statesは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはIturi Province（イトゥリ州）が最初の発生地で、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当する高リスク案件。

article.articleHeadline: ABD'de maymun çiçeği virüsü alarmı: İki bilim insanına kaçakçılık suçlaması
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox virus alert in the United States: Two scientists charged with smuggling.
article.articleSummary: Two scientists at a U.S. government laboratory—Vincent Munster, head of the Virus Ecology division at Rocky Mountain Laboratories, Montana, and Claude Kwe—are charged in a Detroit federal case with smuggling inactivated mpox (monkeypox) samples into the United States. They reportedly returned from a nine-day visit to the Republic of the Congo in Central Africa on a Paris-bound flight and were stopped at Detroit Metropolitan Airport. Munster initially denied bringing biological material, but later testing detected mpox-containing vials among their belongings. The FBI says the samples were not declared and no permits were obtained. NIH Inspector Marcus Sykes warned that importing such materials without authorization threatens public safety. The men were due to appear in federal court in Missoula, Montana on June 3, 2026. The FBI continues the investigation; NIH says it is cooperating. Mpox, formerly monkeypox, typically presents with rash and fever; the 2022 outbreaks affected more than 70 countries.

triage.headline_ja: 米国でのサル痘ウイルスアラート：2人の科学者が密輸罪で起訴
triage.triage_reason: 密輸事件は公衆衛生上の懸念を引き起こすが、実際の感染症流行ではなく刑事事案が主体。記事サマリーではコンゴからの非申告サンプル持ち込みという異常事態が述べられているが、公開情報では実際の感染患者発生や急速な拡大の証拠が不明である。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症イベントというより、行政・刑事事案としての色彩が強い。コンゴでの検体採取という国際的な危険物輸送の違法行為であり、感染症流行の報告ではない。ただし、不申告の高リスク病原体サンプル（Mpox Clade I/II）が米国に不正搬入された点は異常性が高く、公衆衛生上の潜在的リスクとして注視が必要。米国内での実際の感染者発生の報告はサマリーに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus Disease: UNICEF emergency response and preparedness
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda led the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026. Children are disproportionately affected by Ebola outbreaks, facing direct infection and broader harms from disrupted health, nutrition, education, and child protection services. The UNICEF Emergency Response and Preparedness for EVD outlines the situation as of 21 May 2026 and provides details of UNICEF's response efforts. The brief underscores the need for rapid, coordinated action to support affected children and maintain essential services amid the outbreak. It situates UNICEF's activities within the wider emergency response and preparedness framework, reflecting ongoing efforts in the DRC and Uganda since the PHEIC declaration on 17 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病：UNICEFの緊急対応と準備態勢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大、PHEIC宣言済み）。コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ流行は2026年5月17日にWHOがPHEIC宣言済みのため、即座にフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのアウトブレイク対応に焦点を当てており、対象国リスト外のため除外。PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）のため優先度は最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: India's support to Africa-led Ebola response efforts
article.articleSummary: India extends urgent medical assistance to Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) to support Ebola response in Africa, following a request from the African Union Commission. The first tranche of about 2.5 tons of urgent medical supplies was dispatched on 24 May 2026 to Kampala, Uganda, including protective gear, medical monitoring equipment, essential medicines and supplements. After receiving a detailed requirements list, MEA mobilised a larger second tranche of 43 tons comprising protective gear, diagnostic/monitoring devices, sample transport kits, infection prevention supplies, medicines and supplements; the second tranche will reach Kampala on 2 June 2026 and be handed over to Africa CDC. The initiative underscores India's commitment to African public health partnerships, with Missions in Addis Ababa and Kampala coordinating with the African Union Commission and Africa CDC to support Ebola response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ主導のエボラ対応努力に対するインドの支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の発生がウガンダおよびエチオピアで確認されており、IHR基準の「異常/予想外性」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。また、複数国での流行兆候と国際的な公衆衛生支援体制の構築が示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドの支援活動について述べているが、基礎となるエボラ発生がウガンダとエチオピアで確認されている。verified_locationsはサマリーで実際に言及されているKampala（ウガンダ）とAddis Ababa（エチオピア）に基づき設定。インドは支援国であり発生国ではないため除外。対象国リストに該当する発生国はウガンダとエチオピアだが、エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれていない可能性があるため、ウガンダのみの確実な該当を確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: EUA Avaliam Nomeação de Responsável Único Para Coordenar Resposta ao Surto em África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: U.S. weighs appointment of a single official to coordinate the outbreak response in Africa.
article.articleSummary: On June 2, 2026, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told a House committee that the Trump administration is considering appointing a single official to coordinate the Ebola outbreak response in Africa, though he avoided the label 'Ebola czar'. The appointed coordinator would work full-time to liaise across agencies; several candidates are being considered. In the meantime, agencies hold daily briefings and the State Department maintains a 24/7 task force monitoring the outbreak. The World Health Organization reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 321 laboratory-confirmed cases and 116 suspected cases, with 48 deaths and 6 recoveries. Uganda's Ministry of Health confirmed six new cases, bringing the national total to 15 infections.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国、アフリカでの感染症流行対応を調整する単一責任者の任命を検討
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCで321確定例・116疑似例・48死亡、ウガンダでも15例の確認事例があり、米国が政府レベルの調整体制強化を検討するほどの国際的懸念を示している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行の詳細な症例数（321確定例、116疑似例、48死亡、6回復）を記載。ウガンダでの事例もサマリーに明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。米国の政府レベルの対応強化（専任調整官の任命検討）は国際的な懸念の高さを示す重要な指標。

article.articleHeadline: Dwóch rządowych naukowców oskarżono o przemyt wirusa. Złamane wszystkie procedury
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two government scientists were charged with smuggling a virus. All procedures were breached.
article.articleSummary: Two scientists at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana were charged with smuggling a deactivated mpox (monkeypox) virus from the Republic of Congo to the United States. Prosecutors say samples were not declared at customs nor transported with the required approvals. Vincent Munster allegedly denied transporting any biological samples and claimed documents were on his laptop; later review found vials containing deactivated mpox. Investigators allege the materials were not reported to authorities and lacked proper permits. The FBI regards some explanations as potentially false. The men, long-time mpox and infectious disease researchers, were detained on arrival at Detroit Metropolitan Airport after a nine-day Congo trip via Paris and are due in federal court in Montana. NIH is cooperating with authorities. Congo faced an mpox outbreak with over 2,000 deaths, declared ended in April.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の政府科学者がウイルスの密輸で告発される。すべての手続きが違反された
triage.triage_reason: Mpox違法輸送事案であり異常・予想外だが、記事主体は犯罪捜査であり感染症アウトブレイク事案ではない。対象国はDRCが含まれるが、既に終結した過去のアウトブレイク背景での密輸事案のため、現在の公衆衛生的脅威は限定的。情報不足を含め継続観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの違法ウイルス輸送事案であり、米国内での密輸犯罪が主体。DRCのMpoxアウトブレイク自体は既に2025年4月に終結と記載されている。現在の公衆衛生的リスクは低いが、バイオセキュリティ面での懸念（違法輸送、手続き違反）と異常性から継続監視。米国での二次拡大の可能性は低いとも記載（不活化ウイルス）。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉！非洲2國居民禁入台灣90天　入境旅客自願免費採檢 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Ebola! Residents of two African countries barred from entering Taiwan for 90 days; inbound travelers voluntarily undergo free testing.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-03, Taiwan's CDC announced enhanced border measures after WHO declared the Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. From 3 June to 30 June 2026, four international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung—offer free voluntary Ebola testing for asymptomatic travelers with travel history to DRC or Uganda. Tests use a 5 ml whole-blood sample in HEPA-equipped testing rooms and are voluntary; symptomatic arrivals will be directed to contracted hospitals for medical assessment and rapid clearance. In parallel, visa issuance to residents of the DRC and Uganda is suspended for 90 days, with exemptions for enrolled degree-seeking students, diplomatic/official personnel, Taiwanese spouses and minor children, and certain emergency/humanitarian cases. Travelers must self-report health status daily via the national self-report system; violations carry NT$10,000–150,000 fines. Level 3 (Warning) advisories urge avoiding Ebola-affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症を防止！アフリカ2カ国の居民は台湾への入国を90日間禁止　入境旅客は自発的な無料検査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は重大な感染症だがDRCとウガンダでのアウトブレイク情報であり、台湾での実際の発症報告はなく、台湾が実施する水際対策・防止措置の記事である。対象国リストに台湾は含まれないため verified_locations は DRC のみ。IHR基準は潜在的に3つ該当する可能性があるが、台湾自体でのイベント発生ではなく、記事サマリーから実際の感染事例が台湾にあるかは不明。情報の充実化と続報を要注視。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク情報が主題であり、台湾はこれに対する防止措置（水際対策）を実施している状況。台湾自体での感染事例報告はない。対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみ含まれるため、verified_locationsに記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。WHO PHEICの宣言を受けた各国の対応記事であるため、WPRO地域における重要な情報である。

article.articleHeadline: World News in Brief: Violence hampers Ebola efforts, aid delivery in Darfur and Gaza, Nicaraguan activist's death in custody
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths (as of 31 May) and at least six recoveries; outbreaks in Ituri’s Mambasa Territory and fighting in North and South Kivu hinder access to fields and health workers. Uganda reports 11 Ebola cases, including two deaths, linked to cross-border transmission from DRC as of 1 June. UN OCHA notes ground support: treatment centres, meals, supplies, and strengthened surveillance, plus Bunia airport reopening for humanitarian use. In Darfur, aid delivery persists despite violence and funding gaps, with April food assistance reaching over 3 million and nearly 500,000 displaced in Tawila; clashes and drone strikes affect Central, West, and South Darfur. Gaza aid convoys face delays due to new Israeli screening routes via Kerem Shalom/Karem Abu Salem; Zikim remains closed. West Bank displacement surpasses 33,000 since Jan 2025. Nicaragua’s OHCHR calls for a prompt, impartial probe into Indigenous activist Brooklyn Rivera’s death in custody after 32 months.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ニュース速報：暴力がエボラ対策の妨げに、ダルフールとガザでの援助配送、ニカラグアの活動家が収容中に死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）で確認・拡大中であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大）を満たす。WPRO基準でも高重症度と流行しやすさが該当。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはスーダン、パレスチナ、ウガンダなども含まれるが、記事サマリーの主体的なエボラ発生地はDRC（イツリ州マンバサ）および同国からの越境感染によるウガンダの事例。ただし、ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めていない。ダルフールはスーダン（対象国外）、ガザはパレスチナ（対象国外）であり、本イベントのエボラ流行に直接関連していないため除外。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kaluma warns of cross-border Ebola risk, pushes for quarantine facility in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya faces cross-border Ebola risk as Homa Bay Town MP Peter Kaluma urges urgent establishment of an Ebola quarantine facility to boost preparedness, citing outbreaks in parts of Africa and Kenya's sizable populations in DRC and Uganda. He warned that cross-border movement could bring infected Kenyans home if precautions are not in place. Kaluma called for a dedicated facility to strengthen Kenya's containment and response capacity. The move comes amid political controversy, with the United Opposition accusing the government of secrecy and demanding full disclosure of Ebola-related protocols, agreements, and intergovernmental commitments. Separately, US representatives defended Kenya as the preferred site for a proposed quarantine facility, noting its proximity to DRC and regional outbreak zones. CMS Administrator Mehmet Oz stated that rapid transfer requires an adjacent operating room when a patient is sick, underscoring time-sensitive logistics.

triage.headline_ja: カルマ議員、ケニアにおけるエボラの越境リスクに警告、隔離施設の設置を推し進める
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的拡大リスク（DRC、ウガンダからケニアへの越境感染）が明確であり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。ケニア政府の隔離施設整備要求という具体的な対応が進行中で、米国も関与している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にケニアのエボラ対応準備状況を論じており、DRCとウガンダからの越境リスクを警告している。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めず、DRCのみを列挙。米国の関与は記事に言及されているが、米国での実際の発生ではなく隔離施設立地に関する政治的議論であるため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Friendly pre-World Cup match between DR Congo and Chile cancelled in Spain due to Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-03, a pre-World Cup friendly between Chile and DR Congo scheduled for June 9 in La Línea de la Concepción, Cádiz, was canceled by mayor Juan Franco amid fears of the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, officially declared an epidemic by the WHO. Andalusia health authorities recommended scrapping the match, citing insufficient safety documentation; the mayor warned of a serious pandemic and lack of a vaccine. DR Congo had qualified for the 2026 World Cup after beating Jamaica in March playoffs; Chile did not qualify. Congolese players have been training in Belgium since before the outbreak, reducing import risk, but organizers' paperwork raised doubts about health guarantees. US travel bans otherwise apply to travelers from DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan; however the players will be permitted to enter the United States to play group-stage matches against Portugal, Colombia, Uzbekistan in Houston, Atlanta, and Guadalajara, Mexico.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ懸念によりスペインでのDRコンゴ対チリ親善試合が中止
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでのエボラ流行により国際スポーツイベント中止という異常な事態。IHR基準で国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・流行性が該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが抽出した多くの地域（米国、スペイン、メキシコなど）は記事の主題ではなく、参考情報として言及されているのみ。実際のエボラ流行地はDRコンゴであり、国際的な移動・スポーツイベントへの影響が記事の核。WHO公式宣言によるエボラ流行であり、渡航規制も実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Feds: 2 researchers smuggled monkeypox through Detroit airport
article.articleSummary: Two NIH scientists, Vincent Munster (53) of the Netherlands and Claude Kwe (38) of Cameroon, stationed at NIH’s Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Montana, are charged with conspiracy to smuggle monkeypox and lying to a federal officer after 113 vials were found in their luggage at Detroit Metropolitan Airport on Jan. 25. The Delta Flight 229 arrival from Paris originated in Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, where monkeypox outbreaks had been reported. Officers recovered a black plastic case; Munster claimed it contained diagnostics and testing equipment, but FBI testing of 20 vials so far shows 17 contained deactivated monkeypox virus, one chickenpox virus, and two human DNA. They are scheduled to appear in federal court in Missoula, Montana (June 3) and will face Detroit prosecution; maximum sentence five years if convicted. This case highlights smuggling of viral pathogens into the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦当局：2人の研究者がデトロイト空港を経由してサル痘を密輸
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの違法な国際輸送事案であり、公衆衛生への影響は深刻（113本のウイルス含有サンプルの密輸）、異常・予想外で、国際的な感染症制御体制への脅威を示唆している。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はミシガン州デトロイト空港での密輸事案を報道しているが、発生地域としてのMpoxアウトブレイクはコンゴ民主共和国で確認されており、これが対象国リストに含まれる唯一の該当国である。USA, France, Netherlands, Cameronは発生国ではなく、流通経路上の地域のため除外。111本のMpox含有ウイルス（うち17本は不活化確認）の違法な国際移動という極めて異常な事案であり、生物安全保障上の重大懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Träningsmatch före VM mellan DR Kongo och Chile ställdes in i Spanien på grund av Ebola-farhågor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Training match before the World Cup between DR Congo and Chile was canceled in Spain due to Ebola concerns.
article.articleSummary: Spain canceled a World Cup warm-up between Chile and the Democratic Republic of Congo in La Línea de la Concepción, Cádiz, slated for June 9, due to Ebola concerns after health authorities cited regional guidance amid a WHO-declared Ebola epidemic in Africa. Mayor Juan Franco stated organizer documentation was insufficient, deeming cancellation the prudent option. Chile did not qualify for the 2026 World Cup; DR Congo qualified for the tournament for a second time, after defeating Jamaica in March qualifiers last year. Congolese players have trained and based in Belgium since the outbreak began, making transmission risk unlikely, though health-and-safety guarantees for the match remained in doubt. The United States maintains strict entry bans for non-U.S. citizens who have been in DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan; DR Congo players will still enter the U.S. to play group-stage games against Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan in Houston, Atlanta, and Guadalajara.

triage.headline_ja: エボラへの懸念からスペインでのDR コンゴ対チリのW杯前のトレーニングマッチが中止に
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの既知の流行（アフリカでのWHO宣言済みエピデミック）に関連した報告だが、実際のヒト患者の症例報告ではなく、スポーツイベント中止の意思決定に基づく。国際スポーツイベント関連の渡航・貿易への潜在的影響あり。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ（DRC）でのエボラ流行による国際的な影響（スペインでのスポーツイベント中止、米国の渡航禁止）を報道しているが、対象国（WPRO/SEARO地域）に該当する確認された発生地はDRCのみ。スペイン、チリ、米国での症例報告はなく、懸念ベースの政策対応を扱う二次的な報道である。フルRRAは必要ないが、スポーツイベントを通じた国際人流への影響と、DRCからの実際の患者移動リスクについては継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Trump wants to offload the DRC's Ebola cases to Kenya
article.articleSummary: US plans to open a quarantine centre in Kenya to isolate American patients infected with Ebola linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain). In collaboration with Nairobi, Washington sought to deploy 30 healthcare workers and 50 hospital beds, to be used before repatriating patients to the United States once recovered. Kenya has recorded no cases linked to the Bundibugyo strain so far. The proposal triggered street protests in Laikipia, near a military base, where hundreds demonstrated and two people died, with civil society groups challenging the plan in court. Kenyan courts subsequently barred the state from creating or operating any Ebola-linked quarantine facility. Despite backlash, two military aircraft reportedly landed in Laikipia to help install the beds. Kenya’s health minister, Aden Duale, argued the facility could strengthen surveillance and response; Washington has offered about $13.5 million in a bilateral package.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権、DRCのエボラ患者をケニアに移送したい考え
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の国家間患者移送提案であり、国際的な感染症危機管理の重要な案件。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCのエボラ患者のケニアへの移送提案であり、DRCが発生地である。ケニアは提案実施地（受け入れ国）だが、実際の感染症発生地ではなく、現在のところEbola症例は報告されていない（記事本文に「Kenya has recorded no cases linked to the Bundibugyo strain so far」と明記）。したがってverified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。対象国リストではDRC(203312)が含まれているため該当。

article.articleHeadline: PS Mary Muthoni calls for regional unity as Kenya strengthens Ebola preparedness
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Principal Secretary for Public Health, Mary Muthoni, urged regional unity to bolster Ebola virus disease (EVD) preparedness as East Africa faces outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Speaking at a June 3, 2026 press briefing, she highlighted that pathogens do not respect borders and called for shared experiences, coordinated surveillance, and a unified continental strategy to combat EVD across neighboring countries. The appeal accompanies intensified cross-border vigilance, information exchange, and joint emergency-response mechanisms among governments and health agencies. Kenya said it is strengthening readiness through enhanced surveillance systems, laboratory capacity, and rapid response capabilities. Muthoni emphasized that regional cooperation is essential to prevent cross-border transmission and protect public health, urging solidarity and sustained collaboration to reinforce containment measures across the region.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラ対策を強化する中、マリー・ムトニ公衆衛生局長が地域統一を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴとウガンダでのエボラ流行に対する東アフリカ地域の準備体制強化は、複数国での流行懸念を示す重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴとウガンダでのエボラ流行を背景とした、ケニアを中心とする地域的な準備強化に関するもの。対象国リストではコンゴ（DRC=203312）のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国外だが、記事の主題として重要な流行国として認識されている。ケニアの準備体制強化により、地域的な感染症の高い関心と対応準備が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تعلن تسجيل 321 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization reports 321 confirmed Ebola virus cases in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports 321 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, Bundibugyo ebolavirus, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 116 suspected cases and 41 deaths; six patients have recovered. Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death linked to the same outbreak. This is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in DRC, with Bundibugyo ebolavirus identified in May and later designated by WHO as a public health emergency of international concern. In response, Congolese authorities have reopened Bunia airport, the capital of Ituri region, after weeks of suspension. Air travel will resume gradually with strict health measures, including fever screening before departure and on arrival, hygiene and disinfection protocols, and a ban on travel for anyone with fever symptoms to curb cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴでのエボラウイルス確認患者321例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、死亡例41例を含む重度の公衆衛生危機。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による国際的な感染症集団発生の報告であり、国際保健上の懸念事項に指定されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの9確認患者と1死亡が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要な発生国。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による17番目のエボラアウトブレイクで、WHO による国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事項（PHEIC）として指定されている。

article.articleHeadline: 台湾、空港でエボラ出血熱の無料検査実施　ウガンダなどに渡航歴ある帰国者や旅行者対象 - フォーカス台湾
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan conducts free Ebola virus disease testing at airports, targeting returnees and travelers with travel history to Uganda and other destinations - Focus Taiwan
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's Ministry of Health and Welfare, through the Department of Disease Control, announced free infectious disease testing at airports for asymptomatic returnees or travelers with recent travel history to the Congo (formerly Zaire) or Uganda, in response to Ebola outbreaks in central Africa. The testing runs through June 30. Starting June 2 at 00:00, entry restrictions will suspend residents from Congo and Uganda for 90 days, excluding emergency humanitarian cases—the first border controls since COVID-era measures. At Taoyuan International Airport, and also Taipei Songshan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung airports, travelers with Congo/Uganda travel histories who are asymptomatic will receive a self-health management notice and free tests. Those entering with symptoms will be transported to medical facilities; airport and immigration staff will support expedited processing for medical care where needed.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾、空港でエボラ出血熱の無料検査実施　ウガンダなどに渡航歴ある帰国者や旅行者対象
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。Ebola出現による高度なリスク、かつ台湾による即応的な国境管制措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカでのEbola流行に対応した台湾の能動的スクリーニング措置。2026年6月2日から90日間の入境制限開始と、COVID-19後初の国境管制実施。DRCとウガンダはいずれも対象国外だが、台湾（対象国外だが、WPRO地域の主要関係国）における重大な感染症対応活動であり、シグナル抽出の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: VVerschwörung im Dienste der Forschung? Virologen schmuggeln Mpox-Viren in die USA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Conspiracy in the service of research? Virologists smuggle Mpox viruses into the United States.
article.articleSummary: Two NIH virologists, Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, were indicted in Detroit for smuggling inactivated mpox virus into the United States. After a January field mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, customs at Detroit Metropolitan Airport seized more than 100 ampoules of virally laden material found in their luggage, declared on forms as diagnostic devices and without required import declarations or biosafety permits. The samples were linked to the NIH-affiliated Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, and both scientists reportedly had access to a high-security facility. They face charges including conspiracy and false statements to federal officers; a federal court appearance is scheduled in Missoula, Montana. The case prompts renewed scrutiny of biosafety procedures and international transport rules. Mpox, formerly monkeypox, causes fever and a characteristic rash; since 2022 outbreaks outside Africa have occurred and the virus can spread via close contact, with most infections resolving.

triage.headline_ja: 研究のための陰謀？ウイルス学者がエムポックスウイルスを米国に密輸
triage.triage_reason: エムポックスウイルスの国際的な違法輸送事件であり、生物安全保障上の重大な懸念が生じているが、これは刑事事件であり感染症アウトブレイク事象ではない。DRCでの実際の感染拡大を示す公衆衛生インシデント情報がないため、情報不足の状態にある。
triage.notes: 本事象は実際の感染症アウトブレイク（患者発生）ではなく、ウイルス検体の違法輸送に関わる刑事事件である。DRCは記事に記載されているが、DRCでの現在の感染拡大状況についての具体的な情報はない。米国内での感染症イベント報告はなく、差し押さえられたウイルスは不活化サンプルとされている。生物安全保障上の重大な懸念があるため「WATCH」とし、続報を監視する必要があるが、フルRRAは不要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surpass 300 in Congo as more health zones affected
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpassed 300, with 48 deaths, according to Health Ministry figures cited by Anadolu Agency. The outbreak spreads across 23 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Ituri alone reporting over 260 confirmed cases. Community resistance in Bunia and the northeastern town of Nizi, along with rumors and disinformation, hinder response efforts. Four patients recovered and were discharged from the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus concluded his visit after discussing the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak with President Félix Tshisekedi; a new 60-bed treatment center in Bunia has been opened and vaccine trials are underway. Bunia Airport reopened to facilitate response logistics after monitoring devices were installed at departure and arrival, having been closed except for humanitarian flights. The outbreak was declared on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ症例が300件を超え、より多くの保健地区が影響を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模集団発生で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。フルRRA実施を推奨。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の急速な拡大。症例数300件超、死亡48件、23の保健地区に拡大。Ituri州が最も深刻（260件以上）。コミュニティの抵抗、デマ、虚偽情報が対応を妨害。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、治療センター開設、ワクチン試験開始など国際的対応が展開中。空港再開により流行地区から人的・物的移動増加の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор исключил возможность распространения лихорадки Денге в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor ruled out the possibility of the spread of Dengue fever in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor said it is monitoring dengue fever and that the spread of dengue within the Russian Federation is excluded. The statement followed reports of a Russian woman who became infected after returning from South Africa. The agency, cited by RIA Novosti, declared that the spread of dengue fever on the territory of the Russian Federation is excluded. The update indicates no domestic transmission and frames the case as linked to international travel rather than an outbreak in Russia. Earlier, Russians were warned about the dangers of dengue fever in tropical countries, including Thailand and India. Authorities continue routine surveillance and public health messaging.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾル、ロシアにおけるデング熱の拡大の可能性を排除
triage.triage_reason: ロシア国内でのデング熱の国内伝播は除外されており、海外渡航者の輸入症例に限定される。対象地域（タイ、インド）での流行報告ではなく、ロシア当局による「拡大なし」の公式声明のため、シグナル基準未該当。

article.articleHeadline: Malattia di Chagas spaventa l'America Latina, circa 6 mln convivono con l'infezione parassitaria - CN24TV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease frightens Latin America, about 6 million live with the parasitic infection - CN24TV.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026, Chagas disease, caused by Trypanosoma cruzi, affects about 6 million people in Latin America and is a neglected tropical infection tied to social vulnerability. Transmission is primarily vector-borne by nocturnal Triatominae (kissing bugs); other routes include blood transfusion, organ transplantation, vertical (congenital) transmission, and ingestion of contaminated food or drink. Infections often begin in childhood in rural areas and progress silently; about 30% develop serious cardiac complications—arrhythmias, heart failure, stroke—decades later. Benznidazole and nifurtimox are highly effective when given early, but roughly 70% of people remain unaware of their infection. Infections are most common in Brazil, Argentina, Bolivia, and Venezuela; Bolivia has the highest prevalence, with 80–115 new cases per 100,000 annually. Migration has shifted transmission to urban settings; congenital transmission is rising. Diagnosis is often incidental during blood donor, pregnancy, or transplant screening; prenatal programs are not universal. Oral transmission is rising in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病がラテンアメリカを脅かす、約600万人が寄生虫感染と共生している
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのシャーガス病の負担は確認されるが、記事は主に疾病負担の概要・統計報告であり、新たな流行イベント、急速な拡大、または管理危機を示唆する情報がない。適切な監視が必要だが、緊急のフルRRA実施基準は満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はシャーガス病の風土病的負担を報告するもので、新たな感染症危機イベントではない。ボリビアはGeoNames上の対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。ブラジルのみ対象国として検証された。社会的・政治的関心の程度が不明であるため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, dispuesto a jugar a puerta cerrada el partido prohibido en España por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, willing to play behind closed doors the match banned in Spain due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 3 June 2026, DR Congo's national team faced a bid to play a pre-World Cup friendly against Chile in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, scheduled for 9 June, after the mayor banned the match over Ebola outbreak fears. Coach Sébastien Desabre said the team could play behind closed doors at another venue and would adapt to sanitary decisions; training in Belgium in Liège proceeded normally. Congo were due to also face Denmark in Liège ahead of the World Cup in the United States, Mexico, and Canada (June 11–July 19). In the World Cup group K, Congo is drawn with Colombia, Portugal, and Uzbekistan. The White House suggested the team would need a 21-day Ebola quarantine bubble to enter the United States for the tournament.

article.articleHeadline: Congo World Cup warm-up match in Spain cancelled over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's World Cup warm-up match in Spain (La Línea de la Concepción) against Chile was canceled by the local mayor over Ebola-related health concerns. FECOFA says the team remains compliant with health protocols and discussions with Spain's federation are ongoing to find an alternative warm-up. The cancellation comes as the World Cup starts mid-June, with DR Congo in Group K. It follows a regional Ebola health warning affecting eastern DR Congo and ongoing debates about health protocols for teams traveling to the US-hosted tournament. Local authorities cited precautionary concerns, while FECOFA stressed adherence to guidelines. The situation may prompt venue changes or other European or US warm-up options, with an official statement expected from FECOFA or the Spanish federation. DR Congo last qualified for the World Cup in 1974; organizers are weighing travel and health measures for the group stage.

triage.notes: 記事はDRCの地域的エボラ熱警告に言及しているが、患者数、死亡数、発生規模の詳細が不明。スペイン・チリでの試合キャンセルは国際的な関心と行動制限を示唆するが、エボラ熱発生の深刻度評価には不十分な情報。続報により患者数・重症度が確認されればPICKUPへの格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: قبل مونديال 2026.. إيبولا يتسبب في إلغاء مواجهة دولية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of the 2026 World Cup, Ebola forces the cancellation of an international match.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted the cancellation of a June 9 friendly between DR Congo and Chile in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, due to health and precautionary concerns amid the outbreak. City mayor Juan Franco said safety of residents and fans comes first, leading to the withdrawal of hosting approval. The football federations are seeking a replacement venue if arrangements can be made in the coming days. DR Congo’s World Cup preparations were affected, as they are drawn into Group VIII with Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan. The squad includes Spartak Moscow winger Theo Bongonda, the only Russian Premier League player on the team.

article.articleHeadline: Two Shot Dead After Protests Turn Deadly Over US Ebola Center in Kenya - Business Today Kenya
article.articleSummary: Two people were shot dead by authorities in Nanyuki Town, Laikipia, during protests against plans to establish a 50-bed Ebola isolation facility at Laikipia Air Base (BATUK Barracks) about 8 km from Nanyuki. One victim, 27-year-old Charles Mang'aro Mwangi, died in hospital after being shot near the base around 6 pm local time; his family says he was not involved in the protests. A second man was dead on arrival at the facility. Protests on Monday saw hundreds marching, blocking roads and burning tyres. The Ebola isolation centre would be staffed by American medics to treat U.S. citizens infected in the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Kenya to assist in treating exposed or infected Kenyans; Kenya has reported no Ebola cases. A U.S. official cited proximity to the outbreak and limited regional medevac capacity, noting plans to transport infected Americans to Kenya as needed, including by plane.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの米国エボラセンター計画に対する抗議デモが暴動化、2人が射殺される

triage.notes: 本記事は社会的抗議デモによる死傷事件が主題であり、感染症の実際の発生ではない。DRCのエボラ流行は継続しているとされているが、ケニアでの確認例はないと明記されている。Nanyuki/Laikipiaはケニア領内（対象国リスト外）のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Kiambu leaders react on Ebola quarantine center in Laikipa
article.articleSummary: Kiambu opposition leaders condemn the Kenyan government over an Ebola quarantine center in Laikipia, arguing that the response is carelessly handled; they note the U.S. has advised its citizens not to visit Kenya, particularly Laikipia, where protests against the center have occurred. Former Limuru MP Peter Mwathi blasted the government for pursuing a center with Americans to establish an Ebola center in Kenya, despite his assertion that there is no Ebola in the country; he warned of street protests in June and cited sovereignty. Kikuyu parliamentary aspirant Kigathe Kionywe pressed that public health decisions of this magnitude require national sensitivity, scientific preparedness, and assured safety, criticizing gaps in Kenya's healthcare readiness and the legitimacy of quarantining highly contagious disease facilities without robust home capacity. Jubilee leader Stephen Mwangi urged transparency and public participation, urging the U.S. to respect Kenya's sovereignty and suggesting the Ebola center belong in the Democratic Republic of Congo, not Kenya.

triage.notes: 本記事はケニアの政治的反発と隔離施設建設に関する報道であり、実際の感染症イベント（患者報告、症例確認、アウトブレイク）ではない。記事サマリーで『ケニアに現在エボラは存在しない』と明記されており、感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては該当しない。DRCは記事内で言及されるが、DRC自体でのアウトブレイク報告ではなく、政治家の意見表明に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: Группа китайских медицинских экспертов прибыла в ДРК для оказания помощи в борьбе с эпидемией Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A group of Chinese medical experts arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist in the fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: A group of Chinese medical experts arrived in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on June 2 for a three-month mission to bolster the country's Ebola response. Welcomed by Luk Maleyo Marius of the DRC Ministry of Health, the delegation is described as timely and decisive support. Lead expert Lu Min said the team would begin promptly, cooperating with local health facilities and disease-control agencies to assess the outbreak, treat patients, and strengthen prevention and control efforts, sharing Chinese experience to help curb transmission at an early stage. The Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15 and is the 17th outbreak in the DRC since the virus was first identified in 1976; the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. This international collaboration aims to reinforce containment and medical response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の医学専門家グループがエボラ流行対応を支援するためコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行に対する国際的な公衆衛生対応が報道されており、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的な関心」「異常性」の複数が該当。WHO が PHEIC を宣言済みであり、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「中国」を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーでは中国は支援国であり、エボラの発生地はDRC（具体的にはキンシャサ市）である。verified_locationsはDRCのみを含める。本イベントはWHOが2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済みの17番目のDRCエボラアウトブレーク関連記事。

article.articleHeadline: Cinco Presos Que Recibían Tratamiento contra el Ébola Se Escapan de Centros Sanitarios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five prisoners receiving treatment for Ebola escape from health centers.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, five prisoners suspected of Ebola escaped while receiving medical care in Bunia, in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Two escaped overnight from Bunia General Reference Hospital; the other three fled on Monday from a treatment center in Rwampara, about 10 km from the city. The detainees were not under police guard to avoid potential contagion, prompting fears of community transmission and leading authorities to intensify preventive measures at Bunia’s central prison with support from the International Committee of the Red Cross and other humanitarian groups. Ituri remains the outbreak’s epicenter, which the government reports at 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths nationwide; Ituri alone accounts for 322 cases and 46 deaths. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, with 15 cases and one death, an imported case from DRC. The WHO has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス治療を受けていた受刑者5人が保健施設から逃げる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WHO PEICの宣言、逃亡受刑者による感染拡大の危険性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Vakaları Azalıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases are decreasing.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola strain, is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with a 30-50% mortality range. In the northeast, authorities reported May 26 over 1,000 suspected cases and 121 confirmed; by June 1 suspected 116 and confirmed 321. US CDC confirmed the update, noting many suspected cases were ruled out. WHO spokesperson Christian Lindmeier said symptoms are tracked; negatives are removed, positives confirmed. Some patients are diagnosed with other illnesses, such as malaria presenting with fever, diarrhea, and unexplained bleeding. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Most cases are in the northeast; travel restrictions have been imposed in some countries. Officials aim to limit the outbreak to three provinces, with ongoing isolation and contact tracing. Uganda reports six new cases (total 15), one death, two recoveries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数が減少している

article.articleHeadline: Fiebre chikungunya: se notificaron 160 nuevos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya fever: 160 new cases reported.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Argentina reports 160 new chikungunya cases in epidemiological week 20, following a peak of 430 in week 16. The 2025–2026 season totals 2,547 confirmed and probable cases, with 2,393 autochthonous and 154 travel-associated. About 96% of cases are in the Northwest Region (NOA), led by Salta with 1,329, then Tucumán (661), Santiago del Estero (230), and Jujuy (197). In the Central region, Buenos Aires Province has 46, Córdoba 36, and the City of Buenos Aires 13. Dengue shows no new cases in week 20, totaling 66 since season start, with 59% autochthonous (no travel history) and 41% with travel history to Brazil, Paraguay, Venezuela, Mexico, Colombia, the Dominican Republic, Cuba, Indonesia, Pakistan, the Maldives, and Sri Lanka. Data from the Boletín Epidemiológico Nacional.

article.articleHeadline: Fußball-WM: WM-Testspiel wegen Ebola abgesagt: DR Kongo hofft auf Lösung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA World Cup: World Cup warm-up match canceled due to Ebola: DR Congo hopes for a solution.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda since April prompted cancellation of a World Cup warm-up: DR Congo vs Chile, planned for June 9 in La Linea de la Concepción, Cádiz, Spain. The mayor cited health risks linked to the outbreak, prompting the decision. The Congolese Football Federation says all health, sport, and regulatory protocols will be observed and is negotiating with the Spanish Football Federation and international bodies to find a swift, satisfactory solution, including possible attendance restrictions or a behind-closed-doors arrangement. Chile’s team manager indicated willingness to discuss concession options. Ebola is described as a highly contagious, life-threatening disease transmitted by direct contact with blood or bodily fluids. End-May, USA, Canada, and Mexico had already imposed entry restrictions for people with prior stays in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, reflecting outbreak-related travel controls.

triage.notes: 記事は DRC とウガンダでの 4 月以降のエボラ流行を主要な主題としており、スペイン・カナダ・メキシコでの報道ですが、実際の発生地は DRC です。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に追加していません。複数国での渡航制限（USA、Canada、Mexico）が既に実施されており、国際的影響は顕著です。

article.articleHeadline: مساحات سبورت : الكونغو تتمسك بمواجهة تشيلي في إسبانيا رغم إلغاء المباراة بسبب إيبولا - مساحات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Masahat Sport: The Congo persists in facing Chile in Spain despite the match being canceled due to Ebola - Masahat
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompted the mayor of La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, to cancel a planned friendly against Chile. The decision cited health concerns and documentation gaps proving no risk. The Congolese federation had prepared in Belgium, with most players based in Europe, scheduling a Denmark friendly in Liège and another Spain date before the World Cup. The federation says it remains committed to health, sport, and organizational standards and is negotiating with the Spanish Football Federation to relocate the match within Spain if needed. Congo plans to base in Houston for the World Cup, with Portugal on June 17, and Colombia and Uzbekistan matches on June 23 and 27, under ongoing FIFA medical coordination and health protocols. The World Cup finals are hosted by Canada, Mexico and the United States.

triage.notes: 記事内容はスポーツニュースであり、エボラ発生の公式な流行情報ではない。DRCでの継続中のエボラ流行が存在することは示唆されているが、本記事自体は感染症監視の対象となる疫学的シグナルではなく、スポーツイベント対応の影響を扱っている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC espera jugar el amistoso con Chile en España pese a la cancelación por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC hopes to play the friendly against Chile in Spain despite the cancellation due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo aimed to play a World Cup warm-up against Chile in Spain, but La Línea de la Concepción mayor canceled the match amid concerns about an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The team had been training in Belgium under coach Sébastien Desabre and was due to face Denmark in Liege on Wednesday as part of a two-match prep before flying to the World Cup co-hosted by Canada, Mexico and the United States. FECOFA said the squad was compliant with health, sporting, and regulatory requirements and was in talks with the Spanish Football Federation to find a solution. The Congo will base in Houston for the tournament, starting Group K with Portugal on June 17, then Colombia (June 23) in Guadalajara and Uzbekistan (June 27) in Atlanta. The coach indicated a solution could be found; doctors maintain daily contact with FIFA.

triage.headline_ja: DRCはエボラの懸念にもかかわらずスペインでチリとの親善試合の実施を希望
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はDRC代表チームのワールドカップ準備試合であり、エボラアウトブレイク自体ではない。DRC国内のエボラ発生と試合キャンセル懸念の関連付けは表面的で、実際の流行活動・公衆衛生への深刻な影響は記事に記載されていない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域は記事中に言及されている複数国（スペイン、ベルギー、米国、メキシコ、チリ、カナダなど）を含むが、これらは試合開催予定地またはワールドカップ参加国であり、エボラアウトブレイクの発生地ではない。記事はスポーツイベント関連の報道であり、感染症シグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo kleiner als zunächst befürchtet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Congo smaller than initially feared.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus in parts of the Democratic Republic of the Congo is smaller than feared. As of May 31, 2026, Congo reports 116 suspected and 321 confirmed Ebola cases, with 48 deaths and six recoveries. Neighboring Uganda has nine cases and one death. WHO says the drop in suspected cases reflects extensive testing, with many initially suspected cases found to have other illnesses or only fever. The virus variant is rarer and lacks targeted treatments or approved vaccines, complicating control. In Bunia, eastern Congo, the WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced five recoveries from the rare form; four were discharged today, one yesterday, at a new treatment center. CEPI announced planned acceleration of three experimental vaccines against Bundibugyo virus, investing up to €53 million in a vaccine pipeline involving IAVI, Moderna, and Oxford candidates produced by Serum Institute of India. The three are deemed most promising by WHO.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ流行は当初の予想より小さい
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確認事例、致死的ウイルス、治療法・ワクチン不足により管理可能性に懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（希少変異株）で治療法・ワクチン不足が記載されており、管理困難性が高い。CEPI等による国際的なワクチン開発加速の動きがあり、国際的関心・支援ニーズが明確。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Fünf Verdachtsfälle aus Kliniken in Ituri entkommen - Suche läuft
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: Five Suspected Cases Have Escaped from Clinics in Ituri — Search Underway.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province: five inmates classified as Ebola suspects escaped from two facilities in Bunia between Saturday and Monday. Two fled Bunia Central District Hospital, three from a treatment center in Rwampara, about 10 km southwest of the city. The escape occurred as authorities sought to confine potential cases; no armed guards were posted to avoid further transmission. A search is ongoing for the five. Ebola is a severe viral hemorrhagic disease transmitted by direct contact with blood, body fluids, contaminated objects, or handling of the deceased; it is not airborne. The WHO reports variable mortality, roughly 25–90%, with around half dying on average. Vaccines and targeted drugs are available only for the Zaire strain. Protective measures have been stepped up in Bunia, including chlorine, handwashing stations, and infrared thermometers; MONUSCO plans a transit center, while Caritas trains 25 fellow inmates as hygiene ambassadors. Authorities prioritize locating the escapees and stopping spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ熱: イトゥリ州の診療所から5人の容疑者が逃げた - 捜査中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定/疑い患者5名が隔離施設から逃亡という異常で深刻な公衆衛生事象であり、IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い患者5名の隔離施設からの逃亡は、コミュニティへの直接接触を通じた急速な伝播リスクを大幅に高める。DRC政府の管理能力に対する懸念があり、MONUSCO等の国際機関の関与も言及されている。ワクチンと治療薬の入手可能性に制限がある（Zaire株のみ）ため、管理可能性への悲観的評価が正当化される。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Macedônia mobiliza moradores para grande arrastão contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Macedônia City Hall mobilizes residents for a major anti-dengue sweep.
article.articleSummary: Macedônia City Hall launches a five-day urban cleaning campaign from June 8–12, 2026, to combat dengue in the municipality. Morning activities run 8:00–11:00, focusing on material collection and inspection to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites, the mosquito that transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Active community participation is deemed indispensable, with residents urged to thoroughly inspect yards and properties, remove tall grass and accumulated trash, and properly discard containers that can collect rainwater—plastic bottles, old tires, cans, and empty pots. The effort underscores that small daily precautions inside homes can save lives by preventing dengue and protecting families, aiming to halt new cases in the region.

triage.headline_ja: マケドニア市役所が、デング熱対策の大規模清掃キャンペーンに住民を動員

triage.notes: 記事は定期的な予防キャンペーン（2026年6月8-12日予定）の告知であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。Bluedot APIの地域フィールドにNorth Macedoniaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはブラジルのマケドニア市（Macedônia）における活動を説明しており、これはブラジルの市部名称であり北マケドニアとは無関係。verified_locationsはBrazilのみ。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: a kongói ebolajárvány kisebb a vártnál
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Congolese Ebola outbreak smaller than expected.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 116 suspected and 321 confirmed Ebola cases in the current outbreak as of May 31, with 48 deaths and 6 recoveries. Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. WHO said the drop in suspected cases results from testing, with many individuals ruled out after investigation. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rarer Ebola strain lacking targeted vaccines or therapies. Key challenges include early detection, rapid isolation, strict contact tracing, safe burials, and strengthening infection prevention in health facilities. Five patients have recovered, with four discharged and one released recently in Bunia, where a new Ebola treatment center opened. CEPI is fast-tracking three Bundibugyo vaccine candidates, pledging up to €53 million; IAVI, Moderna, and Oxford University programs are to be manufactured by Serum Institute of India, as among the most promising options.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ流行は予想より小規模
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は極めて高リスク疾患であり、複数国での確認事例、死亡例、および進行中の治療開発と国際支援体制が機能している状況はフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC（ブニア地域）およびウガンダでの確認事例が主述されている。発生地域にインドが含まれているが、サマリーではインドはワクチン製造パートナー（Serum Institute of India）として言及されるのみで、エボラ発生地ではない。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。Bundibugyo株は希少なエボラ亜型で、ワクチンや治療薬が限定的であり、国際的支援（CEPI、IAVI、Moderna、Oxford）が既に動員されている点から、優先度の高いシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Hanya Jaga Kamtibmas, Bhabinkamtibmas Polresta Solo Kini Jadi Tracer TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not only safeguarding public order and safety, Solo City Police's Bhabinkamtibmas are now TB tracers.
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) tracing is underway in Surakarta City, Indonesia. Bhabinkamtibmas from Pajang Village, Laweyan District, Polresta Solo, Aiptu Slamet Widodo, together with Puskesmas Laweyan staff and local TB tracer Cadres, trace residents suspected or confirmed with Pulmonary TB to prevent community transmission. For coughs lasting more than two weeks, initial screening uses a tracing kit; symptomatic individuals have sputum samples collected and sent to the Puskesmas for laboratory testing to determine TB exposure. The effort combines education and persuasion to encourage testing and adherence to treatment when TB is diagnosed. Plt. Kasat Binmas AKP Broto Tri Yulianto emphasizes this police-health collaboration supports the national TB elimination program. Tracers are equipped with public-communication training, the TB Tracer Pocket Book, and tracing kits, working with health workers to ensure targeted, effective tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 公共の秩序維持だけでなく、ソロ市警察のバビンカムティブマスが今やTB(結核)トレーサーとなった
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）での結核トレーシング活動の報道。公衆衛生対応としては標準的な接触追跡であり、新規の異常事象や危機的状況は明示されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア（スラカルタ市、ジャワ中部州）での日常的な結核接触追跡活動を報じている。警察と保健当局の協力による国家TB排除プログラムの一環。死亡や重症化の報告、異常な感染拡大の兆候は記載されていない。WPROスクリーニングでは長期曝露と流行リスクの基準に該当するが、社会的・政治的関心の具体的な高まりが不明であり、フルRRAに進むまでには至らない。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ: Kongo'daki Ebola salgını ilk korkulandan çok daha küçük
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in Congo is much smaller than initially feared.
article.articleSummary: WHO says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is much smaller than initially feared. As of May 31, DR Congo reports 116 suspected and 321 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, with 48 deaths and 6 recoveries; neighboring Uganda records 9 cases and 1 death. The active strain is Bundibugyo virus, a rarer Ebola lineage with few targeted vaccines or therapies, complicating response. The DRC Health Ministry cites challenges including early case detection, rapid isolation, strict contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and strong infection control in health facilities. Five patients in Bunia, in the eastern city, have recovered as a new Ebola treatment center opens there. CEPI will accelerate development of three experimental vaccines targeting Bundibugyo, committing up to €53 million, with candidates from IAVI, Moderna, and Oxford, produced by the Serum Institute of India; WHO regards these as the most promising options.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行は当初の懸念よりもはるかに小規模

triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）での発生が主題であり、ウガンダの症例も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。インドはワクチン製造国として言及されているが、感染症イベント発生国ではないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀なエボラ株系統）の確認、ワクチン・治療法の限定性、複数国での死亡者あり、国際的な対応が進行中（CEPI による€53百万の投資）など、重大な懸念要素が多数存在。

article.articleHeadline: سازمان جهانی بهداشت: شیوع ابولا در کنگو کمتر از حد انتظار

article.articleHeadline: OMS: la epidemia de ébola en Congo es menor de lo temido

CEPI will invest up to €53 million to accelerate three vaccine candidates (IAVI, Moderna, Oxford), to be produced at Serum Institute of India, targeting Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は当初の懸念より少ない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、予想外の展開）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の確認された複数国での発生、死亡例、および国際的なワクチン開発投資（CEPI €53百万）が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC内のBunia市での発生、ウガンダでの9症例・1死亡を記述。Bluedot APIがIndiaを含めているのは、記事でセラム研究所インド（ワクチン製造委託先）が言及されているため推定されるが、インドでの感染症イベント発生ではないため除外。DRCでの確認感染者321例、死亡48例、回復6例；ウガンダは対象国リストに非含有。最近の新規治療センター開設とワクチン候補加速化により、CEPI投資決定は国際的関心・管理体制構築が進行中であることを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Конго меньше, чем опасались, заявили в ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo smaller than feared, WHO says.
article.articleSummary: WHO confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo 116 suspected and 321 confirmed Ebola cases as of May 31, lower than earlier estimates. There have been 48 deaths and 6 recoveries. In neighboring Uganda, nine cases and one death are reported. Spokesperson Christian Lindmeier said the drop reflects expanded testing, eliminating suspicions where patients had other diseases or only fever. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rarer Ebola strain with no targeted treatments or vaccines yet. Congo’s Health Ministry cites challenges in a remote region, including early detection, rapid isolation, thorough contact tracing, safe burials, and strong infection-control in facilities. Five patients have recovered — four discharged today and one yesterday — from a new treatment center in Bunia, east Congo. CEPI is accelerating development of three experimental vaccines, pledging up to €53 million with IAVI, Moderna, and Oxford, to be produced by Serum Institute of India.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生規模、当初の懸念より小さい：WHO発表（コンゴ民主共和国）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外な減少報告、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認例があり、複数国に影響。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus株）の発生を主題としている。ウガンダでの事例も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO公式発表、治療法・ワクチン未開発のまれなウイルス株、国際的ワクチン開発プログラム進行中。この見直し報告自体が異常/予想外な情報としてシグナル価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: NIH Researchers Charged With Smuggling Viral Pathogens Into United States
article.articleSummary: NIH researchers Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, both with the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases and working at a high-level NIH lab in Montana, were charged on June 2 for allegedly smuggling viral pathogens into the United States and lying to investigators. They traveled in January from Congo, where there was a monkeypox outbreak, and landed at Detroit, Michigan. The charges allege they transported viral pathogens and provided false statements to prosecutors. The case underscores biosafety and import-control concerns within U.S. research facilities. The article identifies the two individuals, their NIH affiliation, and the Montana laboratory location, with prosecutors publicly announcing the charges on 2026-06-02.

triage.headline_ja: NIH研究者がウイルス性病原体を米国に密輸した容疑で起訴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスク2項目該当。さらにWPRO基準で異常性・流行可能性・管理可能性が該当。米国のNIH施設でのバイオセーフティ侵害事件は公衆衛生上の重大な関心事であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴのサルポックス流行地域から米国へのウイルス病原体密輸事件を報じている。発生地域にはMontana、Detroit、Michiganが含まれるが、いずれも対象国（CEPR評価対象国）に該当しないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。バイオセーフティ侵害と国際的な病原体移動は感染症危機管理上の重大な懸念であり、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当に加えて社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: 'If Ebola comes, we'll be wiped out': fear grips camps in DRC
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia in Ituri province as the outbreak epicentre. As of May 31, 2026, the World Health Organization reported 321 confirmed DR Congo cases and 48 deaths, and nine confirmed cases in Uganda with one death; the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Kingonze displaced persons camp near Bunia, housing more than 25,000 people, faces high transmission risk from overcrowding, poor hygiene, and severely limited water access (a single borehole, only a few hours of daily supply) along with a lack of protective gear. No vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; containment relies on protective measures and rapid contact tracing. No infections have yet been recorded at Kingonze, but authorities warn of potential spread and urge international aid, equipment, and specialist staff to avert disaster amid ongoing conflict and displacement. The airport serving humanitarian actors reopened as suspected cases declined.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラが来たら、われわれは壊滅する」：DRCの難民キャンプに恐怖が広がる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。ブンディブギョエボラの確認症例321例・死亡48例、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、予防接種・治療法なし、難民キャンプでの大規模感染リスク。フルRRA実施必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラ株による活発な感染拡大。5月31日時点でDRC321例確認、ウガンダでの国際的拡大を確認。ワクチン・治療法が存在しない。25,000人以上を収容する難民キャンプでの爆発的感染リスク極めて高い。国際支援と専門家派遣が緊急に必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: El ECDC avisa: los brotes de ébola y hantavirus ponen prueba el sistema de seguridad sanitaria de Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The ECDC warns: Ebola and hantavirus outbreaks test Europe’s health security system.
article.articleSummary: EU health security is under scrutiny as the ECDC reports Ebola outbreaks in Central Africa and hantavirus cases on a cruise testing Europe’s readiness. Ebola has 332 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda with 49 deaths and 160 suspected cases; no EU cases so far, and the risk to Europe remains very low but is of high concern due to instability in affected regions, surveillance and diagnostic challenges, and the absence of a vaccine or treatment. The ECDC deployed experts to Addis Ababa and relies on the EU Health Task Force and EU reference laboratories to coordinate response. The hantavirus incident led to coordinated support for Tenerife, with Spain and the Netherlands involved. Officials advocate better preparation with more funding, real-time surveillance, cross-border coordination, One Health integration, and AI tools to reinforce outbreak response, including rapid detection at entry and strengthened exit controls at airports. Projections warn of 80,000 new HIV infections and 9,000 TB deaths in three years if no action is taken, and propose a European network of 15–20 hospitals and mandatory cross-border drills.

triage.headline_ja: ECDC警告：エボラとハンタウイルスの流行がヨーロッパの保健安全保障システムを試す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数の重篤な感染症（エボラ、ハンタウイルス）がアフリカで流行し、ヨーロッパへの波及リスクが指摘されており、公的・国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン（カナリア諸島のハンタウイルス）とヨーロッパの対応について述べているが、対象国リストではスペインは含まれない。DRCでのエボラ流行が記事の主題であり、対象国はDRCのみ。エチオピア（アジス・アベバでのECDC活動）とウガンダも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: World Cup team's plans thrown into chaos after match cancelled over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's World Cup preparations were disrupted when a planned June 9 friendly against Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain, was canceled after health officials warned of Ebola risks linked to an outbreak in eastern DR Congo involving the Bundibugyo strain. Officials described the decision as precautionary; none of the players have recently traveled to affected areas. The squad, largely overseas and including Aaron Wan-Bissaka, Noah Sadiki and Yoane Wissa, had abandoned a Kinshasa training camp and is based in Belgium. Despite the cancellation, DR Congo are set to face Denmark in Liege this week and must maintain strict camp protocols ahead of travel to North America. The United States has announced travel restrictions for non-Americans who recently visited DR Congo, Uganda or South Sudan, but participation is not expected to be affected. DR Congo qualified for the World Cup for the first time since 1974 and will base in Houston, in Group K with Portugal, Colombia and Uzbekistan, opening against Portugal on June 17.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖症後、ワールドカップチームの計画が混乱に陥る（試合キャンセル）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限のリスク）。エボラの確認された発生地DRC、国際的な影響（ワールドカップ参加国の試合キャンセル、米国の渡航制限）、対象国DRCで実際の発生が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した地域にはスペイン、ベルギー、アメリカ、ウガンダ、スーダンなど複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題イベント（エボラ発生）はDRC東部で確認されており、その他の地域への感染報告はない。スペイン・ベルギーは試合キャンセルの影響を受けた国だが、エボラ発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: OMS révise fortement le bilan d'Ebola en RDC: 116 cas contre plus de 1 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO significantly revises the Ebola case tally in the DRC: 116 cases versus more than 1,000.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be smaller than feared, with 116 suspected and 321 confirmed cases, and 48 deaths and 6 recoveries. The neighboring Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. The discrepancy between suspected and confirmed counts stems from testing, with most patients negative or suffering from other illnesses or fever alone. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola, a rarer virus variant, complicating response due to lack of targeted vaccines or treatments. Containment challenges include early detection, rapid isolation, rigorous contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and strengthened infection prevention in health facilities. Five patients have recovered from this rare form; four will be discharged today and one yesterday, as a new Ebola treatment center opens in Bunia. CEPI will accelerate three Bundibugyo vaccines, investing up to €53 million in candidates from IAVI, Moderna, and Oxford, produced by Serum Institute of India.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱患者数を大幅に修正: 1,000人以上から116人に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の国際的拡大（DRC＆ウガンダ）、重症度（死亡48例）、予想外の症例数修正により、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでのエボラ熱outbreak（Bundibugyo型）は確認され、WHOによる患者数大幅修正、国境を越えた症例（ウガンダ9例）、希少ウイルス亜型による対応困難性、ワクチン開発加速など、複数の重大要素を含む。

article.articleHeadline: WHO smanjio procjenu broja slučajeva ebole u Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reduced the estimated number of Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo strain, may be smaller than initial estimates. As of 31 May, Congo reported 116 suspected and 321 confirmed cases, with 48 deaths and 6 recoveries; neighboring Uganda recorded 9 cases and 1 death. The drop in suspected cases follows confirmatory testing showing many illnesses were due to other diseases or fever alone. Bundibugyo Ebola is a rarer strain with no targeted therapies or vaccines. Key response challenges include early detection, rapid case isolation, comprehensive contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and strengthened infection prevention in health facilities. Five patients have recovered; four will be discharged today and one yesterday, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who opened a new treatment center in Bunia. CEPI plans up to €53 million to accelerate three vaccine candidates—developed by IAVI, Moderna, and Oxford University—produced at Serum Institute of India.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ症例数推定値を引き下げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な多国発生であり、死亡例を伴う確定症例が報告されている。IHR基準の複数項目に該当し、WHOが積極的に対応している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに記載されたBundibugyo Ebola outbreak はDRCおよびウガンダで発生。DRCは対象国リスト内で confirmed cases 321件、deaths 48件の深刻な状況。インドは記事内でセラム研究所がワクチン製造拠点として言及されているのみであり、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。発生地域フィールドの Indiaは Bluedot の誤分類。IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準5項目全て該当、WHOおよび国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲爆伊波拉疫情　19抵港旅客曾訪疫區　無發現感染個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa; 19 travellers arriving in Hong Kong had previously visited affected areas; no infections detected.
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, Hong Kong reported no Ebola infections among 19 travellers who had recently visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda during the May 17–24 outbreak window. The Centre for Health Protection conducted health assessments on all travellers and found no suspected Ebola cases. Travellers were provided health information and advised that if symptoms develop within 21 days of arrival, they should report to the centre and seek medical care; authorities will monitor them. Any suspected or confirmed cases would be transferred to the Hospital Authority Infectious Disease Centre at Princess Margaret Hospital for isolation and treatment, with clinical samples sent to the Public Health Laboratory Service for testing, and would be reported to the Department of Health. Ebola spreads via close contact with infected animals or people through blood, secretions, organs, or other bodily fluids. Previous global case fatality rates range 25–90%, averaging about 50%.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱の流行　香港に到着した旅客19名が流行地域を訪問　感染例は検出されず
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で高リスク疾患だが、当該記事は香港での検出ケースが「ゼロ」であり、報告は監視対象旅客の健康評価に限定されている。DRC/ウガンダでの流行そのものの詳細（規模、死亡数、新規患者数など）は記事から不明であり、完全なリスク評価のための情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）でのエボラ流行を背景に、香港の輸入リスク監視体制と旅客対応の現況を報告しているが、DRC/ウガンダでの流行そのものの規模（患者数、死亡数）や新規発生状況は記事から読み取れない。Hong Kong（発生地域に含まれる）は中国領域として verified_locations に China を含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。フルRRAに進む前に、DRC/ウガンダでの流行ダイナミクス（新規患者の傾向、死亡数、地理的拡大）に関する続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Misereor kämpft im Ostkongo gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Misereor fights in eastern Congo against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is unfolding in a conflict-affected zone. Attacks on hospitals, fear of medical interventions, and restricted access for aid workers have severely hampered response, leaving health systems collapsed in many areas. Misereor, the Aachen-based aid organization, warns that insecurity and disrupted health infrastructure threaten containment. It calls on the German government and the European Union to increase political pressure on the conflict parties to protect healthcare facilities and ensure aid access. On the ground, Misereor and local partner organizations are intensifying measures against the epidemic and rely on donations to sustain their work. The report centers on operational challenges rather than reporting case or death counts, and it does not detail any imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ミセレオルが東コンゴでエボラに対抗
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。DRCでの確認されたエボラ流行であり、対象国に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東コンゴのエボラ流行に焦点を当てており、紛争地域での医療施設への攻撃、医療介入への恐怖、援助労働者へのアクセス制限により対応が著しく妨げられている状況を示している。ドイツのアーヘンを本拠地とするミセレオルがこの情報源であるが、実際の流行地はDRCである。具体的な症例数や死亡数は記載されていないが、保健システムの崩壊が複数地域で報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mengapa Wabah Ebola Kacaukan Persiapan Historis RD Kongo di Piala Dunia?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why did the Ebola outbreak disrupt the Democratic Republic of the Congo's historic World Cup preparations?
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-03, an Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted safety concerns that disrupted the Les Leopards' World Cup preparations. DR Congo's national team, the Leopards, who qualified for the finals for the first time since 1974 (as Zaire), had a crucial warm-up against Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain canceled by mayor Juan Franco following Andalusia health authorities' recommendations. The decision underscores health risks despite players undergoing strict international travel screening. Earlier, DR Congo moved its training base to Belgium to avoid the outbreak's epicenter since mid-May and faced stiff immigration rules in host nations, notably the United States. The cancellation robs the team of a key competitive test before the tournament.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国のワールドカップ歴史的準備を混乱させた理由
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラウイルス流行により、国際的な懸念（各国での入国制限、試合キャンセル）が生じており、IHR基準3項目該当およびWPRO基準複数項目該当。国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ流行が主題。スペイン・ベルギー・米国は外国での対応・制限が記載されているが、疾患イベントの主要発生地はDRCのみ。エボラは既知の流行疾患だが、現在進行中のアウトブレイクが国際的なスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）に影響を及ぼしており、公衆衛生上の重要性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Hollandalı bilim insanları, virüs taşıyan 113 tüple yakalandı! İçinden çıkanlar endişe yarattı - ensonhaber.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dutch scientists were caught with 113 virus-carrying tubes! What came out of them raised concerns.
article.articleSummary: On June 3, 2026, Dutch virologist Vincent Munster and Cameroonian researcher Claude Kwe were detained at Detroit Metropolitan Airport after returning from the Republic of the Congo mpox outbreak. A black case carried 113 vials described as biological samples and diagnostic materials; investigators later found some contained inactivated monkeypox (mpox) virus, varicella-zoster (chickenpox) virus, and human DNA. FBI analysis of 20 vials identified 17 as containing inactivated mpox virus. The researchers, affiliated with Rocky Mountain Laboratory and the U.S. National Institutes of Health (NIH), face scrutiny for allegedly smuggling viral pathogens out of the Republic of the Congo on a commercial flight, breaching U.S. law, according to U.S. Attorney Jerome F. Gorgon Jr. The incident highlights biosafety and biosecurity concerns surrounding handling of outbreak-related specimens.

triage.headline_ja: オランダの科学者がウイルス運搬管113本で逮捕！その中身が懸念を生じさせた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク3項目に該当。Mpoxを含む生物サンプルの国境越え輸送とバイオセキュリティ侵害は、公衆衛生上深刻な懸念であり、フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ共和国でのMpoxアウトブレーク関連サンプルの違法な国境越え輸送であり、DRC のみが verified_locations として該当。米国（デトロイト）はインシデント現場だが、実際の感染症発生地ではなく、オランダはサマリーにバイオセキュリティ研究機関の所属地として言及されるのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。バイオセキュリティ侵害、Mpox Clade I/II、複数ウイルスの関与により緊急性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya oo Dowladda ku Amartay inay Shaaciso Faahfaahinta Xarun Karantiil oo Ebola ah
article.articleSummary: On 3 June 2026, Kenya’s Supreme Court ordered the government to publicly disclose details of a controversial Ebola quarantine and treatment facility project reportedly backed by the United States. The court also halted construction of any Ebola center in Kenya and barred entry of people suspected of exposure until the case is heard. Health Minister Adan Ducaale must publish all documents related to the project, including the foundation agreement, health and safety assessments, legal approvals, and operating procedures. The Katiba Institute human rights group filed the suit, alleging inadequate public consultation and disclosure. The proposed 50-bed center at the Laikipia Air Base drew protests in Nanyuki, where two people died in clashes. US officials say the facility would mainly serve Americans who may have encountered Ebola while asymptomatic. President Ruto defended the plan as preparedness amid Bundibugyo Ebola activity in Uganda and the DRC, highlighting Kenya-US health cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア最高裁、米国が支援するエボラ隔離・治療施設プロジェクトの詳細公開を政府に命令
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は国際的に高い関心を持つ疾患であり、DRC・ウガンダでの活動が既に確認されている中での新たな施設計画は国際的拡大リスクと評価される。ケニアでの司法判断を伴う社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にはケニア・ウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーを精読すると、実際のエボラウイルス活動（確認例）はDRCとウガンダに限定されている。ケニアでは施設計画段階であり、すでに症例が発生している国ではない。対象国リストではウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。米国は対象国外のため除外。ただしDRCでの活動がある点で国際的シグナルとして PICKUP と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Чемпионат мира-2026 - матч сборной ДР Конго отменили из-за угрозы вируса Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026 - DR Congo national team's match canceled due to the Ebola virus threat.
article.articleSummary: Friendly match between the Democratic Republic of Congo and Chile, planned for June 9 in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, was canceled due to Ebola outbreak concerns in DR Congo. Mayor Juan Franco canceled the game after consultations with regional medical services, stating the documents did not fully confirm health safety for residents. DR Congo’s football federation says the team complies with medical and regulatory requirements; the squad has been training in Belgium, with most players and staff residing in Europe and little recent travel to the homeland. Negotiations are underway with the Spanish federation and local authorities to relocate the match to another venue. Separately, Ebola outbreak fears prompted questions about World Cup attendance; DR Congo is set to compete in Group K with Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan at the 2026 tournament.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ2026 - エボラウイルスの脅威によるコンゴ民主共和国代表チームの試合キャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR報告対象疾患であり、DRCでの発生が言及されているが、本記事の主題はサッカーの国際試合キャンセルであり、感染症の流行状況や公衆衛生への具体的影響が不明確である。続報によるエボラの発生規模・地理的拡大の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる内容はスポーツイベントのキャンセルであり、DRCにおけるエボラ発生の具体的な患者数、重症度、感染経路、地域的拡大状況など公衆衛生学的詳細が明記されていない。DRCの代表チームは主にベルギーで訓練中で、ヨーロッパ在住選手が多く、本国への最近の渡航歴も少ないとされている。スペイン（La Línea de la Concepción）でのエボラ発生は言及されていない。DRCのエボラ発生に関する詳細情報と国際的な公衆衛生上の影響について、より具体的な続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: USAID cuts have a hand in Ebola outbreak overseas
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is the third largest in recorded history, with over 900 suspected cases in Congo as of late May. The circulating strain has no vaccine or targeted treatment. The response capability has been eroded by funding cuts: USAID foreign aid to the Congo reached about $1.2 billion in 2024 but collapsed to $67 million in the final three months of 2025, representing 0.3% of the federal budget versus 13% for the DoD. Returning responders and established local partnerships were dismissed when USAID was dismantled, described as the 'glue' coordinating health officials, NGOs and donors, with the backbone workforce eroded. A Barcelona Institute for Global Health projection warns global aid cuts could cause at least 9.4 million excess deaths by 2030, including 2.5 million children under 5; 760,000 deaths had already occurred by January due to these cuts.

triage.headline_ja: 海外でのエボラ感染症の流行拡大にUSAIDの削減が関係
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。コンゴとウガンダでのエボラ感染症の大流行（900例以上）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響あり、国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により異常で予想外な状況。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行可能性・管理能力の課題が確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはスペイン（バルセロナ）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴとウガンダでの感染症流行が主題であり、スペインでの実際の患者発生は記載されていないため除外した。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。資金削減による対応能力の低下が重大な懸念要因として記述されており、RRA（詳細リスク評価）が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Çinli Uzman Ekip, Ebola ile Mücadeleye Destek İçin Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'ne Ulaştı
