article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A team of Chinese experts arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts international assistance as a Chinese medical team arrives in Kinshasa for a three-month mission. The DR Congo confirmed its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, and the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later. The Chinese team, led by Lu Ming, will collaborate with local health authorities on outbreak assessment, case management, and related activities to boost prevention, control, and treatment capacities and hasten containment. The team will be supported by a five-expert contingent from China's National Health Commission. In Kinshasa, Luku Maleyo Marius, a Ministry of Health representative, welcomed the arrival, highlighting that China's contribution aims to protect people's safety and health by sharing expertise and adapting practical experience to local conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の専門家チームがエボラ対策支援のためコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な影響、異常な状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的な保健上の懸念事項の緊急事態を宣言しており、シグナルの優先度が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にChinaを含めているが、これは支援チームの出身国であり、エボラの実際の発生地はDRCのKinshasa市である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。記事では17番目のエボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日確認）、WHO宣言（5月17日）、中国からの支援医療団派遣など、すべての情報が明確に述べられており、高優先度のシグナルと判定される。

article.articleHeadline: C'è anche il Castelli tra i presidi sanitari di riferimento per i casi sospetti di Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Castelli is also among the reference health facilities for suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Six reference hospitals in Piedmont are designated for suspected Ebola cases, with a total of 157 tertiary-level beds. Following the May 29 Ministry of Health circular, Turin hosts Giovanni Bosco Hospital and Regina Margherita Children's Hospital as the main reference points, while Novara, Vercelli, Verbania, and Asti will host the other facilities. Verbania Hospital is among the selected centers. The region has also published a health portal section for residents arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda to provide information and guidance. The measure aims to bolster preventive measures for suspected infections and ensure regional readiness. Publication date: 2026-06-03.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い症例対応に向けピエモンテ州6つの基幹病院が指定される、カステッリ病院も対象に
triage.triage_reason: イタリアのピエモンテ州がエボラ疑い症例対応の準備体制を整備した報道だが、記事は実際の症例発生ではなく予防的準備措置であり、DRC・ウガンダ発症地での疫学的状況変化の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリアでの予防的措置（病院指定、住民向けポータル）であり、実際のエボラ症例発生の報道ではない。参考地域としてDRCとウガンダが言及されているが、記事サマリーからは両国での現在の流行状況の詳細が不明。対象国のうちDRCのみ verified_locations に含める。DRC発のシグナル情報については別途確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: l'épidémie d'Ebola bien moins grave que prévu, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the Ebola outbreak is far less severe than expected, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreaks involve 116 suspected and 321 confirmed cases, with 48 deaths and 6 recoveries; neighboring Uganda reported 9 cases and 1 death. The World Health Organization says the apparent drop reflects extensive testing, with many suspected cases later testing negative; many patients likely have other illnesses or fever alone. The outbreak is driven by a less common Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, complicating response due to lack of targeted vaccines or treatments. Main containment challenges include early detection, rapid isolation, thorough contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and reinforced infection prevention in health facilities. Five patients have recovered; four were discharged today and one yesterday in Bunia, site of a new Ebola treatment center. CEPI plans emergency funding up to €53 million to advance three vaccine candidates (IAVI, Moderna, Oxford) produced by Serum Institute of India.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行は予想より遙かに軽微、WHO発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準で複数項目該当。エボラウイルスの確認例・死亡者があり、複数国に拡大している重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生を主題としており、隣国ウガンダでの事例も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。インドは発生地域に含まれているがサマリー上の主題は CEPI による SERUM INSTITUTE OF INDIA への ワクチン開発資金配分であり、インド国内でのエボラ発生ではないため除外した。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: مونديال 2026 في مرمى حرب الفيروسات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026 in the crosshairs of the war against viruses.
article.articleSummary: World Cup 2026 in the United States, Canada, and Mexico (June 11–July 19, 2026), with 48 teams competing for the first time, faces intensified health concerns as warnings of hantavirus, Ebola, and measles outbreaks surface in participating or host nations. Authorities contemplate stricter screening and quarantine for arrivals from outbreak areas, including players from the Democratic Republic of Congo, amid fears of measles spread in some U.S. cities and a hantavirus-linked Dutch cruise ship incident. The piece traces a centuries-spanning pattern: from the 1919 Stanley Cup influenza cancelation to polio fears before the 1958 Sweden World Cup; SARS in 2003 shifting Women’s World Cup to the United States; avian influenza in Asia during the 2004 Asian Cup; rigorous health checks for 2006 Asian Games in Qatar; 2009 Mexico league games behind closed doors; Ebola fears in Africa for AFCON 2015; MERS in Korea 2015; Zika before Rio 2016; and the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020 that halted sports globally. The article argues preparations for 2026 must match its scale.

triage.headline_ja: 2026ワールドカップ：ウイルス戦争の標的
triage.triage_reason: 複数の疾患（ハンタウイルス、エボラ、麻疹、インフルエンザなど）が列挙されているが、記事は主に過去の事例と2026WC開催における仮想的な健康懸念の総括であり、現在の具体的な感染症アウトブレイク情報に乏しい。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は2026ワールドカップに関連する仮想的な感染症リスクについての論説であり、DRC（麻疹言及）とブラジル（過去のジカ熱2016の記述あり）が対象国内で言及されているが、現在進行中の具体的なアウトブレイクの詳細情報は記事サマリーに含まれていない。複数の歴史的事例の羅列となっており、シグナルトリアージの段階では評価対象となる現在のイベント情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông tử vong sau 5 tháng bị chó nhà cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man dies five months after being bitten by the family dog.
article.articleSummary: On June 3, 2026, in Bạch Hà Commune, Đô Lương District, Nghệ An Province, Vietnam, a man (N.V.V., born 1957) died from rabies suspected to be caused by a canine bite about five months earlier. The family dog bit him and died five days later; the man did not seek medical care or receive post-exposure vaccination, instead using traditional remedies. About five months later he developed rabies symptoms—vomiting, hydrophobia, irritability—and was hospitalized. He died the morning of June 3, 2026, despite transfer to higher-level care. Local health authorities and the Do Luong Center of Health, in coordination with Bạch Hà authorities, conducted risk assessments and intensified rabies prevention measures. The health ministry urges proper wound cleaning with soap and water and prompt vaccination, including rabies vaccine and immunoglobulin. Rabies remains nearly 100% fatal once symptoms appear but is preventable with timely prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が飼い犬に噛まれてから5ヶ月後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響：死亡事例、異常性：予防可能な感染症での致命的転帰、国際的拡大リスク：狂犬病の潜在的伝播）。WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は約100%の致死率を示す。本事例は予防接種の不実施と伝統的治療への依存が直接的な死亡原因。ベトナム当局が追加対策を実施。狂犬病は国境を超えた動物からのヒト感染リスク。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: Fiebre chikungunya: se notificaron 160 nuevos casos en el país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya fever: 160 new cases were reported in the country.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya fever: Argentina reported 160 new cases in epidemiological week 20, following a peak of 430 in week 16, with a progressive decline in confirmed, probable, and cases under investigation. For the 2025-2026 season, the accumulated total reaches 2,547 confirmed or probable cases, of which 2,393 are autochthonous and 154 have travel history. About 96% of cases are in Northwest Argentina (NOA), led by Salta with 1,329, Tucumán 661, Santiago del Estero 230, and Jujuy 197; in the Central region, Buenos Aires Province has 46, Córdoba 36, and the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires 13. Dengue records no new infections in week 20, remaining at 66 confirmed since the start of the season; 59% have no travel history, while 41% report travel to Brazil, Paraguay, Venezuela, Mexico, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Cuba, Indonesia, Pakistan, the Maldives, and Sri Lanka. BEN report dated 2026-06-03.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱：国内で160の新規感染が報告される
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱とデングの同時流行でIHR基準3つ以上該当。アルゼンチン北西部で主に流行し、2,500例以上の累積症例があり、ヒト-ヒト感染が可能な媒介蚊による拡大が継続している。地域内での著しい地理的拡大と他国への輸入症例が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な発生地はアルゼンチン（対象国外）であるため、verified_locationsはアルゼンチン国内での流行に関連する輸入感染症報告の記述から、デング患者の渡航先として記載されたBrazilとIndonesiaを含める。Pakistanなどは対象国外であるため除外。アルゼンチンでの流行自体は対象国外であるが、地域内での国際的拡大とブラジルなど近隣国への輸出リスクが示唆されており、PICKUP判定の根拠としている。

article.articleHeadline: Febre amarela: São Paulo registra décimo caso e seis mortes pela doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow Fever: São Paulo records its tenth case and six deaths from the disease.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever in São Paulo state: on Monday, June 1, the Secretaria de Estado da Saúde confirmed ten notified cases and six deaths, all in men aged 38–64; none had vaccination history. The fatal case: a 54-year-old man from Lençóis Paulista in the Bauru region. This year, eight cases in the Vale do Paraíba with five deaths, and one case in Sorocaba survived. Vaccination is the principal prevention and is free at basic health units; those traveling to rural areas or regions with virus circulation should vaccinate ten days before travel. Since 2019, vaccination is indicated for the entire São Paulo population. A first non-human primate case was detected in Santo André (ABC Paulista) at the end of last month. Monkeys do not transmit to humans but indicate transmission risk; primates serve as sentinels. Authorities intensify vigilance and vaccination; unvaccinated people should update their vaccination status.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病：サンパウロ州で10例目と6人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのサンパウロ州で黄熱病の10例と6人の死亡が確認されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常/予想外」に該当。また、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度（死亡多数）」「流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染リスク）」に該当し、シグナル識別の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのサンパウロ州での黄熱病発生を主題としている。6人の死亡と10例の確認は深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す。動物（非人間霊長類）での検出も報告され、環境での病原体循環を示唆している。ワクチン接種の推奨が強調されているが、未接種集団に対する管理可能性の課題が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: WM-Testspiel des Kongo in Spanien abgesagt - Verband protestiert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Congo's World Cup warm-up match in Spain canceled - federation protests.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts cancellation of a World Cup warm-up match in Spain between DR Congo and Chile, scheduled for June 9 in La Línea de la Concepción, Cádiz. The DR Congo Football Federation protests, saying all health, sporting, and regulatory requirements were met and international protocols followed; talks ongoing with the Spanish federation and international bodies, with a compromise proposal to play behind closed doors. Chile’s manager indicated willingness to proceed without spectators if needed. The Ebola outbreak began in April in Congo and neighboring Uganda; Ebola is highly contagious and transmitted via contact with blood or body fluids. In response to the epidemic, the United States, Canada, and Mexico have begun travel restrictions for travelers who recently visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan. Ongoing discussions aim to reschedule under safer conditions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生：コンゴのワールドカップ準備試合がスペインで中止 - 連盟が抗議
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大（DRC、ウガンダで発生し、北米での渡航制限開始）、国際スポーツイベントへの影響、高い重症度と感染性が確認される。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ出血熱発生を主題としているが、対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。スペイン、チリ、ウガンダ、スーダン、米国、カナダ、メキシコは対象外。発生地域フィールドに多くの非対象国が含まれているが、実際の感染イベントはDRCで確認されている。国際的な渡航制限と高い感染性・重症度のため、全方向でのリスク評価が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo meno grave del previsto, secondo l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo less severe than expected, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows 116 suspected and 321 confirmed cases as of May 31, with 48 deaths and 6 recoveries; neighboring Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. WHO notes the dramatic drop in suspected cases due to testing, with many patients ruled out because they had other diseases or only fever. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a less common strain that lacks targeted treatments or vaccines, complicating response efforts. Congo’s health ministry highlights early detection, rapid isolation, strict contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and strengthened infection prevention and control in healthcare facilities as key challenges in this remote region. Five patients have recovered in Bunia, eastern DRC; four will be discharged today and one yesterday. CEPI announces up to €53 million to accelerate three experimental vaccines against Bundibugyo, involving IAVI, Moderna, and Oxford University, to be produced at Serum Institute of India.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、WHOによるとコンゴでの流行は予想ほど深刻ではない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、不十分な対応能力）およびWPRO基準複数項目該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に重要な感染症であり、確認事例と死亡報告により深刻性が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの報告あり（9例、1死亡）だが、サマリーの主要な焦点はDRCでの発生。WHO・CEPI による国際的な支援体制が構築されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirusという希少株による流行で、ワクチン・治療薬の開発が進行中。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: L'ebola, un accordo top secret con gli Usa, 2 morti (ma non per il virus): cosa sta succedendo in Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, a top-secret deal with the U.S., two dead (but not from the virus): what's going on in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Two people died during protests near the U.S. Laikipia airbase in Kenya over a top-secret deal to establish a 50-bed Ebola quarantine and monitoring center for Americans suspected of Ebola linked to the outbreak in the neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo. Kenyan authorities say no Ebola patients have arrived and only strictly logistical materials reached the base. In Nanyuki, hundreds protested, with one 27-year-old, Charles Mang'aro Mwangi, reported killed by a gunshot; the second death’s cause remains unconfirmed. Nairobi High Court temporarily suspended any Ebola treatment facility by the United States or other foreign countries; Katiba Institute filed suit demanding disclosure of all accords and risk assessments, and ordered government agencies not to admit or transfer Ebola-exposed individuals until clarity. US officials, including Medicare/Medicaid Administrator Mehmet Oz, confirm collaboration with Kenya; a similar center could be opened in other regional countries. The administration also seeks a special Ebola envoy and vaccine production partnership with Gavi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、米国との極秘合意、2人が死亡（ただしウイルスではない）：ケニアで何が起こっているのか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（IHR報告対象疾患）の発生がDRCで確認されており、ケニアに隔離施設設置の動きがある。国際的な公衆衛生対応と政治的関心が高く、複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの政治的抗議と施設計画だが、実際のエボラ発生は隣接するDRCで確認されている。ケニアは発生地域としてはサマリーに明示されておらず、むしろ受け入れ国（対応地点）として言及されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い（米国との極秘合意、裁判所命令、死亡事例）。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Balloon Juice - Plagues & Pandemics Update - June 3, 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) dominates the Plagues & Pandemics update. WHO has drastically downsized the number of confirmed cases, while the CDC reports 321 total confirmed cases. As of 6/1, DRC records 633 confirmed & suspected cases with 23 new cases confirmed yesterday; Uganda has 15 cases. The first patient has recovered and was released from an Ebola treatment unit after two negative tests. Roughly 20% of cases are healthcare workers, and relief organizations caution the outbreak may take several more months to contain amid a chaotic response. Brazil and Italy reported suspected Ebola cases (travel-related) that tested negative. Import/export concerns feature US policy debates and Kenya’s field-hospital plans; a Kenyan court rejected transporting exposed Americans to Kenya, while one American doctor evacuated from Congo is treated in Prague.

triage.headline_ja: バルーン・ジュース - 疫病とパンデミックの最新情報 - 2026年6月3日
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで確認された明らかな感染症イベント。IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響、予想外の発生、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当し、国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラウイルス発生の主要な地域はDRC（633例、確定・疑い例）とウガンダ（15例）。ブラジル・イタリアの疑い例は旅行関連で陰性検査結果。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。チェコのプラハに疎開した米国医師については、イベント発生地ではなく治療地であるため除外。対象国リストに含まれているのはDRCとブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: India Sends Second Tranche of Ebola Aid to Africa CDC Amid Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda; on May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. India dispatched the second tranche of medical aid to the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC), about 43 tonnes, complementing an initial 2.5-tonne shipment on May 24 to Kampala, Uganda. The second tranche, comprising protective gear, diagnostic and monitoring equipment, sample transport kits, infection prevention supplies, medicines and supplements, will be handed over in Kampala to Africa CDC after delivery. Indian External Affairs Ministry statements note ongoing coordination with Africa CDC and the African Union Commission, and missions in Addis Ababa and Kampala support Ebola response and regional public health preparedness across the African Union. The article does not provide case counts or symptom details.

triage.headline_ja: インドがエボラ出血熱流行対応でアフリカCDCへ医療支援物資第2弾を送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のPHEIC宣言を伴う国際的な流行であり、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。対象国DRCおよびウガンダで発生している国際的に重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はWHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を2026年5月17日に宣言。DRCおよびウガンダでの流行が報告されているが、対象国リストはDRCのみ該当。インドからの国際支援物資派遣は流行の深刻性と国際的関心の高さを反映。ケース数や症状の詳細は記事では不明だが、PHEIC宣言の事実が最大のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Honey-Trap Accused Found HIV+ Sparks Major Health Scare In Madhya Pradesh
article.articleSummary: Bhind district, Madhya Pradesh, faces potential HIV exposure amid a honey-trap extortion racket. A woman arrested is HIV-positive and has been on antiretroviral therapy for three years. The case began when a 60-year-old farmer alleged blackmail; after paying Rs 5,000, he faced demands for Rs 7 lakh. Police recovered videos on seized devices and arrested three more suspects (two men, one woman). Investigators say 15–16 men appear in the videos, with primary inquiry suggesting 6–7 may have had physical contact with the woman, prompting medical examination and counselling. This elevates a public health concern in light of India’s HIV burden: over 25 lakh people living with HIV, about 66,400 new infections annually, and more than 16 lakh on ART. In Madhya Pradesh, over 48,000 receive HIV-related treatment; authorities are tracing identified victims.

triage.headline_ja: ハニートラップ容疑で逮捕された女性がHIV陽性、マディヤ・プラデーシュ州で大規模な健康不安が発生
triage.triage_reason: HIV陽性者との接触が確認された限定的な事例であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは明確ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本事例は限定的なハニートラップ事件に関連した露出であり、15-16名の接触候補者のうち6-7名の可能性が示唆されているに留まる。HIV陽性者は既に3年間抗レトロウイルス療法を受けており、感染リスク低減状態にある可能性がある。州レベルでの接触者追跡と医学的検査が実施中であるが、本件が公式な感染症アウトブレイクを構成するかどうかは情報不足で判断できない。

article.articleHeadline: Researchers 'tried to smuggle vials of MPox and human DNA on packed flight'
article.articleSummary: Two NIH researchers, Vincent Munster (53) and Claude Kwe (38), have been detained at Detroit Metropolitan Airport, Michigan, and charged with conspiracy to smuggle mpox virus vials into the United States, plus giving false statements to federal agents. They reportedly traveled from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, amid an mpox outbreak that caused hundreds of deaths globally in 2025, arriving in Detroit in January 2026. Authorities recovered 113 vials in Styrofoam coolers; testing revealed 17 vials contained deactivated mpox virus, one contained chickenpox virus, and two contained human DNA. The pair, employed by NIH at the Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Hamilton, Montana, were described as researching emerging viral pathogens and cross-species transmission, with prior biosafety credentials. Prosecutors allege the operation involved smuggling viruses on a packed commercial flight from Congo; FBI and CBP investigations followed.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者らが満員飛行機でMpoxウイルスとヒトDNAのバイアルを密輸しようとした疑い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性（Mpoxの違法密輸）・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準で異常/予想外性・長期曝露リスク・流行しやすさに該当。バイオセキュリティ上の重大な懸念事項。
triage.notes: バイオセキュリティ事件。MpoxウイルスとヒトDNAの違法国際密輸、NIH研究者による組織的な密輸疑い。コンゴのMpox流行地から米国への違法持ち込みはバイオセキュリティリスクが極めて高い。米国の発生地域情報（Montana, Michigan, Ohio等）は逮捕・調査場所であり、Mpoxの実発生地はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Dois Mortos em Protestos Contra Centro Sanitário Dos EUA no Quénia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Two Dead in Protests Against US Health Center in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Kenyan High Court in Nanyuki on June 2 blocked for three more weeks the construction and operation of a proposed 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility for US nationals exposed to the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo or Uganda. The injunction comes amid protests in Nanyuki, with hundreds opposing the plan; police opened fire, causing two deaths according to security sources, though a police spokesman later said he had no knowledge of fatalities. The judge ordered the government to publish within seven days all agreements and operational protocols related to the project, with a further hearing scheduled for June 23. U.S. health official Mehmet Oz said at a White House briefing that the administration expects to reach a favorable agreement with Kenya. Despite the injunction, U.S. military flights were reported to continue transporting personnel and equipment to the air-force base in central Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ケニアの米国保健センターに対する抗議で2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認地域（DRC、ウガンダ）での発生に加え、ケニアでの隔離施設建設に関連した死傷者を伴う社会的混乱が報告されており、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）を満たすとともに、WPRO基準の重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさも該当し、社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染症イベントはDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ曝露ケースの隔離施設建設問題に関するもの。ケニアで死傷が報告されているが、これは施設建設反対デモに伴う社会的混乱であり、ケニアでのエボラ発生ではない。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみ。高い社会政治的関心と複数国間の公衆衛生的課題が存在するため、フルRRA対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Two men charged with trying to smuggle vials of mpox virus into the US
article.articleSummary: Two US government laboratory scientists, Vincent Munster of Rocky Mountain Laboratories (Hamilton, Montana) and Claude Kwe, were charged with illegally importing deactivated mpox (monkeypox) vials from Africa and lying to investigators after their Detroit Metropolitan Airport interception in January. They had spent nine days in the Republic of Congo, a country that recently endured a significant mpox outbreak linked to over 2,000 deaths and declared over in April. Federal filings allege the pair traveled with mpox samples without declaration or authorization, despite Munster saying documents were on his laptop and that he “does this all the time.” There was no mention in court filings about why they sought to bring the material. Mpox symptoms include rash and fever; most people recover. The men are due to appear in Missoula, Montana, as investigations continue, with mpox research backgrounds noted by the FBI.

triage.headline_ja: 米国へのエムポックスウイルスの違法密輸で2人が起訴
triage.triage_reason: 違法な病原体輸入という異常事象であり、DRC由来の検体が米国に持ち込まれた懸念があるが、検体は既に不活化されており、実際の感染イベント（患者発生）ではなく密輸事件が主体。社会的関心は高いが、感染症の公衆衛生的な直接的脅威の有無が不明瞭であるため、続報を注視する段階が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の実際の患者発生ではなく、違法な病原体輸入事件が主体。検体は既に不活化されていると述べられており、米国内での実際の感染リスクは不明。ただし、規制物質の違法輸送という異常事象と、DRCの最近の大規模アウトブレイク（2,000死亡以上）との関連から、病原体管理・バイオセキュリティの観点で注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Malattia di Chagas spaventa l'America Latina, circa 6 mln convivono con l'infezione parassitaria - Rete55
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease alarms Latin America, about 6 million live with the parasitic infection - Rete55
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease, caused by Trypanosoma cruzi, affects about 6 million people in Latin America and is a neglected tropical infection tied to social vulnerability. Transmission is primarily vectorial via nocturnal Triatominae kissing bugs, whose feces contaminate the bite site or hands touched to the face, enabling infection. Non-vector routes include blood transfusion, organ transplantation, vertical (mother-to-child) transmission, and ingestion of contaminated food or drinks. Urban migration has broadened exposure beyond rural areas; oral transmission is now the most common route in Brazil, representing over half of acute cases. Bolivia has the highest national prevalence (80–115 new cases per 100,000 annually), with Brazil, Argentina, and Venezuela also affected. About 30% of infected individuals develop serious cardiomyopathy (stroke, arrhythmias, heart failure) decades post-infection; 70% remain undiagnosed. Early treatment with benznidazole or nifurtimox is highly effective, yet diagnosis in Latin America is reported for only 10–20% of cases, highlighting gaps in screening, including prenatal testing to prevent congenital transmission (5–10% of pregnancies).

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病がラテンアメリカで懸念、約600万人が寄生虫感染と共存
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルが対象国に含まれ、シャーガス病は医学的に重要な感染症だが、記事は現在の流行勃発や急性アウトブレイクではなく、既知の風土病の概況レビューであり、具体的な新規イベントの記載が欠けている。情報不足のため要経過観察段階。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはシャーガス病の既知の疾病負担と伝播経路（ボリビア、ブラジル、アルゼンチン、ベネズエラ）を述べているが、新規発症、流行の拡大、或いは具体的なアウトブレイクの報告はない。医学的重要性は高いが、シグナル化には具体的な新規イベント情報が必要。対象国はブラジルのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo eleva a 344 los casos de ébola confirmados, incluyendo 60 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises confirmed Ebola cases to 344, including 60 deaths
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths as of June 3, 2026. Ituri province remains the epicenter with 322 cases and 46 deaths; 173 suspected cases in isolation and 116 under investigation. The virus has spread to eastern North and South Kivu, with Uganda reporting 15 cases and 1 death. Six people have recovered. The Bundibugyo strain carries an estimated fatality rate of 30–50%, and the World Health Organization notes no authorized vaccine or specific treatment. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri, near Uganda and South Sudan, and was later declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Bunia airport reopened after a two-week closure; rapid detection of new foci, notably Mambasa, underscores ongoing community surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、確認されたエボラの症例数を344件に引き上げ、死亡者60名を含む
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みで、複数国への拡大（ウガンダで15症例1死亡）が確認されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとSudanが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCにおけるエボラ爆発である。Ugandaは15症例が言及されているが、確認されたイベント発生地はDRCのみ。既にWHOによるPHEIC宣言（May 17, 2026）がなされており、Bundibugyo株の高い致死率（30-50%）およびワクチン未使用の状況が懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: غضب في كينيا بسبب خطة أمريكية لإنشاء مركز حجر صحي لمرضى الإيبولا‬ - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outrage in Kenya over US plan to establish an isolation center for Ebola patients - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, Ebola outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, caused by a Bundibugyo strain for which no licensed vaccine or proven therapy exists. WHO has declared a public health emergency. DRC reports 344 confirmed infections and 60 deaths; Uganda 9 infections and 1 death; Kenya has no known cases. In Kenya, the United States plans to set up a 50-bed Ebola isolation center in Nanyuki to care for potential cases among Americans, staffed by about 30 U.S. medical workers; Washington says the aim is to prevent importing cases. The proposal sparked wide protests and concerns about local risk; a Monday demonstration left two dead. Kenya’s High Court temporarily halted the project and ordered disclosure of all related agreements within seven days. The incident follows earlier reports of an American doctor with Ebola in DRC being treated in Germany with his family.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者の隔離センター設置を巡るケニアの怒り - 米国計画に対する抗議
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC・ウガンダでの複数国に及ぶエボラ流行、WHO公式宣言、死亡報告があり、国際的対応（米国の隔離センター設置）も進行中。社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC・ウガンダでの流行が主題だが、ケニアはまだ発症報告がない状況。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダも隣接地域での流行地だが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国・ドイツの言及は隔離管理対応の背景であり、疾病発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ดีอาร์คองโก ลดยอดผู้ติดเชื้อต้องสงสัย 'ไวรัสอีโบลา' เหลือ 116 ราย - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo lowers the number of suspected Ebola virus cases to 116.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 116 suspected Ebola cases still under investigation, down from 1,077 on May 26, after laboratory results ruled out infection for many previously identified cases, with some found to be malaria, meningitis, or other diseases. WHO’s Christian Lindmeier noted that suspected cases identified via surveillance or hospital presentations are classified as suspects until laboratory confirmation. As of June 1, 2026, the number of people confirmed with Ebola exceeds 340, including 60 deaths and 6 recoveries, with 173 suspected cases still in isolation. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ、疑い例数を116件に削減 『エボラウイルス』- ザ・バンコク・インサイト
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しているエボラ症例が継続中であり、確認症例340件以上・死亡60件を含む重篤な状況が継続している。
triage.notes: 既にWHOがPHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。Bundibugyo Ebola virus株で、承認ワクチン・特異的治療薬がない。確認症例340件超・死亡60件・回復6件・隔離中173件の報告。疑い例数が削減傾向にあるが、真の感染の衰退か症例識別の改善かは不明。継続監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Feds: 2 researchers brought vials of monkeypox to DTW
article.articleSummary: Two NIH researchers, Vincent Munster (Netherlands, 53) and Claude Kwe (Cameroon, 38), affiliated with the NIH Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Montana, were charged in federal court with conspiracy to smuggle monkeypox into the United States and making false statements. They allegedly attempted to bring 113 monkeypox vials into Detroit Metro Airport, McNamara Terminal, on Jan. 25 after returning from the Republic of Congo, where outbreaks were ongoing. Seventeen vials tested positive for monkeypox; officers initially described the case as containing diagnostics and testing equipment, but investigators found the vials and lack of proper import paperwork. Munster reportedly claimed the required paperwork existed, which investigators disputed. The FBI noted the trip’s stated purpose was to provide research support for the Congo outbreak through diagnostics, genomic sequencing, and bioinformatics, not to import samples. The charges carry a maximum five-year sentence.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦当局：2人の研究者がDTW（デトロイト・メトロ・エアポート）にサル痘のバイアルを持ち込んだ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。サル痘の違法輸入という深刻なバイオセキュリティインシデントであり、米国、DRC、カメルーンにまたがる国際的事案。
triage.notes: 本件はバイオセキュリティとバイオテロ対策の重大な懸念事項。記事は米国への違法なサル痘輸入事件を報道しており、DRCでの発生状況が背景にある。対象国リストに米国、カメルーン、オランダは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただし、この事件自体は多国籍研究者による国際的な法執行事案であり、フルRRA実施時には米国での状況も含めた分析が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Madiun imbau warga tingkatkan kewaspadaan penyakit pancaroba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Madiun Health Office Urges Residents to Heighten Vigilance Against Seasonal Diseases
article.articleSummary: Seasonal health risk alert from Madiun Regency, East Java, Indonesia, as the dry-season pancaroba raises transmission risk for acute respiratory infections (ISPA) and influenza, with dengue fever potential. The Dinas Kesehatan issued a circular to all puskesmas strengthening readiness for seasonal illnesses, including pneumonia and diarrhea, and to ensure drug stocks, inpatient ward readiness, and enhanced health education via promotors. Residents should wear masks outdoors and drink plenty of water to combat heat and dust. As of March–May 2026, pneumonia in children under five was 119 (March), 101 (April), 21 (May); ISPA in under-fives was 800 (March), 897 (April), 271 (May). No deaths reported in these figures. If cases rise, health workers will investigate and educate promptly, with continued vigilance for vulnerable groups like toddlers and the elderly.

triage.headline_ja: マディウン保健局が季節疾患への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）での季節性疾患（インフルエンザ・デング熱）に関する予防警告だが、現在のところ明らかな異常や重篤事象の報告がなく、情報が不足している。経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性疾患の定期的な予防警告であり、具体的な新規発生事象や異常な疫学的パターンは記載されていない。マディウン県の呼吸器感染症およびデング熱のリスク増加は季節要因によるもの。死亡報告なし。WPROスクリーニング基準2項目該当（長期曝露、流行しやすさ）だが、重症度の明らかな証拠や管理困難性がないため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: OMS confirmă că numărul de infectări cu Ebola din Congo e în scădere
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms that the number of Ebola infections in Congo is decreasing.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, the WHO reports the Congo Ebola outbreak is shrinking: 116 confirmed infections, 48 deaths, and 6 recoveries. Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. The drop in suspected cases reflects testing; many eliminations involved patients with other illnesses or only fever. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a less common strain with no specific treatments or vaccines. Congo’s Health Ministry cites early detection, rapid isolation, strict contact tracing, safe burials, and stronger infection control in health facilities as core challenges. Five recoveries are recorded among Bundibugyo cases; four will be discharged today and one yesterday, as a new Ebola Treatment Center opens in Bunia, eastern Congo. The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations will accelerate three experimental vaccines targeting Bundibugyo, with up to €53 million invested, including candidates from the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative, Moderna, and the University of Oxford for production at Serum Institute of India.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴのエボラ感染者数が減少していることを確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例と死亡が報告されており、IHR基準の公衆衛生への影響（深刻）と国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及）の2つ以上に該当する。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確認症例116件、死亡48件がコンゴで報告。ウガンダでも9症例1死亡が確認され、国際的波及の証拠がある。ワクチン開発にセーラム・インスティチュート・オブ・インディアが関与しているためIndia（1269750）をverified_locationsに含める。情報不足やIndia内での発生は確認されていないが、ワクチン製造との関連性により関連国として計上。

article.articleHeadline: La Nación / Paraguay reúne las condiciones técnicas para responder a un brote de aftosa, concluye informe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Nación / Paraguay meets the technical conditions to respond to a foot-and-mouth disease outbreak, the report concludes.
article.articleSummary: Paraguay has technical, operational, and institutional conditions favorable to respond to foot-and-mouth disease emergencies, according to a Panaftosa report relayed by Senacsa. The finding follows the 2026 Foot-and-Mouth Disease emergency response drill, concluded a few weeks earlier. The veterinary service notes strong technical-team readiness, adequate supplies, and effective cooperation with the private sector, plus collaborative mechanisms with neighboring countries. The OPS Pan American Center for Foot-and-Mouth Disease adds that these elements bolster national preparedness and response to a potential outbreak. It underscores the national veterinary service’s institutional commitment in planning and leading the exercise, with participation from government bodies and veterinary agencies from Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, and Uruguay. The simulation also identified improvement opportunities and possible enhancements through training and updates, as shared by Senacsa on social media.

triage.headline_ja: パラグアイは口蹄疫の発生に対応する技術的条件を備えている、報告書が結論
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は口蹄疫への対応準備状況に関する報告書の発表であり、実際の発生イベントではなく、シミュレーション演習の評価結果である。感染症の実際の患者発生や国際的拡大の懸念がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の口蹄疫発生イベントではなく、パラグアイが2026年に実施した緊急対応訓練（シミュレーション演習）の結果報告である。Panaftosaとの協力状況や隣国との連携体制についての情報提供が主目的であり、公衆衛生上の急迫した懸念事項はない。対象国リストに基づき、記事で言及されている国のうち、Brazil（3469034）のみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Feds: 2 researchers brought vials of monkeypox to DTW
article.articleSummary: Two NIH researchers, Vincent Munster (Netherlands, 53) and Claude Kwe (Cameroon, 38), were charged in federal court with conspiracy to smuggle monkeypox into the United States and making false statements to investigators. Employed at the NIH Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana, they allegedly arrived at Detroit Metropolitan Airport on Jan. 25 after returning from the Republic of Congo during an ongoing monkeypox outbreak. At a checkpoint, officers found a plastic case containing 113 vials, 17 of which tested positive for monkeypox; the pair had claimed the case held diagnostics and testing equipment. Munster allegedly stated he had import paperwork, which investigators found absent. FBI notes indicated the Brazzaville, Congo trip was to provide research support for diagnostics, genomic sequencing and bioinformatics, not to transport samples. If convicted, they face up to five years in prison. Monkeypox symptoms include a rash, fever, chills and swollen lymph nodes; transmission requires close contact. Outbreaks persist in central and eastern Africa since 2023 per the CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦当局：2人の研究者がモンキーポックスのバイアルをデトロイトに持ち込む
triage.triage_reason: NIH研究者による意図的なモンキーポックス密輸事案であり、バイオセキュリティ侵害の重大性、国際的な感染症管理体制への脅威、著しく異常な事象として複数のIHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。また国家間のバイオセーフティ規制逸脱という社会・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本件はバイオセキュリティ侵害事案であり、感染症の自然発生ではなく意図的な規制逃避による密輸。DRC発の活性モンキーポックスサンプル(Clade I/II)が米国に不正持ち込まれ、112日前(2026年1月25日)にデトロイト空港で摘発。記事サマリーに基づき実際の発生地はDRCと米国。オランダ・カメルーン籍研究者が関与しているが、感染症イベント発生地としてはDRCと米国が対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Spanish Local Government Cancels Congo-Chile Friendly Over Ebola Fears
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo leads to cancellation of the Congo–Chile friendly in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, after health authorities warned of risks. The match, set for June 9, was canceled by local authorities. The WHO reports Bundibugyo-type Ebola with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths in DRC as of May 27, and says the outbreak has reached Uganda. Congo also canceled a three-day training camp and send-off event in Kinshasa; the squad has moved to Belgium to train and will face Denmark in Liège. The U.S. government demands a 21-day bubble for Congolese players entering the United States, warning that noncompliance could bar entry. Congo qualified for the World Cup for the first time since 1974; their group games are Portugal (Houston), Colombia (Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (Atlanta).

triage.headline_ja: スペイン地方政府、エボラ懸念によるコンゴ・チリ親善試合をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の東部DRCでの流行（906疑い例、223死亡）が確認され、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が報告されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当、および国際スポーツイベントの中止による社会政治的関心の高まりからピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域には複数の国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は東部DRCでのエボラ流行。ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。スペイン、ベルギー、デンマーク、USA、メキシコ、ポルトガル、コロンビア、ウズベキスタンなどはイベント対応地（試合会場やスポーツ移動）であり、実際の感染症発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Meghalaya govt intensifies efforts to check spread of African Swine Fever
article.articleSummary: Meghalaya reports African Swine Fever outbreak with confirmed cases in East Khasi Hills (Pynursla, Mawlai), West Khasi Hills (Mawthadraishan), Ri-Bhoi (Umsning, Bhoirymbong), Eastern West Khasi Hills (Mairang) and the Regional Pig Breeding Farm at Kyrdemkulai; affected villages include Urksew Wahpathaw, Mawkajem, Mawlai Mawkynroh, Nongkasen, Kyrdemkulai, Lum Umpih, Mawkyrdep, Mawphanniew. Authorities declare 1 km infected zones around premises and 10 km surveillance zones; complete ban on movement of live pigs, pig feed, pork and pork products into/out of affected areas; pig markets, slaughterhouses and abattoirs in zones closed. Swill feeding prohibited; carcasses must be disposed by deep burial with lime; penalties Rs 2,000-5,000 and up to 3 months imprisonment for repeat offenders. Biosecurity measures reinforced; restrict visitors, disinfect vehicles; veterinary surveillance intensified; forest department to monitor wild boar. Local bodies urged cooperation; disease-free areas advised to confine animals, avoid contact with wild boars, report illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: メガラヤ州がアフリカ豚熱の拡大抑制に努力を強化
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は既知の家畜感染症で、インドで複数地域で確認されているが、ヒト-ヒト感染がなく公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的。情報不足のため経過観察段階に適切。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は動物感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染がないため公衆衛生上の深刻性は限定的。ただし、複数地域での拡大確認、移動制限の実施、野生イノシシ監視の必要性から、家畜感染症として管理上の関心はある。インド国内の経済的影響（豚産業）に限定される可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo revises down number of suspected Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak comprises 321 laboratory-confirmed cases and 116 suspected infections under investigation. Earlier counts cited 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected Ebola-related deaths linked to the Bundibugyo strain, while Africa CDC reported more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. WHO spokesperson Christian Lindmeier said the discrepancy stems from testing and investigations that ruled out hundreds of suspected cases, with some individuals found to have other diseases or only fever. Surveillance and contact tracing continue, causing fluctuations in reported totals. The report confirms Bundibyo?o-strain involvement but provides no details on infection source or imported/exported cases, nor explicit symptom profiles beyond reference to fever. The situation remains an active outbreak with ongoing laboratory confirmation and case finding in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ疑い患者数を下方修正
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目すべて満たす。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、確認症例と疑い例が存在し、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクがある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確認症例321件、疑い例116件が報告されている。疑い例数の修正（906件から116件への下方修正）は、検査と疫学調査による除外を反映している。DRCにおける能力構築と国際的支援の継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Tightens Border Screening To Prevent Ebola Spread
article.articleSummary: Nigeria tightens border screening to prevent Ebola importation after Bundibugyo strain outbreaks in East and Central Africa, including the Democratic Republic of Congo. Nigeria reports no confirmed Ebola cases. High-risk travelers face secondary screening, isolation and referral; entry points deploy infrared thermal scanners, handheld thermometers, health declarations, travel history checks and risk profiling. Surveillance is reinforced through expanded integrated disease monitoring, community networks and public health alert tracking; Public Health Emergency Operations Centres are activated and Rapid Response Teams stand by. Hospitals are told to watch for viral hemorrhagic fevers, strengthen triage, isolate suspected cases quickly and follow reporting protocols. Citizens are urged to wash hands, avoid contact with sick people's bodily fluids, and refrain from bushmeat from unknown sources. Lawmakers warn of funding gaps at the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control, urging urgent funds and reinforced screening.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ拡大防止のため国境スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。東・中央アフリカでのブンディブギョウ株アウトブレイク受け、ナイジェリアが積極的な予防措置を実施しており、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にはNigeria、Mozambique、DRCが含まれているが、記事サマリーの検証により、実際のエボラアウトブレイクは東・中央アフリカ（DRC含む）で発生し、ナイジェリアは予防措置を実施している国として位置づけられている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations はDRCのみ。DRCでのアウトブレイク、ナイジェリアの積極的な予防対応、資金不足懸念など複数の懸念要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: 可1傳14人！國中弟「水痘長滿身」爆膿痂疹　醫示警：同空間就中
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Could infect 14 people! Junior high student with chickenpox all over his body develops pus-filled crusted lesions; doctor warns: in the same space you’ll catch it.
article.articleSummary: Varicella (chickenpox) outbreak in Guanpu District, Hsinchu, Taiwan, linked to a junior high student with widespread varicella and concurrent bacterial impetigo crusts; patient has recovered after treatment. The doctor warns varicella is highly contagious via droplets and airborne spread, with transmission likely in the same room. A single patient can infect 12–14 people (R0 12–14), six times more than influenza or enterovirus. Taiwan CDC data show clusters: 58% occur in elementary schools, 34% in kindergartens. Early symptoms include fever and malaise, followed by a red rash with vesicles; severe cases may progress to pneumonia or encephalitis. First-dose varicella vaccine provides about 80% protection; a second dose raises protection to about 98% and reduces breakthrough infections by ~84.6%. Doctors urge parents to consider a self-paid second dose for children over age 4 to strengthen protection; several classmates were infected and some classes were suspended.

triage.headline_ja: 1人が14人に感染か！国中の弟「水痘が全身に」膿痂疹が爆発　医師が警告：同じ空間にいると感染する
triage.triage_reason: 水痘アウトブレイク（高い感染性R0 12-14、学校クラスター報告）が確認されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の異常性・流行しやすさ・重症化リスク（敗血症性膿痂疹、肺炎・脳炎の可能性）に該当するが、現時点で死亡や深刻な公衆衛生影響の明確な報告がなく、IHR基準2つ以上の該当が確認できないため、情報の充実化と発展状況の経過観察が必要。

verified_locations.name: China
verified_locations.note: Hong Kong included as part of China per protocol

triage.notes: 記事はTaiwanの新竹市Guanpu地区の水痘アウトブレイクを主題としているが、同時にJiangsu Sheng（中国江蘇省）の地域参照も含まれている。サマリーの主要イベントはTaiwan限定であるが、発生地域リストに中国が含まれるため検証が必要。ただしサマリー上、江蘇省での具体的な症例報告は明記されていない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、地理的検証上、中国のみを verified_locations に含める。水痘は予防可能疾患だが、ワクチン接種率や予防接種戦略が不明であり、今後の展開（国際的拡大、死亡事例の報告など）を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria identificada na água Crystal pela Anvisa é a mesma dos lotes da Ypê; entenda riscos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The bacterium identified in Crystal water by Anvisa is the same as the one in Ypê's batches; understand the risks.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Anvisa confirmed a single lot of Crystal Natural Sparkling Water contaminated with Pseudomonas aeruginosa, the same bacterium found in Ypê products during a May inspection. About 374,400 bottles were voluntarily recalled by Mineração Bom Jesus Ltda. The batch is LZ1 VAL200127 3 P 200126, 500 ml bottles, distributed to Distrito Federal (roughly 230,000), Goiás (66,768), Tocantins (1,439), and interior of São Paulo (75,750). No consumer complaints were recorded. Infections by Pseudomonas aeruginosa range from mild to severe, particularly in immunocompromised people, and can affect skin, lungs, blood, eyes, ears, urinary tract, or gastrointestinal tract; severe cases may lead to sepsis and organ failure. High-risk groups include cancer patients, transplant recipients, HIV/AIDS, chronic corticosteroid use, autoimmune diseases, diabetics, and hospitalized individuals. Consumers with the batch produced 20/01/2026, expiring 20/01/2027 from Luziânia should not drink it; a return/refund process will be announced.

triage.headline_ja: AnsvisaがCrystal水から識別した細菌はYpêのロットと同じ。リスクを理解してください
triage.triage_reason: Pseudomonas aeruginosa污染による製品リコール事象であり、食品・環境汚染の公衆衛生上の影響は存在するが、記事は「HIV」疾患として誤分類されており、実際の臨床感染症アウトブレイクではなく製品汚染対応である。現在のところ消費者からの感染報告はなく、情報不足のためWATCHと判定。
triage.notes: 疾患分類の誤り：イベントはHIVではなくPseudomonas aeruginosa（緑膿菌）による製品汚染。記事は食品安全事象であり感染症アウトブレイクの自然発生ではない。現在のところ臨床感染例の報告なし。Anvisa（ブラジル保健当局）が対応中。続報で実際の感染例発生の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Der Sport-Tag: Testspiel abgesagt: Ebola bedroht Kongos Auftritt bei der WM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Sports Day: Cancelled Friendly: Ebola Threatens Congo's World Cup Appearance
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompted cancellation of a Congo national team World Cup warm-up against Chile in La Línea de la Concepción, Cádiz, Spain, scheduled for June 9. Mayor Juan Franco canceled the game citing health risks linked to the outbreak. Municipal authorities deemed the submitted documentation insufficient by city experts and the Andalusian regional government. The Congolese Football Federation stated that all necessary measures have been taken to comply with health, sporting, and administrative requirements and that the delegation adheres to international protocols. The federation is in ongoing talks with the Spanish Football Federation and international bodies, hoping to reach a quick, satisfactory solution to play the match under the best possible conditions.

triage.headline_ja: スポーツの日：試合中止：エボラがコンゴのワールドカップ出場を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ発生は深刻だが、記事の主眼は試合中止という体育行事であり、感染症の公衆衛生的な危機管理情報が限定的。対象国への実際の発生確認であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はコンゴでのエボラ発生によるスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ準備試合）の中止である。実質的な感染症危機管理情報（患者数、死亡数、地域的拡大、対応方法など）は記事サマリーに記載されていない。スペインの地域（La Línea de la Concepción、Cádiz、Andalusia）や チリは試合予定地として言及されているが、これらの国での発生は報道されていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Er kämpfte gegen Ebola - und warnt jetzt vor einer noch grösseren Gefahr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: He fought Ebola - and now warns of an even greater danger.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) triggers a WHO international health emergency at the second-highest alert level. In the north, the epicenter of fighting with militias complicates response. Suspected cases rose from about 100 two weeks ago to over 1,000; more than 300 are lab-confirmed, with at least 49 deaths. Lessons from the 2014–2015 West Africa Ebola epidemic—Sierra Leone, Guinea and Liberia—highlight ring vaccination, contact tracing and quarantine, but containment remains challenged by armed conflict and vast, difficult-to-reach areas near Uganda and South Sudan borders, implying many undetected infections. Charlie Herbert, a former British Army major general who led the Sierra Leone mission, warns Western governments to maintain funding for pandemic preparedness and health systems, arguing early containment is cheaper than instability and displacement. He notes the risk of zoonotic spillover from bushmeat and fears a future outbreak reaching Europe.

triage.headline_ja: エボラと戦った彼が今、さらに大きな危険について警告している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱のDRC発生は公衆衛生上深刻な影響を示し、WHO第2警戒レベルの国際的保健上の緊急事態として認定されており、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を主題としており、西アフリカ2014-2015流行の教訓や国際的な対応準備の必要性を論じている。武装勢力との対立や地理的困難さによる対応の課題、ウガンダ・南スーダン国境地域における未検出感染の可能性が指摘されている。Sierra Leone、Guinea、Liberiaは過去の流行事例として記述されており、現在の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: USA. Dwóch naukowców przemyciło wirus Mpox z Demokratycznej Republiki Konga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USA. Two scientists smuggled the Mpox virus from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) material smuggling case in the United States: January incident at Detroit, Michigan, involving Vincent Munster, a Dutch citizen and head of the virus ecology section at Rocky Mountain Laboratories, Hamilton, Montana, and Claude Kwe, a Cameroonian researcher, who traveled from Brazzaville, the Democratic Republic of the Congo. CBP detained them after they claimed the black suitcase contained diagnostic equipment. FBI/CBP inspection uncovered 113 vials; 20 examined so far, with 17 containing mpox virus material. One vial contained varicella-zoster virus, and two contained human DNA. The mpox material was inactivated, incapable of replication or causing disease. The scientists face up to five years in prison. Prosecutors allege they violated the law by smuggling pathogenic materials from an outbreak area into the United States, posing a potential public-safety risk.

triage.headline_ja: USA. 二人の科学者がコンゴ民主共和国からMpoxウイルスを密輸
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で『異常/予想外』『国際的拡大リスク』の2つに該当。さらにWPRO基準でも『異常/予想外』『流行しやすさ』『管理可能性』に該当し、国際的な法執行事案として政府関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本事案は科学者による病原体密輸の違法行為であり、米国での逮捕・起訴という司法事案。Mpox材料は失活状態（感染性なし）とされているが、国際的な生物セキュリティ侵害事例として重要。記事サマリーより、イベントの主要な発生地はDRC（Brazzaville経由）からUSA（Michigan）への密輸事案であり、サマリー上で実際の疫学的発生は記載されていない。ただし、IHR通知基準および国家間の生物学的脅威という文脈で、シグナルとしてピックアップする価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bị chó dại cắn không tiêm phòng, tử vong sau 5 tháng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bitten by a rabid dog, unvaccinated, died after five months.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Nghệ An, Vietnam. On June 3, a 69-year-old man from Trù Sơn 7, Bạch Hà, Đô Lương district, died after about five months of illness following a dog bite; the dog later died, and the man had not received post-exposure rabies vaccination, resorting to traditional remedies. He developed vomiting, hydrophobia, agitation, and fear before death. Local health authorities, led by Đô Lương Center, are intensifying case reviews and rabies prevention efforts. Earlier on June 3, in Ban Ke Trang village, Mậu Thạch commune, another dog tested positive for rabies; five people were bitten—two received vaccination and monitoring at provincial facilities, three at Con Cuong Health Center. Authorities urge prompt medical consultation after bites, caution against handling suspected animals, and promote vaccination of pets. The report also notes the death of a dog-meat seller from rabies, with authorities tracing the infection source.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の犬に噛まれワクチン未接種、5ヶ月後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで狂犬病による死亡事例と複数の露出事例が報告されており、IHR基準で異常性・重症度が確認でき、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・流行性が該当。地域保健当局による能動的な対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ベトナムのNghệ An州で複数の狂犬病事例が確認されている。死亡例1件、露出例5件が報告されており、地域保健当局による対応が展開中。ワクチン未接種による感染例であり、公衆衛生上の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Lữ đoàn 955 đưa ngư dân bị nhiễm trùng đường ruột về bờ an toàn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brigade 955 brings fishermen suffering from a gastrointestinal infection safely ashore.
article.articleSummary: Gastrointestinal infection in a fisherman from Da Nang was safely brought ashore by Brigade 955 of the Vietnamese Navy. Patient: Nguyen Van Tam (born 1987), from Binh Hiep, Thang Binh, Da Nang; crew on fishing vessel QNa 94464 TS, with 42 crew. Vessel departed Tam Quang Port, Nui Thanh District, Da Nang on 6 May 2026 to squid fish in the Spratly Islands. About four days before admission, he developed abdominal pain, vomiting, and feverish symptoms with abdominal distension; fever subsided after a day but condition remained unstable. On 27 May he was diagnosed with a gastrointestinal infection at Thuyen Chau D Island Health Center (temperature 37.5 C). At 15:30 on 29 May, per Region 4 Navy orders, Truong Sa 20 departed to pick him up; during transit he was monitored and then handed to 486 Treatment Team for continued care. No fatalities reported; highlights naval support for fishermen and maritime livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: 第955旅団がベトナムの漁師を腸管感染症から救出し安全に上陸させた
triage.triage_reason: 単一患者の散発的な腸管感染症であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクのいずれも認められない。社会的・政治的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 単一患者の散発的なイベント。患者は既に適切に治療を受けており、致死例なし。集団発生や異常性の兆候なし。疾患名が「Unknown Illness」とされているが、サマリーでは腸管感染症と診断されている。シグナル化の基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Er kämpfte gegen Ebola - und warnt jetzt vor einer noch größeren Gefahr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: He fought Ebola—and now warns of an even greater danger.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the WHO has declared an international health emergency of the second-highest level. As of June 3, 2026, authorities report over 1,000 suspected cases, more than 300 confirmed, and at least 49 deaths. The outbreak covers a large area near Uganda and South Sudan, heightening concern of undetected transmission. The 2014–2015 West Africa epidemic—killing at least 11,000 people in Sierra Leone, Guinea, and Liberia— is cited as a benchmark; response measures now include ring vaccination, contact tracing, and quarantine. Charlie Herbert, former British Major General who led aid missions in Sierra Leone, warns Western nations against cutting funding for pandemic preparedness, arguing zoonotic spillovers (including bushmeat consumption) threaten broader stability. The DR Congo's security situation and armed conflict complicate outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスと戦った者が今、さらに大きな危険を警告している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の発生は、IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WHO第2レベルの国際保健緊急事態が宣言されている。確認患者300人以上、死亡者49人以上という重症度と、ウガンダ・南スーダン近郊での広範な地域的拡大リスクが確認される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはSudan、Sierra Leone、Liberia、Ugandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの現在の発生である。2014-2015年の西アフリカ流行（Sierra Leone、Guinea、Liberia）は歴史的参考例として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地はDRCに限定されている。WHO PHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）第2レベル宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: JOOTRH Activates Ebola Emergency Preparedness Measures Amid Uganda Outbreak Fears
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Jaramogi Oginga Odinga Teaching and Referral Hospital (JOOTRH) in Kisumu, Kenya, activated Ebola emergency preparedness amid fears of spread from neighboring Uganda. No Ebola infections have been confirmed in Kenya. JOOTRH, a major western Kenya referral center serving border regions, has intensified readiness to detect, isolate, and manage suspected Ebola cases, including three isolation rooms in the Accident and Emergency Department and an annex with six closed rooms. Laboratory preparedness has been strengthened through staff training and partnerships with specialized testing facilities; PPE stocks are being reviewed and expanded. Public awareness campaigns via flyers, social media, and internal channels are planned to counter misinformation. Authorities emphasize no cause for alarm; border screening and surveillance have been boosted at key points along routes linking Kenya with Uganda and the DRC. Additional health personnel may be deployed if cases emerge, with recruitment plans already in place.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのアウトブレイク懸念の中、JOORTHがエボラ緊急対策を発動
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク懸念に対するケニアの準備措置であり、ケニア国内での確認症例はなし。地域的な対応段階だが、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア（対象国外）での準備措置について報告しており、実際のエボラ発生はウガンダおよびDRCで生じている可能性があるが、記事の主題はケニアの対応に限定。対象国リスト内での確認症例がないため、verified_locationsは空配列。ウガンダでのアウトブレイクが確認された場合はPICKUP判定に変更すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Πάει Ρίγα και Βρυξέλλες ο Υπ. Υγείας σε συνάντηση ΠΟΥ για Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister heads to Riga and Brussels for WHO meeting on Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Cyprus Health Minister Neophytos Charalambides travels to Riga, Latvia for the 12th High-Level Meeting of the WHO European Region Small Countries Initiative, addressing health workforce staffing challenges. He will meet Latvian Health Minister Hosams Abu Meri and sign a Memorandum of Understanding on health and medical sciences to deepen bilateral cooperation, with additional bilateral meetings planned to exchange public health best practices. From Riga, he proceeds to Brussels for an extraordinary informal EU Health Ministers videoconference on June 5 to discuss the Ebola surge in Central Africa. The report cites WHO figures: 321 confirmed and 116 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, underscoring ongoing outbreak concerns in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣、エボラについてのWHO会議でリガとブリュッセルへ向かう
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカ（DRC）でのエボラ流行に関するEU保健相会議の開催であり、公式な国際対応の枠組みを示している。ただし、対象国のDRCにおける実際の新規症例発生や地域的拡大の具体的情報は記事に含まれておらず、本記事は外交・行政対応の報道である。情報不足のため段階的監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカ（特にDRC）のエボラ流行に対するEU・WHO公式対応に関するもの。DRCでの321確認例、116疑い例が言及されている。ただし本記事自体は外交会議の予告であり、新規発生事象ではなく、実際の症例数増加やアウトブレーク拡大の詳細情報は記事に含まれていない。対象国外（ラトビア、ベルギー、キプロス）における発生はなく、会議場所のみの言及である。

article.articleHeadline: الصبليون حتى هما وقفو ماتش بسبب فيروس إيبولا - كود: جريدة إلكترونية مغربية شاملة.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Spaniards even stopped the match because of the Ebola virus - Code: Moroccan comprehensive online newspaper.
article.articleSummary: Spain suspended a World Cup 2026 qualification match between the Democratic Republic of Congo and Chile due to an Ebola outbreak in DR Congo. The June 9 fixture in La Línea de la Concepción was postponed after local authorities refused to issue a license for a gathering involving DR Congo amid Ebola risk. The DR Congo Football Federation is negotiating with the Spanish Football Federation and international bodies to secure a swift resolution so the game can be played. Separately, the White House reportedly requires the DR Congo delegation to undergo at least 15 days of quarantine before entering the United States, due to Ebola, as a condition for participating in the 2026 World Cup. The article highlights how an Ebola outbreak is affecting international football, travel, and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: スペイン人はエボラウイルスのため試合を中止した - コード：モロッコの総合オンラインニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の発生報告であり、国際スポーツイベントの中止と渡航制限措置が実施されており、シグナルとして確実に分類される。
triage.notes: Bluedotが検出した他地域（スペイン、チリ、米国）は感染が報告されている場所ではなく、影響を受けている地域である。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に列挙した。記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生であり、その結果としてスペインでの試合中止と米国の入国制限が生じている。

article.articleHeadline: O que é a bactéria encontrada na água Crystal, a mesma dos produtos da Ypê
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the bacterium found in Crystal water, the same as Ypê's products.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Brazil's National Health Surveillance Agency (Anvisa) ordered the withdrawal of a batch of Crystal mineral water after laboratory analyses confirmed the presence of Pseudomonas aeruginosa. This follows a prior detection of the same bacterium in Ypê-brand products, which prompted a voluntary recall and led Anvisa to broaden quality-control inspections. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is widely distributed in air, water, soil, and even the skin of healthy people, but it is regarded as an opportunistic pathogen that can cause infections when the immune system is compromised. Infections can range from localized, mild to severe, depending on health status. Vulnerable groups include cancer patients, transplant recipients on immunosuppressants, uncontrolled HIV, long-term corticosteroid users, and those with autoimmune diseases; hospitalised, debilitated patients, diabetics, cystic fibrosis patients, and those on immunosuppressive therapies are at greater risk. Areas favored by the bacteria include moist environments such as sinks, bathrooms, poorly chlorinated pools, and outdated antiseptics.

triage.headline_ja: Crystal水から検出された菌は、Ypê製品と同じ菌
triage.triage_reason: HIV関連情報ではなく、Pseudomonas aeruginosa（緑膿菌）の水汚染事例。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当せず、検出は環境汚染であり感染症流行ではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが疾患をHIVと分類していますが、記事サマリーはPseudomonas aeruginosaの環境汚染（飲料水製品への混入）に関するもので、HIV感染症事例ではありません。環境汚染リコールは通常の公衆衛生対応であり、感染症危機管理のシグナルレベルではありません。該当対象国がないため verified_locations は空配列です。

article.articleHeadline: Cinco presos sospechosos de ébola escapan de centros sanitarios en Bunia, Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five prisoners suspected of having Ebola escape from health facilities in Bunia, Congo.
article.articleSummary: Five prisoners suspected of Ebola escaped from health facilities in Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, over the weekend and Monday. Two fled Bunia General Reference Hospital, and three escaped from a treatment center in Rwampara, about 10 km from the city. The patients were not under police custody to prevent contagion among officers. The escape raises concerns about potential community transmission as authorities intensify searches and bolster prevention measures at the central prison with support from the International Committee of the Red Cross and other humanitarian groups. Ituri province accounts for the outbreak’s majority; official data show 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, including 322 infections and 46 deaths in Ituri. The outbreak has spread to Uganda with 15 infections and one death, imported from DRC. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのブニアの衛生施設からエボラが疑われる5人の受刑者が逃亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の既知アウトブレイク下での受刑者逃亡事案。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、国際的な二次感染リスク、および公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を伴うため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 既に WHO による PHEIC 宣言済み。受刑者逃亡により未把握のコミュニティ感染拡大リスクが高まった。ウガンダへの越境感染も確認済み。Kigali Province（ルワンダ）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリーでは DRC とウガンダのみが主題の感染事象であるため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 19名港人曾到非洲埃博拉疫情暴發區　未現疑似個案 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nineteen Hong Kong residents who had visited the Ebola outbreak area in Africa; no suspected cases have been reported.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Hong Kong has issued a red outbound travel alert for the Democratic Republic of Congo amid Ebola outbreaks in Africa. Health authorities report 19 residents who had visited outbreak areas, but none developed suspected Ebola cases after assessment. With no direct flights from DRC or Uganda, travelers to Hong Kong typically transit via Ethiopia. The Centre for Health Protection has requested further information from the WHO, Africa CDC, and the health authorities of DRC and Uganda, and has sent two notices to all doctors and hospitals requiring any person who has been in the affected areas within 21 days and develops related symptoms to be treated as a suspected case. Regarding hantavirus, since 2008 Hong Kong has recorded 14 infections, including 12 local, all of which were lower-fatality hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS); the cruise outbreak involved no Hong Kong residents. In the past five years HK average 0-2 per year; last year and up to May 2026 there were no hantavirus infections. Public health impact considered low.

triage.headline_ja: 19名の香港市民がアフリカのエボラ出血熱流行地域を訪問；疑似患者は報告されていない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念疾患であり、DRCで流行中の報告が該当。香港が赤色渡航アラートを発令し、接触者追跡と疑似患者定義の強化が実施されており、国際的拡大リスクと管理対応の必要性が認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCにおけるエボラ流行と香港への輸入リスク評価。エチオピアはトランジット地点として言及されているが、アクティブな流行地域として記述されていないため除外。ハンタウイルスは補足情報として触れられているが、公衆衛生影響は低いと評価。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: بسبب إيبولا.. الكونغو الديموقراطية مستعدة للعب بدون جمهور أمام تشيلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Because of Ebola, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is ready to play behind closed doors against Chile.
article.articleSummary: Ebola concerns linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted adjustments to a June 9 friendly against Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain, with the mayor canceling the match as a precaution. DR Congo coach Sebastien Desabre indicated options include playing behind closed doors or at an alternative venue, stressing health-compliance while remaining ready to compete. The team’s Belgium-based training camp proceeds normally, with players sourced from Europe. The Chile match would be part of Europe-based friendlies ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, Mexico, and Canada (June 11–July 19). DR Congo were also slated to face Denmark in Liège, Belgium. The White House, on May 23, announced a 21-day isolation “bubble” for the squad to avoid Ebola if they enter the United States for the tournament. In World Cup Group 11, DR Congo faces Colombia, Portugal, and Uzbekistan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラのため、コンゴ民主共和国はチリとの試合を無観客で行う準備ができている
triage.triage_reason: エボラの懸念によりスポーツイベント（サッカー試合）の実施方法に変更が生じているが、実際の患者発生や健康影響ではなく、予防的措置に基づく報道。IHR基準の該当は限定的で、情報不足が多い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月のサッカー親善試合の実施方法変更を報道しており、実際のエボラ患者の発生を報告していない。DRC内でのエボラアウトブレイクの有無が不明であり、シグナルとしてはWATCHレベル。スポーツイベントの中止や変更のみの報道では感染症危機管理の優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Por mês, Grande ABC registra 26 casos de meningite no primeiro quadrimestre do ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Greater ABC records 26 meningitis cases per month in the first four months of the year
article.articleSummary: Greater ABC averaged 26 meningitis cases per month from Jan-Apr 2026 (104 total), with the state recording 1,108 in the period. A confirmed meningococcal meningitis (bacterial) case in a 37-year-old man in Sao Paulo capital was later ruled out as Ebola after testing. Meningitis is inflammation of the brain's meninges; bacterial and viral forms spread via respiratory droplets, with the bacterial form more severe and 20-30% fatality, higher in children and older adults. DataSUS shows a 6% four-month rise from 2025 (98). Experts say this is within expected variation. Vaccination is key: meningococcal C and ACWY vaccines are offered by SUS in the first year, alongside BCG, pneumococcal, and pentavalent vaccines. In Greater ABC, Sao Bernardo do Campo leads with 34 cases, followed by Santo Andre 24, Diadema 17, Maua 15, Ribeirao Pires 6, Rio Grande da Serra 5, Sao Caetano do Sul 3. Santo Andre and Rio Grande da Serra reported vaccination outreach in schools and transit hubs.

triage.headline_ja: グレーター・ABCは2026年最初の4カ月間に月平均26件の髄膜炎症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける髄膜炎症例の増加を報告しているが、変動は専門家により予想範囲内と評価されており、IHR基準は満たさない。Ebolasuspectionは検査で除外されている。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（サンパウロ州およびグレーター・ABC地域）の髄膜炎症例についてのものである。2026年1～4月の104症例（月平均26件）は、前年同期の98症例からの6%増加であり、専門家により予想範囲内との評価。疑わしいEbola事例は検査で除外された。ワクチン接種が推奨されており、公衆衛生対応は機能している。対象国リストにはBrazilが含まれるため verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, WHO drastically reduces number of suspected cases: from 906 to 116
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows fluctuating surveillance. As of May 31, WHO reported 116 suspected cases down from 906 the previous week, with 321 confirmed in the DRC and 48 deaths; nine confirmed cases (one death) reported in neighboring Uganda. The epidemic was declared May 15 in Ituri province (northeast DRC). Despite suspected cases, many were ruled out after testing, as symptoms overlap other diseases; six confirmed cases have recovered. Earlier tallies included about 223 suspected Ebola deaths, now considered uncertain due to unexhumed remains. The Bundibugyo strain underlies the outbreak, prompting EU concerns and a draft summit stance. EU Council draft conclusions (June 18–19) call for monitoring and coordinated actions, note rapid WHO funding for epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing, and laboratory strengthening, and express willingness to support WHO and Africa CDC in containment and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、WHO が疑い例数を大幅削減: 906件から116件に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認例（321件、死亡48件）と国際的拡大（ウガンダでも9件確認）があり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。重症度が高く、国家間での対応調整が必要な状況。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国（203312）として含める。サマリーにより DRC が主要な発生地で、Ituri州は DRC 内の地理的詳細。EU 評議会の関与と国際的な資金援助の動きが記載されており、国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo plot first World Cup assault in more than 50 years amid Ebola concern
article.articleSummary: DR Congo will play at the World Cup in North America for the first time since 1974, with Sebastien Desabre guiding 'The Leopards' and a squad rebuilt with European influence around captain Chancel Mbemba. They qualified via CAF play‑offs, defeating Jamaica and eliminating Cameroon and Nigeria. Group K features Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia, and Desabre relishes a test against Ronaldo. Preparations were disrupted by an Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, prompting the cancellation of a Kinshasa training camp and a move to Belgium; the WHO declared it a public health emergency of international concern, though not a pandemic. The defense is anchored by Mbemba and Axel Tuanzebe, with Aaron Wan‑Bissaka at right-back and Noah Sadiki in midfield. Yoane Wissa, transferred to Newcastle for £55m, has three goals this season and aims to shine at his World Cup debut.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの懸念の中、コンゴ民主共和国が50年以上ぶりのワールドカップ初出場を目指す
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生がコンゴ民主共和国（東部）で確認され、WHO が国際保健上の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、フルRRA進行対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが多数の地理的位置を返しているが（Cameroon、Portugal、Colombia等）、記事サマリーの主題は DRC 東部でのエボラ発生である。DRC のみが対象国リストに該当し、verified_locations に含める。WHO が PHEIC 宣言済みで、国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: اتهام عالمين أميركيين بتهريب عينات من فيروس جدري القردة والكذب على المحققين - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two American scientists charged with smuggling samples of the monkeypox virus and lying to investigators - Al Ahli Stadium
article.articleSummary: Two American scientists, Vincent Monster, head of the virus environment division at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana, and his assistant Claude Kow, were charged after attempting to smuggle vials containing an inactivated monkeypox virus into the United States and lying to federal investigators at Detroit Metropolitan Airport. They returned from a nine-day field study in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where monkeypox outbreaks had claimed more than 2,000 lives. Congolese authorities announced the end of the two-year outbreak in April, but the risk of transporting sensitive biological materials remains high. Federal investigators found hidden vials during screening, with samples brought without proper permits or disclosure. They are due to appear in federal court in Missoula, Montana. The case highlights strict biosafety and border-control protocols for handling and transporting infectious agents.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の2人の科学者がサル痘ウイルス検体の密輸と捜査官への虚偽で起訴される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）し、バイオセキュリティと公衆衛生に関する重要な懸念事項。さらにWPRO基準でも複数項目該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は米国での法的事件を主題としているが、病原体の出所および流行発生地がDRC（2000人以上の死亡を報告）であり、生物素材の国際輸送と国境管理の違反がバイオセキュリティリスクとして認識されている。DRCは対象国のため verified_locations に含める。米国の事件そのものは対象国リストに含まれないため、監視地域からは除外。

article.articleHeadline: OMS regista queda acentuada de casos de Ébola - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO records a sharp drop in Ebola cases - O País - The truth as news
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, the World Health Organization reports a sharp reduction in suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, from over 900 to 116 after epidemiological investigations discarded hundreds of notifications. The DRC outbreak has 321 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 48 deaths, and 6 recoveries. Uganda confirms six new infections among contacts of previously identified cases, bringing its total to 15. Authorities maintain a high state of alert. The WHO warns that outbreak control hinges on rapid contact tracing, active surveillance, and reinforced prevention measures to prevent further transmission. The situation remains under close surveillance by health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ患者数の急激な減少を記録 - O País - ニュースとしての真実
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な発展、国際的拡大リスク）。確認症例、死亡者、複数国への拡大、継続的な感染伝播リスク有。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames IDが対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCおよびウガンダでの確認症例、死亡者、継続的な接触者への感染拡大が報告されている。WHOによる継続的な監視体制が確立されている。記事では患者数が減少傾向を示しているが、依然として活動的な伝播が継続中。
