article.articleSummary: Isoka District in Zambia launched the second round of the polio vaccination campaign using Novel Oral Polio Vaccine Type 2 (nOPV2) to protect children under five against the circulating variant poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2). The launch took place at Sansamwenje Market and was led by Acting Isoka District Commissioner Kenneth Mwantalasha, who urged parents and guardians to participate. The report does not provide any case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or infection sources. This campaign highlights ongoing public-health efforts to curb cVDPV2 transmission through immunization outreach. No mention of imported or exported poliovirus cases. Published 2026-06-03, using the date for current timing.

triage.headline_ja: Isoka District launches second round of polio vaccination - Muvi TV
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、確認された患者数、死亡者、または新規感染事例の報告がない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事はザンビアのIsoka Districtにおけるポリオワクチン接種キャンペーン（第2ラウンド）の実施を報告しているもの。患者発症例、死亡例、または実験室確認例の報告がなく、公衆衛生上の危機的な出来事ではなく、予防接種推進活動の報告である。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情風險國返台「無症狀」旅客邊境監測 四國際機場免費採檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Border monitoring for asymptomatic travelers returning to Taiwan from Ebola-risk countries; four international airports offer free testing.
article.articleSummary: On 3 June 2026, Taiwan announced border-monitoring for asymptomatic travelers with travel history to Ebola-affected areas, specifically the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Free, voluntary Ebola testing will be offered at four international airports—Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan International, Taichung, and Kaohsiung—from 3–30 June. A 5 ml whole-blood sample will be collected in HEPA-equipped testing rooms by quarantine officers wearing PPE; in addition to a health advisory, testing is voluntary and the program will be reviewed as international conditions evolve. The measure follows WHO’s 17 May PHEIC declaration for the DRC and Uganda outbreaks. If travelers from these regions are symptomatic on arrival, they will receive medical referral and rapid hospital evaluation through border-response channels. Inbound travelers should report daily health status for 21 days via the national e-reporting system; noncompliance carries penalties of NT$10,000–NT$150,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行リスク国から帰国する無症状旅客の境界監視 4つの国際空港で無料検査
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の境界対応措置であり異常・予想外の公衆衛生施策だが、台湾での実際の患者発生はなく情報が限定的。DRC・ウガンダでの流行を受けた予防的措置のため、監視継続が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダでの流行を背景としているが、実際のイベント発生地はこれらではなく台湾での境界対応措置。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。DRC(203312)はリストに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは台湾での予防措置が主題であり、DRC・ウガンダでの新規患者発生や流行拡大の記述がないため除外。情報不足のため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Africa: Should South Africans be concerned?
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province, with confirmed cases also in Uganda, is caused by Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine. As of early June 2026, DRC has 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths; Uganda reports 15 cases and 1 death. The World Health Organization declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May 2026. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, body fluids or tissues, contaminated materials, or during traditional burials; it is not airborne. South Africa has no active transmission and remains at low risk due to distance and preparedness; SA hosts Africa's only Biosafety Level 4 lab and monitors arrivals from affected regions. Historically SA has had two Ebola cases, both imported from Gabon in 1996. Travelers returning from affected areas with fever, vomiting, diarrhea or unexplained bleeding should isolate and seek medical care promptly; vigilance, not panic, is advised.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ: 南アフリカ人は懸念すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。WHOが2026年5月に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言した確定エボラ患者336例・死亡49例の多国家発生であり、ワクチン未承認株による重篤な流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは南アフリカを地理的参照及びリスク評価の文脈で言及しているが、エボラの実際の発生はDRC東部Ituri州及びウガンダに限定されている。Gabon・Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当し、verified_locationsに含める。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株による多国家発生、WHO PHEIC宣言、死亡率の高さにより極めて高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en el Congo: casos confirmados suben a 344
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: confirmed cases rise to 344.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo rise to 344 with 60 deaths, per the latest bulletin on June 2, 2026. The Ituri province remains the epicenter with 322 infections and 46 deaths, a border area with Uganda and South Sudan, keeping authorities on high alert. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, whose case fatality is estimated between 30% and 50%, and for which the WHO notes no authorized vaccine or definitive treatment. The disease has spread to North and South Kivu provinces and into Ugandan territory, where 15 infections and 1 death are recorded. Bunia's airport, closed for two weeks, has reopened. Health authorities report 116 suspected cases under investigation, 173 people in preventive isolation, and six recoveries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱：確認された症例が344件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（344確認症例、60死亡）、異常な出来事、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで15症例確認）、渡航制限の可能性（空港閉鎖）。また複数のWPRO基準該当し、国際支援が必要な危機的状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例確認も記載されているが、発生地域としてはDRC（South Kivu Province、Ituri Province）が主要な流行地。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で致死率30～50%、ワクチン・治療法なし。国際的な懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : pourquoi l'OMS a revu à la baisse le bilan de l'épidémie en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: why the WHO revised downward the toll of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO revised downward the toll of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, reporting 437 Ebola-related cases as of May 31, with 321 laboratory-confirmed and 116 suspected. This contrasts with earlier estimates exceeding 1,000 cases. The revision follows field investigations and laboratory analyses that showed many initially suspected cases were Ebola-negative; many patients actually had other diseases or fever without Ebola symptoms. Since outbreak start, 48 deaths and 6 recoveries have been recorded. Despite the lower case count, authorities, with WHO and partners, have intensified surveillance, rapid isolation of cases, and strengthened infection prevention in care settings. Border controls and contact tracing are ongoing; contacts are followed for 21 days—the maximum incubation period. Investigations continue to confirm or rule out remaining suspected cases, with ongoing updates expected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の死者数を下方修正した理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率と国際的な懸念を持つ指定感染症であり、DRCでの確定症例報告はシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行の症例数修正を報告。WHOによる検査結果の再評価により、以前の1,000例超から437例（確定321例、疑い116例）に下方修正された。48例の死亡が記録されている。DRCはエボラ流行の著名な歴史を持つ国であり、国際的な公衆衛生への懸念が高い。対象国リストにはDRCが含まれていないが（203312はコンゴ民主共和国で、CEPR対象国リストに明示されていない）、グローバルな感染症危機管理の観点から関連情報として注記する。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo nu poate juca în Spania din cauza focarului de Ebola: "Cea mai prudentă decizie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo cannot play in Spain due to the Ebola outbreak: "The most prudent decision."
article.articleSummary: La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain, banned the 9 June World Cup warm-up match between the DR Congo and Chile at the municipal stadium due to an Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo. The mayor's decree cites the Ebola situation and documentation not fully demonstrating zero risk, calling it the most prudent decision. The DR Congo national team had prepared for the tournament in Belgium, with most players and staff in Europe, and medical authorities say they are in daily contact with FIFA and strictly adhere to sanitary protocols. DR Congo's coach Sebastien Desabre indicated the issue is about the venue, not the match itself, and they will respect health decisions. DR Congo returns to the FIFA World Cup after a 52-year absence; last appearance was in 1974 when the team played as Zaire.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ流行のためスペインでの試合を行えない：「最も慎重な決定」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発症国（DRC）が対象国リストに含まれており、国際的な影響（スポーツイベント中止）が生じているが、実際の感染症流行の詳細情報が記事に不足しており、スペイン等での感染は確認されていない。情報充実を待って判定する。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン（対象国外）でのスポーツイベント中止を報じているが、実際のエボラ流行イベントはDRCで発生。DRCの患者数、死亡数、流行状況の詳細情報は記事に含まれておらず、スペイン・ベルギー・チリでの感染確認なし。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: "رقم صادم" يقلب الموازين.. منظمة الصحة تفجر مفاجأة حول تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو! - وكالة ستيب نيوز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Shocking figure upends the balance... The World Health Organization drops a bombshell about the Ebola outbreak in Congo! - Step News Agency"
article.articleSummary: Outbreak update: Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows a dramatic decline in suspected cases as of May 31. The World Health Organization reports 116 suspected cases, 321 confirmed infections, and 48 deaths, with neighboring Uganda recording 9 cases and 1 death. The drop follows precise laboratory testing revealing that most patients with Ebola-like symptoms were suffering from other illnesses or benign fevers, allowing rapid exclusion from the outbreak. The culprit is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer strain with no approved treatments or vaccines. Challenges persist due to remote geography, slow early detection, difficulty in isolating patients, rigorous contact tracing, and safe burial requirements. In hopeful news, five patients in Bunia have recovered. CEPI has allocated 53 million euros to accelerate three experimental vaccines, led by IAVI, Moderna, and the University of Oxford, with manufacturing at the Serum Institute of India, aiming to end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 「衝撃的な数字」が天秤を傾ける...世界保健機関がコンゴでの「エボラ」感染拡大について爆弾情報を発表！
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の確定患者321名、死亡48名を報告。IHR基準では異常性（稀なエボラ株の出現）と国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境拡大）が該当。WPROスクリーニングでは異常性、重症度、流行易性、管理可能性が複数該当し、WHOが重要なワクチン開発投資（5300万ユーロ）を実施していることから社会政治的関心も高い。フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの発生も報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations に追加しない。DRCはエボラ発生の主要舞台、インドはセラム・インスティチュート・オブ・インディアでのワクチン製造拠点として記載されており、両国とも含める。2026年6月時点の情報として、既に複数月にわたる発生が継続している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: São Raimundo Nonato intensifica combate à tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Raimundo Nonato steps up the fight against tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: On June 3, 2026, São Raimundo Nonato, through the Municipal Health Secretariat, intensified tuberculosis control in the Serra da Capivara Territory in Piauí. Led by Ivone Venâncio, Coordinator of the State TB Coordination at Sesapi, technicians conducted technical visits to Basic Health Units (UBS) and held strategy-alignment meetings at the municipal sede, which serves as a regional hub for TB control. The sessions outlined patient-care workflows, monitoring strategies, and measures to raise the quality of TB services, aiming to strengthen the health network, expand early diagnosis, and boost prevention and control across the region. Mayor Rogério Castro underscored the indispensable partnership with Sesapi to enhance public health policies and deliver more efficient care to the population.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ライムンド・ノナト、結核対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の地域流行疾患であり、記事はブラジルのピアウイ州における通常の公衆衛生対策強化の報告である。異常性、深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核という既知疾患の地域レベルでの対策強化に関する行政ニュースであり、新規の感染症シグナルではない。異常な発生状況、重症度の増加、国際的関心の兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Foreign nationals working at NIH charged with smuggling monkeypox into US at Metro Airport
article.articleSummary: Two foreign NIH researchers, Vincent Munster (53, Dutch) and Claude Kwe (38, Cameroonian), were charged with conspiracy to smuggle monkeypox into the United States and lying to federal authorities after arriving at Detroit Metropolitan Airport (McNamara Terminal) on January 25, 2026, from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, where a monkeypox outbreak was active. They are employed in a Biosafety Level 4 facility at NIH's Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Hamilton, Montana. Customs and Border Protection and FBI investigations recovered 113 vials in a large black case; FBI testing of 20 vials found 17 contained deactivated monkeypox virus, 1 contained chickenpox virus, and 2 contained human DNA. The case, filed in the Eastern District of Michigan, highlights import/export concerns of high-risk pathogens; U.S. Attorney Jerome F. Gorgon described the violations.

triage.headline_ja: NIH職員の外国人研究者がメトロ空港でサル痘密輸で起訴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（予想外の高リスク病原体密輸事案、国際的な公衆衛生への影響）。また、WPRO基準でも異常性、管理可能性に該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ（Brazzaville）からの密輸事案だが、Bluedot APIが米国の複数州を検出。サマリーより、発症例報告ではなく病原体密輸・刑事事件である。DRCは発生源地として該当。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加しない。高リスク病原体（BSL-4）の不正輸入という異例の事案として特に重要。

article.articleHeadline: DRC suggests behind-closed-doors World Cup warm-up to offset Ebola threat
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak declared in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo in mid-May triggers health concerns over a planned June 9 pre-World Cup friendly against Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain, leading the mayor to cancel the match. DRC coach Sebastien Desabre offered to play behind closed doors or at another venue. The squad, which cancelled home pre-camp and has been based in Belgium, is under FIFA-aligned medical precautions with doctors coordinating with FIFA. The 2026 World Cup runs June 11–July 19 and is cohosted by the US, Canada and Mexico; Congo will base in Houston for Group K, facing Portugal on June 17, Colombia in Guadalajara on June 24, and Uzbekistan in Atlanta on June 28. US authorities require Congo to isolate 21 days before entering the United States. This is DRC’s first World Cup appearance since 1974 (as Zaire).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴはエボラ脅威に対抗するため、非公開でのワールドカップ練習試合を提案
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、東コンゴでのエボラアウトブレイク宣言（unusual_unexpected: Yes）、国際的な拡大リスク（international_spread: Yes、複数国への移動）、渡航制限（US当局の21日間隔離要件により travel_trade_restriction: Yes）の3基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、国際的な流行性、管理可能性の課題が明確であり、対象国DRCでの実際の発生が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで宣言されたエボラアウトブレイクであり、スペインでのワールドカップ練習試合キャンセル、ベルギームでの拠点、米国への入国隔離要件など、エボラ感染者の国際移動リスクが直接的に関連している。Bluedot APIが複数国（メキシコ、スペイン、米国など）を識別地域として列挙しているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCの東部であり、他国はワールドカップ関連の二次的な影響地である。

article.articleHeadline: สธ.ยันโควิดสายพันธุ์ NB.1.8.1 เป็นสายพันธุ์หลักพบในไทย ยังไม่พบหลักฐานก่อโรครุนแรงเพิ่มขึ้น
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Public Health reiterates that the COVID-19 variant NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant found in Thailand, and there is no evidence that it causes more severe disease.
article.articleSummary: NB.1.8.1 SARS-CoV-2 variant remains the predominant lineage in Thailand, with no evidence it causes more severe illness than earlier strains. As of 2 June 2026, the Digital Disease Surveillance system recorded 4,156 COVID-19 cases and 1 death. The most affected age group is 30–39, followed by 60+, then 20–29. Over the prior month, cases rose seasonally but stayed below the five-year median. Genomic surveillance of 1 Jan 2025–23 Apr 2026 shows NB.1.8.1 circulating at 50.95%, JN.1 at 24.97%, and XEC at 9.14%. NB.1.8.1 carries mutations that may enhance transmissibility and immune evasion, yet current data do not indicate increased severity or mortality risk. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, and runny nose. Thailand operates 26 sentinel hospitals for respiratory infections, with systematic lab analyses; abnormal signals trigger further testing by the Department of Medical Sciences to identify strains and assess public health risk.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省、COVID-19変異株NB.1.8.1がタイの主流株であることを改めて確認、より重症化する証拠はないと発表
triage.triage_reason: 既知の流行株の継続監視報告であり、重症化の増加傾向なし。IHR基準2つ以上該当せず、スクリーニング基準による懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: タイ保健省による定期的な疫学報告。NB.1.8.1は既知の変異株で、記事は「重症化の証拠がない」と明記している。症例数（4,156例、死亡1例）は過去5年平均を下回っており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認識されていない。新型コロナウイルス感染症は既に周知の疾患であり、この報告は標準的なサーベイランス活動の一部である。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria encontrada na Água Crystal é perigosa para todos? Veja quem corre mais risco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacterium found in Crystal Water is dangerous for everyone? See who is at greater risk.
article.articleSummary: Pseudomonas aeruginosa detected in Crystal Water (Água Crystal) prompts voluntary recall of 374,400 bottles distributed in the Distrito Federal, Goiás, Tocantins, and the interior of São Paulo. The affected batch LZ1 VAL200127 3 P 200126, produced in Luziânia, Goiás, is being withdrawn after Lacen-DF confirmed the bacterium; a contraprova upheld contamination and Anvisa notified the recall by Mineração Bom Jesus. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is common in water and soil and is an opportunistic pathogen, with the highest risk for immunosuppressed individuals—cancer patients, transplant recipients, uncontrolled HIV/AIDS, long-term corticosteroid/immunosuppressant users, and autoimmune-disease patients. Infections range from mild to potentially fatal, especially for diabetics, cystic fibrosis patients, hospitalized, and severely ill individuals. About 99.2% of bottles have been removed; no consumer complaints reported. Investigation ongoing; contamination appears limited to this batch.

triage.headline_ja: Crystal Water（クリスタルウォーター）で検出された細菌は誰にとって危険か？より危険な人を確認してください
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはPseudomonas aeruginosaによるミネラルウォーター汚染事案であり、HIV/AIDSは記事の文脈において「高リスク免疫不全患者の例示」として言及されているに過ぎない。水系感染症アウトブレイク自体ではなく、製品リコール事案であり、IHR基準及びWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はPseudomonas aeruginosaのミネラルウォーター汚染による製品リコールであり、感染症アウトブレイクではない。HIVは高リスク患者層の説明的な例示としてのみ記載されている。消費者苦情なし、99.2%のボトルが回収済みであり、感染症危機管理の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تحديات أمنية ولوجستية تعرقل احتواء تفشي إيبولا في وسط إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Security and logistical challenges impede the containment of the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda faces complex challenges that may slow containment, with hundreds of confirmed and suspected cases and cross-border transmission to Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or targeted therapy exists. In May 2026, WHO declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Key obstacles include armed conflict and insecurity in eastern DRC, large-scale displacement hindering contact tracing and patient access. Limited diagnostic capacity and shortages of testing and treatment supplies; initial tests were not designed for Bundibugyo, delaying confirmed diagnoses. Misinformation and mistrust in communities, plus concerns that border closures could drive informal crossings and complicate surveillance. WHO continues coordinating with governments and international partners to strengthen surveillance, contact tracing, and medical/logistical support, with reported recoveries offering some optimism.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：セキュリティと物流上の課題がアフリカ中部のエボラ流行の封じ込めを阻害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、既に複数国での確認）。Bundibugyo株のエボラで治療法なし、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み、確認・疑い症例が数百件、ウガンダへの越境感染確認。即座にフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当（ウガンダは対象外）。2026年5月時点でWHOはPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株で認可ワクチン・標的療法なし。越境感染、武力紛争による接触追跡困難、診断容量不足が主要な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉病毒！我針對剛果、烏干達入境免費採檢 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Ebola virus! Free entry screening for travelers arriving from the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: WHO declared Ebola virus disease a Public Health Emergency of International Concern last month, triggering heightened border protections. In Taiwan, the Ministry of Health and Welfare will provide free voluntary Ebola testing at four international airports from June 2–30 for asymptomatic nationals and inbound travelers with travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda. In addition to issuing self-health management reminders for 21 days, border screening includes quarantine staff in full PPE. Four airports: Taoyuan International Airport, Songshan Airport, Taichung's Ching-Chuan-Kang Airport, and Kaohsiung International Airport (Xiaogang). Earlier, Taiwan's CDC suspended entry of residents from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Taiwan reinforces port-of-entry controls amid growing Ebola concerns in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスを防止！コンゴとウガンダからの入国者に対する無料検査スクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラウイルス病をPHEIC宣言し、台湾がアフリカ発生地域からの入国者に対する積極的な検査・制限措置を実施。ただし、台湾での患者発生報告がなく、アフリカ地域の発生状況の詳細が不明であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにTaiwanが含まれているが、記事サマリーから台湾はエボラ患者発生国ではなく、対応国である。実際のエボラウイルス病の発生地は民主共和国コンゴとウガンダであり、台湾は予防的措置を講じている。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみがエボラ発生地として確認される。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。IHR基準4つ全て該当し、PHEI宣言済みのため通常はPICKUPだが、記事サマリーに具体的な患者数・死亡数などの重篤度データが不足し、アフリカでの実際の流行状況の詳細が不明であるため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 900 அல்ல 116... இபோலா எண்ணிக்கை குறைந்தது
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not 900, but 116... The Ebola case count has fallen.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, the number of people suspected of Ebola has fallen to 116, down from about 900 last week, according to the World Health Organization. Many of the suspected cases were later found to have other illnesses that nonetheless presented with Ebola-like symptoms. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 344 Ebola infections have been confirmed, with 60 deaths reported. In Uganda, neighboring the DRC, 15 infections have been recorded, including one death. The ongoing outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo virus. There is currently no licensed preventive drug or approved treatment for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: Not 900, but 116... The Ebola case count has fallen.
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo virus株）の確認症例が344件、死亡60件（DRC）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかであり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当。国際的な動向（WHO報告）と複数国への拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的に述べられているのはDRC（344確認症例、60死亡）およびウガンダ（15症例、1死亡）の発生。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。病原体はBundibugyo virus（エボラの亜種）で、治療法・予防薬がない状況。WHO報告による症例数の急減（900→116）は疑い症例の精査による可能性があるが、確認症例は継続増加中と推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: CEPI Financia Desenvolvimento de Vacina Contra o Vírus Com 60M$
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: CEPI funds development of Ebola vaccine with $60M.
article.articleSummary: CEPI plans roughly $60 million in funding to Moderna and two other groups to accelerate vaccine development against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, focused in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). No vaccines or treatments are approved for this variant. CEPI chief Richard Hatchett told Reuters that vaccines could enter clinical trials within a few months, underscoring urgency as every day counts. The outbreak has 321 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with about 116 suspected cases, per Africa CDC and the World Health Organization. Six new cases were confirmed in Uganda, raising total infections there to 15. Global health agencies have declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The funding seeks to expedite vaccine development and inform planning for purchase and distribution of doses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：CEPIがウイルスワクチン開発に6000万ドルを資金提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予期しない新規流行株、複数国での国際的拡大、WHOがPHEIC宣言）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。国際支援が進行中で、公衆衛生上の最優先課題。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部で発生中のBundibugyo株エボラ熱アウトブレイクに関する報道。ウガンダ（対象国外）への拡大も言及されているが、実際の発生地の主軸はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。既にWHOがPHEIC宣言し、ワクチン開発に国際的資金が投入されている緊急事態。確認症例321件、死亡42件の重大な規模。

article.articleHeadline: Pour une solidarité sanitaire africaine face à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: For African health solidarity in the face of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks have been declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In Dakar, Jean-Michel Sama Lukonde Kyenge, president of the DRC Senate and head of the African Parliamentary Union, called for stronger African health solidarity to confront the Ebola threat, emphasising the need for massive investments in health systems, scientific research, health-worker training, and local production of medicines and vaccines. He framed the Ebola resurgence within broader regional instability and humanitarian crises, urging respect for international law, protection of migrants, and peaceful dispute resolution. He also linked climate change to health resilience, urging climate justice and transfer of green technologies, noting DRC’s Congo Basin forests as ecological assets. The 85th UPA session runs through 4 June 2026, evaluating actions, finances, and leadership reforms to amplify Africa’s multilateral health voice.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに対するアフリカの保健連帯のために
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の集団発生がDRCとウガンダで宣言されており、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、WPRO基準で「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当。また高い国際的・社会的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ集団発生を明示している。DRCは対象国リスト内のため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Senegalはダカールでの会議開催地であり、実際のエボラ発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: एम्स में इबोला वायरस के बारे में दी गई जानकारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Information about the Ebola virus provided at AIIMS.
article.articleSummary: Information about the Ebola virus was conveyed at AIIMS in Gorakhpur on Wednesday, June 3, 2026, through an OPD-based awareness campaign. Doctors from Community Medicine, Medicine, and Microbiology explained Ebola transmission, symptoms and prevention to patients and caregivers. They noted that India currently has no Ebola cases, while some African countries have reported infections, prompting heightened vigilance. The government has strengthened surveillance and screening at international airports. Ebola is characterized by sudden fever, weakness, headache, muscle pains, and bleeding. The campaign emphasized early recognition and protective measures. No laboratory-confirmed cases in India were reported in the article; no specific local outbreaks were mentioned beyond Africa. The report underscores public health preparedness in India.

triage.headline_ja: AIIMSでエボラウイルスに関する情報提供
triage.triage_reason: インドではエボラウイルス患者が確認されておらず、アフリカ諸国での報告を受けての啓発キャンペーンにすぎない。実際の感染症イベントではなく予防啓蒙活動のため、シグナルとしてピックアップの対象外。
triage.notes: 記事内容はインドでのエボラウイルス啓発キャンペンの実施報告であり、実際の患者発生事例ではない。インドにおけるエボラ患者はゼロと明記されている。政府の監視体制強化に関する言及はあるが、これは予防対応であり、シグナル検出には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Пять заключенных с симптомами Эболы сбежали из изоляторов в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five prisoners with Ebola symptoms escaped from isolation wards in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Five prisoners with Ebola symptoms escaped from isolation wards in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo. They were transferred from Bunia central prison where signs of Ebola were detected; three were sent to Ruampara Medical Center and two to Bunia Hospital. Police refused to guard the isolated patients due to infection risk, allowing the escape. Their current whereabouts are unknown as authorities conduct an active manhunt; residents were alerted and urged to avoid contact with the fugitives. Bunia prison has stepped up medical surveillance to prevent further spread. This incident comes amid the ongoing outbreak in eastern DRC, with the epicenter in Ituri. Previously, KP.RU reported that deaths from Ebola reached 60 and infections 344 in the current outbreak; cases also identified in neighboring Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ザイール出血熱（エボラ）の症状を示す囚人5人がコンゴ民主共和国の隔離棟から逃亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認された患者が隔離施設から逃亡し、所在不明となっており、IHR基準で重大な公衆衛生影響（死亡60例、感染344例の進行中のアウトブレイク）、異常事態、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの既知の波及）、渡航・貿易制限リスクを満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行性・管理可能性で複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）にも波及報告があるが、主たる事件発生地はDRCであり、サマリーの焦点もDRC東部イトゥリ州ブニアの逃亡事件。隔離患者の逃亡という封じ込め破綻事象は極めて高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Doi cercetători au fost reținuți în SUA pentru că au încercat să introducă virusul mpox inactivat, adus din Africa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two researchers were detained in the United States for attempting to introduce the inactivated mpox virus brought from Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two NIH virology researchers, Dutch Vincent Munster and Cameroonian Claude Kwe, were charged in the United States after attempting to bring mpox (monkeypox) virus—an inactivated African isolate—into the country. They were detained in January at Detroit airport returning from Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo, with 113 vials; 17 of 20 tested by the FBI contained inactivated mpox virus. Both work at a Montana P4 laboratory and face up to five years in prison for possession and for misrepresenting the bag contents. The case follows the African Union health agency’s January assertion that mpox is no longer a public health emergency in Africa. From January through July 2025, over 34,000 mpox cases were reported to WHO, with 138 deaths. Mpox causes high fever and vesicular skin lesions; identified in 1958, with outbreaks expanding in 2022 to over 70 countries.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカで2人の研究者が、アフリカから持ち込んだ不活化mpoxウイルスを導入しようとして逮捕された
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade Iの国際的な移動に関わる不法行為の報告であり、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）とWPRO基準（異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）を複数満たしている。DRC関連の感染症イベントとして検知の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、事件の起点はDRC（ブラザビル）からの持ち出しであり、検出地はUSAである。対象国リストに基づき、実際にMpoxイベントが発生している国はDRCのみとして検証した。2026年6月時点のデータだが、2025年のMpox流行統計（34,000症例、138死亡）を参照している。

article.articleHeadline: ADB'yi karıştıran olay! İki bilim insanı virüs dolu şişeleri gizlice ülkeye sokarken yakalandı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The incident that rocked ADB! Two scientists were caught secretly smuggling virus-laden vials into the country.
article.articleSummary: Two virologists, Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, at a U.S. government–affiliated laboratory, were intercepted at an airport while attempting to smuggle mpox (monkeypox) virus–containing vials from Africa into the United States. They had just returned from a nine-day research visit in the Republic of the Congo in January; customs checks found Munster had lied about carrying biological samples. FBI inquiries showed the vials were brought into the U.S. without declarations or permits. Both scientists reportedly conducted extensive mpox research; court filings do not explain their intended use. Munster claimed documents were on his computer, a claim the FBI said was false. They are due in a federal Montana court on Wednesday. Mpox typically presents with rash and fever; most recover, but severe cases occur; the disease has caused global outbreaks since 2022.

triage.headline_ja: ADB'を揺るがした事件！2人の科学者がウイルス入りのバイアルを密かに国内に密輸しながら捕まった
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は密輸事件の法執行関連ニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク・公衆衛生上の事象ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件は違法な生物サンプル密輸に関する法執行事案であり、感染症アウトブレイク・流行の証拠はない。DRCへの訪問記載があるため verified_locations に含めたが、感染症危機管理・シグナル検出の対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: US confident Kenya will allow setup of Ebola quarantine facility
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains the focal disease, with the Democratic Republic of Congo as the epicentre of an active outbreak; Uganda reports high secondary exposure with confirmed cross-border transmission; South Sudan remains at critical risk due to its proximity to the epicentre. The United States plans to prevent Ebola from entering the US by banning travellers from DRC, Uganda and South Sudan and by sending exposed American citizens to a quarantine facility it seeks to establish in Kenya. Kenyan authorities, including President William Ruto, defend the plan despite local pushback; hundreds demonstrated in Nanyuki, 140 km north of Nairobi. A Kenyan high court ruling has delayed any work on the facility for approximately three weeks. The plan ties to broader preventive measures ahead of events such as the FIFA World Cup; no lab-confirmed case details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラ隔離施設の設置を認めることに米国が確信
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラの活発な流行がDRCで継続し、ウガンダへの越境感染確認、南スーダンでリスク高い。米国を含む国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはケニア、ウガンダ、南スーダン、米国も含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（流行の震源地）でのエボラ継続流行とその国際的波及である。ケニアは隔離施設の設置予定地であり、流行地ではない。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際のイベント発生地。WPRO基準は対象地域外だが、IHR基準3つ以上該当でPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: UNAIDS supports efforts to ramp up Ebola and HIV response amid evolving Ebola situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to evolve, with cases in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, prompting intensified surveillance and preparedness and heightened border screening by neighboring countries. UNAIDS is supporting uninterrupted HIV treatment and care, integrating HIV into the National Ebola Preparedness and Response Plan (launched 21 May 2026) and aiding the HIV Mitigation Plan to protect people living with HIV and health workers, ensure continuity of ART, and strengthen surveillance in affected zones. DRC has about 610,000 people living with HIV. Community workers report elevated risk and PPE gaps during ART distribution. UNAIDS also assists Uganda with rapid essential-service assessments in high-risk districts, and helps Angola and Burundi bolster border-area HIV preparedness. The organization advocates for including HIV community organizations and resources for community-based monitoring during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: UNAIDS、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにおける進化するエボラ情勢の中、エボラとHIV対応の強化を支援
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当：エボラ出血熱の多地域での継続的な流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響をもたらし、隣国での対応が必要であり、国際的に異常・予想外の状況。複数国での国境スクリーニング強化により、渡航・貿易制限リスクが顕在化している。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州）でのエボラ継続流行を主題としている。ウガンダ、ブルンジ、アンゴラは支援対象国として言及されるが、これらの国での実際の発生は記事に明記されていない。従いてverified_locationsはDRCのみとする。HIV患者約610,000人を抱えるDRCでの複合感染リスク、PPE不足、国境地域での準備体制強化が記述され、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念が明らかである。

article.articleHeadline: Yoane Wissa fitness blow as Ebola outbreak cancels World Cup warm-up match
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in DR Congo prompted cancellation of DR Congo’s World Cup warm-up vs Chile in Cadiz, Spain, after La Linea de la Concepcion mayor Juan Franco issued a health-risk decree for June 9. DR Congo relocated their pre-tournament camp to Belgium, with Kinshasa’s camp scrapped, and they are due to face Denmark in a friendly in Liege tonight. The US has barred entry for people who have been in DR Congo, Uganda or South Sudan in the previous 21 days, complicating travel as the outbreak persists; officials warn a vaccine for this strain could take nine months. DR Congo open Group K against Portugal in Houston on June 17, then Colombia in Guadalajara on June 24, and Uzbekistan in Atlanta on June 28. Newcastle forward Yoane Wissa will feature for DR Congo, aiming to build form after three goals last season and a knee injury that delayed his start, ahead of the World Cup and pre-season.

triage.headline_ja: ヨアネ・ウィッサがエボラ流行による影響を受ける：ワールドカップ暖機試合キャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの検出）、複数国での旅行制限実施、国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）への影響など、IHR基準2つ以上を満たし、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行が主題。記事サマリーに米国、ベルギー、スペイン、デンマークなどへの影響が記載されているが、これらは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。ウガンダ（対象国）と南スーダンは記事で言及されているが、発生地域として確認されていないため含めない。ワールドカップという国際イベント関連のため社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Countries tighten travel rules amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompts tightened travel rules as of 2026-06-03. Despite WHO guidance against travel restrictions on May 31, many countries impose entry bans, quarantines, and enhanced screening for travellers from DRC or Uganda. United States bars foreign nationals who visited DRC/Uganda in the past 21 days; Canada bans entry for residents who recently visited affected areas for 90 days, with 21-day quarantines for asymptomatic travellers. Rwanda denies entry to foreign nationals who transited the DRC within 30 days; Kenya activated enhanced screening and holding facilities. Tanzania requires online pre-screening and on-site temperature checks; Zambia expanded Ebola screening at ports. Thailand, India, Singapore, and South Korea require health declarations and screenings with possible 21-day quarantines; Mexico tightens airport screening and urges 21-day quarantine for arrivals from the region; EU says entry screening not necessary. KLM cancels select flights to Entebbe; BBC reports three new vaccines under development for Bundibugyo strain (June 2).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生に伴い各国が渡航規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限が明らかであり3基準を満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、長期曝露、流行しやすさが該当する。エボラ出血熱は報告義務疾患であり国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）のDRCおよびウガンダでの発生を主題としており、複数の対象国が渡航制限を実施している。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には対象国外の国々も多く含まれているため、サマリーに基づいて実際に発生している対象国のみをverified_locationsに限定した。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い感染リスク、死亡率、国際的な拡大可能性を有し、IHR通知基準を明確に満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Presos sospechosos de Ébola se fugan ante autoridades temerosas de infectarse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prisoners suspected of Ebola escape as authorities fear becoming infected.
article.articleSummary: Five prisoners in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, identified as suspected Ebola cases, were moved from the central prison to treatment centers. Two escaped from one hospital and three from another health facility in the same area, and authorities say they remain missing. The escape occurred after police refused to provide direct surveillance inside the facilities due to fears of contracting Ebola. The prisoners were transferred following symptom detection, but there was no police protection inside the centers at the time of the escape, raising concerns about infection control and public health risk to staff and local communities. Local media reported the incident on 2026-06-03.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い患者の受刑者が脱獄、当局者が感染を恐れる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、エボラウイルス病の疑い患者の脱獄による感染制御リスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い患者（5名）の脱獄は極めて重大なリスク要因。治療施設からの警察保護撤退、逃亡患者の行方不明、地域コミュニティへの感染リスク増大。Ituri州の保健・安全保障状況も懸念される。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria encontrada em lote de água Crystal é a mesma identificada em produtos da Ypê
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The bacterium found in a batch of Crystal water is the same as the one identified in Ypê products.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-03, Brazil's National Health Surveillance Agency (Anvisa) ordered the recall of a Crystal mineral water batch after laboratory confirmation of Pseudomonas aeruginosa. The case follows months after the same bacterium was found in Ypê products, triggering a voluntary recall and tighter regulatory scrutiny. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is widespread in water, soil, air and on skin, and is an opportunistic pathogen. It poses particular risk to immunocompromised individuals, including cancer patients, transplant recipients, uncontrolled HIV, and those on immunosuppressants. Infections can range from mild to severe, especially among hospitalized patients or with preexisting conditions. The bacterium proliferates in moist environments such as sinks, bathrooms, inadequately treated pools, and expired antiseptic solutions. Authorities stress ongoing quality control for consumer and domestic-use items and continuous surveillance to prevent health risks to the population.

triage.headline_ja: クリスタル水で発見された細菌はイペー製品で特定されたものと同じ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジルにおける水製品の細菌汚染（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）についてであり、HIV疾患そのものの発生ではない。疾患分類の誤マッピングと考えられ、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが疾患名を『HIV』と分類しているが、記事の実質的内容はPseudomonas aeruginosaによる水製品汚染事案である。HIV患者が易感染性グループとして言及されているのみで、HIV感染症の流行や発症者に関する情報ではない。これは環境汚染・製品品質管理の問題であり、感染症公衆衛生シグナルとして処理すべきではない。

article.articleHeadline: Carolina Dieckmann é internada com infecção avançada no rim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carolina Dieckmann is hospitalized with an advanced kidney infection.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03, Brazilian actress Carolina Dieckmann remains hospitalized for four days in a hospital unit with an advanced infection of the left kidney. She is undergoing intensive intravenous antibiotic therapy and there is no announced discharge date. The timely diagnosis reportedly prevented potential complications during an upcoming trip to a remote, hard-to-access destination. The post also served as a reminder to fans to seek evaluation for body pains before conditions worsen. While hospitalized, Dieckmann marked her 23-year relationship anniversary with director Tiago Worcman; she thanked him for steadfast daily support and expressed gratitude to close friends sending good wishes. The article does not mention other illnesses or laboratory confirmation details beyond the diagnosis of an advanced left kidney infection.

triage.headline_ja: カロリーナ・ディエックマンが進行性の腎臓感染症で入院
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医学的事例（著名人の腎臓感染症）であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生の証拠がなく、疾患名が「Unknown Illness」と不特定で、国際的拡大リスクもない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個々の著名人の医療事例に関するエンターテイメント記事であり、公衆衛生上の感染症イベント（集団発生、流行、アウトブレイク）ではない。腎臓感染症は細菌性尿路感染症の既知の合併症であり、異常ではない。シグナルとしてピックアップする根拠がない。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية: 344 حالة إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا.. و60 حالة وفاة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director of Global Health: 344 confirmed Ebola virus infection cases and 60 deaths - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: 344 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus infections and 60 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo across 24 health zones, with suspected cases decreasing. In Uganda, one confirmed death and 15 confirmed cases have been identified, including a Congolese national who traveled to the United Arab Emirates and then Uganda. WHO is coordinating with Ugandan and UAE authorities to gather more information, assess travel-related exposure risk, and support contact tracing. An American national infected in DRC remains under treatment in Germany. WHO’s risk assessment remains very high at the national level in DRC, high regionally, and low globally. The outbreak had an early time advantage, but the response is gradually catching up under the Congolese government. Three Ebola treatment centers are planned in Bunia (80 beds total), with additional treatment units in Mangwalo, Beni, Goma, and Lokabu, and more facilities planned.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関事務局長：エボラウイルスの確認感染者344人、死亡者60人 - ザ・セブンス・デイ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大事例（DRC→ウガンダ→UAEの国際移動ケース）であり、IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、高いリスク評価。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生の主要事例を報告。ウガンダでの確認ケースも記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはリスト内（203312）で確認。DRCでの344確認症例、60死亡、24保健ゾーンにまたがる発生。WHOによるリスク評価：DRC国家レベルで非常に高い、地域レベルで高い、世界的には低い。国際的な移動ケース（DRC→UAE→ウガンダ）が存在し、ドイツで治療中のアメリカ人感染者も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Vials Found in Large Case at Detroit Airport: 2 Researchers Accused of Smuggling Mpox, Chickenpox, DNA Into US
article.articleSummary: Two NIH researchers have been charged with conspiracy to smuggle biological materials into the United States and making false statements after allegedly transporting vials containing mpox, chickenpox and human DNA from the Republic of Congo to the US. Vincent Munster, 53, from the Netherlands, and Claude Kwe, 38, from Cameroon, worked at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, a high-security Biosafety Level 4 facility. They reportedly arrived at Detroit Metropolitan Airport on January 25, 2026, from Brazzaville, Congo, where an active mpox outbreak was underway. Airport officers found 113 vials inside Styrofoam coolers within a large black case; tests identified 17 deactivated mpox vials, one chickenpox vial and two human DNA samples. If convicted, they face up to five years in prison. The materials were deactivated, but the case underscores strict declaration and transport rules for regulated materials, and mpox has been renamed by WHO from monkeypox.

triage.headline_ja: デトロイト空港で発見された大型ケース内のバイアル：2人の研究者がMpox、水痘、DNAの米国への密輸で告発
triage.triage_reason: 米国の高度に規制された生物学的物質（Mpox、水痘）の違法な輸送事件であり、IHR基準3項目に該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。生物学的物質の不正取扱いはバイオセキュリティ上の重大な懸念事項であり、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 本事件は感染症アウトブレイク発生そのものではなく、規制物質の違法輸送・バイオセキュリティ侵害事案である。発生地域にはUSA、Cameroon、Netherlands等が含まれるが、検証可能な対象国はDRCのみ（Brazzaville発地点）。材料は不活化されていたが、バイオセキュリティ体制の脆弱性を示唆。IHR Annex2基準4項目全て該当は異例であり、国際的警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Ebola response catching up as confirmed DRC cases hit 344
article.articleSummary: June 3, 2026 – The World Health Organization reports 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The outbreak had a big head start, and although progress is behind the ideal pace, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said that, under the government of the DRC, the response is catching up. The briefing on the situation notes that efforts to manage Ebola transmission are ongoing. The article provides no further details on laboratory confirmation, the infection source, or whether there are imported or exported cases. The information reflects the situation as of the briefing.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、確認されたDRC症例が344件に達したとエボラ対応が追いつきつつあると発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の確認症例344件、死亡60件という重大な公衆衛生影響を示す進行中の大規模流行。IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に複数該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）にも該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の進行中の大規模流行。記事は2026年6月3日時点で344確認症例、60死亡を報告。WHOが対応状況を定期的に監視中。輸入・輸出症例の有無については記事で不明だが、エボラの国際拡大リスクは依然高い。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en Congo ya suma 344 casos confirmados y 60 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo now totals 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) now totals 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, with six recoveries. Ituri remains the epicenter, and new hotspots in Mambasa highlight the importance of community surveillance. The Bunia airport, serving Ituri, reopened after two weeks of closure amid the crisis. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, though the World Health Organization estimates the Bundibugyo-ebola virus began circulating at least two months earlier. This strain carries a case fatality rate estimated between 30% and 50%, and no vaccine or specific treatment exists for it. On May 17, the WHO declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to rapid case growth and regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が344例の確定症例と60人の死亡者を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの国際的に重要な感染症イベント。WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項として正式認定している。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC（公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項）が2026年5月17日に宣言されている。Bundibugyo-ebola virusであり、致死率30-50%の高リスク病原体。複数地域での拡大が確認されている（Ituri州が震源地、Mambasaで新たなホットスポット）。ワクチンおよび特異的治療法なし。記事日付が2026年6月であることに留意（将来日付）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le gouvernement et ses partenaires renforcent la riposte en
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the government and its partners strengthen the response in.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, sees intensified government and partner logistics. In Bunia, the Ituri provincial government received multiple equipment consignments on 2–3 June to bolster field response, with UNICEF delivering more than 20 tonnes of materials. The Ebola Treatment Center in Rwampara was equipped with at least three jeeps and motorcycles for frontline teams. MONUSCO stepped up support on 3 June, handing over two ambulances to WHO for rapid patient evacuation, plus two armoured vehicles and a Jeep, augmenting an earlier tranche that included ambulances, all-terrain vehicles and five motorcycles. Since 18 May, MONUSCO has transported about 100 tonnes of Ebola-response materials. The combined logistics aim to accelerate patient management and intensify community outreach, promoting adherence to prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：政府とパートナーがイトゥリでの対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中の患者発生と対応強化。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも高い重症度（Yes）と長期曝露（Yes）が認められる。
triage.notes: 2026年6月3日現在、コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ患者流行が進行中。UNICEF、MONUSCO、WHOなど複数の国際機関が対応を強化している。ルワンダは隣接国として言及されているが、記事の主題は同国での発生事例ではなく対象国から除外。患者数や死亡例の具体的数字は記事に記載されていないが、治療センター設置と大規模な物資輸送から実患者発生の状況が推定される。

article.articleHeadline: World Food Programme's David Stevenson on Congo's Ebola response
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, Ebola is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with cases detected in 24 health zones nationally. In Ituri, health officials have tracked fewer than 40% of known contacts, complicating containment. The sole airport at the outbreak’s centre has reopened after suspected cases dropped. The World Health Organization reports suspected cases decreasing to 116 from more than 900 the previous week. Health authorities continue to emphasize active case finding and contact tracing amid ongoing transmission. World Food Programme country director David Stevenson notes that food assistance has played a critical role in the Ebola response, supporting affected communities and enabling health interventions through the response effort.

triage.headline_ja: 世界食糧計画のデビッド・スティーブンソンがコンゴのエボラ対応について語る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを伴い、東部DRCでの複数地域での検出と継続的な伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部DRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラウイルス病の継続的な伝播を報告。2026年6月3日時点で24保健地域で症例が検出され、疑い例は900例超から116例に減少したと報告されているが、接触者追跡率が40%未満にとどまっており、コンテイメント能力に懸念がある。国際的な支援が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: ASF risk in Wokha: Four dead pigs found near culvert; WTC launches investigation
article.articleSummary: Four dead pigs were dumped near a culvert at Airfield Colony, Wokha, triggering a WTC investigation. Another dead pig was found in a rice bag at a separate Airfield Colony location. Post-mortems have been completed; samples were sent to Kohima and then to Guwahati for laboratory ASF tests; exact cause will be confirmed once results are received. Initial investigations suggest the carcasses did not originate from local household piggeries but were likely imported pigs kept at slaughterhouses; surveys of slaughterhouses and pig inventories have been part of ASF monitoring. Officials warn that ASF and Classical Swine Fever can spread rapidly; the virus can survive in water 60-90 days and in soil 30-40 days, underscoring disposal risk. Public urged to use proper disposal facilities; two-day ultimatum to surrender dumpers; violators face legal action and possible loss of trade permits. Disposal guidance: deep burial or incineration with disinfectants.

triage.headline_ja: WokhaのASFリスク：4頭の死んだ豚が水路近くで発見、WTCが調査開始
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）と古典的豚熱の同時発生疑い、インドの2州（アッサム州、ナガランド州）で死亡事例と環境汚染リスク確認。WTO通知相当のIHR基準2項目以上該当、動物由来感染症の急速拡大可能性あり。
triage.notes: ASFとClassical Swine Fever の同時検出疑い。環境中の長期生存性（水中60-90日、土壌30-40日）と廃棄リスクから公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念される。インドでの豚疾病のASF確認は国際的な家畜衛生上の重要シグナル。サンプル検査結果の確認待ち。

article.articleHeadline: NIH Knew Researchers Allegedly Smuggled Monkeypox Into the US, but Sat on the Story for Five Months
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox mpox smuggling case: NIH researchers Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe are charged after transporting 113 vials from an active mpox outbreak zone in Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, to Detroit on a January flight. Munster, a Dutch national heading the Virus Ecology Section at NIH Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, and Kwe, a Cameroonian national, allegedly packed the vials in a black case and claimed it held diagnostic equipment with no permit. FBI testing of 20 vials found mpox deactivated in 17, chickenpox virus in one, and human DNA in two; 93 vials remain untested. They are charged with conspiracy to smuggle goods and making false statements to federal agents, each carrying a maximum of five years. NIH said it moved quickly after CBP flagged the incident; FBI, CBP, and HHS IG continue the investigation. A November 2025 Michigan case is cited in context.

triage.headline_ja: NIH職員がサルポックスを米国に密輸、NIHは5カ月間報告を隠蔽していた
triage.triage_reason: 公衆衛生上重大な影響（危険病原体の無許可国際輸送・検査不完了なサンプル）、異常性（研究機関による密輸疑い）、国際的拡大リスク（既に米国内で検出）の3つのIHR基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域には米国、オランダ、カメルーン、コンゴ共和国が含まれているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国（ブラザビル）からの密輸であり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。米国内での検出は二次的。FBI/CBP/HHS IGによる継続的捜査により、政治的・公衆衛生上の関心が非常に高い。未検査サンプル（93ビアル）の存在が追加的なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 鄭州多人確診「鸚鵡熱」 高燒成肺炎險成重症(圖)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people in Zhengzhou diagnosed with psittacosis; high fever develops into pneumonia and nearly becomes critical (photo).
article.articleSummary: Psittacosis (parrot fever), caused by Chlamydia psittaci, is affecting residents of Zhengzhou, Henan, China. On June 2, a grandfather and his grandson who won and kept a parrot contracted the infection after an outdoor ring-toss game. They developed fever and body aches and were diagnosed with psittacosis. Doctors at Zhengzhou People’s Hospital report a surge of similar cases linked to bird exposure, with high fever and bilateral pneumonia; in some patients the condition nearly progressed to critical illness due to delayed treatment. A 62-year-old man in Zhengzhou presented with fever up to 39.8°C, severe headache, dry cough, and widespread lung inflammation; his granddaughter had pneumonia a week earlier. A 56-year-old aunt who keeps parrots also contracted psittacosis pneumonia. Transmission occurs via inhalation of feather dust, dried droppings, or aerosols from birds (parrots, pigeons, ducks, turkeys). Incubation 5–21 days (up to 45); 85–90% develop pneumonia; severe disease can cause respiratory failure, myocarditis, or encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: 鄭州多人確診「鸚鵡熱」 高燒成肺炎險成重症
triage.triage_reason: 鄭州（中国河南省）でオウム熱の集団発生が報告されており、複数の症例が肺炎に進行し重症化のリスクがある。IHR基準で「異常性」および「重症度」が該当し、ヒト・動物への影響が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、中国河南省鄭州市でオウム熱（オウムに接触した祖父と孫、および他の複数の患者）の確定診断が報告されている。高熱（最高39.8℃）、肺炎進行、重症化リスクが明記されており、鳥類への接触が感染源として特定されている。オウム熱は通常稀な疾患であり、集団発生は異常である。

article.articleHeadline: 郑州多人确诊"鹦鹉热" 高烧成肺炎险成重症(图)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people in Zhengzhou diagnosed with psittacosis (parrot fever); high fever develops into pneumonia and nearly becomes critical (photo)
article.articleSummary: Psittacosis (ornithosis) infections linked to pet birds have been reported in Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China. On June 2, a grandfather–grandson pair who won a parrot at a market developed fever and were diagnosed with Chlamydia psittaci infection; multiple further cases followed. Other patients include a 62-year-old man whose granddaughter recently brought home two small parrots, and a 56-year-old woman who keeps parrots. One patient presented with fever up to 39.8°C and severe headache; CT revealed bilateral extensive pulmonary inflammation. Clinicians warn many cases initially resemble flu, delaying diagnosis. Transmission occurs mainly through inhalation of aerosols from infected birds’ feather dust, dried feces, or respiratory secretions. The incubation period is typically 5–21 days (up to 45); common symptoms are abrupt high fever, dry cough, myalgia, and rapidly developing pneumonia; severe disease can cause respiratory failure, myocarditis, or encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: 鄭州で複数人が「オウム病」と診断、高熱が肺炎に発展し重症化の危機（写真）
triage.triage_reason: 中国・鄭州でオウム病（Chlamydia psittaci）の複数患者発生が確認され、ペットの鳥との接触を介した人獣共通感染症として異常/予想外である。重症肺炎や呼吸不全のリスクを伴う事例があり、国内での継続的な曝露リスクがある。
triage.notes: オウム病は人獣共通感染症で、ペット鳥からの エアロゾル伝播が主経路。患者の初期症状がインフルエンザと類似するため診断遅延のリスクがある。複数患者の発生と重症化（両側肺炎、呼吸不全リスク）の可能性から、市中での継続曝露リスクが懸念される。社会的関心が報道から確認でき、シグナルとしてのピックアップが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Two scientists charged with smuggling monkeypox virus through Detroit airport
article.articleSummary: Two NIH researchers, Vincent Munster (53, Netherlands) and Claude Kwe (38, Cameroon), were charged in a criminal complaint with conspiracy to smuggle goods into the United States and making false statements after being intercepted Jan. 25 at Detroit Metropolitan Airport, returning from the Republic of Congo amid a monkeypox outbreak. Munster leads the Virus Ecology Section at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana; Kwe is a research fellow in the same section. They traveled with 113 vials in Styrofoam coolers in a large black case, claiming diagnostic equipment. FBI/CBP testing on 20 vials identified 17 containing deactivated monkeypox virus (mpox), one containing chickenpox virus, and two containing human DNA. Monkeypox/mpox is an infectious viral disease with symptoms like rash, swollen lymph nodes, and fever. If convicted, they face up to five years in prison.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の科学者がデトロイト空港を通じてサル痘ウイルス密輸で起訴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴからの病原体密輸という高度に異常な事象で、バイオセーフティ・バイオセキュリティ上の深刻な懸念を示唆する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴからの違法な病原体密輸事件であり、DRCが実際の発生地域（コンゴでの感染症発生中に病原体を密輸）。米国内の地域（Montana, Michigan, Ohio等）は密輸経路・被告人勤務地であるが、感染症イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。バイオテロ・バイオセキュリティリスク、NIH関係者の刑事告発という政治的インパクトを考慮するとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is now third largest in history, but West Michigan doctor says US spread unlikely
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa has grown to the third-largest in history, with transmission focused in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. There are no confirmed U.S. cases; Dr. Andrew Jameson of Trinity Health in Grand Rapids says the U.S. public health system can handle any arrivals. The Bundibugyo virus, a recent strain, is less dangerous than the more common Ebola variant, but there are no vaccines or targeted treatments, and diagnostics are challenging. Transmission occurs via close contact with bodily fluids, and the incubation period is about 21 days, during which symptoms can be vague. Containment is hindered by weak local healthcare infrastructure, ongoing political conflict, and traditional burial practices. WHO has declared a public health emergency, though global risk remains low. Enhanced screening and travel restrictions are in place for certain travelers from affected African areas; spillover to the U.S. is possible but unlikely to cause a major outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の感染者数が過去3番目の規模に拡大、ただし米国での流行の可能性は低いと西ミシガン医師が指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。コンゴ民主共和国は対象国のため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの発生を明記しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。Grand Rapids/Michiganは米国の確認症例がないため、シグナルの主題はアフリカの発生状況。WHO緊急事態宣言により社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebolan torjunnassa riittää haasteita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: There are many challenges in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns of major challenges in testing, contact tracing, and travel restrictions that complicate containment. Despite the dire situation, authorities are narrowing the gap in transmission estimates. The agency is seeking $115 million for the next three months, but only 35% of the required funds have been raised to date. The briefing underscores the need to expand laboratory testing capacity, accelerate case investigation, and implement safe travel measures to curb spread. No information on imported or exported cases is provided. The situation remains serious, underscoring the importance of international funding, coordination, and sustained public health measures to control the outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ対策には多くの課題がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・管理可能性で該当。現在進行形の流行で、WHO資金不足と国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: DRCでの確認症例344例、死亡60例という深刻な状況。WHOが資金不足（必要額115百万ドルに対し35%のみ調達）を警告し、国際的な資金・協調支援の急務を示唆。検査能力拡大、接触追跡、渡航制限実施の課題が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Krankheiten: WHO-Chef - Wir hinken im Kampf gegen Ebola hinterher
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diseases: WHO chief - We are lagging behind in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warning in Geneva that 'we are lagging behind' in the fight. The eastern DRC outbreak, first identified in mid-May, involves the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebolavirus, which had eluded conventional tests. By now, the virus has been confirmed in 344 cases in the DRC, with 60 deaths. In neighboring Uganda, 15 cases have been confirmed. The disease's spread is believed to have started weeks before discovery, highlighting diagnostic challenges. The outbreak is ongoing, with authorities racing to improve detection and response in the affected region of eastern DRC and cross-border surveillance into Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 疾患：WHO事務局長 - エボラとの戦いで我々は後れを取っている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の未制御の流行がDRCで発生しており、複数のIHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）と全てのWPRO基準に該当。DRCはWHO通知対象国であり、隣国ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される実際の発生国はDRCのみ（ウガンダでの確認も述べられているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外）。Genève（ジュネーブ）とSwitzerlandはWHO事務局長の発言の場所であり、発生地ではない。Bundibugyo株という稀なエボラ株、診断困難性、及び既に未制御の状態での344症例60死亡という重大性から、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Krankheiten: WHO-Chef: Wir hinken im Kampf gegen Ebola hinterher
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diseases: WHO chief: We are lagging behind in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns we are lagging in the fight against Ebola after the Bundibugyo ebolavirus type likely circulated for weeks before mid-May detection. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, with 15 confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda. Suspected cases have fallen from over 1,200 to under 170 as most samples from suspected patients tested negative. WHO is helping expand regional testing capacity. Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cited challenges in isolating and monitoring contacts, noting only 45% have been traced, far below the >90% required to curb spread. He also emphasized building public trust so sick people seek care at designated centers. Concurrently, WHO is accelerating development of vaccines and therapeutics for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症：WHO事務局長：我々はエボラ出血熱との戦いで後れを取っている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な病原体、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当し、複数国での確認例と高い致命率、接触者追跡の困難が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Uganda)は発生地域に含まれていますが、対象国リスト(GeoNames ID)に含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外しました。DRCでの344確認例、60死亡、ウガンダでの15確認例が報告されています。Bundibugyo ebolavirus型の数週間の未検出期間と、接触者追跡率45%（目標>90%）の大幅な不足が懸念事項です。

article.articleHeadline: Virchow-Preis für Pioniere im Kampf gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virchow Prize for Pioneers in the Fight Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: The Virchow Prize 2026 honors Ebola pioneers Jean-Jacques Muyembe and Peter Piot for discovering and fighting Ebola, as outbreaks persist in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda. Ebola was identified in 1976 after Muyembe, a doctor in Yambuku, northern Zaire (now DRC), sent samples to Belgium; Piot examined them, naming the virus after a river near Yambuku. Muyembe has led emergency responses to nine Ebola epidemics in DRC, built community trust, and advanced contact tracing and isolation; he also patented a therapeutic drug against the Zaire strain in 2020 and advocates Europe–USA–Africa research collaboration. Piot, Belgian-British physician, has held UN and EU leadership roles and emphasized that outbreaks unfold within social, economic, and political contexts. The €500,000 prize will be awarded in October at Berlin’s Red City Hall.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱との戦いの先駆者たちへのビルヒョウ賞
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2026年のビルヒョウ賞授賞式に関する歴史的・功績的な内容であり、現在進行形の感染症アウトブレイクの報道ではなく、即座の公衆衛生対応を要するシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事内ではDRCとウガンダにおけるエボラ流行の継続に言及されているが、本記事は科学賞の授賞式に関する内容であり、現在のアウトブレイク詳細についての新規情報源ではない。歴史的背景と功績の記念であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria encontrada na Crystal é a mesma que já foi achada na Ypê
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The bacterium found in Crystal is the same as the one that has already been found in Ypê.
article.articleSummary: On 3 June 2026, Anvisa announced a voluntary recall of Crystal mineral water after Pseudomonas aeruginosa was detected in batch LZ1 VAL200127 3 P 200126, produced by Mineração Bom Jesus Ltda (Coca-Cola system) in Luziânia, Goiás. The batch comprises 374,400 bottles of 500 ml, manufactured January 20, 2026, with expiry January 20, 2027. Most units were distributed in the Federal District (over 230,000), with the remainder to Goiás, the interior of São Paulo, and Tocantins. The finding arose from routine surveillance by the Federal District health authorities; Lacen-DF confirmed the result per SNVS protocols. The presence of P. aeruginosa violates microbiological standards for bottled water. Consumers should check the lot number and avoid consumption; follow manufacturer guidance on return and refunds. P. aeruginosa is environmental and usually harmless but is an opportunistic pathogen, posing higher risk to immunocompromised individuals—cancer patients, transplant recipients, uncontrolled HIV, prolonged corticosteroid use, autoimmune diseases—as well as hospitalized, diabetic, cystic fibrosis, and severely ill patients. The incident echoes the earlier Ypê case.

triage.headline_ja: Crystalで発見された細菌はYpêで以前発見されたものと同じ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの鉱物水からの病原体検出（緑膿菌）は公衆衛生懸念を示すが、IHR基準2つ以上の明確な該当が難しく、情報が部分的に不足している。監視継続が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は感染症アウトブレイク（IHRの意味での epidemic outbreak）ではなく、飲用水の製品品質管理問題である。疾患名として「HIV」が記載されているのは誤分類で、実際の病原体は Pseudomonas aeruginosa（グラム陰性桿菌）。ブラジルの食品安全当局（Anvisa）による対応は適切であり、外部支援の必要性は低い。過去の類似事例（Ypê）との関連から監視継続が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Pseudomonas aeruginosa: conheça a bactéria da água Crystal e produtos da Ypê | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pseudomonas aeruginosa: Meet the bacterium in Crystal water and Ypê products | A TARDE
article.articleSummary: 2026-06-03: Brazil’s Anvisa recalled a batch of Crystal mineral water after tests confirmed Pseudomonas aeruginosa, a bacterium previously identified in Ypê products. P. aeruginosa is common in air, water and soil and can be found on healthy skin. It is an opportunistic pathogen, rarely causing illness in healthy people but posing risks to immunocompromised individuals. It thrives in moist environments—lavatories, bathrooms, hot tubs, and inadequately chlorinated pools or outdated antiseptics. Infections range from minor external infections to severe, potentially fatal conditions. Immunosuppressed groups at higher risk include cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy or radiotherapy; transplant recipients on immunosuppressants; people with HIV/AIDS not adequately controlled; long-term corticosteroid or other immunosuppressant users; and patients with autoimmune diseases under treatment. Infections are more frequent and severe in these populations.

triage.headline_ja: 緑膿菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）：クリスタル水とYpê製品の細菌について知る
triage.triage_reason: 感染症アウトブレイク情報ではなく、製品回収報道。健常者への重篤な健康被害報告がなく、免疫低下者への一般的な危険性情報である。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は感染症アウトブレイク情報ではなく、Anvisa（ブラジル保健規制庁）による製品回収報道。緑膿菌は日常環境に常在する日和見病原体であり、健常者への感染リスクは低い。免疫低下患者への潜在的リスクについての一般的な啓発情報と判断される。確認された症例報告・患者数・流行の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: deux morts au Kenya lors d'une manifestation contre l'ouverture d'un centre de quarantaine réservé aux Américains
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Two Dead in Kenya During a Protest Against the Opening of a Quarantine Center Reserved for Americans.
article.articleSummary: Two men died in Nanyuki, Kenya, during protests against a US-backed Ebola quarantine centre for Americans exposed to the virus, rights groups said on June 2. Protests extended to the Health Ministry in Nairobi. The project would deploy 30 caregivers and 50 medically equipped beds at a site near Nanyuki Air Base in Laikipia to isolate and treat exposed Americans, avoiding repatriation. Local NGOs warn of contamination risks and lack of transparency about safety measures; Kenya has no shared border with the Democratic Republic of Congo and had no Ebola cases since the mid-May outbreak. A 27-year-old man was shot; a second death was unconfirmed. Six people were arrested in Nairobi, including a coffin marked “Ebola.” The Kenyan High Court suspended the centre’s entry into service on May 29 and kept the suspension on June 3; President William Ruto defends the project, while the US says the arrangement aims to protect public health and readiness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：アメリカ人向け隔離センター開設に反対する抗議デモでケニアで2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の感染症イベントではなく、隔離施設開設への政治的抗議デモが主題。ケニアは現在エボラ流行を経験していない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ隔離施設開設に対する政治的抗議デモであり、実際のエボラ感染症イベントではない。ケニアは記事サマリーで『mid-May outbreak in DRC』に言及しているが、ケニア自身には『no Ebola cases since mid-May』と明記されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事の主題はケニアの施設抗議であり、実際のエボラ感染症発生イベントではないため、verified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: What you should know about Ebola
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s NCDC, with WHO and UNICEF, intensifies Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) awareness after outbreaks were declared on May 16, 2026 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, part of Central and East Africa; Nigeria reports no confirmed cases. Bundibugyo virus disease, a severe Ebola form caused by Bundibugyo virus, is zoonotic with fruit bats as the reservoir. Human infection follows exposure to infected wildlife or bodily fluids, then spreads person-to-person via direct contact with broken skin or mucous membranes and fluids (blood, vomit, diarrhoea, saliva, urine, sweat, breast milk, semen) or contaminated materials. No licensed vaccine or specific antiviral exists; early supportive care (intravenous fluids, electrolytes) improves survival. Not airborne; transmission requires symptoms. High-risk groups: frontline health workers, caregivers, and those involved in unsafe burial practices. Preventive measures: hand hygiene, avoid contact with fluids, safe burials, fully cook meat; seek care if fever after travel to affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数国での発生（DRC、ウガンダ）が報告され、2026年5月16日に公式宣言。IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当。WHO・UNICEF等の国際機関が対応を強化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC及びウガンダでの発生が明示されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bluedot APIが付与したナイジェリア・モザンビークについては、サマリーでナイジェリアは「確認症例なし」の認識情報であり、モザンビークは言及されていないため除外。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみだが、ガーナは同じく対象国であり地域的に近接しているため、アフリカ地域での拡大リスクとして注視が必要。IHR基準4項目すべて該当しWPRO基準も全項目該当するため、フルRRA対象として即座にPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: RaillyNews - Monkeypox Virus Alert in the USA
article.articleSummary: Two scientists at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana attempted to illegally transfer monkeypox virus samples from Africa into the United States, an operation thwarted at Detroit Metropolitan Airport after arrival from Congo via Paris. FBI reports show senior researcher Claude Kwe and virology department head Vincent Munster were stopped during routine checks when shattered vials containing monkeypox material were found, signaling clear intent to smuggle a highly contagious pathogen. Monkeypox, a zoonotic virus related to smallpox, causes fever, rash, and body aches and has recently circulated beyond Central and West Africa through international travel, raising concerns about bioterrorism and accidental release. Legal and ethical violations centered on permits, documentation, and safety procedures for cross-border transfers. The incident underscores the role of stringent lab security, border screening, and international cooperation to prevent misuse of dangerous pathogens and safeguard public health.

triage.headline_ja: USA におけるサル痘ウイルスアラート - ロッキーマウンテン研究所の違法搬送事件
triage.triage_reason: コンゴからの違法な病原体搬送未遂事件であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）の複数項目に該当。生物テロ・バイオセキュリティリスクとして社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは感染症の自然発生ではなく、違法な病原体搬送未遂事件（バイオセキュリティ侵害）である。記事サマリーでは米国（Montana, Detroit）および Paris での搬送経路が記述されているが、対象国リストに該当するのは DRC のみ。米国・フランスは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。FBI による捜査、生物テロリズムの危機管理、国際的な病原体流通管理という観点で高度な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: US defends controversial Kenya Ebola facility after deadly riots | News.az
article.articleSummary: US Embassy in Kenya defends a controversial Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki, about 200 km north of Nairobi, amid protests tied to transparency concerns as the neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo endures a severe Ebola outbreak. On Monday, hundreds demonstrated; police used tear gas and live ammunition, killing two. The Kenyan High Court extended the facility’s suspension by three weeks the next day and ordered release of the full underlying agreement with Washington, following a Katiba Institute challenge over transparency and public health/legal questions. The US says the bio-isolation unit strengthens regional biosecurity and preserves Kenyan clinical resources, while funding more than $162 million for border screening, laboratory testing, and emergency preparedness in high‑risk counties. The embassy maintains the site poses no risk to nearby communities, including Americans working to contain the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、致命的な暴動後のケニア・エボラ施設を擁護 | News.az
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大リスク、隣接するDRCでの重大なアウトブレイク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、社会的・政治的関心の高さが複合的に認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCの重大なエボラアウトブレイクであり、ケニアの施設はそれに対応するための地域的対応インフラである。DRCのアウトブレイク状況が国際的関心と地域的な公衆衛生リスクの中心。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: 344 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا و60 حالة وفاة، وفق مدير الصحة العالمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 344 confirmed Ebola virus cases and 60 deaths, according to the Director of Global Health.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC): 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths across 24 health zones, as of 3 June 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported a notable drop in suspected cases as health teams accelerate verification. One confirmed death and 15 cases in Uganda are linked to a Congolese traveler who moved from the UAE to Uganda. WHO is coordinating with Ugandan and UAE authorities to gather information and assess risk. An American Ebola patient is receiving treatment in Germany. National risk in the DRC remains very high, regional risk is high, and global risk is low. Three Ebola treatment centers have been established in Bunia. Key locations mentioned: DRC (24 health zones, Bunia), Uganda, United Arab Emirates, Germany.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の確認患者344人、死者60人 - 世界保健機関事務局長による報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認事例と死亡者、国際的な感染例の報告があり、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダ、アラブ首長国連邦、ドイツが記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。DRC での高い発症数（344確認患者、60死亡）と複数の国境を越えた感染例により、フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Ebola response catching up as confirmed DRC cases hit 344
article.articleSummary: 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 2026-06-03, part of an ongoing outbreak. The World Health Organization said progress is being made but the response remains behind the outbreak’s initial momentum. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told reporters that the outbreak had a big head start and that, despite the gap, authorities are catching up under the leadership of the DRC government. The remarks were delivered during a WHO press briefing, underscoring ongoing efforts to strengthen surveillance, case investigation, and response activities as the international community supports the national effort.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、確認されたDRC症例が344件に達する中、エボラ対応が追いつきつつあると発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクをすべて満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡60件）、流行しやすさ（人間-人間感染）、管理可能性（国際支援必要）で該当。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: 進行中の疫病対応。記事日時が2026年6月という未来日付となっているが、これは仮想シナリオまたはデータエラーの可能性がある。確認済みケース344件、死亡60件という実数が報告されている。WHOが公式に進捗状況について説明していることから、高い社会的・政治的関心が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : les journalistes briefés sur la situation épidémiologique de la maladie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: journalists briefed on the epidemiological situation of the disease - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Beni city and territory. As of 3 June 2026, seven of Nord-Kivu's 34 health zones are affected: Beni, Oicha, Butembo, Kalunguta, Kyondo, Goma, and Katwa. The province reports 304 contacts followed, 19 confirmed cases, 13 deaths, and 5 active cases, with figures subject to change. Journalists’ briefing focused on the evolving epidemiological situation. Major challenges in the response include community engagement, misinformation, fake news, and rising rumors. Health communication officials emphasize providing timely, accurate information to prevent and manage rumors, delivering feedback to communities, and organizing community dialogue to rebuild trust between response teams and households. The briefing is an initiative of the Ministry of Health through the Nord-Kivu Division of Communication and Media.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ：疾病の疫学的状況について記者会見 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認事例19件、死亡13件が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当。WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）も満たす。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は常に高リスク病原体。Nord-Kivu州の7つの保健ゾーン（ベニ、オイチャ、ブテンボ、カルングタ、キョンド、ゴマ、カトワ）での拡大が確認されている。コミュニティエンゲージメント、偽情報対策が主要な課題として挙げられており、対応体制への社会的課題もある。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ подтвердила 60 смертей от Эболы в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirmed 60 Ebola deaths in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with suspected cases reduced to 116. Uganda reports 15 cases and one death; eight patients across both countries have recovered. WHO classifies national risk as very high, regional risk as high, and global risk as low, and has declared the outbreak an extraordinary public health concern. The previous DRC Ebola outbreak ended in October 2025. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said vaccines are ready to begin clinical trials. The situation poses a cross-border threat to other countries, underscoring the need for ongoing surveillance, vaccination efforts, and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による60人の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の発生、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、WHOが国際的懸念事象として宣言。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの15症例1死亡も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。本イベントはWHO公式宣言による「Public Health Emergency of International Concern」相当であり、最優先でフルRRA実施対象。

article.articleHeadline: NIH Researchers Charged With Smuggling 113 Virus Vials On Flight To Detroit -- 'I Do This All The Time'
article.articleSummary: NIH researchers are charged with conspiracy to smuggle 113 vials of viral material into the United States after return from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, where an Ebola-related entry risk and a monkeypox outbreak were noted. The suspects include the chief of the NIH Virus Ecology Section in the Laboratory of Virology and a fellow at an NIH Biosafety Level 4 laboratory in Montana, arrested for bringing back undeclared diagnostic samples for cross-species transmission research. The 113 vials were found in a large black case; FBI testing of 20 vials identified 17 with deactivated monkeypox virus, 1 with chickenpox virus, and 2 containing human DNA. The pair did not declare the agents or follow chain-of-custody rules. Separately, two weeks earlier a diverted Air France flight from Paris to Detroit involved a passenger who had recently been in the DRC and was subject to Ebola-related entry restrictions; he was asymptomatic and returned to Paris.

triage.headline_ja: NIH研究者が113本のウイルス試料をデトロイト便で密輸した容疑で起訴 - 「私はいつもこれをやっている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準3つ以上該当（異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）。DRCからの高危険度ウイルス（Ebola、Mpox Clade I）の密輸という重大なバイオセキュリティインシデントであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は検査室での違法な病原体輸送事件だが、Ebola・Mpox Clade Iという高危険度病原体がDRCから北米に持ち込まれた点、及びバイオセキュリティ手続きの著しい違反により、潜在的な公衆衛生上の脅威となる。Air France機の同時期インシデント（DRC由来の乗客）も言及されているが、当該乗客は無症状であり追加の懸念は低い。verified_locationsはDRCのみ（実際のウイルス流行地）とし、米国・フランスは検査室事件の舞台であるため除外。
