article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Usl Valle d'Aosta attiva il tavolo di coordinamento richiesto dal Ministero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Aosta Valley Local Health Unit activates the coordination table requested by the Ministry.
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-06-03, the Aosta Valley Local Health Unit activated an internal Ebola coordination table under the Ministry of Health and opened a dedicated email channel for residents returning from Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The aim is to ensure full implementation of national provisions and continuous epidemiological monitoring. The internal team includes Health Director Mauro Occhi, head of the Territorial Emergency Service 118 Luca Cavoretto, Emergency Department Director Stefano Podio, and Infectious Diseases Director Magnani. The measure is preventive: WHO and Italian health authorities deem the infection risk to Italy as low, noting foci are hundreds of kilometers from airports, making cross-border transmission unlikely but compliance is prudent. The table coordinates prevention, surveillance, information, and handling of reports, maintaining liaison with the Ministry, Civil Protection, and other institutions. Citizens returning from Uganda or Congo in the prior 21 days must self-report within 24 hours, even if asymptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、アオスタ渓谷保健局が保健省により要請された調整委員会を発足
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染症は重篤な疾患だが、本記事はイタリアでの予防的対応措置であり、実際の患者発生ではない。DRC・ウガンダから帰国者への監視体制構築が主題であり、イタリア側の低リスク評価に基づく防災対応。情報不足かつ社会的関心の程度が不明なため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ患者発生ではなく、イタリアの予防的対応措置。発生地域フィールドにイタリア（対象国外）が含まれるため除外。DRCとウガンダが言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストにないため除外。WHO及びイタリア保健当局はイタリアへの感染リスクを低と評価。監視体制の構築は通常の公衆衛生対応であり、現時点ではシグナルレベルの緊急事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: "Ebola, une zoonose transmise par n'importe quel contact avec les animaux domestiques infectés" ( un vétérinaire) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, a zoonosis transmitted by any contact with infected domestic animals (a veterinarian) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is described as a zoonosis with transmission to humans via contact with infected domestic animals, in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Frugivorous bats are considered the primary natural reservoirs, capable of transmitting to non-human primates (gorillas, chimpanzees, monkeys), antelopes, and other small wild mammals. Wild-to-domestic transmission occurs through direct contact (biting, scratching, saliva, urine on fruits, blood) and via shared environments, water sources, or vectors such as fleas and ticks that bite an infected wild animal then a domestic one. Pigs can be infected by certain Ebola viruses, while dogs may develop antibodies after exposure without clear clinical signs. Risk zones include tropical forests, hunting areas, bushmeat markets, villages near bat habitats, and regions with unusual wildlife mortalities. In the DRC, Ituri, Equateur, Tshopo, and Nord Kivu provinces show notable human–animal–environment interfaces. Domestic animal guidance emphasizes surveillance, restricted roaming, reporting abnormal mortalities, waste control, enclosure hygiene, PPE, and One Health collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、感染した家畜とのあらゆる接触により伝播する人畜共通感染症（獣医師）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの人畜共通感染症的特性と伝播メカニズムに関する教育的記事。DRC内での複数州（Ituri、Equateur、Tshopo、Nord Kivu）における人獣環境インターフェースの記述はあるが、具体的な新規患者発生やアウトブレイク事例の報告ではなく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラウイルスの人畜共通感染症的特性と伝播経路に関する一般的な教育情報。Ecuador がBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題であり、Ecuadorは医学的文脈で言及されていないため除外。Ecuador は対象国リストにも含まれない。具体的なアウトブレイク事例、患者数、死亡数が記載されていないため重症度等は不明。WPROスクリーニング基準の「epidemic_prone」は該当（ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある病原体）だが、他のスクリーニング基準との組み合わせと社会的関心の情報が不足しているため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns Ebola outbreak had 'big head-start' but response 'catching up'
article.articleSummary: 3 June 2026 — The World Health Organization said the Ebola outbreak in central Africa, confirmed to have killed 359 people, had a big head-start but that the response is catching up. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told reporters in Geneva the outbreak had a substantial head-start, yet progress is being made under the Democratic Republic of Congo government's leadership. The remarks underscore ongoing efforts to contain transmission and accelerate the response, with authorities hopeful that operations are closing the gap with the outbreak’s spread. The statement confirms a 359-death toll and frames the situation as improving despite the outbreak’s early lead, as international and local teams coordinate to enhance response efforts under DRC governance.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行は「大きな先制攻撃を受けた」が対応は「追い付きつつある」と警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認死亡者数359人という重大な公衆衛生への影響、国際的関心（WHOによる公式声明）、および DRC での継続的な流行により IHR 基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはGenève（スイス）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行が主題であり、WHOの声明がジュネーブで行われたという報道地点に過ぎない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。359人の死亡者数確認、DRC政府主導での対応進行中、国際的およびローカルチーム間の連携強化が記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: Krankheiten: WHO-Chef: "Wir hinken im Kampf gegen Ebola hinterher"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diseases: WHO chief: "We are lagging behind in the fight against Ebola".
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled, according to WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The Bundibugyo-type Ebolavirus has caused 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths in the DRC, with 15 cases in neighboring Uganda. Suspected cases have fallen from over 1,200 to under 170 as most samples were negative. Laboratory confirmation now identifies this virus variant, after conventional tests had failed to detect it earlier. Challenges include isolating and monitoring contacts; only about 45% have been traced, well short of the 90% target needed to stop transmission. WHO is expanding regional testing capacity, working to rebuild public trust so patients seek care in prepared treatment centers, and accelerating vaccine and therapeutic development for Bundibugyo Ebola. The outbreak began weeks before mid-May and remains a significant public health threat.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症：WHO事務局長「エボラとの闘いで私たちは遅れをとっている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、深刻な影響（344確認例、60死亡）、公衆衛生危機、高い国際的懸念。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの15例の確認により国際的拡大が進行中。接触者追跡が目標の45%に留まり、制御困難な状況が示唆される。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは従来の検査では検出されず、診断確認が遅延した可能性がある。WHOは地域検査能力の拡大、ワクチン・治療薬開発を加速。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: Pseudomonas aeruginosa: conheça bactéria detectada em lotes da Crystal e da Ypê | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pseudomonas aeruginosa: meet the bacterium detected in Crystal and Ypê batches | Itatiaia Radio
article.articleSummary: Anvisa announced a voluntary recall of Crystal's still mineral water batch LZ1 VAL200127 3 P 200126, comprising 374,400 bottles of 500 ml distributed in Goiás, Tocantins, São Paulo, and Brasília. Lab results from Lacen-DF detected Pseudomonas aeruginosa in the product, the same genus species linked to Ypê batches suspended by Anvisa in April. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is an environmental bacterium found in soil and water, especially in damp areas, and is a recognized opportunistic pathogen. Immunocompromised individuals are at higher risk, including those with severe disorders, diabetes or cystic fibrosis, hospitalized patients, people with HIV, and those on immunosuppressive therapy. The bacterium is common in hospital settings, often in sinks, antiseptics, and urine-collection containers; medical devices such as urinary catheters and ventilators increase contamination risk. Infections can affect blood, skin, bones, ears, eyes, urinary tract, heart valves, lungs and wounds.

triage.headline_ja: Pseudomonas aeruginosa：クリスタルおよびYpê製品で検出された細菌を知る | Itatiaia Radio
triage.triage_reason: 本件はPseudomonas aeruginosaを含有するミネラルウォーター製品のリコールであり、HIV自体のアウトブレイクではなく、製品汚染管理事案である。IHR基準に該当せず、感染症シグナルとしての重大性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は疾患分類でHIVと標記されているが、本文主題はPseudomonas aeruginosa汚染水の製品リコール事案であり、HIVアウトブレイクではない。Anvisaによる行政措置（voluntary recall）の報告であり、感染症伝播イベントではない。対象国はBrazilに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Στα 344 τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα στη Λαϊκή Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 344 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03, the World Health Organization reports 344 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases with 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, indicating an ongoing outbreak. The counts are laboratory-confirmed within the DRC. The WHO and partners acknowledge ongoing challenges, but progress is being made under the leadership of the DRC government. To sustain control efforts over the next three months, WHO is seeking $115 million, of which only 35% is funded so far, with additional support required from other partners. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted the outbreak had a sizeable head start and the response remains behind schedule, though the trajectory improves with government-led leadership.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国で344件の確定患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、進行中の異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確定患者344名、死亡60名の進行中アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の進行中アウトブレイク。WHOは3ヶ月間の対応継続に1億1,500万米ドルが必要と報告。資金調達が不足している状況。DRC政府主導の対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Santé. Ebola : l'OMS appelle à lever les restrictions de voyage et assure rattraper le retard dans la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health. Ebola: WHO calls to lift travel restrictions and says it will catch up on the delay in the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, led by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, is described by the WHO as having a significant early advance, with the humanitarian response now catching up. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged countries imposing general travel restrictions to lift them, arguing such measures disrupt supply chains and hamper containment efforts. The agency reiterated exit screening at airports, seaports, and land borders to prevent exportation of Ebola cases and contacts, while balancing trade and travel needs. Under the leadership of the DRC government, authorities say they are narrowing the gap in the delayed response. The WHO continues to coordinate international support to accelerate outbreak control and protect regional health security.

triage.headline_ja: 健康. エボラ：WHOは渡航制限の解除を要請し、対応の遅れを取り戻すと表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の流行は国際保健上の重大事象であり、渡航制限・貿易影響があり、国際的対応が進行中である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高危険病原体で、確認された流行地はDRC。WHOが国際レベルで対応を強化しており、渡航・貿易制限が実施されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Fogging Massal, Cara Lapas Kelas IIA Pekanbaru Cegah Warga Binaan Terpapar DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mass Fogging, Pekanbaru Class IIA Prison's Method to Prevent Inmates from Being Exposed to Dengue Fever
article.articleSummary: A mass dengue prevention fogging operation was conducted at Pekanbaru Class IIA Prison in Pekanbaru, Riau, Indonesia, on June 2, 2026, in collaboration with the Pekanbaru City Health Office. The operation deployed layered fogging against Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector, covering offices, drainage, shrubs, and inmate living quarters. Inmates were evacuated to open, safe areas before spraying to minimize exposure. The exercise is framed as a preventive measure to protect inmates from Dengue Fever amid changing weather, underscoring the facility’s commitment to a clean, healthy environment. No outbreak details are reported; the activity emphasizes public health protection rather than responding to current cases.

triage.headline_ja: 集団的な薫蒸、ペカンバル第IIA級刑務所が受刑者のデング熱感染を防ぐ方法
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防的な蚊媒介対策であり、発生中の症例報告やアウトブレイク情報がない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はペカンバル刑務所における予防的な蚊駆除活動の報告であり、デング熱患者の発生やアウトブレイク状況の報告ではない。「No outbreak details are reported」と記載されている通り、シグナルとして検出すべき感染症イベントの兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Krankheiten: WHO-Chef: "Wir hinken im Kampf gegen Ebola hinterher" - Wissenschaft - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diseases: WHO chief: "We are lagging behind in the fight against Ebola" - Science - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled. The Bundibugyo-type Ebolavirus, a rare strain, likely circulated for weeks before detection in mid-May; conventional tests initially failed to detect it. The WHO reports 344 confirmed cases in the DRC with 60 deaths, while neighboring Uganda has 15 confirmed cases. Suspected cases have fallen from over 1,200 to under 170 as most samples tested negative. Contact tracing and isolation are major bottlenecks, with only about 45% of contacts located and monitored, far short of the 90% needed to halt transmission. WHO is expanding regional testing capacity and reinforcing treatment centers, while accelerating vaccine and therapeutic development for this Ebola type. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus spoke in Geneva after visiting the affected area.

triage.headline_ja: 病気：WHO事務局長「エボラウイルスとの闘いで後れをとっている」－科学－ラインツァイトゥング
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目全て満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て満たす。エボラウイルスの確認された多国間アウトブレイク（DRC 344例、60死亡、ウガンダ15例）であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大、接触追跡の重大な欠陥などが報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラアウトブレイクを主題としている。スイス・ジュネーブはWHO本部の所在地であり、Tedros事務局長がジュネーブから言及したに過ぎず、実際の感染症イベントの発生地ではないため除外。ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。本シグナルはエボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo型）の確認された多国間拡大と制御困難性、および重症度の高さが明確であり、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Chef: "Wir hinken im Kampf gegen Ebola hinterher"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief: "We are falling behind in the fight against Ebola."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled as of 3 June 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said in Geneva that 'the disease had a head start, and we are still behind,' following a multi-day visit to the eastern region of the country. The deadly Ebola virus had likely spread for weeks before it was discovered in mid-May, highlighting a lag between transmission and detection. The comments underscore ongoing challenges confronting containment efforts in eastern DRC and reflect concern within the international health community about the outbreak's trajectory.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：「我々はエボラ対策で遅れている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイクはDRCで制御不能状態が継続し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はジュネーブで開催されたWHO会見の報道であるが、実際のエボラアウトブレイクはDRC東部で発生・継続中。Geneva（スイス）の記載は会見開催地であり、疾患の実際の発生地はDRCのみ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: İki bilim insanı hakkında şok suçlama! Virüslü örnekleri gizlice ülkeye getirdiler
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking accusation against two scientists! They secretly brought virus-containing samples into the country.
article.articleSummary: Two virologists, Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, at a government-affiliated research laboratory, face FBI scrutiny for allegedly importing mpox virus–related biological materials into the United States without proper authorization after returning from nine days of fieldwork in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in January. At the airport, they reportedly denied carrying biological samples. FBI investigations allege they brought inactivated mpox virus–containing vials into the U.S. without notifying authorities or completing required permits. Documents claim Munster asserted the necessary paperwork was on his computer, but no supporting records were found. They are due to appear in a federal court in Montana on Wednesday. Mpox typically presents with fever, fatigue, and skin rashes; the disease, formerly monkeypox, has caused notable outbreaks, including the 2022 global events.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の科学者に対する衝撃的な告発！ウイルス含有サンプルを密かに国に持ち込んだ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。米国でのバイオセーフティ違反疑惑とDRC由来のMpoxの国際持ち込み事例は、公衆衛生危機管理上の重要シグナル。
triage.notes: バイオセーフティ違反疑惑の刑事裁判事案。DRC由来のMpox（Clade I可能性）が無許可で米国に持ち込まれた。ただし記事は2件の対象国（USA、DRC）に関連するが、Bluedot発生地域にMontana(USA)のみ詳細表示されている。FBIの関与・連邦裁判所手続により政府機関の関心は高い。該当対象国リストに米国は含まれないため、DRCのみが実質的なシグナル対象国だが、米国のバイオセーフティ違反事案の国際的波及性を考慮してPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: ايبولا ... حب ونظافة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ... Love and Hygiene.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks: First recognized in June 1976 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (then Zaire) and in Sudan, linked to the Ebola River near Kinshasa. A major resurgence occurred in 2013–2016 in West Africa, centered in Guinea (Conakry) and spreading to Liberia, Sierra Leone, and Nigeria; about 28,000 people were infected and around 11,000 died. Rural Congo and Sudan suffered repeated village outbreaks, with transmission marked by an incubation period, fever, rash and blisters, head and body pains, and sometimes bleeding and diarrhea. Public health responses combined patient isolation, contact tracing and management in Ebola facilities, vaccination of contacts and their networks, and safe burial practices, alongside broad public education. The outbreak was declared over in 2016. The article underscores love, hygiene, and compassionate care as vital complements to medical interventions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ... 愛と衛生
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2013-2016年の西アフリカにおけるエボラアウトブレイクの歴史的な回顧記事であり、現在の新規発生事象ではなく、既に2016年に終息が宣言されている過去のイベントについての教育啓発記事である。現在進行形の感染症イベント（新規発生、拡大、再燃）を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去のエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク（1976年初認、2013-2016年西アフリカ流行）の歴史的概説であり、2016年に終息宣言済みである。現在の新規感染症イベントとしてのシグナル特性を持たない。記事本文が空欄のため詳細な内容確認は不可だが、サマリーから明らかに回顧記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Tenaga Medis Berjuang Melawan Misinformasi dan Ketakutan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in Kongo: Healthcare Workers Fight Misinformation and Fear.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with cross-border spillover into Uganda. As of June 1, 2026, 321 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 48 deaths are recorded in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Uganda reporting 15 cases and 1 death. The outbreak is fueled by fear and misinformation, eroding trust in health facilities, delaying care, and triggering disruptions at treatment centers. UNICEF-led efforts involve community and religious leaders and women’s groups to rebuild trust and bolster decontamination and isolation messaging, though logistics are hindered by damaged infrastructure and limited field-team mobility. The IRC cautions official counts may understate reality, with only about 20% of contacts traced. Health workers continue to operate in full PPE in extreme heat. On June 2, 2026, the U.S. announced a return to the Gavi vaccine alliance, aiming to improve vaccine availability; experts are cautiously optimistic due to faster international support and stronger surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：医療従事者が偽情報と恐怖と戦う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な地理的拡大、国境を越えた感染、渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されている。しかしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めていない。米国の言及は支援国としての役割であり、発生地ではないため除外。321確定患者、48死亡、致命率約14.9%で深刻な事態。医療従事者の信頼喪失、偽情報の蔓延、接触者追跡率20%という管理上の課題が存在。

article.articleHeadline: O que é Pseudomonas aeruginosa, bactéria encontrada em lote de água Crystal e produtos da Ypê
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Pseudomonas aeruginosa, the bacterium found in a batch of Crystal water and Ypê products?
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Anvisa has ordered the recall of Crystal mineral water after tests detected Pseudomonas aeruginosa, a finding also linked to Ypê products. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a widely distributed bacterium found in air, water, soil, and even healthy skin, thriving in moist environments such as sinks, bathrooms, inadequately chlorinated pools, hot tubs, and contaminated antiseptics. It is an opportunistic pathogen; usually harmless in healthy people but can cause infections from mild to severe and potentially fatal when conditions favor growth. The organism is associated with antibiotic resistance, complicating treatment, and is among the leading causes of hospital infections, especially in intensive care units, with international health organizations citing hundreds of thousands of deaths annually. High-risk groups include cancer patients on chemotherapy or radiotherapy, transplant recipients, people with HIV, long-term corticosteroid or immunosuppressant use, autoimmune diseases, diabetes, cystic fibrosis, and prolonged hospitalizations. The recalls underscore consumer safety for vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: クリスタル水とYpê製品のバッチで発見された細菌Pseudomonas aeruginosaとは何か
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは特定製品の自主回収に関するニュースであり、感染症の集団発生ではない。HIV自体とは無関係で、免疫低下者への潜在的リスク言及にとどまる。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疾患分類がHIVとされているが、記事の実際の主題はPseudomonas aeruginosa汚染による製品回収である。感染症の発生報告ではなく、製品安全性に関するニュース記事。環境汚染と一般的な感染症リスク教育であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya court blocks US Ebola quarantine plan for three more weeks - Report Focus News
article.articleSummary: On 3 June 2026, a Kenyan High Court extended an injunction blocking the United States–backed plan to establish a 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base near Nanyuki (about 140 km north of Nairobi) to treat U.S. citizens exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The court ordered the government to disclose details of its agreement with Washington; protests in Nanyuki led to reports of two demonstrator deaths after police opened fire, though authorities gave conflicting accounts. Kenya defends the facility as part of national preparedness; President William Ruto described it within a broader preparedness system. The United States remains confident of a favorable arrangement. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, declared 15 May and centered in eastern Congo with spillover into Uganda; over 900 suspected cases and more than 220 suspected deaths; Kenya has reported none. U.S. CDC has imposed entry bans on non-citizens who have been in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, later extended to green-card holders, amid FIFA World Cup preparations.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所、3週間さらに米国のエボラ隔離計画をブロック - Report Focus News
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の地域流行、米国を含む多国間対応、死亡を伴う深刻な事態。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの隔離施設計画ですが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。発生地域には米国、スーダン、ウガンダ、ケニアが含まれていますが、サマリーの主要な流行中心はDRC東部であり、対象国はDRCのみが該当します。エボラウイルス病は最高レベルのバイオセキュリティ懸念事項であり、死亡数920例超、疑い症例220例超の重大流行です。

article.articleHeadline: اتهام باحثين بالتآمر لنقل "جدري القرود" إلى أميركا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers charged with conspiring to transport monkeypox to America.
article.articleSummary: Two Rocky Mountain Laboratory researchers charged with conspiring to transport monkeypox (mpox) to the United States and making false statements to federal authorities. Vincent Monster, 53, Dutch, head of the Virus Environment Section, and Claude Kou, 38, Cameroonian, arrived January 25, 2026 at Detroit Metro from Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo, where mpox is circulating. They claimed a black bag contained diagnostic equipment, but investigators found 113 vials in cooling containers: 17 vials contained inactivated mpox virus, 1 vial contained varicella-zoster virus (chickenpox), and 2 vials contained only human DNA. The material was reportedly destined for export/import activities linked to the Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Hamilton, Montana. They are due in federal court in Missoula, Montana. FBI Detroit warns against illicit transport by researchers; HHS OIG stresses public-trust and safety implications of concealing or moving biological materials without authorization.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者がサル痘をアメリカに運搬する陰謀で告発される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。生物学的物質の不正輸送、複数の病原体（Mpoxクレード、水痘帯状疱疹ウイルス）、公開訴追事件として社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は米国での刑事訴追事件を報道。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には米国内複数地点（Montana、Ohio）とDRC・Republic of Congo関連地点が含まれているが、サマリー上の実際のイベント発生地はDRC（Brazzaville）での病原体採取と米国への不正輸送。公開訴追事件としての社会的・政治的関心が高く、FBI・HHS OIGの公式発表が含まれている。生物セキュリティ上の重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织总干事呼吁建立长期医疗防御机制 应对埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General calls for establishing a long-term medical defense mechanism to respond to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On June 3, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged establishing a long-term medical defense mechanism to respond to the Ebola outbreak. Controlling the current outbreak is a matter of time, but lasting success requires preventing future epidemics. While leading the response, WHO will assist the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda in building and strengthening long-term medical and humanitarian service systems to break the 'headache-for-the-headache' cycle of reactive responses. As of May 17, the Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda were declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), signaling international concern. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The article cites CCTV News as the source.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が長期医療防御メカニズムの確立を呼びかけ、エボラ流行への対応を促進
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準3項目該当（予想外の重症化、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。既にPHEIC宣言済みの進行中の国際的エボラ流行事案。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダのエボラ発生が明示されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは対象国（203312）。サマリーではウガンダとの越境リスクが述べられており、ザンビアは地理的に隣接する国として監視対象に含める価値あり。既にPHEIC宣言（5月17日時点）済みで、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療法なし）による国際的脅威。WHO総長による正式声明として高い信頼性。

article.articleHeadline: Ministry of Health Closely Monitors the Global Situation of the Ebola Virus Disease - The Voice St. Lucia News
article.articleSummary: On May 17, 2026, the WHO declared the Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in eastern DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern under the IHR (2005). The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is responsible; the outbreak is concentrated in Ituri, Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu (DRC) and Kampala (Uganda). As of May 27, 2026, there were 1,018 cases (1,011 DRC, 7 Uganda) and 234 deaths (233 DRC, 1 Uganda), CFR ≈23%. No licensed vaccines or therapeutics exist for this strain. There are no Caribbean cases; risk in the Caribbean is assessed as low, though importation via travel is possible. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, secretions, organs or fluids, contaminated surfaces, and wildlife; incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle pain, fatigue, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain and bleeding. The Ministry of Health is boosting surveillance, port screening, preparedness plans, PPE, and risk communication; testing capacity is not available in the Caribbean; samples may be sent to CDC Atlanta.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラウイルス病の世界的状況を綿密に監視 - ザ・ボイス・セント・ルシア・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO が PHEIC 宣言した DRC と Uganda でのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo 株）、1000 例超・死亡例 23% CFR、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限等のリスクあり。
triage.notes: WHO が 2026 年 5 月 17 日に PHEIC 宣言。Bundibugyo ebolavirus 株は未承認ワクチン・治療薬なし。1,018 例、234 死亡（CFR ≈23%）。DRC 側に Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu 州、Uganda 側に Kampala での発生が確認。カリブ海地域への輸入リスク低評価だが、渡航経由の持ち込みリスク存在。発生地域に Georgia（USA）と Atlanta が含まれているが、記事サマリーは DRC と Uganda の実際の流行に言及しており、米国での確認事例はない。

article.articleHeadline: Jefe de la OMS alerta de que muchos contactos con enfermos de ébola no han sido rastreados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief warns that many contacts of Ebola patients have not been traced.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that only 45% of contacts of Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's current outbreak have been traced, with Bunia in Ituri Province the epicenter. The outbreak has 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths. Ongoing security challenges, including armed conflict and internal displacement, hinder contact tracing, which the WHO aims to raise to 90%. He noted a delay in diagnosing early cases but said response efforts are gaining ground. Six people have recovered in the DRC and two in Uganda, where 15 cases have been linked to the same outbreak, underscoring that survival is possible with timely access to care at health facilities. Tedros urged continued vigilance and access to diagnostic and treatment services.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ患者との濃厚接触者の多くが追跡されていないと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準5項目中4項目該当。進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（344確認症例、60死亡）で接触者追跡が不十分であり、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRCでのアウトブレイク（344確認症例、60死亡）が述べられており、ウガンダ（15症例関連）も同じアウトブレイクと述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsはDRCのみ。発生地域フィールドにはUgandaも含まれているが、記事の主題はDRCアウトブレイク。接触者追跡の不十分さ（45%）と武力紛争による対応課題が強調されており、管理可能性の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Chef: Hinken bei Ebola-Epidemie noch hinterher, holen aber auf
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief: Still lagging behind in the Ebola epidemic, but catching up.
article.articleSummary: June 3, 2026 — The World Health Organization chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the international community is still lagging behind the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa but is catching up. The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains the epicenter of the current outbreak, which has 359 laboratory-confirmed Ebola-related deaths. In mid-May, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; by Tuesday, Ebola-suspected cases in the DRC and neighboring Uganda have fallen sharply. Tedros warned that blanket travel bans hamper response and supply chains; instead, he urged targeted controls at airports, seaports, and borders to prevent exportation of cases and contacts. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no specific treatment or approved vaccine. Transmission occurs via body fluids and presents with fever and bleeding. Countries such as the United States have imposed entry bans on non-US citizens from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOトップ：エボラ流行対応に遅れているが追いついている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）が宣言されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当が明確。国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限、死亡者発生、治療法・ワクチン欠如により、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの症例減少が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。米国の入国禁止措置が記載されているが、米国は発生国ではなく、対策実施国であるため除外。Bundibugyo変種による流行で、治療法・ワクチン未承認という重要なリスク要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织总干事呼吁建立长期医疗防御机制 应对埃博拉疫情-国际在线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General calls for the establishment of a long-term medical defense framework to respond to the Ebola outbreak - International Online
article.articleSummary: On June 3, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called for establishing a long-term medical defense framework to respond to Ebola outbreaks. He said controlling the current Ebola outbreak is only a matter of time, but true success lies in preventing future ones. WHO will help local governments build enduring medical and humanitarian service systems to break the cycle of reactive, short-term responses. On May 17, the Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and in Uganda were declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment available. Emphasis is on preparedness, surveillance, and sustained health-system strengthening to mitigate future spillovers and cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱対応に向けた長期的医療防御メカニズムの確立を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。2026年5月17日にコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行が国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の事象（PHEIC）として宣言されており、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダの両国でのエボラ流行について言及しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsではDRCのみを列挙。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）による流行で、ワクチンおよび特異的治療法が利用不可能な状況。PHEICとしての正式宣言により、国際的リスクは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda asegura a viajeros y turistas que el país es seguro a pesar del brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda reassures travelers and tourists that the country is safe despite the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Uganda remains under control for travelers, with six new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours. Uganda’s total is 12 cases, with one death and two recoveries; authorities report all contacts are in quarantine and urge early symptom reporting. The outbreak began after a Congolese man died in Kampala on May 15 and Ebola was laboratory-confirmed. The World Health Organization has declared an international emergency due to a surge of cases in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). In DRC, 116 suspected and 321 confirmed cases are reported, with 48 deaths and six recoveries, reflecting ongoing regional transmission. The International Organization for Migration calls for urgent cross-border coordination, warning that border closures could drive irregular movements and hinder surveillance, tracing, and detection.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラアウトブレークにもかかわらず、国が安全であることを旅行者と観光客に保証
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。エボラウイルス病は優先度の高い病原体であり、複数国での確認と国際的な懸念表明がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主要な懸念はDRCにおけるエボラの流行（116疑い例、321確定例、48死亡）である。ウガンダはDRCでの事例に関連して12例（1死亡）が報告されており、DRCからの輸入例と考えられる。WHOが国際的緊急事態を宣言し、国際移住機関が国境協力を呼びかけており、国際的な懸念が高い。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ευλογιά των πιθήκων: Επιστήμονες μετέφεραν κρυφά τον ιό στις ΗΠΑ - Τι αναφέρει το κατηγορητήριο του FBI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox: Scientists secretly transported the virus to the United States — What the FBI indictment says.
article.articleSummary: Two senior scientists from a U.S. government lab, Vincent Manster and Claude Kve, face FBI charges for illegally transporting vials of inactivated monkeypox virus from Africa to the United States and for making false statements at Detroit Metropolitan Airport. The indictment, filed in a Michigan federal court, follows a January stop after nine days in the Democratic Republic of Congo and a flight from Paris. Both work at the Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Hamilton, Montana, and the NIH says it is cooperating. Investigators found they traveled with undeclared, inactivated monkeypox samples without proper authorization. Manster reportedly told investigators that the necessary paperwork existed on his computer and that he does this all the time; the FBI characterizes the statements as false. World Health Organization notes monkeypox symptoms include rash and fever, with most patients recovering. Congo has recorded over 2,000 deaths since 2023, although the two-year surge was declared over in April.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘：科学者がウイルスを秘密裏に米国に輸送 — FBIの起訴状が明かすこと
triage.triage_reason: 不活化ウイルスの違法輸送という異常なイベントであり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」に該当するが、現時点では公開情報の詳細が限定的で、実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく犯罪事件として報道されているため、フルRRA前に続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントは不活化（感染性のない）ウイルスの違法輸送に関する刑事事件であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク警報ではない。記事では米国内での感染確認は述べられていない。DRCはサル痘流行地域だが、本事件そのものは輸送違反と偽造陳述の刑事案件である。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、公衆衛生上の緊急性は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS confirma 344 casos y 60 muertes por el brote de ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms 344 cases and 60 deaths from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DRC confirms 344 Ebola (Bundibugyo strain) cases and 60 deaths across 24 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu as of 3 June 2026. Uganda reports 15 cases and 1 death, including a Congolese resident who traveled to UAE and then Uganda; a US citizen infected in the DRC remains in Germany for treatment. WHO maintains risk levels: very high nationally, high regionally, low globally. Major challenge is contact tracing, with only ~45% of contacts followed; objective is >90% in the context of insecurity, population movements, and cross-community mobility. Diagnostic and laboratory capacity is being strengthened, with Bunia hosting three treatment centers (80 beds) and units in Mongbwalu, Rwampara, Beni, Goma, and Bukavu. Six recoveries in the DRC and two in Uganda reported. Travel restrictions should be lifted; exit controls at airports, ports, and borders advised to prevent export. Community mistrust noted; no vaccines or specific treatments yet; leadership and trust are essential.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で344症例と60死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo strain）の多国間での確認例、高い死亡率、国際的な二次感染（ウガンダ、ドイツ、アラブ首長国連邦での報告）、および渡航制限の検討が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されている発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダ、ドイツ、アラブ首長国連邦での報告は二次感染例（国際的拡大の証拠）だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。DRC内では Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu の24保健ゾーンに分布。接触者追跡率が約45%と低く、不安定性と人口移動がリスク要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تعافى 6 مرضى من إيبولا وعدم توفر اللقاحات يمثل تحديا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Six Ebola patients have recovered, and the lack of vaccines poses a challenge.
article.articleSummary: Six Ebola patients have recovered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, reported by the World Health Organization on June 3, 2026. With no approved vaccines or therapies yet, the outbreak remains challenging. Populations are urged to seek care promptly upon symptom onset. Five main challenges hinder containment: (1) testing and diagnosis—plans to expand decentralized labs in priority areas, including Mangwalo, Beni, Aru, Yakunda, and Kromi; (2) contact tracing—only ~45% of contacts are followed, versus the >90% target; security and population movement impede tracing; (3) travel restrictions— blanket bans disrupt supply chains; WHO recommends exit screening at airports, ports, and borders and urges lifting broad restrictions; (4) community distrust; building trust with local communities is essential; (5) absence of vaccines and treatments—clinical trials must be accelerated, with leadership, community ownership, partnerships, and trust as key drivers. WHO and partners remain committed to supporting Congo until the outbreak ends and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラからの回復患者6人、ワクチン不足が課題
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がDRCで報告され、IHR基準の「異常性」「重症度」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。またWPRO基準の「異常性」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に複数該当し、WHO発表という高い信頼性により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはギリシャ（Néa Krómi、Eastern Macedonia and Thrace）やシエラレオネも含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生が主題であり、これらは言及されていない。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ワクチン・治療薬の欠如、接触者追跡率の低さ（45% vs 90%目標）、コミュニティ不信など、複数の制御困難要因が明記されており、管理可能性に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola cases dropped sharply in DR Congo, says WHO
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has seen suspected cases under investigation drop sharply to 116 after laboratory testing ruled out many Ebola-like cases; others were diagnosed with malaria, meningitis or unrelated illnesses, according to WHO spokesperson Christian Lindmeier. A DRC Health Ministry report released May 27 said there were 1,077 suspected Ebola cases as of May 26. The latest update shows more than 340 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths, with six recoveries and 173 suspected cases in isolation. The World Health Organization had declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The strain driving this outbreak is Bundibugyo, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The evolving figures underline the ongoing transmission risk in the DRC and the importance of laboratory confirmation to distinguish Ebola from other illnesses among those presenting Ebola-like symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congoの感染者数が急減、WHO発表：エボラ疑い患者が大幅低下
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的懸念）、WHO公式発表による公式なPHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株による継続的な感染リスク。フルRRAに進むべき
triage.notes: WHO が2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。確認患者数340例超、死亡60例。Bundibugyo株は承認されたワクチンや特定治療法がなく管理困難。疑い患者の大幅減少は検査精度向上による結果だが、継続的な感染リスク存在

article.articleHeadline: Klaudia jest już w Polsce. Samolot z chorą Polką wylądował
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Klaudia is already in Poland. A plane carrying a sick Polish woman has landed.
article.articleSummary: Polish woman Klaudia Uciechowska returned to Poland after surgery to remove an ovarian teratoma in China; transport was organized by the Ministry of National Defence. Doctors had already removed the tumor, but beforehand it caused extensive damage including acute peritonitis, pneumonia, encephalitis, a duodenal perforation, and a hepatic abscess. Her mother Joanna described the situation on Siepomaga.pl, a fundraising site for her treatment. The case underscores serious infectious and inflammatory complications in a complex medical course requiring international care and repatriation. The article mentions China as the site of surgery and Poland as the destination; no further outcome details are provided. This summary reflects the reported medical issues and repatriation arrangement.

triage.headline_ja: クラウディアはすでにポーランドにいます。病気のポーランド人女性を乗せた飛行機が着陸しました
triage.triage_reason: 本症例は個人の医療搬送事例であり、新規の感染症流行や公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。既知の医学的合併症（脳炎を含む）を伴う個人患者の医療帰国であり、国際的感染リスクや集団感染の可能性がない。
triage.notes: この記事は個人患者（腹腔内奇形腫の手術後に脳炎を含む合併症を発症）の医療搬送事例である。感染症の流行シグナル、異常発生、または公衆衛生上の脅威を示さない。記事は中国での治療とポーランドへの帰国を述べているが、これは感染症イベント監視の対象ではなく、個人の医療事例である。対象国リスト内の実際の感染症イベントではないため、verified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: OMS rastrea contactos de paciente con ébola que viajó a Emiratos Árabes Unidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO traces the contacts of an Ebola patient who traveled to the United Arab Emirates.
article.articleSummary: WHO traces contacts of a Bundibugyo Ebola patient who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (epicenter) to the United Arab Emirates and Uganda. Uganda reports 15 confirmed Ebola cases linked to this outbreak, with one patient having traveled to UAE. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said authorities are collecting information to trace contacts and assess exposure risk during the patient’s journey, with UAE and Uganda cooperation. He warned against broad travel restrictions, reiterating WHO's stance on exit screening at airports, seaports, and land borders to prevent exported cases. He urged lifting general travel bans that disrupt supply chains and the health response. In positive data, suspected cases in the DRC have fallen from about 1,000 to 116 as many symptomatic individuals tested negative, and expanding diagnostic capacity remains a priority to reduce confirmation delays.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱患者の接触者追跡 - アラブ首長国連邦への渡航者を巡りWHOが対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の複数国への国際的拡大、重大な公衆衛生上の影響、死亡を伴う重症症例、渡航制限のリスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 修正: verified_locationsはサマリーに基づき検証。記事の主題国はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）、ウガンダ、アラブ首長国連邦だが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外、UAEも対象国外。Indiaは当初リストに含まれていないため記事サマリーを再確認したところ、実際には言及されていない。したがってverified_locationsはDRC(203312)のみに修正するべきだが、情報確認上の安全性を考慮し、主要な流行地点であるDRCを確実に含める。

article.articleHeadline: У Конгу потврђено 344 случаја еболе, 60 пацијената преминуло
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 344 Ebola cases confirmed, 60 patients have died.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization confirms 344 Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the response remains behind the outbreak, but health services under the DRC government are narrowing the gap. The Ebola epidemic has spread to neighboring Uganda, where the Ministry of Health reported 15 confirmed Ebola cases and one death as of June 2, 2026. The Ugandan figures reflect cross-border transmission and highlight the need for intensified surveillance, cross-border coordination, and timely public health actions across both countries to contain further spread. Authorities continue to monitor cross-border movement and bolster bilateral coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱344例が確認、患者60人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国家拡大（DRC→ウガンダの越境感染）、高い重症度と死亡率（60死亡/344例）、国際的に極めて高いリスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの発生が主題であり、ウガンダへの越境感染についても言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみ該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い死亡率（約17.4%）を示しており、WHOが確認している越境拡大はシグナルの優先度を最高水準に引き上げる。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo confirmó 344 contagios y 60 muertes por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo confirmed 344 cases and 60 deaths from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On June 3, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths from an outbreak declared May 15 in Ituri, near Uganda and South Sudan. Ituri accounts for 322 cases and 46 deaths; 116 suspected under investigation and 173 suspected in isolation. Six patients have recovered. Ituri remains the epicenter, with rapid detection of new foci in Mambasa underscoring community surveillance. The outbreak has spread to North and South Kivu and into Uganda, with 15 infections and one death reported there. The strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with a case fatality of roughly 30–50% and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Bunia airport has reopened after closure of less than two weeks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルス感染者344人および死亡者60人を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は致命率30～50%の重篤な感染症で、国際的な拡大（ウガンダ既に確認）と国際保健上の懸念が極めて高い。WHO がPHEIC（国際保健上の懸念となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を5月17日に宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの拡大（15感染、死亡1例）が明記されているが、Bluedot APIが付与した「発生地域」にUganda（226074）が含まれている点に留意。本トリアージでは記事の主題がDRCの発生であることから、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo strain）は致死率30～50%で、ワクチンまたは特異的治療法の承認実績がないため、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威度は極めて高い。WHOのPHEIC宣言により既に国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Scare? Infection Diseases Specialist Dr Shakeel Dispels Myths Amid Rumors Of Covid-19 Like Pandemic [Exclusive]
article.articleSummary: Ebola Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda was declared a PHEIC on May 17, 2026. As of 3 June 2026, India reports no confirmed cases; a Ugandan patient quarantined in Bengaluru illustrates imported-case concerns. Case fatality in the current outbreak is about 40% (historically up to 90%). Transmission occurs via contact with tissues or body fluids of infected animals; human infection can result from contaminated hands; person-to-person transmission requires direct contact with body fluids of living or deceased patients; semen can transmit from recovered individuals. No evidence of sustained respiratory spread. Outbreaks remain largely local, with limited potential for a pandemic unless an incubating traveler seeds spread. Vaccines rVSV-EBOV and Ad26. EBOV/MVA-BN-Filo exist but are not approved against the Bundibugyo strain. Preventive measures include strict infection control, PPE, exposure monitoring, and counseling on post-recovery shedding in urine, vaginal secretions, and breast milk. Monitor health updates.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖症？感染症専門医Dr. Shakeelが新型コロナのようなパンデミック噂の中で迷信を払拭[独占取材]
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準全5つ該当。DRCとウガンダでPHEIC宣言済みの現在進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク。インドへの輸入症例確認。シグナル確認すべき。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクはWHO-PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。インド（ベンガルール）での隔離患者はウガンダからの輸入症例。致命率40%（歴史的には最大90%）。現在のところインドでの確認症例なし。しかし輸入症例のリスクが具体化している点が重要。Bluedot発生地域にはウガンダが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC、ウガンダ、インドのため、対象国リスト内ではインドのみverified_locationsに追加。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため追加。

article.articleHeadline: Novi izveštaj iz žarišta virusa: Epidemija se širi, raste broj preminulih, hitno se oglasila SZO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New report from the virus hotspot: The epidemic is spreading, the death toll is rising, the WHO has issued an urgent statement.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 344 Ebola cases and 60 deaths as the outbreak continues. The World Health Organization issued an urgent statement, with Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noting that the response remains behind schedule, but health services under the Congolese government are catching up with the epidemic. The outbreak has spread to neighboring Uganda, where the Ministry of Health reports 15 confirmed Ebola cases and 1 death as of June 2, 2026. The Ugandan data reflect ongoing cross-border spread since the outbreak began. These figures reflect ongoing transmission and the urgent need for a strengthened response. Public health authorities urge continued vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス震源地からの新たな報告：流行が拡大し、死亡者数が増加、WHOが緊急声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急速拡大、国際的拡大、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラ出血熱は最高危険度の感染症であり、DRCとウガンダでの同時発生、死亡例あり、WHO緊急声明により社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの344症例60死亡、ウガンダでの確認事例があり、WHO Director-General による緊急声明で国際的な高い関心が示されている。エボラ出血熱の本性上、管理可能性が極めて低く、全ての危機管理基準に該当する高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông tử vong sau 5 tháng bị chó nhà cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man dies five months after being bitten by a domestic dog.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death suspected in Nghệ An Province, Vietnam. On 3 June 2026, Dong Luong District Health Center and Bạch Hà Commune authorities reviewed exposure risks after recording a likely rabies death. A 69-year-old man, N.V.V., from Bạch Hà, was bitten by a domestic dog about five months earlier; five days after the bite, the dog died. He did not receive rabies vaccination and instead used herbal remedies from a local traditional healer in Văn Kiều Commune. He subsequently developed vomiting, hydrophobia (fear of water), and agitation, was hospitalized, and died on 3 June 2026. The health center is tracing potentially exposed individuals and reinforcing rabies prevention and public awareness. No laboratory confirmation is reported in the article; the death remains a suspected rabies case, prompting ongoing local surveillance and risk assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 国内の犬に5ヶ月前に咬まれた男性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の死亡例（疑い例）がベトナムで報告され、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度と長期曝露に該当するが、検査室確認がなく情報が限定的であり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。続報による確認が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は疑い例で検査室確認未報告。患者は5ヶ月間の潜伏期後に死亡し、咬傷から5日後に犬も死亡している。ワクチン接種なしで伝統療法を使用。現地当局による曝露者の追跡と監視が開始されており、政府関心は確認されるが、散発例であり国際的拡大リスクは低い。確定診断の報告を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: NIH Researchers Allegedly Smuggled Monkeypox Into America, Lied About It
article.articleSummary: Two NIH-funded researchers, Drs. Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, are accused of smuggling monkeypox into the United States. They arrived from the Republic of the Congo at Detroit Metropolitan Airport with a case of 113 tubes, at least 13 containing deactivated monkeypox samples requiring approval to transport; border agents were told the case held diagnostics and testing equipment, with Munster allegedly remarking, You won’t need them. FBI lab testing had analyzed 20 vials by filing. The monkeypox strain is described as a moderate outbreak concern and differs from the U.S. local outbreak strain in 2022. Monkeypox can cause painful rash, enlarged lymph nodes, fevers, and can be fatal. Transmission is human-to-human and animal-to-human. WHO notes the 2022 outbreak predominantly affected men who have sex with men. The DOJ alleges concealment; NIH says it is cooperating and has activated biosafety protocols to safeguard facilities and materials.

triage.headline_ja: NIH研究者がエボラを密輸入した疑い、米国への持ち込みを隠蔽
triage.triage_reason: 未承認の病原体輸送（Mpox サンプル113本、うち13本は不活化体）、国境越境での隠蔽疑い、生物安全性リスク、複数国への感染拡大可能性が疑われるため、IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事は米国（Detroit）での違法輸入疑いが主題だが、対象国リストに米国が含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ列挙。ただしサマリーの説明通り、当該Mpoxサンプル自体はDRCから米国へ密輸入されたものであり、現在の重大懸念はアメリカ国内での管理・隔離状況である。DOJ調査・NIH関与・生物安全性プロトコル発動の記述から、政府・機関レベルの対応が既に開始されている。情報源が Daily Caller（保守系メディア）であり、公式確認前の可能性があるため、フルRRA実施時は DOJ・NIH・CDC の公式ステートメント確認が必須。

article.articleHeadline: NIH Researchers Allegedly Smuggled Monkeypox Into America, Lied About It |
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox smuggling case: NIH-funded researchers Drs. Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe arrived in Detroit from the Republic of the Congo with a case of 113 tubes, at least 13 containing deactivated monkeypox samples requiring transport approval. They allegedly lied to federal agents, claiming the case held diagnostics and testing equipment; Munster purportedly said, “You won’t need them. I do this all the time.” FBI lab had tested 20 vials by the filing. The monkeypox strain studied was a moderate US outbreak concern and differed from the 2022 localized US outbreak strain. Monkeypox can cause painful rash, fever, and enlarged lymph nodes and can be fatal. Transmission occurs human-to-human and animal-to-human, with the WHO noting patterns and a predominance among men who have sex with men since 2022. NIH states cooperation with authorities and ongoing biosafety protocols as the investigation proceeds.

triage.headline_ja: NIH研究者がサル痘をアメリカに密輸した疑い、嘘をついていた
triage.triage_reason: 本件は密輸・バイオセキュリティ違反の疑いを含む重大な事象だが、実際の流行発生ではなく、不活化サンプルの不正輸入事案である。一方、サル痘の国際的性質とDRCからの輸入という要素から、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本案件は感染症の流行事案ではなく、NIH資金提供研究者による不活化サンプルの不正輸入・虚偽申告という法執行機関案件である。DRCからの輸入という国際的要素とバイオセキュリティリスク、および公共メディアでの報道という社会的関心があるため、WATCHとして継続監視を推奨する。フルRRAは不適切である。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Chef warnt: Seltene Ebola-Variante breitet sich unkontrolliert aus - Tausende betroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General warns: Rare Ebola variant spreading uncontrollably — thousands affected.
article.articleSummary: Rare Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus is spreading uncontrollably in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with mid-May outbreak detection after weeks of undetected transmission. The World Health Organization reports 344 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC and 60 deaths, with 15 confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda. Suspected cases have fallen from over 1,200 to under 170, and most samples from suspected patients are negative as lab results are largely completed. Authorities are expanding testing capacity with WHO assistance. Major challenges include contact tracing, which has succeeded for only about 45% of contacts; estimates suggest more than 90% tracing would be needed to halt spread. Public trust remains low, hindering sick individuals from seeking care. Tedros emphasizes urgent development of vaccines and therapeutics specifically for this rare virus type, with the WHO pursuing rapid progress.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：稀なエボラ変異型が制御不能に拡大――数千人が影響を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準に4/4該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の稀な変異型、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5/5に該当。高い死亡率と国境を越えた拡大が確認されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは確認症例（15例）の言及のみで、現地での活動的な感染拡大が主題ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。DRCでの稀なBundibugyo型エボラの制御不能な拡大が主要な懸念。ワクチン・治療薬開発の緊急性が強調されている点も注目。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-baas: steeds meer grip op ebola in Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief: growing grip on Ebola in Africa
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring countries shows progress, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. There are 344 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with more than 250 deaths reported. The outbreak concerns the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus; there is no approved treatment for this variant yet, though vaccines are being developed for this and other variants. Ghebreyesus noted that medical teams are gaining ground under the leadership of the DRC, though the outbreak had an early start and authorities are still catching up. He said it is possible the outbreak began in January in the region, but investigations are needed to confirm the timeline.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：アフリカのエボラに対する対応が強化されつつある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（250人以上の死亡）、国際的拡大リスク（隣接国への波及）、未承認治療法の存在という複数の懸念が認められ、基準2つ以上該当。WPRO基準でも重症度（死亡多数）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染ウイルス）、管理可能性（治療法未承認）が該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo変異株）のアウトブレイク。344例の確定症例、250人以上の死亡報告。未承認の治療法（治療薬）が課題。WHOが進捗を評価しているが、感染拡大の初期段階で対応が遅れている可能性あり。隣接国への波及も示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: O que a bactéria encontrada na água Crystal pode causar no corpo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What the bacteria found in Crystal Water can do to the body.
article.articleSummary: Pseudomonas aeruginosa detected in a Crystal Water mineral water batch in Brazil prompted ANVISA to recall the product on 2026-06-03. The bacterium is common in air, water, soil, and on healthy skin but acts as an opportunistic pathogen, causing infections when host defenses are weakened. Symptoms range from mild skin irritation, redness, and local inflammation to severe fever, respiratory and urinary infections, infected wounds, and hospital-related complications; extreme cases can be life-threatening. Highest risk groups include immunosuppressed individuals (cancer patients, transplant recipients, uncontrolled HIV, long-term corticosteroids, autoimmune diseases), hospitalized patients, diabetics, and cystic fibrosis patients. After consumption, monitor for health changes and seek medical care if fever, infection, or unusual symptoms appear, especially among at-risk groups; for healthy individuals, risk is low. The recall serves as a preventive public health measure.

triage.headline_ja: Crystal水から検出された細菌が体に何をもたらすか
triage.triage_reason: 製品回収に伴う予防的な情報提供であり、既存の健康危機を示す証拠がない。Pseudomonas aeruginosaは日和見病原体として既知であり、健康な個人へのリスクは低いと明記されている。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのミネラルウォーター製品からのPseudomonas aeruginosa検出に関する予防的措置についての情報。ANVISAによる製品回収は標準的な公衆衛生対応。健康な個人へのリスクは低いと明記されており、既存の公衆衛生危機の兆候なし。見出しにはHIVが記載されているが、サマリーではHIVは高リスク群の1つとしてのみ言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ感染疑い米国人の「隔離施設」計画に反発高まるケニア、裁判所が「一時停止」の３週間延長命じる
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya's growing opposition to the plan for an Ebola isolation facility for an American with suspected infection; court extends the temporary halt by three weeks.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's courts extended the three-week pause on the U.S.-backed plan to establish an Ebola isolation facility in Kenya for an American with suspected infection, and ordered disclosure of the pact with Washington. The United States announced on May 28 that, amid Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo, it would begin moving a person suspected of infection to Kenya for isolation on May 29. Kenyan authorities have not confirmed any Ebola cases, fuelling domestic opposition. Protests in the central Kenyan town of Nanyuki drew hundreds on June 1, resulting in two deaths, which demonstrators attributed to police gunfire. The ruling underscores tensions between public health responses and civil rights concerns, as Nairobi grapples with perceived infection risk and demands transparency about the U.S.–Kenya agreement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染疑い米国人の「隔離施設」計画に反発高まるケニア、裁判所が「一時停止」の３週間延長命じる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患（PHEIC指定疾患）の疑い事例が米国人にて報告され、ケニアでの隔離施設計画をめぐり社会的・政治的関心が高まっている。IHR基準4項目中2項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、かつWPRO基準でも複数該当するためシグナルとしてピックアップ。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニアでの隔離施設計画と米国人の疑い事例、ならびにコンゴでのエボラ発生状況を述べている。ケニアではエボラ確定患者は報告されていないが、米国からの患者移送計画に対する社会的反発（ナニュキでの大規模抗議、警官による発砲で2名死亡）が生じており、社会的・政治的関心が顕著。国際的な感染リスクと市民的自由のバランスが課題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo confirma 344 contagios y 60 muertes por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo confirms 344 infections and 60 deaths from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Across eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola has 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, per the latest government bulletin. Ituri province accounts for 322 cases and 46 deaths, while 116 cases remain under investigation and 173 suspected individuals are in isolation. Six people have recovered. New transmission foci are being detected, notably in Mambasa. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri and has spread to North and South Kivu provinces and into Uganda, which has 15 infections including one death. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% fatality rate, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. In response, Bunia airport was reopened after its near two-week closure. The WHO designated the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo confirms 344 infections and 60 deaths from Ebola.
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の多数死亡、国際的拡大実績、渡航制限措置実施）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの高リスク感染症。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも15感染が報告されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC内の発生。WHO PHEIC指定済み（2026年5月17日）。Bundibugyo株で30-50%の致命率。新規感染焦点がMambasaで検出される。拡大リスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: 'Explosividad' del brote de ébola en el Congo alarma al Instituto Pasteur de Dakar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The explosiveness of the Ebola outbreak in the Congo alarms Dakar's Pasteur Institute.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared May 15 in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) shows explosive growth: 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths reported, after revising suspected cases down from over one thousand. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, with 15 confirmed cases and one death. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, with a case-fatality rate of about 30–50%; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Institut Pasteur de Dakar (Senegal), a WHO Collaborating Centre, is coordinating diagnostics, rapid testing development, and vaccine research, deploying field kits and mobile laboratories to reach remote areas, though no rapid tests exist yet for this strain. Security challenges, armed groups, mining activity, and population displacement complicate response, with many transmissions occurring in health facilities. Community engagement and robust case-data mapping are essential in these early weeks to guide response and projections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行の爆発的な増加がダカール・パスツール研究所を警戒させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPRO基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのリスク病原体であり、急速な症例増加と国際的拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は必ず報告が必要な疾患。記事サマリーでDRC（イトゥリ州）での爆発的な症例増加（344確認症例、60死亡）と、ウガンダへの国際的拡大（15確認症例、1死亡）が明記されている。循環株はブンディブギョ型（致死率30-50%）、ワクチン・特異的治療なし。保健医療施設での多くの感染、武装勢力による治安上の課題など対応の困難性が指摘されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: México reduce casos de dengue y avanza en estrategia nacional de prevención
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico reduces dengue cases and advances in its national prevention strategy.
article.articleSummary: Mexico reports significant progress in dengue prevention and control with cases down in 2026 vs the 2024 outbreak. January–May 2026 shows a favorable trend due to strengthened prevention, control, and timely care nationwide. Health Secretary David Kershenobich aims to cut new dengue, Zika, and chikungunya by 50% by 2030, potentially surpassing it. The strategy blends community prevention—Five Steps for a Mosquito-Free Home— with Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes to block dengue transmission. Yucatán has only nine dengue cases. New Wolbachia laboratories are planned in Tabasco, Oaxaca, Morelos, Aguascalientes, Chiapas, and Jalisco. In vaccination, Takeda’s dengue vaccine has Cofepris clearance and may join the national health inputs compendium; Brazil’s Butantan Institute collaborates on genotype-targeted vaccines. The National Vaccination Campaign (Apr 25–May 31) delivered about 8.6 million doses, and the National Public Health Week (May 23–30) reached over 20 million people across all 32 states.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコがデング熱症例を減少させ、国家的予防戦略を推進
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱の複数疾患における国家レベルの予防戦略と改善傾向の報告だが、シグナルとしての懸念（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や異常な流行）は記事サマリーに見当たらない。予防の進捗状況が主題であり、対象国リストにメキシコが含まれていないため、動向監視に位置付ける。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はメキシコの予防戦略の進捗であり、発生地域に列挙されたメキシコは対象国リストに含まれていない。ただしサマリー内でブラジルのブタンタン研究所とのワクチン協力が記載されているため、Brazilのみを verified_locations に含めた。本記事は予防・制御の成功事例の報告であり、新規シグナルではなく継続監視対象と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Muchos contactos con enfermos de ébola no han sido rastreados, alerta jefe de la OMS; reporta apenas un 45%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many contacts of Ebola patients have not been traced, WHO chief warns; only about 45% have been traced.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak update: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Bunia, Ituri Province, with 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths. As of June 3, 2026, only about 45% of contacts of Ebola patients have been traced, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who returned from the country. He warned that contact tracing in the DRC is not at the level it should be and stressed the goal of reaching approximately 90% tracing to curb transmission. Security concerns in the conflict-affected region, along with thousands of internally displaced people, are hindering tracing efforts and overall surveillance. The episode underscores the critical role of robust contact tracing and public health measures in containing this outbreak in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者との接触者の多くが追跡されていない、WHO事務局長が警告；わずか45%のみが追跡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定患者344名、死亡60名の発生がDRCで報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）を複数満たす。WHO事務局長による警告も示唆するように、接触者追跡率が45%にとどまる管理可能性の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 2026年6月時点の発生報告。紛争影響地域での接触者追跡困難、国内避難民数千人という複合的リスク要因がある。WHO事務局長の現地視察と警告は高い政治的関心を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, 60 morti su 344 casi in Congo. Oms: "Ci si può salvare, 8 sono i guariti"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 60 deaths out of 344 cases in Congo. WHO: "There is a chance of survival; 8 have recovered."
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of 3 June 2026, 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths across 24 health zones in three provinces, with 116 suspected cases. Uganda reports 15 confirmed infections and 1 death, including a Congolese resident who traveled to the United Arab Emirates and then Uganda. A U.S. citizen infected in the DRC is under treatment in Germany. WHO risk assessment: very high in the DRC, high regionally, low globally; officials note progress but ongoing challenges. Positive signal from treatment centers: 6 recoveries in the DRC and 2 in Uganda (8 total). Bunia, capital of Ituri, hosts three treatment centers with 80 beds; additional units operate in Mungbwalo, Rwampara, Beni, Goma, and Bukavu, with more planned. Contact tracing remains around 45% followed; targets exceed 90%. travel restricti ons are impacting response; WHO recommends exit screening at airports/ports/borders and urges lifting generalized travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴで344件中60人が死亡。WHO：「生き残る可能性がある、8人が回復」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多地域拡大オウトブレイク。IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数国への国際拡大、死亡者および渡航制限の実例）。緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にコンゴでのエボラ・ブンディブギョ株のアウトブレイク（344例、60死）を扱う。ウガンダでの15例の感染確認も記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ドイツとUAEでの症例確認は、感染源がコンゴであり、患者の移動例であるため primary affected country とは判断しない。WHO評価：DRCでは「非常に高い」リスク、地域レベルでは「高い」、グローバルでは「低い」。接触者追跡率45%で目標90%以下。治療センターでの回復例（DRC 6例、ウガンダ 2例）が報告されている。渡航制限が対応に影響しており、WHOは一般化された渡航禁止の解除を勧告。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: WHO kämpft gegen seltene Virusvariante und Misstrauen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: WHO fights a rare virus variant and distrust.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with the Bundibugyo variant detected; 344 laboratory-confirmed infections and 60 deaths in the DRC, plus 15 infections in neighboring Uganda. The variant proved difficult to identify with standard tests, discovery mid-May after weeks of spread. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the outbreak has run ahead; emphasis on contact tracing and monitoring—only 45% of contacts traced so far, needs over 90% to halt spread. Trust-building with local communities is essential for patients to seek care at established centers. WHO pressures vaccine and treatment research for this variant. Suspected cases have fallen from over 1,200 to under 170 as most samples test negative; WHO aiding expansion of local testing and analysis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ発生：WHOが稀なウイルス変異株と不信に対抗
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な拡大（DRC及びウガンダで確認）、複数の死亡例、稀な変異株の検出、国際的な対応体制の必要性が認められ、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダ（Uganda）への感染拡大が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみを確認済みの発生地として記録。稀なBundibugyo変異株の検出、国内接触者追跡率が45%に留まり90%必要という課題、コミュニティの信頼構築の重要性が強調されている。WHOによる積極的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية متمسكة بمواجهة تشيلي رغم إلغاء المباراة بسبب فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo remains determined to face Chile despite the match being canceled due to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted La Línea de la Concepción's mayor to cancel a friendly against Chile in Spain, halting a World Cup warm-up. The decision cited the Congo's health situation and documentation insufficient to prove no risk. DR Congo had trained in Belgium with players based in Europe and was due to face Denmark before heading to the World Cup in Canada, Mexico and the United States. The Congolese Football Federation says it remains committed to health, sporting and logistical protocols and is negotiating with authorities and the Spanish Football Federation to find a workaround. Coach Sebastien Desabre signaled a possible relocation within Spain. DR Congo will base in Houston, opening Group play vs Portugal on June 17, Colombia on June 23, and Uzbekistan on June 27—their first World Cup in 52 years.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスによる試合キャンセルにもかかわらずチリ戦への決意を示す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響とスポーツイベント開催による国際的な拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準で複数基準該当。エボラウイルスアウトブレイク報告と国際的な対応が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク。スペイン、チリ、ベルギー、デンマーク、カナダ、メキシコ、米国、ウズベキスタン、ポルトガル、コロンビアなどは発生地域ではなく、イベント関連地や渡航先として記載されているため、verified_locationsからは除外。エボラウイルスの確認事例数や重症度の詳細情報は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Scandal într-un institut de elită din SUA: doi virologi sunt acuzați că au încercat să introducă ilegal probe cu virusul mpox din Africa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scandal at an elite institute in the USA: two virologists are accused of attempting to illegally introduce samples of the mpox virus from Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two NIH virologists, Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, are accused of illegally importing mpox (monkeypox) samples from the Republic of the Congo to the United States. Stopped in January at Detroit Metropolitan Airport returning from Congo-Brazzaville, authorities found 113 vials; 17 contained inactivated mpox virus. Both researchers work in a U.S. Montana BSL-4 laboratory studying highly dangerous pathogens. Prosecutors say they transported materials without proper procedures and gave false information about bag contents. They face up to five years’ imprisonment. The purpose and whether the samples were for research have not been disclosed. The case raises biosafety questions amid mpox outbreaks outside Africa. Mpox causes fever, muscle pains, and rash, with severe cases possible; investigation continues to determine if this was administrative violation or deliberate evasion of handling rules.

triage.headline_ja: 米国のエリート機関でのスキャンダル：2人のウイルス学者がアフリカからのMpoxウイルスサンプルを違法に持ち込もうとしたとして非難されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。バイオセーフティの重大な懸念と国際的な感染症管理上の問題を含む。
triage.notes: 本事例は米国内での違法なウイルスサンプル輸送という犯罪的側面が主であるが、Mpoxの国際的拡大リスク、バイオセーフティ上の重大な懸念、および現在進行中のMpox流行（特にアフリカ外での発生）の背景において、公衆衛生上の脅威として扱う必要がある。DRCからのサンプル輸出に関わるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。米国はMpoxの輸入国であり、主な発生国ではないため対象国リストに基づき含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Starosta španielskeho mesta zakázal prípravný zápas medzi výbermi DR Kongo a Čile, dôvodom sú obavy z eboly
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The mayor of a Spanish city banned a preparatory match between the DR Congo and Chile national teams due to concerns about Ebola
article.articleSummary: Spain’s La Línea de la Concepción mayor Juan Franco canceled a preparatory international friendly between DR Congo and Chile scheduled for 9 June due to Ebola fears. The preventive ban followed guidance from the Andalusian health service amid an Ebola epidemic declared in central and eastern DR Congo in mid-May. DR Congo, making its first World Cup appearance since 1974 (then Zaire), had been set to face Denmark in Liège, Belgium, and had based their camp in Belgium ahead of the tournament. As the World Cup is hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico from 11 June to 19 July, US authorities on 22 May required a 21-day quarantine for the team before entering the United States. DR Congo will base in Houston and play Group K fixtures: Portugal (June 17 in Houston), Colombia (June 24 in Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (June 28 in Atlanta).

triage.headline_ja: スペイン南部の自治体がコンゴ民主共和国とチリの準備試合を禁止、エボラ懸念が理由
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（複数国での試合計画）と、国際的な移動制限の実施（米国での隔離要件）により、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。スペイン地方当局による試合禁止という政治的対応も確認される。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はコンゴ民主共和国の中央・東部で5月中旬に宣言された。2026年ワールドカップ（米国・カナダ・メキシコ開催）に参加する代表チームが関わっており、国際的なスポーツイベントへの感染症の影響が確認される。スペイン、ベルギー、デンマークなどが記事に言及されているが、実際の流行発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみであるため、verified_locationsに含めるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Cancels Friendly Games Amid Ebola Crisis Ahead of World Cup Debut
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s historic World Cup debut is disrupted by an Ebola outbreak, after a pre-tournament friendly against Chile was canceled due to fears linked to the illness. As of 2026-06-03, public health concerns amid ongoing Ebola transmission in DR Congo have interrupted Leopards’ preparations, illustrating how outbreaks can affect major sporting events and international participation. The article provides no Ebola case counts, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources. It centers on precautionary measures impacting sports rather than clinical details, signaling heightened caution as the World Cup approaches. The cancellation adds to the challenges facing DR Congo’s readiness to compete on football’s world stage, with organizers remaining vigilant about health risks ahead of the tournament.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機の最中、DRコンゴがワールドカップ初出場を前にフレンドリーマッチを中止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生報告（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性を満たす）。IHR基準で2つ以上該当し、国際的な影響（ワールドカップを含む国際イベント関連）がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが'Republic of Chile'を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではDR Congoでのエボラ発生が主題であり、チリは試合キャンセルの相手国としてのみ言及されている。したがってChileは除外し、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ただし具体的な症例数、確定診断、感染源など臨床詳細が不足しており、情報収集・確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epreuves certificatives : le respect des mesures contre Ebola exigé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Certification exams: compliance with Ebola prevention measures required
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease prevention is being enforced for Congo’s national certification exams in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Inspector General of National Education Hubert Kimbonza confirmed ENAFEP will run June 4–5, 2026, with TENASOSP June 11–12, and the ordinary state-exam session June 22–25. To mitigate Ebola transmission, all candidates and exam organizers must comply with measures: masks required at centers; establishment of handwashing points equipped with soap and hydroalcoholic gel; and enforcement of social distancing. Kimbonza urged center directors to ensure these preventive measures are in place across all examination centers in the three provinces. The emphasis is on strict Ebola prevention during the exams, integrating infection-control practices into the education timetable without additional external outbreak details.

triage.headline_ja: 認定試験：エボラ対策の遵守が必須
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ予防措置が教育現場で実施されている状況であり、異常性や予想外性があるが、新規の流行拡大や重症事例についての記載がなく情報が限定的。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの国家認定試験におけるエボラ予防措置の実装について述べている。South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu の3州で実施される試験での感染対策強化が主題。ただし、現在の流行状況、患者数、重症度についての具体的記載がなく、教育行政の予防措置実施という文脈のため、重大なアウトブレイク指標は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patient traveled through UAE before reaching Uganda, WHO says By Investing.com
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient from the Democratic Republic of Congo traveled to the United Arab Emirates and then Uganda, the WHO said. The individual is among 15 confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros said the agency is coordinating with Uganda and the UAE to gather information, assess travel-exposure risk, and facilitate contact tracing. An American citizen infected in the DRC is being treated in Germany. In the DRC, 344 cases have been confirmed with 60 deaths across 24 health zones in three provinces; suspected cases have fallen to 116 from >1,000 last week as backlog is addressed. Six people have recovered in the DRC and two in Uganda. Contact-follow-up stands at about 45% and must exceed 90% to stay ahead. Insecurity and mobile populations hinder tracing. Risk: very high nationally, high regionally, low globally. Trials for vaccines and therapeutics are being advanced; DRC has halted 16 prior outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者がUAEを経由してウガンダに到達、WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的な拡大と複数国への患者移動が確認されている。スクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当し、緊急対応が必要な重大感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラの複数国への拡大を述べているが、対象国リストに基づき検証location は DRC のみとした（Uganda、UAE、Germany は対象国でない）。ただし事象の重大性（344確定症例、344死亡、患者の国際移動、WHO調整による接触者追跡）から PICKUP 判定。IHR基準全該当、スクリーニング基準全該当。DRC では 3 州 24 保健区間での確定・疑い患者が報告され、接触者追跡率 45% で 90% 到達が必要。不安全性と流動人口が追跡を阻害している状況。

article.articleHeadline: بعد التعافي من إيبولا .. ممرض كونغولي يستأنف مهامه
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After recovering from Ebola, a Congolese nurse resumes his duties.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is grappling with an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus, characterized as a rare strain. The World Health Organization reports more than 344 laboratory-confirmed cases in this outbreak. The article centers on a Congolese national who recovered from Ebola and has returned to duty as a nurse, illustrating a personal recovery story within a continuing public health challenge. The narrative highlights hope and resilience among healthcare workers as the outbreak persists, with authorities tracking confirmed cases and the ongoing need for clinical care and infection control in affected communities. The piece does not detail infection sources or other outcomes beyond the recovered healthcare worker and the broadened case count.

triage.headline_ja: エボラからの回復後、コンゴの看護師が職務を再開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo virus株）は公衆衛生上の重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する。確認症例344件超で進行中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus (BDBV)は稀な株であり、エボラウイルス属の中でも注目すべき亜種。344件以上の確定症例が報告されており、進行中のアウトブレイクと評価される。医療従事者の感染・回復事例は医療体制への負荷を示唆。WHO報告による確定症例数の記載あり。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Centro, São José e Catalão lideram os casos de dengue em Divinópolis - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centro, São José, and Catalão lead dengue cases in Divinópolis - Portal MPA.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Brazil, 3 June 2026 — dengue remains the primary concern in the city, with 3,582 notifications and 1,368 confirmed dengue cases, 236 hospitalizations, and three deaths (one death under investigation) reported for 2026. Chikungunya shows 25 notifications, 3 confirmed cases, 5 hospitalizations, and no deaths; Zika has no 2026 notifications or confirmations. Dengue cases are led by Centro (225), followed by São José (177) and Catalão (128), with additional notable clusters in Planalto (125), Belvedere (111), São Roque (110), Tietê (108), Campina Verde (91), Afonso Pena (81), Niterói (79), Santa Lúcia (71), and Bom Pastor (66). Dengue predominantly affects ages 20–29, then 30–39. The report underscores ongoing dengue activity in Divinópolis as of June 3, 2026, across multiple neighborhoods, with chikungunya present at low levels and no Zika activity reported this year.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノポリスでデング熱の症例が中心部、サンジョゼ、カタラン地区で集中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常または予想外」と「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」の2基準に該当。ブラジルでのデング熱、チクングニア、ジカの同時発生を示唆する多ウイルス流行であり、入院患者と死亡が報告されているため、フルRRA進行対象。
