triage.notes: 2026年のディヴィノポリスにおいて、デング熱1,368確定例、236入院、3死亡が報告され、チクングニアも3例確定している。複数ウイルスの同時活動、年齢別分布（20-29歳が最多）、複数地区での大規模発生（Centro 225例など）が確認される。ジカは2026年の通知なし。Bluedot API発生地域にはBrazilが正しく含まれており、記事サマリーもブラジルの都市ディヴィノポリスでの流行を主題としているため、Brazil（GeoNames ID 3469034）をverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Response Update: June 3, 2026
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03, an Ebola outbreak is being addressed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan. The U.S. Department of State, with the CDC and DoW, is mounting a rapid response to protect Americans and contain spread. A voluntary process for U.S. citizens with possible Ebola exposure or seeking departure from DRC, South Sudan, or Uganda has been published; enrollment in STEP is encouraged for updates. U.S. foreign assistance to fight the outbreak exceeds $162 million, with six dedicated Ebola response clinics and support to dozens of clinics to screen, transport, and treat cases. An additional $350 million through OCHA pooled funds is provided to DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda as part of $1.8 billion in U.S. funding to OCHA announced May 14. Response activities include border screening and surveillance, contact tracing and risk communications, diagnostic supplies, detection and treatment, and food assistance for suspected/confirmed cases and health workers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応最新情報：2026年6月3日
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべて該当。複数国での同時アウトブレイク、高い死亡率、国際的支援体制の構築が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC、Uganda、South Sudan でのエボラアウトブレイク対応が言及されている。対象国リスト内では DRC のみ該当（203312）。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていない。South Sudan も対象国リストに含まれていない。米国への言及は対応国の側面であり、イベント発生地ではないため除外。複数国での流行、高い死亡率、U.S. 政府による大規模支援（$162M以上のドメスティック助成、$350M の OCHA 資金）、国際的な検疫・渡航制限の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Governo do Marrocos cancela seis amistosos por causa de surto de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Morocco's government cancels six friendlies due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa prompts Morocco to cancel six June international friendlies scheduled to be held in Morocco as neutral venue fixtures, a precaution amid the ongoing spread of Ebola focused in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda with rising travel restrictions. Canceled matches include Tanzania vs Uganda; Comoros vs Rwanda; Uganda vs Madagascar; Tanzania vs Rwanda; Burundi vs Equatorial Guinea; and Comoros vs Equatorial Guinea. DR Congo has canceled domestic activities and relocated training to Belgium, while Spain blocked a Congo-Chile friendly over outbreak fears. As of 3 June 2026, the outbreak in DR Congo reports about 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths; Uganda has at least 15 confirmed cases and one death. Organizers continue monitoring the epidemiological situation before announcing further decisions.

triage.headline_ja: モロッコ政府、エボラ流行のため6つの国際親善試合をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラは国際保健規則上の最重要疾患であり、DRCとウガンダでの確認例と死亡例を伴う流行、複数国への拡大と国際試合キャンセル等の渡航制限措置が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域には対象国外のマダガスカル、赤道ギニア、コモロ諸島、チリ、スペイン、ベルギーなども含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC（344確認例、60死亡）とウガンダでのエボラ流行である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。エボラは IHR Annex2上の最重要疾患であり、死亡例を伴う確認例、複数国への拡大リスク、国際試合キャンセル等の渡航・スポーツ活動制限が明記されている。フルのRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : pourquoi aucun vaccin n'est encore prêt face à la souche Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: why no vaccine is yet ready against the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo faces the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine exists. WHO published early recommendations to guide testing of candidate products, prioritizing those with potential protection against Bundibugyo. Ervebo (the only approved Ebola vaccine) targets the Zaïre strain and has a solid safety profile, but its efficacy against Bundibugy o is unproven, making its use mainly experimental in research protocols. Experimental treatments are also being evaluated to protect exposed individuals and treat confirmed cases. Among Bundibugyo-focused candidates, rVSV Bundibugyo (IAVI) is among the most advanced but may require months of clinical evaluation; an Oxford University/Serum Institute of India candidate could enter testing sooner; Moderna is pursuing an mRNA approach with CEPI support. Africa CDC notes possible interest in a Gamaleya Institute vaccine, pending scientific validation. Until solid data emerge, responses rely on rapid detection, contact tracing, isolation, and early care.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンがまだ準備できていない理由
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（既承認ワクチンが効果的でない新株）のDRC発生は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を持ち、国際的な懸念と拡大リスクが明白。IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事主題はDRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の発生であり、既承認ワクチン（Ervebo）が効果的でない新株による脅威を強調している。インドは記事の言及（血清研究所の候補ワクチン開発国）として発生地域に含まれているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Chef: 'Wir hinken im Kampf gegen Ebola hinterher'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief: 'We are lagging behind in the fight against Ebola'.
article.articleSummary: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled, with the virus likely spreading weeks before mid-May detection. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus type, not detected by standard tests. In the DRC’s eastern region, 344 confirmed cases have been reported, including 60 deaths; Uganda reports 15 confirmed cases. Suspected cases have fallen from over 1,200 to under 170 as most samples were negative, but case finding and laboratory confirmation must improve. Contact tracing is a major challenge, with only 45% of contacts monitored versus a target above 90% to halt transmission. Community trust must be strengthened to ensure patients seek care in treatment centers. The WHO is accelerating vaccine and therapeutic development for this virus type and expanding regional testing capacity.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：「エボラウイルスとの戦いで我々は遅れを取っている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な病原体型、国際的拡大），WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当，世界的関心と国際支援ニーズが高い。エボラアウトブレイクの制御不十分状況は重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Uganda)は発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは2次的な言及（15確認症例）であり、主題はDRCのアウトブレイク。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsに含めない。希少なBundibugyo ebolavirus型の検出、制御不十分な状況、接触追跡の低い実施率（45% vs 90%目標）が懸念材料。WHO事務局長の発言による高い政治的・国際的関心。

article.articleHeadline: خبيرة بالصحة العالمية: عدد كبير من العاملين الصحيين أصيبوا بـ إيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global health expert: a large number of healthcare workers were infected with Ebola - Youm7
article.articleSummary: WHO says Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand amid persistent healthcare-worker shortages and security/logistics challenges. Acting WHO Africa Region Emergency Director said 106 field staff are deployed across three affected provinces, with many local health workers infected, prompting recruitment from other provinces; 30 specialists from Kinshasa joined to bolster clinical care. Diagnostics include 2,000 Ebola tests deployed, with a mobile lab in Mangwalo and testing in Bunia. The program plans 278 more staff, but only 38% of that target has been reached. International partners, including Doctors Without Borders, support treatment centers and staffing. To date, 1,445 lab tests conducted; daily suspected cases at 116. 223 historical deaths are being reviewed to reclassify. Five additional laboratories are planned by early next week to enable about 1,000 tests per day under government oversight; credit to Institute of Biomedical Research and Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルヘルス専門家：多数のヘルスケアワーカーがエボラに感染 - Youm7
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は最重症の感染症であり、医療従事者の大量感染、複数州への拡大、国際的支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高致死率感染症。記事では医療従事者を含む多数の感染者、複数州での発生拡大、人員不足、セキュリティ上の課題を言及。WHO、MSF、アフリカCDC等の国際的対応が進行中。検査体制の強化計画あり。DRCはAfrican Regionの内部状況であり国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Presidente do Quénia Defende Centro de Quarentena Apesar dos Protestos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kenya's President Defends Quarantine Center Despite Protests.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's President William Ruto defended a US-backed Ebola quarantine center to be built at Laikipia Air Base for potentially exposed American citizens, despite strong public opposition and police clashes in Nanyuki. The plan is temporarily halted after the Kenyan Supreme Court, at the request of Katiba Institute, suspended the center pending merits of the case, arguing that public interest justified review. Kenya reports no Ebola cases to date. The backdrop is an Ebola outbreak declared May 15 in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with spillover into Uganda; Ugandan authorities have 15 confirmed cases, including one death. Ebola is caused by a virus transmitted through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids, causing fever, severe weakness, muscle pains, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. The World Health Organization notes it is less contagious than COVID-19 or measles.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：ケニア大統領が抗議にもかかわらず検疫センターを擁護
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。アフリカ東部での多国間エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダでの確認事例）と、ケニアでの検疫センター構築に関する政治的対立が同時進行しており、地域的な公衆衛生危機管理上のシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的分析：エボラウイルス病アウトブレイクの実発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（5月15日宣言）とウガンダ（確認事例15例、死亡1例）である。ケニアは地理的隣国だが、記事執筆時点ではケニア国内でのエボラ確認事例はなく、主題はむしろ米国支援の検疫センター建設計画に対する国内政治的対立にある。対象国リスト内でのみカウントするため、verified_locationsはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダおよびケニアは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Pseudomonas: os perigos da superbactéria achada na água Crystal - Aqui
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pseudomonas: the dangers of the superbug found in Crystal Water - Here.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa recalls 374,400 bottles of Crystal natural mineral water (500 ml) after detecting Pseudomonas aeruginosa in batch LZ1 VAL200127 3 P 200126, produced 20-01-2026 and expiring 20-01-2027. Distribution spans Distrito Federal, Goiás, Tocantins, and interior São Paulo. Manufacturer: Mineração Bom Jesus Ltda.; about 99.2% already recalled and no consumer cases reported. Consumers should verify the batch number on packaging; if contaminated, do not consume and await guidance on return/refund. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a bacterium common in soil, water, and plants; typically harmless to healthy individuals but poses infection risks to immunocompromised people, and is a major hospital pathogen with high antibiotic resistance (described as a superbacteria). Infections may involve lungs (pneumonia), bloodstream (bacteremia/sepsis), skin (wounds with greenish-blue discharge and fruity odor), or ears (otitis externa). High-risk groups include hospitalized patients, ICU, those undergoing cancer treatment, HIV, transplant recipients, cystic fibrosis patients, burns, or open wounds.

triage.headline_ja: Pseudomonas：Crystal Waterで発見されたスーパーバクテリアの危険性
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはHIVではなくPseudomonas aeruginosa（緑膿菌）による製品汚染事案であり、既に99.2%が回収済みで消費者被害報告なし。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクのいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の流行検知ではなく、製品汚染に関する安全リコール事案である。疾患名がHIVと誤分類されているが、実際の主題はPseudomonas aeruginosaによる飲料水汚染。既に管理措置が講じられており、感染症イベント監視の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ подтвердила 344 случая заражения и 60 смертей из-за Эболы в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms 344 Ebola infection cases and 60 deaths from Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, the World Health Organization confirmed 344 Ebola virus disease cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with suspected cases lowered to 116 after excluding other diseases with similar symptoms. In neighboring Uganda, 15 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, with 1 death, and eight patients have recovered in each country. The situation remains tense: national risk is assessed as very high, regional risk high, and global risk minimal. The outbreak is concentrated in eastern DRC, largely in areas affected by armed conflict. The report notes laboratory confirmation of cases and provides no further details on infection source or imported/exported cases. The update underscores ongoing transmission and the need for monitoring and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラウイルス感染344例と60人の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に最重大な感染症の1つであり、複数国での確認、高い死亡率、地域的リスク「高」評価、国際的監視対象。フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの15例の確認も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC での 344 確認例、60 死亡（死亡率 17.4%）、および地域的広がりはIHR通知の明確な基準を満たす。東部DRCの武装紛争地域での発生という文脈も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola | La riposte humanitaire est en train de " rattraper " son retard, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak | The humanitarian response is catching up, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with May 15 declaring it the country’s 17th outbreak and the WHO issuing a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The epicentre is Ituri, with 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths across 24 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Suspected cases have fallen from over 1,000 to 116 after review. In Uganda, 15 confirmed cases and one death are reported, including a Congolese resident who travelled to the United Arab Emirates before entering Uganda. An American infected in the DRC remains hospitalized in Germany. The WHO notes ongoing challenges—late detection, insecurity, mistrust, and lack of vaccine—amid progress under the DRC government. It warns that general travel restrictions disrupt response, recommends exit screening at airports, ports, and land borders, and urges lifting those broad restrictions. Risk remains very high nationally, high regionally, low globally.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行 | WHOによると人道的対応が遅れを取り戻している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: DRCの17番目のエボラ流行。Ituri州が震源地で344例の確認例と60例の死亡が報告されている。ウガンダでも15例の確認例が報告されており、国際的な拡大が認識されている。WHOが国際的な保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。ただし、Ugandaはこの評価の対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Zentralafrika: WHO-Chef - Welt hinkt bei Ebola-Bekämpfung noch hinterher
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Central Africa: WHO chief - the world is still lagging behind in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo remains the epicenter of the current Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, with 359 Ebola-related deaths confirmed by WHO. The Bundibugyo variant is in circulation and, as of June 3, 2026, there is no specific treatment or approved vaccine. The World Health Organization warned that the international community is still lagging behind in the response, but government-led efforts in the Democratic Republic of Congo offer hope. The WHO previously declared a public health emergency of international concern in mid-May, though travel bans are viewed as counterproductive; instead, airport, port, and border controls are recommended to prevent exportation of cases and contacts. The United States has imposed entry bans on non-US citizens from the DRC. The outbreak has also affected Uganda, with case numbers declining at one point. Tedros urged coordinated, risk-based measures rather than blanket restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱：WHO事務局長 - エボラ対策でまだ世界が後れを取っている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は確定例359名、死亡例あり、複数国に拡大、国際的に関心も高く、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事由（PHEIC）を宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRコンゴを発生地の中心として記述。ウガンダでも症例があるが、サマリー上でウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない（1327865=Myanmar）。米国の入国禁止措置は対応例示であり、発生地ではない。PHEIC宣言により国際的に重要。Bundibugyo株の流行で予防接種戦略にも影響あり。

article.articleHeadline: Carolina Dieckmann é internada com infecção avançada: 'Já estava avançada'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carolina Dieckmann hospitalized with an advanced infection: 'It was already advanced'.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actress Carolina Dieckmann has been hospitalized for four days with an advanced infection of the left kidney. She is receiving intravenous antibiotics, and there is no estimated discharge date as of 3 June 2026. The infection was diagnosed before the start of a planned trip to an isolated location, and the hospital stay interrupts that travel plan. Dieckmann shared the health update in an Instagram video on Wednesday, noting the IV treatment and the seriousness of the infection. She also marked her 23-year wedding anniversary with her husband in the same message, thanking attentive friends and her spouse for support. The report does not detail the infection source or prognosis.

triage.headline_ja: カロリーナ・ディエックマン、進行した感染症で入院：『既に進行していた』
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医療事例であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や異常な疾患パターンを示す証拠がない。Unknown Illnessであり、感染症イベントの監視対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの著名人1名の個人的な医療事例に関する情報である。感染症の病名が不詳（Unknown Illness）であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報がない。セレブリティに関するメディア報道であり、感染症監視システムのシグナルとしては適切でない。

article.articleHeadline: Распространение смертельно опасной болезни угрожает путешествиям - вирус уже стремится в Европу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The spread of a life-threatening disease threatens travel; the virus is already heading toward Europe.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak spreading rapidly in West Africa, already claiming almost 250 lives, has reached Brazil and other countries, triggering concern over international travel. The World Health Organization said the outbreak was reported two weeks before the article date. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola virus—primarily the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant with up to 40% fatality—has recorded more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths. No approved vaccine exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. With the outbreak expanding and international travel continuing, authorities warn the virus is heading toward Europe, underscoring the risk of imported cases and travel-related spread.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的な病気の拡大が旅行を脅かす - ウイルスはすでにヨーロッパに向かっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の致命的性格（死亡率40%）、Bundibugyo株という稀な変異株による1,000件以上の疑い例と246人以上の死亡、複数国への拡大、ヨーロッパへの拡散リスクなど、全ての国際保健規則上の懸念要件を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは「West Africa」で拡大し、DRCでBundibugyo株による大規模アウトブレイク（1,000件以上の疑い例、246人以上の死亡）が報告されている。ブラジルへの拡大も明示されているため両国を verified_locations に含めた。Angolaはサマリー内で明示的な言及がないため除外した。Bundibugyo Ebolaはワクチン未開発であり、死亡率40%という高リスク。ヨーロッパへの拡散警告もあり、国際的懸念は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: NIH researchers charged with trying to smuggle monkeypox into US: DOJ
article.articleSummary: NIH researchers Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe of the NIH Rocky Mountain Laboratory were charged by the Department of Justice with conspiracy to smuggle monkeypox (Mpox) virus into the United States and making false statements to federal agents. DOJ alleges they arrived at Detroit Metropolitan Airport from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, carrying a large black plastic case and claimed it contained diagnostics and testing equipment. CBP/FBI investigations found 113 vials in Styrofoam coolers; FBI testing of 20 vials showed 17 contained inactivated monkeypox virus, 1 contained inactivated chickenpox virus, and 2 contained only human DNA. Monkeypox is a viral illness transmitted by close contact, causing fevers, headaches, and a blistering rash per WHO; an outbreak was ongoing in the Republic of Congo at the time. Munster and Kwe face up to five years in prison if convicted.

triage.headline_ja: NIH研究者がエボラウイルスを米国に密輸しようとしたとして起訴される：司法省
triage.triage_reason: 犯罪容疑者によるMpox違法搬入事件であり、実際の感染症の流行や拡散ではなく、法執行事象である。ただしコンゴでの進行中の流行背景とリスク意識の高さから経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは感染症の自然発生ではなく、法執行事象（密輸未遂）である。コンゴでのMpox流行が背景にあり、違法な病原体の国際移動リスクを示唆する点で注視価値あり。実際の感染症波及リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Com riscos de ebola e sarampo, Anvisa atualiza medidas preventivas em portos e aeroportos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With risks of Ebola and measles, Anvisa updates preventive measures at ports and airports.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-03, Brazil’s Anvisa updated preventive health measures at ports and airports. Following the WHO’s declaration of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), Normative Instruction No. 448/2026 requires banners about Ebola in international arrival areas. No additional measures for travelers, transport, cargo, or remains were adopted, aligning with WHO and PAHO guidance and without travel restrictions. For measles, aircraft announcements persist due to imported cases in the Americas and World Cup-related travel to the United States, Canada, and Mexico. Brazil has eliminated measles since 2024, but ongoing circulation in the Americas sustains import risk. For poliomyelitis, international spread risk remains under a PHEIC, yet no entry-point health measures are recommended. Overall, Brazil maintains surveillance and risk communications without border closures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとはしかのリスク、アンビサがポートと空港の予防措置を更新
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。複数の高リスク疾患（エボラ、ポリオ、麻疹）に関連し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言に基づくブラジルの公式対応を報告している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは複数の疾患（エボラ、麻疹、ポリオ）を扱っており、DRCとウガンダでのエボラ感染拡大がWHOによるPHEIC宣言の対象とされている。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。スペイン（カナリア諸島）、アメリカ、カナダ、メキシコは地理的参照だが記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya: Statement On Ebola Response Efforts and Cooperation With Kenya
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response in Kenya strengthened through U.S.–Kenya cooperation. The United States and Kenyan authorities are coordinating to enhance detection and spread control, with the Laikipia bio-isolation facility serving as part of a holistic regional response and not posing risk to nearby communities. Efforts expand border detection, accurate testing, and the response in high‑risk counties, and build regional capacity to isolate and test asymptomatic individuals, including Americans assisting the effort. The United States remains the largest financial contributor, with direct assistance exceeding $162 million and an additional $350 million via OCHA to the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan as part of $1.8 billion in OCHA funding announced on May 14. The objective is to halt the outbreak at its source and prevent Ebola from reaching Kenya or the United States; the note references ongoing court action in Kenya while communications remain aligned with Kenyan public objectives.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：エボラ対応努力とケニアとの協力に関する声明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い重症度と致死性を持つ疾患であり、複数国での発生報告と国際的な協力体制の構築が記述されている。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは複数国を記載しているが、記事サマリーより実際の発生地は主にDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンの3国。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ケニアは発生報告ではなく、検出強化と対応準備の対象地として記述されている。米国の記載は援助国としての文脈。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : la riposte humanitaire est en train de 'rattraper' son retard, selon l'OMS - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the humanitarian response is catching up on its delay, according to the WHO - RTBF Actus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 344 laboratory-confirmed cases and 60 deaths across 24 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu as of June 3, 2026. The outbreak was declared on May 15, and WHO has deemed it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus highlighted late detection, insecurity, population distrust, and the absence of a vaccine as major challenges. He urged lifting general travel restrictions that disrupt supply chains, while recommending exit screening at airports, seaports, and land borders to prevent cross-border spread. Suspected cases have dropped from over 1,000 last week to 116 after case-by-case review. The response is catching up to the delay, underscoring ongoing containment difficulties in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: RDC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ：人道支援の対応が遅れを取り戻しつつある、WHO発表 - RTBF Actus
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生で、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。344確定症例、60死亡、24の保健地域で多国にまたがり、WHOがPHEIC認定。国際的拡大リスク高く、渡航制限の話題も含む。
triage.notes: エボラはWHOがPHEIC（国際的懸念事項である公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と認定。複数州での発生、死亡率高い、国際的医療支援が需要、渡航・貿易制限の議論あり。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、記事サマリーも主にDRC（Ituri、South Kivu等の省）での発生を主題としている。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. says $162 million mobilised for Ebola response in central Africa - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleSummary: U.S. mobilises $162 million in bilateral Ebola response, centered in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with operations in Uganda and South Sudan. Aid supports six Ebola response clinics and dozens of facilities for screening, referral and treatment, alongside $350 million channeled through UN OCHA pooled funds to DRC, South Sudan and Uganda. International border screening by IOM continues at points of entry in Burundi, DRC, Rwanda, South Sudan and Uganda. In DRC, partners such as FHI 360 run risk-communication campaigns in French and Swahili; laboratory capacity has been strengthened, with expanded sample transport and testing facilities. Six specialized facilities (five transit centers and one treatment unit) plus 43 clinics support isolation, screening and patient referral. WFP provides food aid to suspected/confirmed Ebola cases and frontline workers in eastern DRC (Goma, Beni, Bukavu). US guidance urges citizens to enrol in Smart Traveler and consider voluntary departures for exposed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱対応に1億6200万ドルを動員 - ラジオ・タマズジ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ）での確認と、国境を越えた対策が実施されていることから、IHR基準を複数満たし、かつ国際的な支援体制の構築が必要とされている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCを中心としたエボラ対応を主題としており、実際の発生地域はDRC（東部、特にゴマ、ベニ、ブカヴ）である。ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジは主に国境スクリーニング地点として言及されているため、実際の発生が確認されたのはDRCのみと判断した。米国は二国間支援を提供していますが、米国内での発生は記事サマリーに記載されていません。エボラ出血熱は高致死率の感染症であり、複数施設での隔離・スクリーニング・患者搬送の実施から、既に相応な規模での流行が進行中と推測されます。

article.articleHeadline: Researchers Attempted to Illegally Smuggle Vials of Monkeypox Into the United States Through Detroit Metro Airport
article.articleSummary: Two NIH researchers, Vincent Munster, 53, from the Netherlands, and Claude Kwe, 38, from Cameroon, were charged with attempting to smuggle vials containing Monkeypox into the United States at Detroit Metro Airport on January 25, 2026, after traveling from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo via Paris. Munster, chief of the Virus Ecology Section at NIH’s Laboratory of Virology, and Kwe allegedly lied to Customs and Border Protection and conspired to import materials without the required documentation. Officers found a large black case with more than 100 vials; 20 of the 113 vials tested so far contained Monkeypox, with 14 testing positive. The case relates to Congo’s Monkeypox outbreak, a strain different from the US 2022 outbreak. The FBI is investigating; the importation could carry up to five years in prison. The WHO renamed Monkeypox to Mpox in 2022, though the virus remains Monkeypox.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者らがデトロイト・メトロ空港を通じてポックスウイルスの瓶を違法密輸しようとした
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・国際的リスク・渡航制限リスクの3つに該当。高リスク病原体（Mpox）の違法密輸企図、複数国関連、公衆衛生への深刻な潜在リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベントの実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Mpoxアウトブレイク）と米国（密輸企図地点）。Brazzaville（コンゴ共和国首都）が記載されているが、サマリー上はDRCのアウトブレイクに関連する事案。対象国リストにはコンゴ共和国（2260494）がないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。フランス、オランダ、カメルーンは記事で言及されているが、イベント発生地ではなく経由地・研究者出身国であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas confirma mais uma morte por gripe neste ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas confirms another death from flu this year.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil reports another influenza‑associated Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) death. A 69-year-old man with comorbidities died on 12 May 2026; symptom onset occurred in 2026 and he was vaccinated. For 2026, Campinas records 130 SRAG cases and 10 influenza deaths. In 2025, there were 552 cases and 67 deaths, with 53 deaths among the unvaccinated. Of the 14 vaccinated who died in 2025, 12 were adequately immunized (vaccine requires ~15 days for full protection); two had symptom onset before full protection. Sixty‑six deaths involved individuals with preexisting conditions. Vaccination remains the main prevention; on 1 June, eligibility expanded to all residents aged six months and older. Since 28 March, 239,672 doses have been administered, including 142,937 to priority groups (elderly, 6 months–<6 years, pregnant). Coverage: elderly 51.01%, children 35.22%, pregnant 55.32%. Vaccine available at health centers except Centro (Paróquia Divino Salvador). Rodoviária vaccination event on 3 June, 9–16h, open to all six months+. Campaign runs through July.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナスが今年のインフルエンザ関連死をさらに1例確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのインフルエンザ死亡報告ですが、季節性インフルエンザの定期的な死亡事例であり、予防接種キャンペーンが進行中の既知の流行です。IHR基準を満たさず、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められません。
triage.notes: ブラジル（3469034）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列です。記事は季節性インフルエンザの定期的な死亡および予防接種キャンペーン進捗の報告であり、新興感染症シグナルではありません。

article.articleHeadline: Protests in Kenya over Ebola quarantine center turn deadly
article.articleSummary: As of 3 June 2026, at least two people have died in Kenya after protests against a planned US-backed Ebola quarantine center turned violent. The plan to build a quarantine facility for US nationals exposed to Ebola has triggered protests and legal challenges, raising questions about global health cooperation. The Ebola outbreak began with a few clusters in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, then progressed to dozens of cases and now hundreds, including in neighboring Uganda, with dozens of deaths reported. The article questions how well the outbreak can be contained and whether there is hope of finding a vaccine to stop it.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ隔離センターに対する抗議活動が致命的に転じる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の多国間での確認と死亡、社会的混乱により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、ケニアでのエボラ関連活動が言及されている。ケニアはBluedetで検出されたが、記事の主題は抗議活動であり、実際のエボラ症例の発生地はDRCとウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれる）。ケニアは対象国外のため除外。米国の隔離センター計画はグローバルヘルスセキュリティ上の関心事だが、米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Hoe de wereld de grip op ebola kwijtraakte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How the world lost its grip on Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola is back. The containment of this deadly virus depends on timely detection of infections, but that visibility is currently lost in the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The World Health Organization has declared an international emergency, signaling global concern. The piece asks why this outbreak is so difficult to bring under control and whether Western audiences are over- or under-worried about the virus. It underscores the challenges in spotting cases promptly, tracing transmissions, and maintaining situational awareness in the affected regions. By examining surveillance gaps and public response, the article frames Ebola’s resurgence as a test of global readiness to detect, report, and respond to emerging infections.

triage.headline_ja: 世界がエボラ熱への支配を失った方法
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、致死的病原体の再発生、国際的懸念、WHO国際緊急事態宣言）。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行性・管理可能性が該当。DRC内での複数の検出困難性と国際的警戒が確認されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み。サマリーが監視ギャップ、感染検出困難性、状況把握喪失を明示。2026年6月時点でのアウトブレイク進行中と記事が示唆。DRC内での伝播追跡困難性が強調されており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola gagne du terrain et les restrictions de voyage freinent la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is gaining ground and travel restrictions hinder the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in Central Africa, led by the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The DRC declared the outbreak on May 15, and the WHO issued an international health alert. Ituri remains the epicenter; late detection, insecurity, mistrust, and lack of vaccine complicate response. The WHO urges lifting general travel bans, which disrupt supply chains, and recommends exit screening at airports, ports and borders to prevent exportation. In the DRC, 344 lab-confirmed cases and 60 deaths across 24 zones in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Suspected cases fell from over 1,000 to 116 after review. In Uganda, 1 death and 15 confirmed cases; a Congolese traveler to the UAE is among them, and a U.S. patient infected in DRC is treated in Germany. WHO risk: very high nationally, high regionally, low globally.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが勢いを増し、渡航制限が対応を阻害している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラの国際的拡大（ウガンダ、UAE、ドイツで確認）、深刻な公衆衛生影響（344確定例、60死亡）、異常性、渡航・貿易制限によるリスクが認識されている。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ、UAE、ドイツにおける症例報告も記述しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要な発生地域であり、対象国に該当するため含める。WHO国内リスク評価「非常に高い」、地域リスク「高い」と明示されている。供給チェーン断絶による社会経済的影響も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 3 لقاحات قيد التطوير ضد فيروس إيبولا - صوت الأمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 3 vaccines under development against the Ebola virus - Voice of the Nation
article.articleSummary: Three vaccines are under development against Bundibugyo Ebola virus: the first by Oxford University with the Serum Institute of India, the second by Moderna, and the third by NIAID. Oxford/SII and Moderna vaccines could enter clinical trials in two to three months, while the NIAID candidate may take seven to nine months. In the DRC's Ituri and North Kivu, WHO highlighted intensified response, including a new 60-bed treatment center with a pediatric wing and strengthened community engagement to counter misinformation. Contact tracing rose from 20% to about 45%, with a goal of 95%. Security and border disruptions continue to hamper response and supply chains. WHO has allocated $3.9 million from its Emergency Fund for rapid start, but only 35% of the roughly $115 million needed for the first phase has been funded. DRC bears about 12% of global malaria burden; malaria services are available alongside Ebola control.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラウイルスに対する3つのワクチンが開発中 - ナショナルボイス
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）のアウトブレイクがDRC Ituri地域で発生しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ワクチン開発状況や対応の課題（資金不足、セキュリティ懸念）が報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC Ituri地域でのエボラアウトブレイクの対応とワクチン開発進捗について。インドはワクチン製造パートナー（Serum Institute）として言及されているが、発生地ではなく、サマリー上の主題はDRCの流行対応であるため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo型エボラの発生は予想外であり、治療センター建設や接触者追跡強化などの対応進行中。セキュリティ懸念と資金不足が主要な課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: خبيرة بالصحة العالمية: إصابة عدد كبير من العاملين الصحيين بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Health Expert: A Large Number of Healthcare Workers Infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO says the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is seeing expanded response capacity. Across three affected provinces, 106 field staff have been deployed to bolster clinical care and surveillance, as a large share of local healthcare workers have become infected, deepening staff shortages amid security and logistical challenges. The organization is supporting the Ministry of Health by redeploying specialists from other provinces, including 30 clinicians from Kinshasa, to deliver inpatient care. Diagnostic capacity has been increased with 2,000 Ebola tests provided and a mobile laboratory established in Mangwalo. WHO plans to deploy a further 278 staff, though only 38% of this target has been achieved so far. Enhanced protection and health measures for responders are being implemented to ensure continuity of health services.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健の専門家：エボラウイルスに感染した医療従事者が多数
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の流行は定義上のシグナルであり、医療従事者の大量感染により対応能力が著しく低下している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つ病原体であり、医療従事者の感染は対応体制の崩壊を示唆する。複数県での流行拡大、セキュリティ・物流上の課題、スタッフ不足により管理困難性が高い。WHOが応援職員配備を推進中だが、目標の38%しか達成されていない状況は懸念材料。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Patient From Congo Traveled to UAE and Uganda, WHO Says
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient from the Democratic Republic of Congo traveled to the United Arab Emirates and then to Uganda. The Congolese resident is among 15 confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda, according to WHO Director General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus at a briefing on 2026-06-03. The World Health Organization is coordinating with partners as Uganda faces an ongoing Ebola outbreak linked to travel from the DRC and UAE. The report does not provide details on symptoms or laboratory confirmation within the excerpt. The situation underscores the importance of surveillance and cross-border public health measures to limit transmission and prevent further exportation of cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国からのエボラ患者がUAEおよびウガンダへ移動、WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大（DRC→UAE→ウガンダ）が確認され、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。ウガンダでの進行中の流行が報告され、公衆衛生上の重大な影響がある。
triage.notes: 対象国リスト確認: DRC(203312)はリストに含まれる。ウガンダ(226074)は対象国リスト外だが、記事の主題がウガンダにおける進行中の流行であり、DRCからの輸出例として記載されているため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。UAEは対象国外であり除外。エボラの国際的拡大、複数国での確認症例、WHOの公式発表により、フルRRA進行の判定。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns Ebola had 'big head-start' but response 'catching up'
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, with over 100 suspected cases; 15 cases in Uganda with 1 death. The outbreak was declared May 15, centered near Mongbwalu in Ituri province, about 90 km from Bunia where a nurse sought care on April 24. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola strain; there is no vaccine or approved treatment, so containment relies on prevention and early identification with supportive care. WHO warns the outbreak had a big head-start and that the virus is ahead of response, with national risk deemed very high, regional high, and global low. Blanket travel restrictions hinder response; exit screening at borders is advised, but wide bans should be lifted to avoid disrupting supply chains.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱について「大きな先制攻撃があった」と警告し、対応が「追いついている」と述べる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された集団発生（344確認例、60死亡例）が発生しており、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する。国家リスク非常に高いと評価されており、ウイルスが対応を上回る状況が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak in DRC (Ituri Province, centered near Mongbwalu) with 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths as of June 3, 2026. Uganda has 15 cases with 1 death. WHO assessment indicates virus is outpacing response. No vaccine or approved treatment available for this strain. Uganda is also affected but is not in the target country list for verified_locations.
